title: The Hundredth Door of the Underlibrary

nodes.title: The Midnight Desk
nodes.brief: You stand at the grease-stained Returns Desk as brass clocks chime midnight, sorting damp volumes while the night-porter warms his fingers over a smoky tallow lamp.
nodes.page: Brass clocks beneath the city of Quillon chime a heavy, grease-stained midnight while you stand at the Returns Desk sorting damp volumes of forgotten philosophy. The night-porter warms his thin knuckles over a smoky tallow lamp, muttering about the cold draft drifting up from the lower stacks where the catalogues have begun to rewrite themselves. Every ledger smells of old paper, lamp-oil, and dried ink, and under it all sits the quiet dread of the missing Archivist, Thessaly Marr. Among the returned arrears lies a damp, folded parchment bearing her urgent handwriting, warning that the Hundredth Door has swung open of its own accord and whoever reads the original Index will decide the world's memory.

nodes.title: The Returns Hall
nodes.brief: The Returns Hall: Shelvers sort mounds of newly returned texts under flickering tallow lamps while searching for any clue regarding the missing Archivist.
nodes.page: Shelvers crowd the damp stone hall under flickering tallow lamps, sorting towering mounds of newly returned texts while whispers circulate about Thessaly Marr's sudden disappearance into the deep stacks. Shadows stretch across the timber sorting trolleys where low magic lingers in the binding glue and margins occasionally hiss when touched. Every scholar here knows the Long Closing approaches, sealing the library for a generation, and the race for the Index has quietly begun among the rival factions.

nodes.title: Piling the Arrears
nodes.brief: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
nodes.page: Stacks of wet parchment smell sharply of rancid tallow and iron-gall ink as you flip through the damp invoice pile with sharp scholarly observation. Each leaf clings to the next like wet skin, refusing to yield its secrets easily while the ambient murmurs of the hall fade into a hushed stillness. Hidden between two volumes of municipal tax law rests a thin, uncatalogued docket tied with coarse twine, pulsing with a faint, low-magic warmth.

nodes.title: The Uncatalogued Docket
nodes.brief: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
nodes.page: Cold damp rises from the stone flags as you isolate the strange docket from the rest of the wet papers, feeling the paper grain shift unnaturally beneath your fingertips. A faint scratching noise, like an insect trapped inside a dry binding, emanates from the creases where the ink has turned an unusual shade of violet. Careful attention reveals tiny, venomous barbs hidden along the margin edge, waiting to punish clumsy fingers that rush the work.

exits.label: Prepare to lift the folded flap

nodes.title: The Poisoned Margin
nodes.brief: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
nodes.page: Holding your breath against the rising smell of bitter almond and old dust, you angle the tallow lamp closer to illuminate the dangerous fold in the parchment. Your thumb hovers millimetres from a jagged paper edge that gleams with a greenish, venomous film left by a disgruntled reader. Concentration strains your mind as you gauge the exact angle required to slip a bone paper-knife beneath the seal without triggering the trap.

nodes.title: A Stinging Oversight
nodes.brief: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
nodes.page: Sharp pain bites into your thumb as the poisoned page slips, and a thin burning scratch darkens the skin at once to the color of stale ink. You suck at the wound in the smoky air and curse the lapse. Venom dulls your senses. You still work the fold until it gives way under pressure, and you keep the page while the lesson in library caution stays with the scratch.

nodes.title: Clean Extraction
nodes.brief: You inspect the damp invoice pile using sharp scholarly observation, risking a paper cut from a poisoned page to unearth the secret docket.
nodes.page: Precision wins the day as the bone knife slides cleanly through the stubborn gummed fold, releasing the secret docket without a single drop of blood drawn. The paper unfolds to reveal a neat, handwritten schedule of restricted stack rotations signed in Thessaly Marr's familiar, hurried hand. You pocket the prize with a quiet sense of triumph, securing an invaluable key to the lower corridors before anyone else notices.

exits.label: Return to the main sorting hall

nodes.title: Smudged Marginalia
nodes.brief: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
nodes.page: Faded ink sprawls across the lower margins of an ancient ledger detailing municipal water rights, overwritten so many times the words crawl across the page like drowsy spiders. Careful academic focus helps you separate the original scribe's hand from the angry scrawls added later by a disgruntled borrower who clearly knew too much about the deep stacks. Hidden within the cramped commentary lies a reference to a misplaced corridor key.

nodes.title: The Ciphered Margin
nodes.brief: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
nodes.page: Lamp-oil flickers as you lean closer to the binding, letting your eyes follow the erratic loops of ink that point toward a forgotten alcove near the binding room. The marginal notes begin to whisper faint, disjointed phrases about shifting shelves and locked doors, warning of traps laid by the rule-bound Cataloguers. Every movement must be calculated precisely to avoid activating the dormant ink-stain hex woven into the parchment.

exits.label: Reach for the hidden key slot

nodes.title: The Ink-Stain Hex
nodes.brief: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
nodes.page: Dark vapors begin to rise from the written words, swirling into a miniature cloud of reactive iron-gall that threatens to stain your skin permanently and blind your eyes with acidic smoke. Your mind races through arcane classifications and grammatical counter-spells, searching for the exact mental anchor needed to neutralize the hex before it triggers. One false thought will unleash a torrent of cursed ink across the entire desk.

nodes.title: The Cost of Curiosity
nodes.brief: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
nodes.page: Purple vapors burst outward with a sharp hiss, staining your fingers and knuckles a deep, indelible violet that no pumice stone will wash away for weeks. The hex drains your concentration and leaves a dull ache behind your eyes, but the defensive ward collapses before it can do any worse damage. You shake out your stinging hands and retrieve the prize from the settling soot.

nodes.title: Untouched by the Bind
nodes.brief: You decipher the smudged marginalia on the ledger's edge through careful academic focus, risking an ink-stain hex to discover a hidden corridor key.
nodes.page: Words settle back into harmless silence as your focused willpower shatters the activation rune before the curse can take full hold of the page. Resting in the crease of the old ledger is a small, heavy brass key shaped like a quill nib, cool to the touch and smelling faintly of library dust. You slip it into your waistcoat pocket, gaining a quiet advantage for the corridors ahead.

exits.label: Step back to the central hall

nodes.title: Decoding the Night-Porter
nodes.brief: You translate the night-porter's cryptic mumbling by studying past roster sheets, risking a bout of exhaustion to secure his old brass sorting stamp.
nodes.page:
Lamp-oil pools in amber circles upon the scarred oak of the Returns Desk while the night-porter mutters his endless cataloguing nonsense into his mutton-chop whiskers. Behind him, stacked columns of past fortnightly roster sheets threaten to avalanche into the ink-wells. You sift through the yellowed records, matching his slurred mutterings of misplaced folios to old duty rotations, your temples throbbing with the strain of deciphering the cramped handwriting.

The goal sits among the clutter: one last push through columns of names and shift numbers to claim the brass sorting stamp before he wakes fully.

nodes.title: The Roster Cipher
nodes.brief: You translate the night-porter's cryptic mumbling by studying past roster sheets, risking a bout of exhaustion to secure his old brass sorting stamp.
nodes.page: Stacks of brittle paper tower around you like limestone pillars in a cavern, their margins swimming before your tired eyes as you hunt for the hidden pattern in the porter's rotational schedule. A wrong deduction means hours of fruitless searching while the lamp oil sputters low, yet every instinct urges you to press deeper into the dense ink before your mind blurs entirely. Your fingers hover over the last page and trace the faded ink lines where the old man hid the true whereabouts of his sorting stamp.

nodes.title: Ink-Stained Fatigue
nodes.brief: You translate the night-porter's cryptic mumbling by studying past roster sheets, risking a bout of exhaustion to secure his old brass sorting stamp.
nodes.page: Tired eyes misread a column under sleep deprivation and take a midnight shift for a midday delivery. The ledger slips from your numb fingers and scatters loose paper across the stone floor with a sharp clatter that startles the sleeping porter into an irritable snort. You rub your aching temples. Your mind is foggy and battered by hours of fruitless ciphering, and a headache sits behind your eyes with precious time wasted. The porter drifts back into snoring slumber without investigating further. The pathway forward is clear.

nodes.title: The Old Brass Stamp
nodes.brief: You translate the night-porter's cryptic mumbling by studying past roster sheets, risking a bout of exhaustion to secure his old brass sorting stamp.
nodes.page: The duty rosters suddenly align into a clear sequence of numbers and names. You slide your hand behind the tumbling stack of folios and grasp the cold, heavy metal of the night-porter's brass sorting stamp, its worn wooden handle fitting snugly into your palm. Whether through sharp deduction or sheer stubborn luck, the prize is yours to keep for the long shifts ahead in the dim stone vaults.

nodes.title: Thessaly Marr's Warning
nodes.brief: A damp, folded parchment left upon your sorting trolley reveals Thessaly Marr's urgent handwriting warning that the Hundredth Door has swung open.
nodes.page:
Resting upon your wooden sorting trolley lies a damp, heavily folded square of parchment bearing the familiar, hurried script of Thessaly Marr, the missing Archivist. The ink is still slightly tacky, smelling faintly of bitter almonds and ancient calfskin, marking it as a dispatch written mere moments before her disappearance. You unfold the brittle sheet beneath the flickering circle of your desk lamp, reading the trembling words that confirm every whispered rumor in the damp corridors.

The Hundredth Door, the sealed vault holding the original Index, has swung open of its own accord into the dark heart of the stacks. The note warns that whoever reads those pages will dictate what the world remembers and what it consigns to oblivion, and the deep stacks are already beginning their slow, inevitable seal for the Long Closing.

exits.label: Push your trolley into the stacks

nodes.title: The Sorting Annex
nodes.brief: The Sorting Annex: Overcrowded book-trolleys rattle past towering rows of moving pine shelves while rival junior pages whisper of the opening vault.
nodes.page: Towering pine bookshelves rumble across iron tracks along the floor, shifting their positions with deep, resonant groans that echo through the stone vaults. All around your station, rival junior pages whisper in hushed, anxious huddles about the open vault and the impending Long Closing. Trolleys piled high with unruly octavos block the narrow avenues, their wheels squeaking against the uneven flags. Lamp-oil smoke hangs thick and blue in the damp air, carrying the scents of dust and old paper as every route out beckons with its own distinct peril and promise.

exits.label: Step through the squeaking wicker gate

nodes.title: Aisle Mathematics
nodes.brief: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
nodes.page:
Columns of heavy shelving groan as they slide silently across the brass floor-tracks, obeying an ancient, unseen geometry that defies simple memory. You track the rhythmic clicking of the overhead mechanical index to anticipate where the massive pine barricades will converge next, guarding against a bone-crushing collision in the narrow gap. The air grows cold and smells of dry dust as you trace the shifting Dewey decimal markers along the wood-grain panels.

A small leather pouch hangs forgotten from a protruding iron bracket on a passing shelf, dangling just within reach before the aisle closes shut entirely.

nodes.title: The Narrowing Gap
nodes.brief: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
nodes.page:
The gap between the towering pine bookcases narrows with a dull, rhythmic grinding sound, squeezing the amber lamplight into a thin, horizontal slit against the opposite wall. You brace your shoulder against the warm, varnish-scented timber, measuring the speed of the moving stack against your own stride. Every second counts as the massive wooden walls threaten to seal off the transverse corridor completely, plunging the entire bay into absolute shadow.

You time your movement carefully with the shifting machinery, preparing to make a decisive lunge toward the safety of the open crossing before the heavy frames lock together.

nodes.title: The Shifting Stack
nodes.brief: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
nodes.page: The massive pine shelving unit drifts sideways with relentless momentum, its heavy iron wheels rumbling against the stone flags as it closes the gap toward the adjacent stack. You study the complex decimal patterns etched into the floor rails, calculating the exact moment the mechanical tracks will cross and create a momentary pocket of safety. A misstep risks being pinned between thousands of leather-bound volumes, yet the dry leather pouch remains tantalizingly suspended on the moving frame before you.

nodes.title: Crushed Ambition
nodes.brief: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
nodes.page: The pine bookcase slams shut against the adjoining stack a fraction of a second too soon, catches your sleeve, and pins you briefly in the tightening squeeze. You wrench your arm free with a sharp yank, leaving a torn cuff of fabric and a bruised shoulder behind as the metal tracks grind to a halt. The near-miss leaves your heart hammering against your ribs and your breath catching in your throat in the dusty, oil-scented air. Though battered and shaken by the crushing weight of the archive, you manage to slip away into the adjacent corridor with your life intact.

nodes.title: The Leather Pouch
nodes.brief: You study the complex Dewey decimal shift patterns to predict the next aisle collision, risking a crushing bookshelf to find a dry leather pouch.
nodes.page: You get your fingers through the gap just as the massive shelves lock home with a hard thud, and you snatch the dry leather pouch from its iron bracket. The container is stiff with age. Its drawstring holds a knot that smells faintly of dried lavender and tallow. The prize sits in your grasp now, safe past the closing mechanism.

nodes.title: The Counterfeit Ledger
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page:
Ink-stained ledgers loom across the high wooden barrier of the reading rooms, where the lending clerk squints through spectacles greased with tallow. You lean against the counter, tapping a fingernail beside an imaginary deficit in the ledger of unreturned folios to draw his gaze away from your twitching sleeve.

Whispering an elaborate falsehood regarding missing fines from the upper parish, you prepare to slip a coil of rough linen twine from the sunken shelf into your pocket while his attention wanders down the aisle.

exits.label: Slide the twine into your coat

nodes.title: The Clerk's Diversion
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page:
Lamp-oil fumes fill the galleried hall as the lending clerk grumbles under his breath, turning another brittle leaf in search of nonexistent fines. You keep an earnest posture and drop your voice so it barely carries over the dry rustle of parchment from nearby scholars.

The spool of linen twine rests just within reach behind a stack of overdue poetry, waiting for the exact moment the clerk looks toward the ink-sellers' archway.

nodes.title: A Question of Balances
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page: Fabricating a ledger discrepancy for the lending clerk requires a steady tongue and an absolute absence of hesitation, but the man's watery eyes narrow with sudden suspicion as you reel off your manufactured account of missing parish fines. You lean further across the dark grain of the counter, gesturing casually toward the shadowed floorboards while your fingers graze the heavy coil of linen twine tucked behind the shelf of poetry. A sharp reprimand hangs in his throat, and you must maintain the illusion before he calls for the guard.

nodes.title: Reprimand and Scraps
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page:
The lending clerk catches your movement with a sharp snap of his ledger, slamming the heavy leather cover down and fixing you with a glare of pure vitriol. A formal demerit is scratched into the blue returns slip with a dry scratch of steel, docking your evening ration of lamp-oil and earning you a stern lecture on the sanctity of inventory.

You escape his counter with stinging fingers and a bruised pride, though the clerk in his irritation leaves a loose tangle of rough linen twine behind on the wood.

nodes.title: The Unnoticed Spool
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page:
Whether through sheer audacity or the clerk's distracted weariness, your fabricated tale of missing fines holds together long enough for your fingers to close around the prize. The spool of rough grey material comes away without a sound, sliding smoothly into the dark folds of your coat while the old man continues muttering about parish ledgers.

You leave the counter behind with a steady pace, carrying your newfound asset into the dim corridors of the stacks.

nodes.title: Flattery Among the Rules
nodes.brief: You flatter the grumpy cataloguer into turning a blind eye to your wandering, risking a formal demerit to gain a pinch of protective alum powder.
nodes.page:
Rows of towering card-drawers rattle softly as the grumpy cataloguer stamps a stack of requisition forms with aggressive enthusiasm. You step into his line of sight, offering a carefully measured compliment regarding his unmatched precision in filing regional cartography, hoping to soften the rigid line of his jaw.

He pauses, his ink-stained thumb hovering over the red stamp while his gaze shifts sideways toward the shelves, giving you an opening to edge closer to the jar of protective alum powder sitting on his desk.

nodes.title: The Grumpy Cataloguer
nodes.brief: You flatter the grumpy cataloguer into turning a blind eye to your wandering, risking a formal demerit to gain a pinch of protective alum powder.
nodes.page: Cataloguing rules are carved into the very mortar of the archway, yet the elderly keeper before you looks particularly susceptible to a well-timed dose of unearned praise about his filing accuracy. You lean against the edge of his high oak desk, spinning a tale of his legendary patience while your fingers drift slowly toward the small stoneware jar of protective alum powder used to seal damp bindings. He stops stamping, his bushy eyebrows twitching as he weighs your flattery against the strict prohibition of civilian handling of chemical supplies.

nodes.title: Sullied Courtesy
nodes.brief: You flatter the grumpy cataloguer into turning a blind eye to your wandering, risking a formal demerit to gain a pinch of protective alum powder.
nodes.page:
The cataloguer sees right through your clumsy praise and slams his brass stamp onto the blotter; a hollow thud answers off the stone flags. He issues a sharp demerit that stains your ledger record with a permanent red mark of censure, costing you precious time and forcing you to listen to a lengthy discourse on proper desk decorum.

You withdraw your hand empty and chastised, though in his flurry of bureaucratic anger he knocks a small pinch of white alum powder onto your cuff.

nodes.title: Alum and Approbation
nodes.brief: You flatter the grumpy cataloguer into turning a blind eye to your wandering, risking a formal demerit to gain a pinch of protective alum powder.
nodes.page:
Your honeyed words land precisely where intended, melting the cataloguer's sour demeanor into a brief, grudging nod of professional fellowship. While he turns away to retrieve a fresh stack of index cards, your fingers dip into the open stoneware jar and lift a fine pinch of the protective alum powder.

You secure the mineral safely in a folded scrap of waste paper, walking away from the desk with a quiet sense of triumph before he changes his mind.

nodes.title: Weight and Stone
nodes.brief: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
nodes.page:
Dusty blue folios lie open across the reading table, their yellowed pages detailing the exact stone-load limits of the lower limestone vaults before the great subsidence. You trace the faded diagrams with a fingertip, calculating the precise tonnage a single pine shelving unit can bear before the flagstones beneath begin to fracture and sink into the dark.

Tucked between two heavy leaves concerning masonry stresses rests a slender ivory bone-handled bookmark, cool to the touch and scored with tiny tally marks left by an unknown hand.

nodes.title: The Blue Folios
nodes.brief: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
nodes.page:
The air in the deep alcove tastes of old linen and chalk dust as you turn the heavy pages of the engineering folios, searching for the calculations that govern the shifting stacks. Each diagram is rendered in fading violet ink, mapping the subterranean pressure points where the foundations meet the living rock of the city below.

Resting deep within the crease of a particularly fragile leaf, an ivory bone-handled bookmark gleams faintly in the dim glow of your rush-light, untouched by the general decay of the lower stacks.

nodes.title: Calculating the Abyss
nodes.brief: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
nodes.page: The ancient floor-weight equations scrawled across the dusty blue folios require absolute precision, for a single miscalculation in the load distribution of the moving stacks could bring down an entire tier of shelving into the ink-rivers below. You trace the intricate geometric proofs by the feeble light of your lamp, your mind racing through load-bearing limits and stone-density ratios while the floorboards beneath your boots emit a faint, ominous groan. Reaching deep into the gutter of the binding where the rarest diagrams reside, you try to extract the ivory bone-handled bookmark without disturbing the precarious stack of heavy volumes leaning against your elbow.

nodes.title: Tremors in the Stack
nodes.brief: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
nodes.page:
The floor-weight calculations prove treacherous. As your fingers close around the bookmark, the towering stack of blue folios shifts with a sudden slide that turns the stomach. A cascade of leather-bound volumes crashes onto the flagstones, kicks up a blinding cloud of ancient dust, and pins your sleeve beneath a jagged corner of masonry.

You wrench your arm free with a sharp yank. A torn scrap of fabric stays behind. Your grasp still secures the slender ivory marker as the shelving settles back into place.

nodes.title: The Bone Bookmark
nodes.brief: You research the ancient floor-weight equations in the dusty blue folios, risking a collapsed stack to retrieve an ivory bone-handled bookmark.
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the beam of your lantern as your fingers trace the heavy blue folios, calculating the dangerous load distributions of the shifting stacks. With immense care, you slide an ivory bone-handled bookmark free from the collapsing seam of the binding before the entire tier groans and settles back into place. Your breathing slows in the dim silence as you pocket the smooth relic, knowing how easily the floor could have given way beneath your boots.

exits.label: Step cautiously into the shifting stack-ways

nodes.title: Into the Moving Stacks
nodes.brief: You step past the squeaking wicker gate into the shifting labyrinth of the stack-ways, holding your flickering lamp high as the Long Closing countdown begins.
nodes.page: Squeaking wicker gives way beneath your weight as you step past the threshold into the great labyrinth of the stack-ways, holding your flickering lamp high above your head. All around you, towering shelves groan and slide across recessed floor-tracks, rearranging themselves according to an invisible and restless logic. Far above in the vaulted darkness, the great clock of the Long Closing tolls its muffled warning, reminding you that time is slipping away faster than the whispered notes in the margins. The air tastes of hot lamp-oil and scorched paper as you forge deeper into the maze.

exits.label: Advance toward the iron reading doors

nodes.title: The Linen Twine
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page: The lending clerk narrows rheumy eyes behind spectacles thick as bottle-glass, muttering about misplaced ledgers and overdue fines from the lower tiers. You lean across the mahogany counter, spinning a plausible web about misplaced administrative rolls in the eastern wing to distract his wandering attention. While his hand hesitates over the ink-pot, your fingers dart sideways to snatch a sturdy bundle of linen twine resting near the stamp-pad. Pocketing the prize with a smooth motion, you offer a polite nod and turn away before suspicion hardens into a public reprimand.

nodes.title: Borrowed Twine and Trouble
nodes.brief: You trick the suspicious lending clerk with a clever falsehood about missing fines, risking a public reprimand to pocket a bundle of linen twine.
nodes.page: Suspicions linger in the wrinkled face of the lending clerk, who continues to peer suspiciously over the rim of his spectacles at your ink-stained cuffs. You maintain an air of absolute calm, spinning another elaborate falsehood concerning missing library fines to keep his attention firmly fixed on the ledger. As he turns to leaf through a stack of yellowed slips, your hand closes securely around the coil of rough linen twine resting near the brass paper-weights. Slipping it into your coat pocket, you offer a crisp, formal bow and make your escape into the dim corridors before he can demand verification.

nodes.title: Haze of Lamp-Oil
nodes.brief: You step through the heavy iron doors of the Reading Rooms into a haze of lamp-oil smoke and rustling parchment.
nodes.page: Heavy iron doors swing inward with a sluggish, protesting groan, releasing a dense wave of lamp-oil smoke and the dry, rustling chatter of a hundred turning pages. You step into the grand Reading Rooms, where galleried tiers rise into the shadowy vaulting and scholars hunch over lecterns like brooding crows. Dust motes dance in the amber glow of brass lamps suspended from iron chains, casting long and erratic shadows across the stone floor. Every scholar here is searching for a clue to the missing Archivist, and the air hums with a quiet, desperate rivalry.

nodes.title: The Lending Desk
nodes.brief: The Lending Desk: A weary clerk demands a permit you do not possess while scholars jostle behind you.
nodes.page: A towering barricade of returned ledgers surrounds the central lending desk, where a weary clerk demands a formal visitor permit you do not possess. Behind you, an impatient queue of rival scholars jostles and mutters, their arms laden with damp, whispering manuscripts that snap and rustle like trapped birds. The clerk taps an ink-stained finger against the counter, waiting for credentials you have not been issued while the clock in the tower counts down the minutes. Every available path outward presents its own immediate hazard, demanding either quick footwork, absolute stubbornness, or diplomatic endurance.

nodes.title: Quick Footwork
nodes.brief: You slip past the distracted clerk using agile footwork, risking a reprimand to gain a forged clearance slip.
nodes.page: When the harried clerk turns toward an argumentative scholar, you drop low and dart past the corner of the wooden barrier. Your boots make scarcely a sound against the flagstones as you weave through the narrow gap between stacked trolleys and towering dictionary stands. A sharp reprimand echoes behind you, but you keep moving, your hand brushing against a loose pile of paper slips that nearly spills across the floor. You duck behind a pillar, breathless and clutching a forged clearance slip acquired through sheer agility.

nodes.title: The Narrow Gap
nodes.brief: You slip past the distracted clerk using agile footwork, risking a reprimand to gain a forged clearance slip.
nodes.page: A second obstruction looms ahead where two moving shelving units have jammed together, leaving only a razor-thin passage of shadow and dust. You squeeze sideways through the gap, feeling the rough pine wood scrape against your coat while the distant scratching of pens fills the background. The forged clearance slip stays clutched tightly in your fist, its wet ink smelling strongly of vinegar and crushed galls. Shadows lengthen across the flagstones as the automated stack-ways resume their slow, grinding crawl toward the center of the hall.

exits.label: Approach the threshold of the risk

nodes.title: Reaching the Clearance Slip
nodes.brief: You slip past the distracted clerk using agile footwork, risking a reprimand to gain a forged clearance slip.
nodes.page: The final obstacle stands before you: a narrow ledge slick with spilled ink, bridging a gap between two shifting tiers of shelving where a misstep means tumbling into the dark. You measure the distance with a practiced eye as the ledge begins to slide sideways in response to the subterranean tremors. You crouch low, preparing to launch yourself across the widening chasm of air and shadow just as the lamp overhead flickers out.

nodes.title: A Costly Slip
nodes.brief: You slip past the distracted clerk using agile footwork, risking a reprimand to gain a forged clearance slip.
nodes.page: Your boot-heel catches the edge of the slick stone, sending a cascade of loose ink-vials clattering down into the dark machinery below. You tumble hard against the rough wooden backing of a moving shelf, scraping your shoulder and tearing the sleeve of your coat on a protruding iron bracket. The forged clearance slip flutters from your grasp, swallowed instantly by the shifting gloom between the stacks. Bruised and empty-handed, you pick yourself up from the dusty floor as the machinery grinds to a halt.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press on

nodes.title: Narrowly Cleared
nodes.brief: You slip past the distracted clerk using agile footwork, risking a reprimand to gain a forged clearance slip.
nodes.page: Your fingers catch the rough edge of the wooden shelf as the ground shifts under your boots and throws you sideways for one terrifying heartbeat. Footing returns. You pant against the cool stone of the inner wall with a small damp scrap of paper in your fist, bearing the official wax seal of the upper tiers - a fragile passport into the restricted zones.

nodes.title: The Trembling Shelves
nodes.brief: You dodge a falling stack of overdue folios with quick steps, earning a grateful nod from a fellow shelver.
nodes.page: Mahogany timbers groan above your head as an entire bay of historical geographies shudders on its iron tracks. You hurl yourself sideways. A towering avalanche of overdue folios crashes down into the ink-slicked trench where you stood a heartbeat before. Dust and yellowed confetti rise in a choking cloud that smells of rancid lamp-oil and centuries of dead bindings. You stand and brush calf-skin flakes from your sleeves, and you catch the eye of a veteran shelver hauling a trolley past the wreckage. She offers a tight respectful nod of solidarity, then vanishes back into the gloom of the Reading Rooms.

exits.label: Step carefully past the fallen timber

nodes.title: A Path Through Dust
nodes.brief: You dodge a falling stack of overdue folios with quick steps, earning a grateful nod from a fellow shelver.
nodes.page: Deeper in, the galleried arches throw erratic currents of air that carry fluttering margin-notes like agitated moths. You dodge them. Your shoulder finds a cold stone pillar while a pair of argumentative scholars hurry by with their arms full of biting lexicons. Iron-gall ink and damp wool scent the route as you trace the perimeter of the grand reading hall toward the upper tiers. The floorboards twitch under your soles as if the whole place were a sleeping beast. Cold stone grit sticks to your palm.

exits.label: Approach the narrow iron staircase ahead

nodes.title: Leap the Swaying Gap
nodes.brief: You dodge a falling stack of overdue folios with quick steps, earning a grateful nod from a fellow shelver.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the floorboards sends the iron gangway swinging away from the gallery wall, leaving a wide, black chasm above the bottomless ink-vats. You crouch low on the trembling planks, measuring the distance to the opposite ledge while loose vellum scrolls slide off the edge into the abyss. There is no time to wait for the machinery to cycle back, and the gap widens with every rhythmic groan of the masonry. You gather your muscles, fixing your gaze entirely on the rough timber opposite, and launch yourself across the yawning dark.

nodes.title: Bruised Shins and Ink
nodes.brief: You dodge a falling stack of overdue folios with quick steps, earning a grateful nod from a fellow shelver.
nodes.page: Momentum deserts you mid-air as the landing shifts, causing your chest to slam hard against the splintered oak edge of the far platform. You scramble desperately with scraped fingers, hauling yourself upward while your dangling boots drag through a cold puddle of spilled manuscript ink. The cost of your clumsy clearance is immediate and stinging: a deep purple bruise along your ribs and the loss of your brass pocket-trowel, which now rests far below among the forgotten refuse. Shaking out your aching arms, you pull yourself onto solid boards and press onward into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Firm Grasp
nodes.brief: You dodge a falling stack of overdue folios with quick steps, earning a grateful nod from a fellow shelver.
nodes.page: Your fingers bite into the rough timber of the gallery rail just as the swinging walkway stabilises with a metallic clatter. You haul yourself over the barrier and land with a muted thud among scattered quires of commentary. Your palm closes on a brass key some careless clerk dropped, its wards cold and patterned with strange, looping sigils. This small token might just unlock doors that remain stubbornly barred to ordinary shelvers.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Clerk
nodes.brief: You stare down the suspicious clerk with steely determination, securing an official visitor badge through sheer stubbornness.
nodes.page: Behind the high mahogany counter of the lending office, the senior clerk narrows his eyes behind tinted spectacles and taps a long, ink-stained finger against the ledger. You meet his suspicious glare without flinching, standing completely still as the ambient murmurs of the Reading Rooms swirl around your shoulders. Stubborn persistence forms your only shield against his endless array of petty regulations and fabricated administrative fines. Slowly, grudgingly, the clerk stops his scratching quill and reaches into a brass drawer to retrieve a stamped tin badge of authority.

exits.label: Accept the visitor badge and move

nodes.title: The Heavy Ledger
nodes.brief: You stare down the suspicious clerk with steely determination, securing an official visitor badge through sheer stubbornness.
nodes.page: Vellum registers bound in green calfskin rise in towering columns across every available square inch of the counter. You slide your newly acquired badge onto your lapel, listening to the monotonous scratching of dozens of quill pens wielded by unseen scribes in the alcoves. Vinegar and gall hit your nose as a nearby scholar drops a fat commentary that begins to whisper insults in an ancient dialect. Ignoring the petulant book, you focus entirely on finding the trail left by Thessaly Marr before the cataloguers notice her absence.

exits.label: Follow the corridor of whispering folios

nodes.title: The Interrogation of Rules
nodes.brief: You stare down the suspicious clerk with steely determination, securing an official visitor badge through sheer stubbornness.
nodes.page: The head archivist blocks the arched exit with a stack of overdue notices, demanding an immediate accounting of your presence in the restricted sector. You must hold your ground against a barrage of bureaucratic threats designed to strip away your resolve and send you back to the basement returns. Every nerve frays under the weight of her inquisitorial gaze as she challenges your right to walk these ink-stained aisles. You gather your mental fortitude, refusing to look away or offer a single apologetic word.

nodes.title: A Costly Concession
nodes.brief: You stare down the suspicious clerk with steely determination, securing an official visitor badge through sheer stubbornness.
nodes.page: Your composure cracks under the relentless barrage of administrative citations, forcing you to nod submissively to avoid outright expulsion from the galleries. The victory is entirely hers, and the price of your momentary hesitation is a towering stack of delinquent catalogues dumped unceremoniously into your arms. Staggering under the unexpected weight, you accept a burdensome clerical debt that will tie you to menial sorting duties for weeks. Still, you retain your access, and you carry the crushing stack deeper into the labyrinth.

nodes.title: Unyielding Resolve
nodes.brief: You stare down the suspicious clerk with steely determination, securing an official visitor badge through sheer stubbornness.
nodes.page: Your unblinking stare holds until the archivist lets out a sharp sigh of exasperation and steps aside. She presses a folded slip of parchment into your hand - an emergency transit permit signed with her own cramped, venomous handwriting. It is a grudging concession, but it grants you absolute freedom to traverse the crowded galleries without further interference from her junior inspectors.

nodes.title: The Signed Parchment
nodes.brief: You endure the endless bureaucratic interrogation without flinching, walking away with a signed authorization letter from the head librarian.
nodes.page:
Ink-stained fingers press the heavy brass seal against the damp red wax, confirming the dry scratch of authority upon your clearance slip. The head librarian's ledger closes with a dull thud that echoes off the vaulted stone ceiling, releasing a fine cloud of ancient dust into the lamp-lit air. You retrieve the official authorization letter, tucking the crisp parchment securely within your canvas satchel alongside your spare nibs and charcoal sticks.

Stepping away from the high mahogany counter, you leave behind the sharp scent of vinegar-based ink and head deeper into the labyrinthine galleries where the murmurs of restless scholars drift like rising smoke.

exits.label: Slip past the heavy oak doors

nodes.title: Withstanding the Scrutiny
nodes.brief: You endure the endless bureaucratic interrogation without flinching, walking away with a signed authorization letter from the head librarian.
nodes.page:
Cataloguers around you stare without blinking while the senior archivist leans across the high desk and demands an immediate explanation for your presence in the restricted stacks. You tighten your grip on the edge of the mahogany counter, refusing to let your gaze waver under the cold, assessing glare that promises immediate expulsion for the slightest sign of hesitation. The air grows thick with the metallic tang of lamp-oil and rising tension as you channel every ounce of stubborn endurance into keeping your breathing steady and your posture unyielding.

Your jaw sets against the rising panic while you gather yourself for the inevitable test of authority.

check.label: Maintain an unblinking composure before the archivist

nodes.title: The Cost of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You endure the endless bureaucratic interrogation without flinching, walking away with a signed authorization letter from the head librarian.
nodes.page:
A sudden tremor in your stance betrays your inner strain, drawing a sharp, triumphant smirk from the senior archivist across the desk. Your momentary slip costs you dearly as she seizes upon your weakness, stripping away three precious hours of your shift in administrative detention and confiscating your favorite steel pen nib. You emerge from the ordeal with a throbbing headache and an empty satchel, your patience wearing as thin as the worm-eaten pages stacked upon the nearby sorting tables.

Trudging away into the dim corridors, you nurse your grievances and count the lost hours against the relentless ticking of the deep-stack clocks.

exits.label: Return to the shadowed sorting aisles

nodes.title: The Authorised Passage
nodes.brief: You endure the endless bureaucratic interrogation without flinching, walking away with a signed authorization letter from the head librarian.
nodes.page:
The head archivist lets out a sharp, parchment-dry sigh of exasperation and steps aside. The flagged corridor opens. Between her ink-stained fingers a brass stamp comes down with a final thud onto a fresh slip of vellum. The crisp sheet lands in your palm still warm from the iron press. It bears the jagged purple seal of the central stacks and a hurried signature in violet gall-ink, certifying your right to pass unhindered through the galleried arches. You slide the paper under your woollen tunic as distant scholars take up their murmur again.

That slip clears the way past the marble pillars toward the bustling hub where the day's transactions are sorted.

nodes.title: Whispers in the Gallery
nodes.brief: You navigate the crowded gallery where rival scholars glare over lecterns laden with damp, whispering manuscripts.
nodes.page:
Elevated walkways creak beneath the hurried footsteps of rival scholars who lean across iron-railed balconies to hiss competing theories about Thessaly Marr and the sudden awakening of the Hundredth Door. Below your boots, damp manuscripts lie heaped upon central reading tables like fallen leaves, their margins whispering faint, disjointed phrases whenever a draft sweeps through the galleried hall. Every archivist and page seems to be watching you from behind towering stacks of overdue ledgers, their eyes sharp with suspicion and greed for the lost Index.

You keep your head down and your fingers brushing against the cold stone wall, navigating the narrow gap between a group of arguing scribes and a towering pillar covered in pasted-over notices. The air tastes of old paper and copper, the taste of a library preparing to seal its vaults for a generation.

You push past a velvet drape and enter a quieter alcove where the shadows stretch long and thin across the mosaic floor.

exits.label: Step into the quiet scholar alcove

nodes.title: The Scholar's Alcove
nodes.brief: The Scholar's Alcove: A proud historian blocks your path, demanding payment for information regarding Thessaly's final research.
nodes.page:
Piled high with grease-stained folios and flickering tallow lamps, the cramped alcove smells intensely of rancid mutton fat and oxidized gall-ink. A notoriously proud historian blocks the narrow archway with an imposing stack of forbidden codices, demanding an extortionate fee in copper or secrets before he will share what he overheard regarding Thessaly's final research. The surrounding shelves lean inward as if straining to eavesdrop on the confrontation, their leather spines clicking softly in the gloom.

You weigh your options carefully while the historian taps a long, ink-stained fingernail impatiently against the edge of his reading desk, waiting to see how you will pierce his defenses.

exits.label: Offer a brilliant translation for passage
Flatter the pompous scholar with clever deception

nodes.title: The Obscure Ledger
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Open before you upon the scarred writing desk lies a massive, calfskin-bound ledger written in the notoriously convoluted dialect of the early cataloguers. You trace the cramped, sloping cursive with the tip of a dry quill, piecing together the archaic vocabulary of cross-references and misfiled entries that points directly toward the lower stacks. The historian watches your progress with a mixture of professional jealousy and grudging respect, his fingers twitching toward the margins where the vital map fragment is tucked.

Securing the torn scrap of parchment, you commit the surrounding annotations to memory before turning away from the cluttered desk.

exits.label: Follow the map into the stacks

nodes.title: The Translated Page
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Sunlight filtering through the high clerestory windows catches the motes of dust dancing above the open ledger as you deftly untangle the dense web of obsolete grammatical structures. The historian lets out a sharp whistle of astonishment, sliding the requested map fragment across the wooden surface with a resigned nod of acknowledgment. You slip the brittle scrap into your pocket, feeling the jagged edges of the paper confirm your success before the ink has even fully dried on your translation sheets.

Walking away from the alcove, you leave the defeated scholar muttering bitterly over his abandoned dictionaries.

exits.label: Journey deeper into the misfiled wing

nodes.title: Decoding the Marginalia
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Faded ink scrawled in the margins of the open ledger begins to twist and writhe under your gaze, forming complex linguistic traps designed to confuse uninitiated readers. You lean closer to the parchment, squinting through the dim lamp-light while trying to separate the genuine historical citations from the mischievous whispers of the marginalia ghosts. The symbols shift shape every time you blink, demanding absolute concentration to prevent the true meaning from dissolving into meaningless scribbles before your eyes.

Your temples throb with the strain of deciphering the archaic script while the deadline for your answer draws perilously near.

nodes.title: The Tangled Translation
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Your eyes blur under the relentless assault of the shifting marginalia, causing you to misread a critical cataloguing code and write down a disastrously flawed translation. The historian sneers, snatching the ruined paper from your hands and demanding an exorbitant penalty fee in rare ink-sticks for your carelessness. You spend the next hour paying off the debt by sorting a towering pile of biting manuscripts, emerging from the task with ink-stained fingers and a bruised ego.

Shaking off the lingering frustration, you gather your remaining belongings and prepare to move onward through the galleries.

nodes.title: The Ledger Secret
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Your finger traces the crabbed, archaic script along the margin of the open ledger until the difficult grammar unlocks under your persistent gaze. The rival scholar scowls, muttering an oath about upstart pages, but concedes the translation is remarkably accurate before sliding a scrap of yellowed vellum across the scarred oak table. That torn piece of map shows a dotted line winding through the forgotten lower tiers toward the shadow of the Hundredth Door. The fragment goes into your pocket just as the scholar snaps the book shut and turns away.

Armed with this clandestine cartography, you slip through the shadows of the tall shelves to confront the next barrier in your search.

nodes.title: Flattery in the Stacks
nodes.brief: You flatter the pompous scholar with clever deception, acquiring a stolen notebook detailing Thessaly's recent inquiries.
nodes.page:
Praise costs nothing when spent upon a scholar whose vanity outstrips his intellect. You lean against the varnished mahogany of the reading desk, offering smooth, unearned compliments regarding his monograph on forgotten scripts. His chest swells beneath his stiff linen waistcoat, and his fingers loosen their jealous grip upon the leather-bound notebook resting beside his inkwell. It details Thessaly Marr's recent inquiries into the vault protocols.

The opportunity sits within arm's reach, wrapped in twine and dust, awaiting a steady hand.

exits.label: Reach quietly for the leather notebook

nodes.title: The Stolen Inquiry
nodes.brief: You flatter the pompous scholar with clever deception, acquiring a stolen notebook detailing Thessaly's recent inquiries.
nodes.page: You draw a breath of old lambskin and tallow and keep up a stream of sycophantic praise while your hand drifts across the desktop. The scholar turns his head to preen under your flattery, exposing the notebook's spine. You ease toward the target and measure the gap against his shifting gaze. A nearby chair scrapes. The sound cracks the galleried hall just as your fingertips brush the edge of the leather cover.

check.label: Slide fingers across the polished desk

nodes.title: A Flawed Deception
nodes.brief: You flatter the pompous scholar with clever deception, acquiring a stolen notebook detailing Thessaly's recent inquiries.
nodes.page: Your fingers graze the leather cover just as the scholar pivots back with a suspicious scowl, wrenching the notebook from your reach with a sharp slap of his palm. He narrows his eyes, muttering about audacious shelvers who mistake politeness for permission. The rebuff leaves your wrist smarting from his signet ring, and you lose valuable minutes standing stiff while he lectures you on library etiquette before he turns away. You salvage your pride, though the encounter leaves you nursing a bruised wrist and a heightened wariness among the rival scholars.

exits.label: Retreat empty-handed into the crowded aisle

nodes.title: The Scholar's Notebook
nodes.brief: You flatter the pompous scholar with clever deception, acquiring a stolen notebook detailing Thessaly's recent inquiries.
nodes.page:
Your fingers close around the warm leather of the notebook, sliding it seamlessly into the deep pocket of your apron while the scholar remains lost in his own bloated reflection. You offer a final, perfectly timed bow before melting back into the shadows of the tall oak shelving. The pages within hold crude maps of restricted corridors and scribbled notes in Thessaly's unmistakable hand, pointing toward the deep annexes.

The risk paid off, leaving you with a vital clue to the Archivist's path.

exits.label: Return to the crowded scholar alcove

nodes.title: The Territorial Bookmark
nodes.brief: You gracefully bypass the scholar's territorial barrier during a heated debate, snatching a discarded bookmark bearing a crucial address.
nodes.page: Heated arguments over cataloguing rights carry through the galleried hall and give cover for your approach. The pompous scholar blocks the narrow corridor with his voluminous robes, guarding his territory like an ancient dragon atop a pile of folios. You slip past his sweeping gestures. Your shoulder brushes the rough wool of his sleeve, and your fingers lift a discarded cardboard bookmark fluttering from his coat pocket, bearing an address written in hurried, familiar ink.

nodes.title: The Narrow Archway
nodes.brief: You gracefully bypass the scholar's territorial barrier during a heated debate, snatching a discarded bookmark bearing a crucial address.
nodes.page: Darting past the raging historian, you aim for the narrow gap between a towering stack of unbound periodicals and a wobbling cart of heavy lexicons. The floor is slick with spilled lamp-oil, and the scholar whirls around with a furious shout, lunging to block your escape route. You throw your weight forward, trusting your momentum to carry you through the tightening bottleneck while your boots slide perilously close to the dark edge of an open floor grating.

check.label: Leap across the oily floor gap

nodes.title: A Slippery Retreat
nodes.brief: You gracefully bypass the scholar's territorial barrier during a heated debate, snatching a discarded bookmark bearing a crucial address.
nodes.page: Your boot heel catches on a loose floorboard greased with spilled lamp-oil, sending you pitching awkwardly into a stack of loose pamphlets. They scatter across the flagstones like startled birds, drawing the sharp rebukes of nearby readers and the stern glare of the lending clerk. You scramble to gather your dignity alongside the fallen papers, nursing a scraped knee and losing precious minutes to the commotion. The scholar huffs in triumph from across the aisle, but you slip away into the gloom before he can demand compensation.

nodes.title: The Torn Address
nodes.brief: You gracefully bypass the scholar's territorial barrier during a heated debate, snatching a discarded bookmark bearing a crucial address.
nodes.page:
Your balance holds through the slide, carrying you cleanly past the flailing historian and into the safety of the transverse stack. Clutched in your palm is a stiff paper bookmark bearing an address in the deep annexes where Thessaly was last seen. The escape cost you a torn sleeve and a moment of breathless panic, but the prize remains secure against your chest.

You press onward into the gloom with a valuable lead on your vanished mentor.

exits.label: Return to the crowded scholar alcove

nodes.title: The Lower Scriptoriums
nodes.brief: You descend into the lower scriptoriums where the air grows thick with the scent of iron-gall ink and damp stone.
nodes.page:
Iron-gall ink and damp stone coat your tongue as you descend the spiral stair into the lower scriptoriums, where the air tastes of oxidized copper and cold river silt. Shadows lengthen across rows of sloping desks where scribes work by the dim amber glow of oil lamps, transcribing rotting codices before their words dissolve entirely into the grain. The murmur of whispered annotations rises from every corner, a ceaseless buzzing like trapped insects inside dry bindings. Nobody looks up as you pass, too absorbed in the desperate race against the expanding decay of the catalogue.

Ahead lies the bustling market where merchants trade in the very fluids that keep the library's memory alive.

nodes.title: The Ink-Sellers' Stall
nodes.brief: The Ink-Sellers' Stall: Merchants hawk dubious liquids that promise to reveal hidden text or make parchment scream when touched.
nodes.page: Canvas awnings strain against greasy drafts in a cavernous bazaar where merchants hawk dubious liquids by flickering lantern light. Glass vials clink against one another, filled with concoctions that promise to reveal hidden text, make parchment scream when touched, or permanently stain wandering fingers. The air smells thick of turpentine, gall, and stale vinegar, laced with the low hum of rival shelvers haggling over prices. Every stall offers a different route through the creeping shadows, tempting you to spend your meager copper on draughts that might ease your journey into the deep stacks.

exits.label: Catch a jar of falling luminescent ink
Identify a rare batch of genuine archive ink
Slip through the market stalls with fluid grace
Trick a greedy merchant with waste-paper
Cross the bridge over the ink canal

nodes.title: The Tumbling Glass
nodes.brief: You nimbly catch a jar of falling luminescent ink, earning a free vial of ghost-scribe fluid from the impressed merchant.
nodes.page: Canvas awnings crack and flap in the grease-laden draft while merchants bark hoarse claims across the narrow aisle. A rusted iron hoop strikes a merchant's crate nearby, and a bulbous glass vessel tumbles from its high plank toward the stone flagstones. You lurch forward. Hands snap out and catch the neck before grit can shatter it. Luminescent blue fluid swirls inside the stoppered bulb and throws an azure light across your knuckles. The relieved vendor nods and slides a stoppered vial of ghost-scribe fluid into your palm as pay for the catch.

nodes.title: Catching the Falling Vial
nodes.brief: You nimbly catch a jar of falling luminescent ink, earning a free vial of ghost-scribe fluid from the impressed merchant.
nodes.page: Droplets of luminescent ink spatter the damp paving as the glass orb wobbles dangerously between your palms, its slick surface refusing to yield a solid grip. The merchant shouts a warning too late, his gnarled fingers clutching at empty air while the heavy vessel lists sideways toward the jagged edge of a copper trough. You twist your torso, throwing your weight into a sudden slide along the slick stone to intercept the momentum before gravity finishes its work.

nodes.title: Slipping on the Flagstones
nodes.brief: You nimbly catch a jar of falling luminescent ink, earning a free vial of ghost-scribe fluid from the impressed merchant.
nodes.page: Your boots slide wide on a patch of spilled tallow, sending you crashing hard against a stack of empty crates that splinter with a sharp report. The falling vessel shatters against the iron rim of a drain, coating your sleeve in a cold, permanent smear of glowing blue ink that stains skin and wool alike. A merchant curses at the loss of inventory, docking your personal ledger balance to cover the mess while you pick wood splinters from your bleeding palms.

exits.label: Gather your stained coat and leave

nodes.title: The Ghost-Scribe's Gift
nodes.brief: You nimbly catch a jar of falling luminescent ink, earning a free vial of ghost-scribe fluid from the impressed merchant.
nodes.page: Fingers close securely around the cold neck of the glass vessel just as it threatens to slip from reach, steadying the turbulent fluid within with a sharp twist of the wrist. The merchant exhales a long whistle of relief, clapping a heavy hand upon your shoulder and pressing a smaller, stoppered vial into your grip as thanks for your swift intervention. This pale fluid clings to the glass like morning mist, whispering faint, unintelligible syllables whenever the lantern light catches its surface.

nodes.title: The Scent of Iron
nodes.brief: You identify a rare batch of genuine archive-grade ink by its bitter scent, trading a secret cataloguing tip for a discount.
nodes.page: Stacks of earthenware pots line the narrow wooden counter, each sealed with melted beeswax that smells faintly of copper and rusted nails. You lean close, nostrils flaring as you sample the heavy vapors drifting from an unlabelled jug tucked behind a stack of ledger covers. The distinctive tang of true archive-grade gall ink settles on your tongue, far superior to the diluted lamp-black hawked to careless scholars. The bearded merchant squints at your junior shelver badge, exchanging a knowing grin before slashing the price in half for a shared secret about misfiled tax rolls.

nodes.title: Inspecting the Dark Varnish
nodes.brief: You identify a rare batch of genuine archive-grade ink by its bitter scent, trading a secret cataloguing tip for a discount.
nodes.page: Rows of identical black jars blur together under the guttering tallow lamps, their wax seals bearing the forged stamps of the central scriptorium. You lift a heavy earthenware container by its hempen handle, squinting through your spectacles at the faint chemical bloom creeping across the leaden lid. The proper vintage should taste of copper and old parchment, but this batch carries a sickly, sweet tang of fermented plum that hints at inferior binders and quick-drying forgery.

nodes.title: A False Vintage
nodes.brief: You identify a rare batch of genuine archive-grade ink by its bitter scent, trading a secret cataloguing tip for a discount.
nodes.page: Your tongue prickles with a sour, metallic burn as a drop of the inferior brew leaks onto your glove and stains your thumb a permanent, indelible violet. The merchant scowls, snatching the jar away and demanding full compensation for a seal broken by an uninvited amateur. You leave the stall poorer by several copper buttons, your fingers throbbing where the caustic forgery ate through your skin.

nodes.title: The Scribe's Discount
nodes.brief: You identify a rare batch of genuine archive-grade ink by its bitter scent, trading a secret cataloguing tip for a discount.
nodes.page: Sharp eyes pierce the deceptive labeling, tracing the subtle flaws in the wax seal straight to a counterfeit batch smuggled up from the lower cellars. The vendor groans softly, acknowledging your expertise with a reluctant nod before trading the genuine article at a steep discount in exchange for your silence. You stow the heavy earthenware jar into your satchel, secure in the knowledge that your writing will never fade or lie on the page.

nodes.title: The Shadowy Passage
nodes.brief: You slip through the crowded market stalls with fluid grace, pocketing a vial of truth-revealing ink unnoticed.
nodes.page: Velvet draperies wall off the noisy main aisle from the shadowy alcoves where merchants trade in illicit draughts that compel confessions from stubborn books. You drop your shoulders, sliding sideways through a knot of argumentative scholars with practiced ease, your soft-soled boots making no sound upon the grit. A heavy glass bottle rests unguarded upon a velvet cushion, its pale contents shifting like liquid moonlight waiting for a careless hand.

nodes.title: Navigating the Stall
nodes.brief: You slip through the crowded market stalls with fluid grace, pocketing a vial of truth-revealing ink unnoticed.
nodes.page: Shadows flicker wildly across the canvas roof as a gust of greasy wind rattles the lantern irons overhead. You slide from heel to toe through a narrow gap between a stack of iron-bound folios and a nervous merchant counting copper coins by touch. The small glass vial sits upon the velvet cloth just beyond your fingertips, requiring one final, silent stretch of your arm to clear the counter's edge.

nodes.title: Caught in the Act
nodes.brief: You slip through the crowded market stalls with fluid grace, pocketing a vial of truth-revealing ink unnoticed.
nodes.page: A ledger shifts under your foot with a sharp creak. Your rhythm breaks, and your elbow crashes into a tower of tin spice boxes. The whole stack rattles down onto the flagstones with a deafening clatter, bringing an angry merchant lunging over the counter with a rusted ink-knife raised. You scramble backward into the surging crowd, leaving behind a torn sleeve and your dignity as shouts follow you into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Moonlight Vial
nodes.brief: You slip through the crowded market stalls with fluid grace, pocketing a vial of truth-revealing ink unnoticed.
nodes.page: Your fingers brush the cool glass surface, lifting the small vessel from its velvet cushion with such fluid lightness that even the merchant's trained ear remains entirely undisturbed. Slipping the prize deep into your tunic pocket, you blend seamlessly back into the drifting throng of students and scribes without a single head turning your way. The liquid inside pulses with a steady, pearlescent gleam that promises to strip away false bindings and reveal whatever secrets the library tries to hide.

nodes.title: The Oily Bazaar
nodes.brief: You barter skillfully with a stubborn ink-seller, trading your spare boots for a flask of permanent index-black.
nodes.page:
Lamp-oil fumes hang thick over the stall where the ink-seller squints through a jeweller's lens at your worn leather boots. You press the heel of your left sole against the rough wooden counter to hide the split seam, letting the dim amber glow catch the polished grain of the calfskin. The merchant taps a stained fingernail against a heavy ceramic jar marked with the sigil of the permanent trade.

Weighing his interest against the rising chill of the Reading Rooms, you offer the boots with a solemn nod, suggesting they will outlast three pairs of these damp market slippers.

nodes.title: Weighing the Trade
nodes.brief: You barter skillfully with a stubborn ink-seller, trading your spare boots for a flask of permanent index-black.
nodes.page:
Thick soot flakes drift down from the iron lamps, settling on the brim of your shelver's cap as the merchant runs a suspicious thumb over the welt of your spare boot. He mutters something about shoddy stitching in the lower tiers, yet his nostrils flare at the genuine scent of neatsfoot oil. You fold your arms across your chest, feigning indifference while your toes ache in the thin stockings.

The flask of index-black sits just beyond his elbow, its leaden stopper sealed with purple wax that smells faintly of old cloves.

exits.label: Push the boots a little closer

nodes.title: A Bargain Struck
nodes.brief: You barter skillfully with a stubborn ink-seller, trading your spare boots for a flask of permanent index-black.
nodes.page: Cold sweat beads at the back of your neck as you match the merchant's unblinking stare, sliding the second boot forward with deliberate, unhurried grace. You speak of cataloguing quotas and the strict rules of the Returns Desk, weaving an elaborate fiction about a shortage of proper footwear in the deep stacks that demands an immediate exchange of equal value. His fingers twitch toward the wax-sealed flask, hovering just above the rim while he decides whether your bold front is genuine authority or desperate bluffing.

check.label: Persuade the merchant with sharp wits

nodes.title: A Costly Exchange
nodes.brief: You barter skillfully with a stubborn ink-seller, trading your spare boots for a flask of permanent index-black.
nodes.page: Your tongue slips on a technical term from the library code, and the merchant's eyes snap wide with sudden, sharp amusement. He snorts, tossing your boots back onto the dusty floorboards with a dismissive flick of his wrist. If you want his finest ink-black now, he demands double the toll, forcing you to hand over your last silver penny and a bundle of precious parchment scraps meant for your evening notes. You stagger away poorer and wiser, your pockets lighter by more than coin.

nodes.title: The Darkest Ink
nodes.brief: You barter skillfully with a stubborn ink-seller, trading your spare boots for a flask of permanent index-black.
nodes.page: The merchant grunts in grudging surrender, sweeping your spare boots into a greasy crate beneath his counter and thrusting the heavy ceramic flask into your open palms. It settles there with a satisfying, leaden weight, cold enough to numb your fingers through your tunic sleeve. What you bargained for is yours, sealed with a sharp nod of mutual disrespect.

exits.label: Return to the bustling stall rows

nodes.title: The Blank Facade
nodes.brief: You trick a greedy merchant into trading his finest invisible ink for a worthless bundle of blank waste-paper.
nodes.page: Smooth sheets of cheap rag paper rustle between your trembling fingers as you fan out the worthless bundle across the counter, making them look like pristine vellum under the flickering lantern light. The greedy merchant leans in close, his grease-stained spectacles sliding down his nose as he inspects the blank margins with hungry eyes. You whisper tales of a lost cartography manual destined for the Index, keeping your voice low and conspiratorial.

nodes.title: The False Ledger
nodes.brief: You trick a greedy merchant into trading his finest invisible ink for a worthless bundle of blank waste-paper.
nodes.page: Heart hammering against your ribs, you point a confident finger at the empty corners of the paper, murmuring that the invisible script requires the heat of a breath to appear. The merchant reaches eagerly for the prize, his fat fingers almost grazing the topmost sheet while suspicion flickers briefly in his rheumy eyes. You hold your breath and pin your hands to the counter edge as he weighs the gamble.

check.label: Trick the merchant with blank paper

nodes.title: Discovered Deception
nodes.brief: You trick a greedy merchant into trading his finest invisible ink for a worthless bundle of blank waste-paper.
nodes.page: A corner of the top sheet catches on a dry splinter, tearing away to reveal the utterly blank, coarse grain beneath. The merchant lets out a sharp whistle of outrage that brings two burly porters charging through the linen drapes behind the stall. You snatch up what you can and bolt, leaving your spare woollen scarf behind in the merchant's furious fist as a token of your hasty retreat.

nodes.title: The Stolen Secret
nodes.brief: You trick a greedy merchant into trading his finest invisible ink for a worthless bundle of blank waste-paper.
nodes.page: The merchant snatches the bundle, grins a yellow-toothed grin of absolute triumph, and shoves a heavy glass vial of clear, stinging fluid into your pocket before he can change his mind. The precious draught of invisible ink stays tucked against your ribs. You slip away into the shifting crowd of scholars before he thinks to test the paper under an open flame.

nodes.title: The Bridge of Spines
nodes.brief: You cross the narrow bridge suspended over a sluggish canal of discarded black ink that ripples with strange murmurs.
nodes.page: Heavy iron girders groan overhead as you step onto the swaying span constructed entirely from discarded, iron-clasped library bindings lashed together with hemp rope. Below you, a sluggish canal of discarded black ink rolls in thick, glistening waves, whispering disjointed phrases from forgotten treatises against the stone footings. The air tastes of copper and old glue, and every footstep sends a dry, paper-crackle shudder through the makeshift bridge. You keep your eyes fixed on the distant lantern light of the scriptorium, ignoring the frantic scratching sounds echoing from the dark water beneath your boots.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium of Strains
nodes.brief: The Scriptorium of Strains: Monks in grease-stained robes argue fiercely over whether marginalia should be scraped clean or preserved.
nodes.page: Greasy candle-stubs gutter upon heavy oak desks while robed monks lean into one another, hissing through yellowed teeth over whether marginalia should be scraped clean or preserved for posterity. Spilled ink congeals in the cracks of the flagstones like dried blood, smelling faintly of vinegar and rotted gall. To your left, a narrow stairwell winds downward into the gloom where rough-knuckled comrades wait in the shadow of the shelves. Straight ahead, an iron-bound wicket gate stands ajar, revealing a chamber choked with discarded parchment scraps. Near the back pillar, a towering lectern holds a massive ledger covered in furious ink-corrections, offering a tempting glimpse of institutional secrets. Every shadow hums with low, marginal whispers that pull at the edges of your attention, urging you to choose your path through the dust.

nodes.title: The Scrap-Basket Inquiry
nodes.brief: You manipulate the arguing monks with quick wit, convincing them to let you inspect their forbidden scrap-basket.
nodes.page: Grease-stained robes brush against your sleeves as you slip past the disputing brothers, your boots crunching softly upon drifts of discarded parchment shavings. The air thickens with the reek of lamp-oil and fermented vinegar, masking the subtle scratch of quills moving in the dark alcoves above. You edge closer to the woven wicker basket where confiscated marginalia and torn-out glosses accumulate like autumn leaves. One of the senior monks turns his hooded head sharply toward you, his rheumy eyes narrowing with instant suspicion. You must act before his suspicion hardens into a formal denunciation by the order.

nodes.title: Assessing the Wicker Depth
nodes.brief: You manipulate the arguing monks with quick wit, convincing them to let you inspect their forbidden scrap-basket.
nodes.page: Fingers twitching against the rough rim of the wicker basket, you slide a hand down past the curled vellum slips while fixing the lead monk with an unwavering, placid stare that masks your rising pulse. The air grows stifling as the old man opens his mouth to challenge your intrusion, his breath sour with stale chicory and ink-dust. You lean your weight forward to block his line of sight, trusting your tongue to spin a plausible fabrication about missing inventory. Every nerve strains against the impending discovery as the monks close their circle around you.

check.label: Talk your way past the suspicious monk

nodes.title: Tangled in the Shavings
nodes.brief: You manipulate the arguing monks with quick wit, convincing them to let you inspect their forbidden scrap-basket.
nodes.page: A bronze paperweight slips from a nearby shelf, crashes onto the flagstones, and shatters the thin veneer of your confident performance. The monks surge forward with outraged squawks, their grease-stained sleeves flapping like the wings of startled crows as they pin your arms against the rough wicker. You twist away, but not before a sharp wooden splinter tears a jagged line across your palm, leaving hot blood to mingle with the black ink staining your knuckles. They bundle you out into the drafty corridor with a chorus of dry curses, heavier by a stinging wound and bruised pride, yet leaving you free to lick your scratches in the gloom.

exits.label: Return to the noisy scriptorium hub

nodes.title: The Scraps Secured
nodes.brief: You manipulate the arguing monks with quick wit, convincing them to let you inspect their forbidden scrap-basket.
nodes.page:
Quick words woven with practiced ease placate the furious brothers just long enough for your fingers to graze the bottom of the wicker receptacle and withdraw a tightly curled scrap of vellum. The monks grunt in grudging acquiescence, turning back to their theological dispute as though you were nothing more than a stray draft of air. You tuck the prize into your waistcoat pocket, feeling the cold weight of a recovered secret pressing against your ribs.

Whether negotiated cleanly or snatched away amid bitter scowls, the victory leaves you richer by a hidden scrap of verse.

nodes.title: The Carved Dialectic
nodes.brief: You parse a complex theological argument carved into the stone wall, gaining insight into the library's foundational flaws.
nodes.page: Cold stone presses against your fingertips as you trace the deep-set grooves of an ancient argument chiseled directly into the load-bearing pillar of the hall. Centuries of lamp-smoke have stained the masonry charcoal-black, filling the carved lettering with a greasy sludge that smells of old tallow and subterranean damp. The words debate the true ownership of forgotten thoughts, each line twisting back upon itself in an endless logical loop. Dust motes drift lazily through the shaft of yellow light piercing the high clerestory, illuminating the faint, ghostly shimmer of marginal notes written in a hand that vanished generations ago.

nodes.title: Shadows of the Foundation
nodes.brief: You parse a complex theological argument carved into the stone wall, gaining insight into the library's foundational flaws.
nodes.page: Deeper into the alcove the carving runs, recounting the foundational collapse of the lower tiers where entire catalogues slid into the dark earth. The stone grows clammy to the touch, and the distant murmur of the reading rooms fades into a low, metallic thrum like the beating of an iron heart. You trace a particularly knotty paragraph where the original mason seems to have doubted the very existence of the indexes he was commanded to immortalize. A tiny beetle emerges from a crack in the verb 'therefore', scurries across your knuckle, and vanishes into the binding seam of a rotting ledger propped against the base.

nodes.title: Decoding the Mason Flaw
nodes.brief: You parse a complex theological argument carved into the stone wall, gaining insight into the library's foundational flaws.
nodes.page: Squinting against the dim flicker of your oil-lamp, you peer into the jagged intersections of the chiseled text where the grammar begins to unravel into pure contradiction. The stone seems to shift under your gaze, the letters expanding and contracting as if responding to the heat of your breath or the rising panic in your chest.
