You press your forehead against the cold masonry, running every rule of library architecture and cataloguing logic through your mind to find the hidden seam in the reasoning. A single misinterpretation could trap your thoughts in the carved loop forever, binding your mind to the silent stone.

nodes.title: The Stone Trap
nodes.brief: You parse a complex theological argument carved into the stone wall, gaining insight into the library's foundational flaws.
nodes.page: A sudden drop in air pressure drives a freezing draft through the fluting of the pillars. Sweat chills on your neck. The chiseled lines blur into grey smears. Your eyes burn from the strain, and a sharp blinding headache blooms behind your temples as the logic collapses inward upon itself like a punctured lung. You stumble backward with a sharp gasp, strike your shoulder on the iron corner of a stationary shelf, and drop your lamp. Oil spreads in a dark shimmering puddle across the floor. You are left in the half-light, poorer by a broken lamp and hours of wasted focus.

nodes.title: The Foundational Crack
nodes.brief: You parse a complex theological argument carved into the stone wall, gaining insight into the library's foundational flaws.
nodes.page:
Logic yields at last under your relentless prodding, snapping open like a stubborn latch to reveal a hairline fracture running straight through the heart of the stone argument. Through this narrow fissure in the masonry, a draft smelling of damp earth and pressed lavender whispers secrets of the library's original design long before the Cataloguers took command. You commit the underlying pattern to memory, feeling the heavy architecture of the room settle slightly as your understanding locks the truth into place.

Whether achieved with effortless clarity or through agonizing trial, the insight settles deep into your bones.

exits.label: Return to the main scriptorium hub

nodes.title: The Monastic Barrage
nodes.brief: You weather the monks' furious verbal assault with unwavering resolve, securing an antique bone stylus as an alliance token.
nodes.page: Sharp tongues lash against your concentration like dry twigs snapping in a gale while hooded librarians press in close, their breath sour with chicory and old grievance. Words fail to pierce your stubborn silence as you anchor your heels into the flagstones, weathering the tempest of theological venom without yielding an inch of ground. A grizzled monk finally spits in disgust, thrusting a yellowed strip of carved bone into your palm before turning his back on your unyielding stance.

exits.label: Take the bone stylus from the monk

nodes.title: Withstanding the Tongue-Lash
nodes.brief: You weather the monks' furious verbal assault with unwavering resolve, securing an antique bone stylus as an alliance token.
nodes.page: Saliva flies from the lips of the senior scribe as he questions your lineage, your loyalty to the Index, and the very sanity of your presence in these hallowed aisles. You lock your jaw against the biting insults, tightening your grip on your oil-lamp until the brass rim bites into your palm. Every instinct screams at you to snap back or turn away, but you force your breathing into a slow, deliberate rhythm, steeling your spine against the mounting psychological pressure.

check.label: Hold firm against the verbal assault

nodes.title: A Costly Resolution
nodes.brief: You weather the monks' furious verbal assault with unwavering resolve, securing an antique bone stylus as an alliance token.
nodes.page: Cracking under the relentless verbal barrage, you flinch and step backward, knocking your shoulder painfully against a jutting stone corbel. The monks jeer at your momentary weakness, exacting a humiliating toll by confiscating your tin of spare lamp-wicks before they allow you to stumble past. You rub the bruised muscle in your shoulder, nursing a fresh ache in your pride as you limp onward into the dusty gloom.

exits.label: Gather your breath and move forward

nodes.title: The Bone Token
nodes.brief: You weather the monks' furious verbal assault with unwavering resolve, securing an antique bone stylus as an alliance token.
nodes.page: Weathering the verbal tempest with granite resolve, however narrowly, you compel the lead scribe to respect your stubborn endurance. He mutters a begrudging curse and shoves a smooth, yellowed sliver of carved bone into your hand, sealing an uneasy truce between your order and theirs. This unassuming relic carries the weight of a hard-won alliance within these labyrinthine stacks.

exits.label: Venture deeper into the reading galleries

nodes.title: Correcting the Ledger
nodes.brief: You spot a logical error in the monks' index system, correcting their ledger to earn a safe passage token.
nodes.page: Glancing over the chaotic columns of the central registry, your eye catches a glaring inversion where the shelf-indices loop backward into a recursive void. You reach out with a piece of chalk, swiftly correcting the misplaced cross-reference before the error can cascade into the main stack. The chief clerk blinks in astonishment at your sharp observation, muttering his gratitude as he hands you a brass pass token.

nodes.title: Spotting the Flaw
nodes.brief: You spot a logical error in the monks' index system, correcting their ledger to earn a safe passage token.
nodes.page: Columns of dense script blur beneath the unsteady glare of your lantern as you scan the massive vellum ledger for the structural discrepancy. You trace a trembling finger along the tangled lines of categorization, searching for the single misplaced entry that threatens to throw the entire bay into chaos. Your mind races through complex classification rules, hunting for the precise thread of logic hidden within the ink.

check.label: Trace the error in the ledger

nodes.title: Miscalculated Lines
nodes.brief: You spot a logical error in the monks' index system, correcting their ledger to earn a safe passage token.
nodes.page: Exhaustion blurs your vision; you misread a cross-reference and plunge your ink-pen straight through the vellum surface. The clerks cry out at the ruined page and make you spend a tedious hour scraping the ink away with a dull penknife while they dock your weekly lamp-oil allowance. You leave the desk with smarting fingers and a lingering headache from the close inspection.

exits.label: Pocket your ruined notes and press on

nodes.title: The Ledger's Secret
nodes.brief: You spot a logical error in the monks' index system, correcting their ledger to earn a safe passage token.
nodes.page: Pinpointing the subtle misclassification with razor-sharp precision, however narrowly, you avert a catastrophic indexing loop that would have sealed the bay for weeks. The head clerk nods in silent appreciation, sliding a heavy brass token across the walnut counter into your waiting hand. This small disk grants you unhindered passage through the administrative turnstiles without further inspection.

exits.label: Proceed toward the Scriptorium of Strains

nodes.title: The Fellowship Hearth
nodes.brief: You reach the echoing vault of the Shelvers' Fellowship where your rough comrades nurse bruised knuckles and lukewarm tea.
nodes.page: Damp stone walls sweat grease and old candle-wax in the vaulted cellar where the Shelvers gather between shifts to nurse their sore feet. Troughs of lukewarm turnip broth steam on iron tripods while rough-hewn pages murmur in small, distrustful clusters around scarred oak tables. Your arrival draws sudden, wary silences from men and women who know that Thessaly's disappearance has turned every junior page into a suspect. Barnaby steps out from the shadows near the hearth, his arms crossed over his leather apron and his eyes narrowed with pointed suspicion.

exits.label: Face the waiting circle of comrades

nodes.title: The Hearthside Inquest
nodes.brief: The Fellowship Hearth: Your fellow page Barnaby questions your loyalty after rumors spread that you saw Thessaly's final note.
nodes.page: Embers pop in the big hearth. Long jittery shadow crawls across the scarred faces of your peers while Barnaby waits by the iron kettle, and his frame fills the aisle so the path ahead stays blocked. Rumors of your brush with Thessaly's final note zip from bench to bench like hornets. In the damp chamber every pair of eyes tracks your next step. Nobody looks away.

exits.label: Point out the cataloguing mark on Barnaby's ledger
Stand your ground against Barnaby's aggressive doubts
Smooth over the tension with calm diplomacy
Slip away into the labyrinthine map-rooms

nodes.title: The Ledger's Mark
nodes.brief: You correctly identify the cataloguing mark on Barnaby's hidden ledger, proving your competence and earning his hard-won respect.
nodes.page:
Smoke curls from a tallow dip. Barnaby slams his thumb against the spine of the contraband volume. Ink-smudged fingers trace the peculiar red cancellation stamp across the flyleaf, a mark you recognize at once from the master register of the upper tiers. You lean across the scarred oak table and point out the subtle divergence in the classification code that proves the book has been illicitly moved from its proper bay. Barnaby narrows his eyes, and the hostility in his posture shifts into something more attentive and grudgingly respectful.

He closes the cover with a hollow thump that stirs the settling dust.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Binding
nodes.brief: You correctly identify the cataloguing mark on Barnaby's hidden ledger, proving your competence and earning his hard-won respect.
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the amber glare of the corner lamp as you lean millimeters from the cracked leather spine, searching for the faint, acid-etched monogram of the renegade cataloguer. Every breath feels heavy with the scent of vinegar and old parchment, and your fingers hover over the textured grain while you calculate the precise angle of the binder's iron stamp. A single wrong guess about the provincial press mark will expose your ignorance to Barnaby and ruin any hope of an alliance. You slow your breath and squint against the glare of the sputtering wick to parse the faded ink before the oil burns completely dry.

nodes.title: A Costly Oversight
nodes.brief: You correctly identify the cataloguing mark on Barnaby's hidden ledger, proving your competence and earning his hard-won respect.
nodes.page: Your fingertips slip against the greasy leather, sending a cascade of loose slips clattering across the flagged floor into the shadows. Barnaby lets out a sharp, disappointed hiss through his teeth, snatching the volume away before you can recover your balance. The abrupt motion leaves a jagged paper-cut across your thumb, welling dark and bright against the grime of your palm as a lasting reminder of your clumsiness. You bite back a curse and nurse the cut while precious minutes tick away in the silence of the alcove.

nodes.title: The Proven Competence
nodes.brief: You correctly identify the cataloguing mark on Barnaby's hidden ledger, proving your competence and earning his hard-won respect.
nodes.page:
Sharp eyes catch the minute discrepancy in the numbering sequence just as the candle gutters, however narrowly securing the truth of the matter from the fading ink. Barnaby grunts, his shoulders dropping as he grants your sharp eye and cool nerve a slow, respectful nod. He shoves a small, dog-eared memorandum across the grain of the table into your palm, offering proof of his clandestine trade without another word of argument.

You pocket the paper quickly, knowing the debt between you has shifted forever.

nodes.title: Standing Firm
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against Barnaby's aggressive doubts, earning his unwavering trust and a heavy iron latchkey.
nodes.page: Barnaby's boots creak on the floorboards as he leans over the battered desk and tries to stare you down with every year of his seniority. He says, "You are only a frightened page." You meet his gaze. Your voice drops to a calm register that cuts through the murmur of the reading hall, and the defiance in your posture takes the wind from his bluster. He exhales a long, whistling breath that smells of stale pipe-weed and ink.

nodes.title: Facing the Interrogation
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against Barnaby's aggressive doubts, earning his unwavering trust and a heavy iron latchkey.
nodes.page: Barnaby's accusations press down upon your shoulders like a sodden wool cloak, demanding an immediate defense while the surrounding shelves seem to lean in close to listen. You feel the hot prickle of anger rise behind your ribs, tempting you to snap back or bolt into the labyrinthine stacks behind your back. Instead, you force your spine to straighten and lock your eyes onto his, summoning every ounce of stubborn endurance you possess to weather his harsh cross-examination without breaking character. The silence stretches taut between you, waiting for your resolve to either hold or shatter completely against his wall of suspicion.

nodes.title: A Heavy Rebuke
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against Barnaby's aggressive doubts, earning his unwavering trust and a heavy iron latchkey.
nodes.page: Your nerve cracks under the relentless pressure, and you stumble backward against a wobbling stack of octavos that cascade down in a noisy avalanche of paper and boards. Barnaby merely watches you scramble among the fallen debris, his expression hardening into absolute contempt as you pick yourself up with bruised dignity and a fresh scrape along your shin. The humiliation burns hot beneath your collar, costing you valuable time and leaving you with a lingering ache in your bones as you retreat from his harsh scrutiny.

nodes.title: Unwavering Trust
nodes.brief: You stand your ground against Barnaby's aggressive doubts, earning his unwavering trust and a heavy iron latchkey.
nodes.page:
Barnaby meets your stare and decides your loyalties still sit with the stacks where they belong. He spits into the sawdust, digs in his deep coat pocket, and draws out a cold lump of forged iron on a knotted hemp cord. The latchkey lands in your palm with a dull clink that marks your place in the fellowship of the stacks.

Your fingers close around the iron.

nodes.title: The Measured Apology
nodes.brief: You smooth over the tense confrontation with calm diplomacy, securing a spare lantern and a promise of backup.
nodes.page:
Soft words slip past your lips, smoothing over the jagged edges of the dispute before Barnaby can draw breath for another caustic remark. You gesture toward the flickering wall-bracket and offer a shared pinch of coarse salt-tabacco, bridging the awkward chasm between your desks with old-fashioned courtesy and tact. His suspicious scowl softens at the edges, replaced by a weary, crooked grin that acknowledges your knack for defusing trouble before it draws the eye of the floor-wardens.

He reaches beneath his stool to retrieve a spare oil-flask for your belt.

nodes.title: Navigating the Tense Exchange
nodes.brief: You smooth over the tense confrontation with calm diplomacy, securing a spare lantern and a promise of backup.
nodes.page: Every sentence must be weighed like gold dust on a jeweler's scale while you maneuver around Barnaby's prickly pride and the rumors buzzing through the lower bays. A single awkward inflection or clumsy gesture will confirm his worst suspicions about your ambitions regarding the missing Archivist's private papers. You step closer to the warm circle of his desk lamp, pitching your voice to a soothing, confidential murmur that invites cooperation rather than defiance. Your fingers tap a quiet, rhythmic tattoo against your thigh while you wait to see if your diplomacy wins the day or invites his derision.

nodes.title: A Clumsy Misstep
nodes.brief: You smooth over the tense confrontation with calm diplomacy, securing a spare lantern and a promise of backup.
nodes.page: Your conciliatory gesture misfires entirely. In the damp vault of the reading hall it reads as patronizing, not polite. Barnaby knocks your outstretched hand aside with an angry swipe. Your ink-horn spins across the trestle table and spills a dark permanent stain across several centuries of municipal bylaws. The mess draws sharp glares from the nearby lending clerks. You earn a severe reprimand and a promise of extra sweeping duty before the night is out.

nodes.title: The Diplomatic Yield
nodes.brief: You smooth over the tense confrontation with calm diplomacy, securing a spare lantern and a promise of backup.
nodes.page:
Graceful phrasing turns the sharp edge of the argument, however narrowly preventing a bitter quarrel that would have echoed through the entire bay. Barnaby relents with a dry cough, sliding a clean brass lantern and a coil of waxed wick across the timber surface as a silent token of truce. You nod your thanks, pocketing the equipment as a safeguard against the creeping gloom of the unmapped corridors ahead.

Around the hall, pens scratch in a common rhythm, and the tension drains away.

nodes.title: The Map-Rooms
nodes.brief: You slip away into the labyrinthine map-rooms where rolled charts of unmapped corridors unroll themselves like sleeping snakes.
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the narrow corridors where rolled charts of unmapped pathways unroll themselves like sleeping snakes along the shelves. You slip away from the bustling reading hall, your boots padding silently against flagstones damp with lingering ink-vapours. Around you, parchment scrolls hiss and twitch in the draft, altering their contours as the geography of the lower bays shifts in the gloom. Thessaly Marr's disappearance leaves a cold vacuum in the archive, and every cartographic draft seems to point toward the sealed vault of the Hundredth Door. You must press deeper into the cartographer's domain before the shifting stacks trap you between floors for good.

nodes.title: The Cartographer's Loft
nodes.brief: The Cartographer's Loft: An eccentric map-maker tries to sell you a chart of corridors that shift whenever someone blinks.
nodes.page: Piles of yellowed vellum block the draughty corners of the loft, where an eccentric map-maker mutters over a brass compass that spins wildly on its mount. He tries to sell you a chart of corridors that shift whenever someone blinks, his ink-stained fingers tapping impatiently on the mahogany counter. Outside his window, the endless stacks rumble as another bay reorders itself in the damp subterranean air. You need a reliable route through this maze before the Long Closing seals the archives.

exits.label: Match wits with the erratic map-maker
Correct the glaring master map errors

nodes.title: The Riddle of Ink
nodes.brief: You outsmart the erratic cartographer in a game of riddles, walking away with a map of the non-existent corridors.
nodes.page: Pungent lamp-oil scents the cramped alcove as the cartographer leans forward, challenging your intellect with a convoluted puzzle about missing chapters and inverted floor numbers. You weigh every syllable carefully, countering his riddles with standard library nomenclature learned during your earliest days as a shelver. The old man narrows his eyes, clearly surprised by your sharp comprehension of the shifting stacks. Satisfied with your intellectual parry, he slides a thin roll of vellum across the cluttered desk toward you.

nodes.title: Cartographic Secrets
nodes.brief: You outsmart the erratic cartographer in a game of riddles, walking away with a map of the non-existent corridors.
nodes.page: Unrolling the crisp vellum reveals a chaotic web of ink lines depicting pathways that supposedly lead straight through solid masonry and bottomless air-wells. The cartographer insists these non-existent corridors open only to those who understand the cadence of the archive's breathing walls. You tuck the peculiar map into your coat pocket, feeling its heavy, fibrous weight against your ribs. The ink is still slightly tacky, smelling faintly of vinegar and crushed galls.

nodes.title: Tracing Phantom Passages
nodes.brief: You outsmart the erratic cartographer in a game of riddles, walking away with a map of the non-existent corridors.
nodes.page: Stepping out into the dim corridor, you match the map's impossible creases against the masonry arches while the stone walls groan and slide around you. A false door shivers in the lamplight, its brass handle turning lazily through empty air as the spatial puzzle shifts beneath your boots. You try to anticipate the exact moment the masonry will realign, relying entirely on your wits to pick the one true path through the geometric illusion.

nodes.title: Misaligned Ambition
nodes.brief: You outsmart the erratic cartographer in a game of riddles, walking away with a map of the non-existent corridors.
nodes.page: Stone grates violently against stone as the corridor snaps shut a fraction of a second too soon, catching your shoulder and sending you sprawling across the gritty floor. The map tears along a phantom crease, and you lose precious minutes digging your lamp out from beneath a pile of fallen cataloguing slips. Bruised and aching from the sudden impact, you pull yourself up against a cold pillar, poorer by a flask of oil and a good deal of pride.

exits.label: Push onward through the altered stacks

nodes.title: The Impossible Cartography
nodes.brief: You outsmart the erratic cartographer in a game of riddles, walking away with a map of the non-existent corridors.
nodes.page: Past the snapping jaws of the rearranging masonry, you step cleanly through the phantom archway into a stable bay beyond. The strange map folds neatly into your palm, its shifting ink settling into a permanent, reliable trace of the hidden passages. You emerge with a clearer understanding of how the library bends its own geometry around unwary shelvers.

nodes.title: The Master Chart
nodes.brief: You correct a glaring topological error on the master map, earning a detailed sketch of the stairs leading downward.
nodes.page: Massive leather-bound atlases sprawl across oak trestles, their pages covered in frantic ink corrections and fading marginal notes left by generations of anonymous scholars. You notice a glaring topological error near the lower registry where an entire stairwell has been transposed with a dead-end bindery. Pointing out the mistake to the busy draftsman earns his grudging respect and a quick flick of his pen.

nodes.title: Ink-Stained Gratitude
nodes.brief: You correct a glaring topological error on the master map, earning a detailed sketch of the stairs leading downward.
nodes.page: The draftsman nods briskly, muttering appreciation as he hands over a detailed, freshly drawn sketch of the stone steps leading downward into the deeper annexes. The paper is thick and heavy, bearing the official stamp of the Cartographers' Court in purple ink that smells of iron and cloves. You roll it tightly and secure it with a length of twine from your belt.

nodes.title: Reading the Topography
nodes.brief: You correct a glaring topological error on the master map, earning a detailed sketch of the stairs leading downward.
nodes.page: Dim amber light flickers across the drafting table as you cross-reference the new sketch with the ancient architectural carvings on the nearby pillars. The stairs below seem to breathe, expanding and contracting with a rhythmic pulse that threatens to scramble your sense of direction entirely. You concentrate fiercely on the structural anomalies, trying to decode the hidden logic behind the shifting stone steps.

nodes.title: A Miscalculated Descent
nodes.brief: You correct a glaring topological error on the master map, earning a detailed sketch of the stairs leading downward.
nodes.page: A sudden tremor shakes the foundation, causing your lamp to flare wildly and casting confusing shadows across the carved steps. You misjudge the rise of the lowest landing, stumbling forward and scraping your knuckles raw against the rough granite wall. The precious sketch slips from your fingers, getting smudged with greasy soot before you manage to scoop it back up from the dusty floor.

exits.label: Recover your footing and press on

nodes.title: The Map Adjusted
nodes.brief: You correct a glaring topological error on the master map, earning a detailed sketch of the stairs leading downward.
nodes.page:
Ink lingers on your thumb as you draw a firm red line across the margin of the master chart, correcting the fold where the seventh aisle swallowed a staircase. The lending clerk watches with grudging respect, sliding a folded slip of parchment across the mahogany desk in silent acknowledgement of your correction. This delicate ink-sketch details the forgotten descent toward the lower galleries, marking every shifting landing with precise notes on where the stone masonry tends to buckle.

You tuck the parchment safely into your sleeve, feeling the dry weight of the favor settle between your ribs like a coin earned in hard currency.

nodes.title: The Changing Parchment
nodes.brief: You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards.
nodes.page: Delicate vellum creases beneath your fingertips, revealing tiny diagrams that writhe like silverfish. You trace the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards who patrol the lower galleries with brass lanterns. Every tuck and fold shifts the geography of the ink-rivers below, whispering instructions that only a trained shelver could hope to parse before the night-porter changes the locks.

nodes.title: Folded Geographies
nodes.brief: You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards.
nodes.page: Shadows lengthen across the reading tables as you repeat the sequence of creases over and over in your head. You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards whose heavy woolen coats smell faintly of floor wax and dried lavender. A stray marginal note scrawled in the margin suddenly bites your thumb, drawing a single bead of dark ink that matches the security seal ahead.

nodes.title: Memorizing the Route
nodes.brief: You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards.
nodes.page: Heavy iron keys jingle in the corridor outside, warning of the impending patrol change among the strict cataloguers. You press the vellum flat against your chest and fix on the labyrinth of folds that offers the only passage through the restricted archway. Closing your eyes, you test your recollection of every secret turn against the rising tide of nervous sweat on your palms, right as a shadow looms across the frosted glass panel.

nodes.title: A Misplaced Turn
nodes.brief: You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards.
nodes.page: A sudden heel-click on the stone flags breaks your concentration, causing your thumb to slip and tear the delicate corner of the map. The guard's lantern swings wide, catching you unawares and forcing a frantic scramble behind a towering stack of unbound gazettes. You escape detection by diving into a damp alcove, but the delay costs you precious time and leaves your left sleeve permanently stained with corrosive gall-ink that burns through the fabric.

nodes.title: The Folded Key
nodes.brief: You study the complex fold patterns of the changing parchment, memorizing the secret route past the cataloguing guards.
nodes.page: Breath held against the smell of old glue and damp wool, you slip through the iron-bound gap just as the cataloguing patrol turns the corner, however narrowly avoiding discovery. Your fingers close around a crisp, folded slip of paper left behind by an anonymous sympathiser in the fellowship. It is a master key drawn in fading iron-gall ink that grants access to the restricted winding stairs.

nodes.title: Tales of Lost Wings
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the amber lamplight while the old cartographer leans heavily upon his brass-rimmed compass-trolley, clearing his throat for yet another interminable yarn about the wing that drifted into the western abyss. You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley through sheer stubborn endurance and the quiet rhythm of nodding at regular intervals.

nodes.title: The Compass Trolley
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Brass wheels squeak against the flagstones as the old man points a trembling finger toward the shifting dark of the northern stacks. You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley by focusing entirely on the tiny magnetic needle spinning wildly within its glass housing. A final wheezing sigh from the teller signals your release from the conversation.

nodes.title: The Endless Yarn
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Monotonous descriptions of drifting corridors threaten to swallow your resolve as the cartographer restarts his favorite story about the library wing that vanished during the great flood of ink. You tighten your grip on the handles of the brass apparatus, fighting off a sudden wave of numbing exhaustion that blurs the edges of the room. Your willpower frays against the relentless drone of misplaced shelves and forgotten architectural plans.

nodes.title: A Lapse in Will
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Your mind drifts for a fatal second into the monotonous cadence, letting a wave of intense fatigue drain your defenses and leave you owing a heavy favor to the exhausted lending clerk for covering your shift. The cartographer notices your distraction and presses a broken quill into your pocket as a debt that must be settled before the night is through. You shake off the mental fog, poorer in time and temper.

nodes.title: The Steady Hand
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Wisdom prevails against the mind-numbing drone of ancient geography, however narrowly preserving your mental equilibrium intact. The old man nods, mistaking your endurance for fascination, and shoves an iron-spoked wheel into your hands as a parting gift. It is an enchanted brass trammel that points true north even when the ceiling rotates.

nodes.title: The Spiral Stair
nodes.brief: You ascend a spiral staircase carved entirely from the spines of confiscated encyclopedias that creak under your boots.
nodes.page:
Heavy leather treads groan under your boots as you ascend a narrow spiral staircase carved entirely from the confiscated spines of thick encyclopedias. Dust and dried glue hang thick in the dim air, coating your tongue with the taste of alum and old paste. Somewhere above, a bell tolls through the stacks, announcing the approach of another shift change.

You keep one hand pressed against the ribbed marble wall, feeling the faint, rhythmic pulse that suggests the very stone is breathing in time with the unwritten Index.

nodes.title: The Binding Gallery
nodes.brief: The Binding Gallery: Binders stitch screaming leather to recalcitrant pages while enforcing strict silence with heavy wooden mallets.
nodes.page:
Binders stitch screaming leather to recalcitrant pages across long oak tables, enforcing strict silence with heavy wooden mallets that thump like a slow heartbeat. The smell of boiling glue and damp sheepskin fills the galleried hall where junior pages hover near the ink-sellers' stalls. Every shadow seems to hold a rival scholar watching your hands for any sign of hesitation or stolen knowledge.

You weigh your options among the clatter of bone folders and the whispered threats of the rule-keepers guarding the exits.

exits.label: Decipher the secret code woven here
Approach the heavy brass gates quietly

nodes.title: The Paste-Pot Corner
nodes.brief: You read a complex binding instruction pinned to the wall, mastering a knot that locks doors from the outside.
nodes.page:
Varnish tins and heavy linen strips litter the low bench where you pause to catch your breath away from the bustling tables. A rusted bodkin pins a complex binding instruction to the damp wall, and you follow its loops with a soot-stained fingertip. Mastering this particular knot will allow you to secure doors from the outside without drawing the attention of the rule-keepers.

The parchment whispers dry warnings about what happens when a knot slips under pressure.

exits.label: Practice the knot on the latch

nodes.title: The Second Knot
nodes.brief: You read a complex binding instruction pinned to the wall, mastering a knot that locks doors from the outside.
nodes.page:
Pulling the waxed cord through a double loop, you feel the fibers tighten with a dry snap that echoes faintly in the confined alcove. The parchment instruction sheet curls at the edges as if eager to escape the wall, its printed ink shifting slightly under your gaze. You repeat the sequence until your fingers move without thought, perfectly mimicking the technique used by the senior binders during the great audits.

A draft of cold air from a hidden vent rattles the loose papers on the bench.

nodes.title: The Faulty Toggle
nodes.brief: You read a complex binding instruction pinned to the wall, mastering a knot that locks doors from the outside.
nodes.page:
Securing the final loop around the iron latch, you apply pressure to test whether the mechanism will hold against an eager intruder pushing from within. The wood of the door groans beneath the strain, and the waxed cord begins to fray under the friction of the rusted staple. You must calculate the exact tension required to keep the toggle locked without snapping the delicate hemp fiber in your grip.

Your pulse thrums in your ears as the timber starts to splinter.

nodes.title: The Frayed Cord
nodes.brief: You read a complex binding instruction pinned to the wall, mastering a knot that locks doors from the outside.
nodes.page:
Hemp snaps with a dry crack. The door swings outward, catches you off balance, and dumps you across the gritty floorboards. A sharp edge of the iron staple rakes your forearm and leaves a shallow burning scratch that starts to ooze dark printer's ink instead of blood. You scramble back as the door rebounds, clutch the arm, and already owe the lending clerk for the ruined cord.

Dust settles on the scattered scraps of your failed knot.

nodes.title: The Secure Toggle
nodes.brief: You read a complex binding instruction pinned to the wall, mastering a knot that locks doors from the outside.
nodes.page:
Hemp holds fast against the straining timber and locks the panel in place with a muffled click. You wipe a smear of excess paste from your knuckles and let out a long breath as the tension in the room eases. The knot leaves you a sturdy length of waxed cord. You know how to keep things shut.

The shadows part slightly. A clear path runs toward the deeper stacks.

nodes.title: The Heavy Air
nodes.brief: You resist the deafening pressure of the collective silence spell, pressing forward to secure a roll of reinforced buckram.
nodes.page:
Silence hangs like wet wool over the narrow gallery, pressing against your eardrums until every breath sounds like a gale in a cavern. You resist the deafening pressure of the collective silence spell, planting your boots firmly against the uneven flagstones. Around you, other pages move like ghosts through the grey gloom, clutching rolls of reinforced buckram under their arms to mend the sagging shelves.

Your shoulders ache from the sheer weight of the unvoiced discipline filling the hall.

nodes.title: The Wall of Quiet
nodes.brief: You resist the deafening pressure of the collective silence spell, pressing forward to secure a roll of reinforced buckram.
nodes.page:
Deafening pressure rises until the air itself feels thick enough to chew, threatening to crush your resolve and force you to your knees in submission. You brace your spine against the invisible weight, drawing deep upon every ounce of stubborn endurance you possess to keep moving toward the shelf of buckram rolls. Your vision blurs at the edges as the silent spell demands total surrender from your weary mind.

Every muscle in your body trembles under the unrelenting stillness.

nodes.title: The Crushing Stillness
nodes.brief: You resist the deafening pressure of the collective silence spell, pressing forward to secure a roll of reinforced buckram.
nodes.page:
Mind gives way under the immense pressure, forcing you to drop to one knee as a wave of intense dizziness steals your focus. The roll of buckram slips from your numb fingers and unrolls across the dusty floor like a white tongue, drawing an immediate, sharp reprimand from a passing catalogue warden. You stumble backward out of the zone of quiet, nursing a bruised shoulder and a bitter sense of failure among your peers.

The silence lingers in your bones long after you crawl away.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Stride
nodes.brief: You resist the deafening pressure of the collective silence spell, pressing forward to secure a roll of reinforced buckram.
nodes.page:
Will holds against the suffocating quiet. You reach out through the still air and secure a stout roll of reinforced buckram. The collective silence breaks around your steady breathing like water parting against a stone, leaving you standing upright and victorious in the dim aisle. You tuck the sturdy material beneath your arm, knowing this small victory plants a quiet seed among the Shelvers' Fellowship that a library needs no locked doors at all.

The other pages watch you with newfound respect from the shadows.

nodes.title: Threads of Iron
nodes.brief: You decipher the secret code woven into the binding thread of a master volume, revealing Thessaly's intended destination.
nodes.page:
Raw pigskin twine twists through the spine of the registry, dyed with crushed galls and walnut husks. Your thumb finds the triple-knot along the headband. The hitch doubles back. Lower-stack stitching is never for show; it marks a route through the blind alcoves where the catalogue loses its grip, and by tilting the volume toward your horn-lantern the tiny indigo gaps between stitches resolve into names of forgotten stairwells. Thessaly left this physical cipher for anyone sharp enough to read the seams.

A final twist of the binding wire exposes the initial waypoint of her descent in the shadow of the gallery pillars.

exits.label: Trace the indigo thread carefully forward

nodes.title: The Crimson Stitch
nodes.brief: You decipher the secret code woven into the binding thread of a master volume, revealing Thessaly's intended destination.
nodes.page:
Crimson silk replaces ordinary linen within the hinge, woven with a stubborn regularity that speaks of haste and deliberate secrecy. Each loop catches the lamp-light, glinting with traces of powdered antimony beaten directly into the fibre. It is a binder's shorthand, taught only to senior clerks before they are sworn to absolute discretion in the dark. The pattern points away from the public desks and down toward the damp foundations where the uncatalogued manuscripts rot in heaps. You follow the sequence of knots with your fingernail, verifying the direction against the tilt of the draft.

The thread terminates abruptly at a rusted staple, pointing straight into the mouth of a disused service chute.

exits.label: Follow the rusted service chute down

nodes.title: Deciphering the Binding Coded Seam
nodes.brief: You decipher the secret code woven into the binding thread of a master volume, revealing Thessaly's intended destination.
nodes.page: Close scrutiny reveals that the crimson thread is not merely decorative stitching, but a precise map of subterranean turnings disguised as standard bookbinding practice. The lamp-oil gutters low as you lean closer, the acrid scent of old glue filling your nose while your eyes strain against the shifting gloom of the stacks. Every knot corresponds to a corridor shift, requiring absolute mental reconstruction of the library's turning architecture before the final route clarifies itself. A single misread twist will throw your reckoning directly into the path of the wandering partitions. Your focus sharpens into a knife-edge as you tally the twists.

nodes.title: Tangled in False Seams
nodes.brief: You decipher the secret code woven into the binding thread of a master volume, revealing Thessaly's intended destination.
nodes.page:
Confusion takes root as the tiny stitches blur under the smoking wick and lead your tired eyes down a deceptive counter-fold in the calfskin. A sudden shudder runs through the nearby shelves. Your elbow jars and the lamp crashes against the stone floor with a sharp hiss of dying oil. You stumble backward into a stack of quartos, bruise your ribs on a protruding iron bracket, and tear a jagged line across your sleeve. The correct path slips from your mind. Lamp-soot coats your tongue.

You salvage your dented tin lantern from the debris and press on.

exits.label: Pick up your lantern and press onward

nodes.title: The Corrected Pattern
nodes.brief: You decipher the secret code woven into the binding thread of a master volume, revealing Thessaly's intended destination.
nodes.page: Patience and careful breath work pierce the maze of knots, and Thessaly's intended route locks into place with startling clarity despite the flickering shadows. The pattern settles in your memory. The surrounding shelves answer with a long groan. You pocket the deciphered fragment, and the exact sequence of turns to the lower thresholds before the Long Closing seals the stone sits clear in your mind. A thin bone stylus left behind by the archivist drops from the binding fold into your open palm.

nodes.title: Silence in the Bindery
nodes.brief: You slip past the mallet-wielding binders with light steps, retrieving a discarded silver bone-folder from the scrap bin.
nodes.page:
Oak mallets thump wet sheepskin in a rhythmic, bone-rattling pulse along the long oak tables. You skirt the edge of the pit where the binders work with dampened rags tied over their mouths, their eyes fixed solely upon the recalcitrant pages they strive to tame. A pile of discarded brass-headed needles and metal shavings hides the scrap bin where offcuts and broken tools are tossed without ceremony. Your boots make no sound against the thick carpet of leather scrapings as you approach the overflowing wicker hamper near the glue-pots.

Resting among the trimmings lies a smooth, curved slip of silvered bone, polished bright by years of thumb-contact.

exits.label: Lift the silver tool from the scrap

nodes.title: Stealing Past the Mallets
nodes.brief: You slip past the mallet-wielding binders with light steps, retrieving a discarded silver bone-folder from the scrap bin.
nodes.page: One false step upon a stray offcut of calfskin will send a sharp crunch through the solemn vault, and the mallets will come down upon your skull. You balance your weight entirely upon the balls of your feet, gliding past a towering stack of drying folios while holding your breath against the rising smell of hot glue. A binder pauses mid-swing and turns a blindfold-wrapped head in your direction as a loose floorboard complains beneath your heel. You freeze instantly, every muscle locked in suspension while the mallet hovers in the dim air.

check.label: Slip past the binders without sound

nodes.title: Caught by the Mallet
nodes.brief: You slip past the mallet-wielding binders with light steps, retrieving a discarded silver bone-folder from the scrap bin.
nodes.page: A sharp crack rings out when your heel clips the rim of an iron glue-pot and wood-shavings spray across the flagstones. The nearest binder drops his wooden mallet and clamps your shoulder hard as a vice, demanding an account of your presence at once. You tear free, leave a rent in your jerkin, and take a raw welt across the forearm as you tumble into the shadow of a towering book-press. The binders take up their pounding again without another word. You sit bruised in the gloom and cradle the smarting arm.

nodes.title: The Silver Tool
nodes.brief: You slip past the mallet-wielding binders with light steps, retrieving a discarded silver bone-folder from the scrap bin.
nodes.page: Lightness of foot carries you past the rows of stooped binders without a single board crying out beneath your tread. Your fingers dip into the deep wicker bin and close around the smooth, cold surface of the bone-folder just as a heavy timber beam settles overhead. You slide the recovered tool into your pocket alongside your tally-chalk, feeling its clean weight steady your pulse against the hushed gloom of the workrooms. It is an implement meant for smoothing stubborn creases, yet it will serve well enough to force a recalcitrant latch when the need arises.

exits.label: Make your way back to the Binding Gallery

nodes.title: The Gates of the Deep Annexe
nodes.brief: You pause before the heavy brass gates of the Deep Annexe where the air grows cold and the lamp-oil gutters low.
nodes.page: Iron gates tall as three men loom before you at the terminus of the vaulted corridor, their surfaces etched with faded rules that shift and rewrite themselves in the gloom. The air tastes thin. Cold stone and ancient tallow sit on your tongue, and your lamp-flame shrinks to a pale blue bead within its horn panes. Beyond the bars the floor drops away into absolute darkness where no shelves have been built, only a vast void that swallows sound before it can leave your lips. A brass plaque riveted to the left pillar warns that unauthorised passage invites immediate shelving among the uncatalogued dead. You clutch your tally-slate closer to your chest as the hinges give a low, metallic shiver.

exits.label: Approach the severe custodian at the gatehouse

nodes.title: The Gatehouse of Rules
nodes.brief: The Gatehouse of Rules: A severe custodian demands proof that you possess the authority to approach the Hundredth Door.
nodes.page:
Heavy iron portcullises frame the entrance to the inner stacks, glowing with the faint, blue phosphorescence of dried salt and crushed gall-nuts. Behind a towering lectern of black oak sits the senior custodian, a man whose spectacles are thick as jar-bottoms and twice as greasy. He taps a brass paper-knife against the ledger, demanding proof that your junior shelver credentials carry proper authorization to approach the Hundredth Door. Dust motes dance in the shaft of amber lamplight that cuts across his ink-stained cuffs, smelling strongly of stale tobacco and sheepskin glue. Every corridor branching from this iron-ribbed vestibule hums with the low, subterranean vibration of shifting card-drawers and sliding shelves.

A narrow gap in the ironwork beckons into the dimmer stacks beyond the desk. Alternatively, a quieter alcove offers a place to polish your arguments against the custodian's scrutiny before you make a move.

nodes.title: Before the Iron Lectern
nodes.brief: You maintain rigid discipline against the custodian's psychological intimidation, forcing him to stamp your travel manifest.
nodes.page:
Brass scales balance on the edge of the register and tip with every draft that whistles up from the deep sub-basements. Your hands stay flat. You do not fidget with your sleeve or glance toward the shadowy archways. The custodian squints through his magnifying lens and examines the frayed edges of your indenture ribbons with a slow skepticism that invites impatience. You let your breathing settle into the cadence of the room and match the faint ticking of the wall-clock that measures the hours of the Long Closing. Every scrap of paper on the desk smells of rancid tallow and old iron filings.

A dry cough rattles from the back of the custodian's throat. He reaches for his red stamping block.

exits.label: Wait for the stamp to descend

nodes.title: The Weight of Scrutiny
nodes.brief: You maintain rigid discipline against the custodian's psychological intimidation, forcing him to stamp your travel manifest.
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch across the flagstones as the central chandelier flickers. Long shapes cross the rows of waiting petitioners. Your travel manifest lies between the ink-pot and the metal paperweight, its faded margins curling from the dry heat of the overhead lamps. The custodian leans forward. His breath carries peppermint leaves and dried ink-powder. You keep your spine straight and refuse to shrink from his gaze or show haste that might wake his administrative suspicion. In the adjacent clerk-room a nib scratches. Nothing else moves.

He turns the document over twice and holds the watermark to the weak amber glow of the corner sconce.

nodes.title: The Custodian's Stare
nodes.brief: You maintain rigid discipline against the custodian's psychological intimidation, forcing him to stamp your travel manifest.
nodes.page: Cold yellow eyes peer over the rim of the magnifying glass, seeking any hairline fracture in your composure or any hesitation in your breath. The custodian begins a rapid-fire interrogation concerning the exact shelf-mark of a missing folio last logged during the previous solstice. You grip the edge of the wooden counter until your knuckles whiten, focusing your entire consciousness on projecting an absolute, unshakeable aura of bureaucratic inevitability. Every fiber of your training as a junior shelver urges you to look down, yet you hold his intimidating glare without blinking. The red ink-pad waits open beside his elbow, gleaming like a fresh wound in the lamplight.

nodes.title: A Flaw in the Armor
nodes.brief: You maintain rigid discipline against the custodian's psychological intimidation, forcing him to stamp your travel manifest.
nodes.page:
Your left eyelid twitches once. Behind the brass-bound lectern the custodian snorts, sharp and unkind. He slams his ledger shut, and wood-shavings scatter across your boots while pain flares through your fingers. A harsh diagonal of purple ink crosses your manifest out, and he mutters that unseasoned novices waste valuable cataloguing hours. You scrub ink-stains from the ledger racks for a tedious hour as a punitive fine, and precious time slips away against the countdown of the Long Closing.

You collect your marked papers and step back into the dim corridor with a bruised thumb and a leftover flush of humiliation.

nodes.title: The Stamped Pass
nodes.brief: You maintain rigid discipline against the custodian's psychological intimidation, forcing him to stamp your travel manifest.
nodes.page:
Your composure draws a reluctant grunt from the custodian. He dips his wooden handle into the crimson well. The stamp comes down on your manifest with a wet smack that smells of vinegar and sealing-wax, pressed deep into the coarse rag-paper of your official papers. He shoves the document back across the polished mahogany without another word and turns to the next petitioner in line. You tuck the damp pass into your doublet pocket. The seal stays tacky.

A frayed parchment scrap bearing a cryptic shelf-coordinate falls from the ledger as he closes it and lands in your open hand.

nodes.title: Through the Archway
nodes.brief: You endure the grueling cross-examination without breaking character, earning an official seal of transit from the reluctant guard.
nodes.page:
Tall stone pilasters rise on either side of the passage, carved with the names of forgotten departments and long-abolished indexing committees. You follow the narrow flagged pathway as it winds past towering stacks of rebound periodicals, their leather spines cracking softly in the dry air. Cooler air carries the sharp metallic tang of fresh printing ink mixed with damp basement brickwork. Faint murmurs drift from the reading carrels hidden behind screens of woven wicker, where rival scholars hunch over their magnifying glasses with suspicious intensity.

A low archway opens ahead. A velvet curtain hangs across it, embroidered with fading silver letters.

nodes.title: Shadows of the Stacks
nodes.brief: You endure the grueling cross-examination without breaking character, earning an official seal of transit from the reluctant guard.
nodes.page:
Dust hangs in the narrow corridors. Long shafts of light pierce the high clerestory windows from the city streets far above. You ease your trolley past a stack of quartos that lean at a perilous angle and look ready to spill across the flagstones if anything knocks them. Boot-heels tap the vaulted ceiling's return, softened by leather-bound volumes from floor to crown. Somewhere ahead a small bell chimes three times. It marks the change of the cataloguing shift across the district.

A side-passage opens toward the ink-sellers' booths. Glowing vials of luminescent gall-ink throw green reflections on the damp stone walls.

nodes.title: The Scholarly Cross-Examination
nodes.brief: You endure the grueling cross-examination without breaking character, earning an official seal of transit from the reluctant guard.
nodes.page: A gaunt scholar in a frayed academic gown steps abruptly out from behind a stack of folios, blocking your path with an outstretched ivory pointer. He demands to know your business in the restricted bays and whether your credentials have been countersigned by the Guild of Indexers. His probing gaze searches your face for any sign of deception or ignorance regarding the complex Dewey systems of the lower tiers. The silence stretches out between you, broken only by the rhythmic dripping of a leaky pipe somewhere in the ceiling vault. You must summon every ounce of your resolve to prevent your voice from trembling under his haughty scrutiny.

nodes.title: A Piercing Reproach
nodes.brief: You endure the grueling cross-examination without breaking character, earning an official seal of transit from the reluctant guard.
nodes.page:
Your hesitation is instantaneous, but it is enough. The scholar taps his ivory pointer against your chest with precise force. He writes a scathing note of reprimand on the back of your sleeve with a piece of blue chalk, marking you as an untutored novice across every station in the wing. The humiliation costs you precious minutes as you argue your case before the shift-overseer. Chalk-dust smudges your collar. Ink sits bitter on your tongue. You press onward through the gloom toward the deep stacks.

You emerge from the dispute into a shadowed alcove lined with discarded research notes.

nodes.title: The Official Seal of Transit
nodes.brief: You endure the grueling cross-examination without breaking character, earning an official seal of transit from the reluctant guard.
nodes.page:
Your calm, unhurried manner disarms the scholar completely. His aggressive questioning turns into grudging appreciation for your professional poise. He reaches into his satchel and presses a small counter into your hand, then stamps your travel manifest with a purple cipher that marks high-level clearance. The seal gleams dull. It smells faintly of cold alloy and elderberry wine. He dips his head in a brief, respectful nod and slips back into the shadows of the manuscript racks without offering his name.

A rival scholars' guild seal sits stamped on the counter in your palm.

exits.label: Step through the threshold into the deep shadows

nodes.title: The Blind Spot
nodes.brief: You slide past the gatekeeper's blind spot with effortless poise, swiping the iron gate-ring key from his belt.
nodes.page: Dust hangs in the lantern-light where the gatekeeper doats over a ledger of fines, his ear-trumpet twitching to the scratch of his own steel nib. Shadows lengthen across the stone flags, offering a narrow strip of absolute dark that slips right past his high wooden booth. You hitch the strap of your canvas shoulder-bag and keep your breathing shallow as stale lamp-oil and dried ink fill your nose. The iron gate-ring key hangs from his belt by a grease-darkened leather thong and sways with each drowsy nod of his head.

nodes.title: The Suspended Pendulum
nodes.brief: You slide past the gatekeeper's blind spot with effortless poise, swiping the iron gate-ring key from his belt.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the alcove, broken only by the rhythmic ticking of a brass bracket-clock that seems to measure the slow decay of the paper around it. With practiced lightness, your fingers brush against the cold wool of your waistcoat, smoothing away any stray flakes of dry charcoal or dried mucilage from your cuffs. The gatekeeper stirs slightly, muttering a dry complaint about missing bookmarks into his damp cravat before settling back against his padded horsehair cushion. The heavy iron key glints dully in the amber glow of the wall-bracket, perfectly within reach if your timing matches the swing of his pendulum.

nodes.title: A Quiet Theft
nodes.brief: You slide past the gatekeeper's blind spot with effortless poise, swiping the iron gate-ring key from his belt.
nodes.page: Your fingers stretch toward the swinging leather thong while you shift from heel to toe on the gritty floor-stone. Concentration fixes on the precise distance between your knuckles and the cold brass rim of the key, and you shut out the scratching of the distant nib and the restless stacks. The gatekeeper gives a sudden, sharp snort. His hand twitches toward his belt. Your window narrows before your fingers can close around the cool metal.

check.label: Pinch the key from his belt

nodes.title: Caught in the Draft
nodes.brief: You slide past the gatekeeper's blind spot with effortless poise, swiping the iron gate-ring key from his belt.
nodes.page: A sudden gust of sulfurous air from the ventilation flues sweeps through the alcove, catching the hem of your coat and ballooning the canvas against the wooden balustrade. The gatekeeper jerks awake with a raspy curse, his ivory pointer snapping out to catch you across the knuckles with a sharp, stinging crack that leaves a dull ache in your bones. You tumble backward into a stack of discarded broadsheets, losing precious minutes gathering your scattered pencils while the old man glares through thick, yellowed spectacles and docks your weekly tallow allowance by three whole farthings.

nodes.title: The Stolen Ring
nodes.brief: You slide past the gatekeeper's blind spot with effortless poise, swiping the iron gate-ring key from his belt.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the cold, greasy metal of the key just as the gatekeeper exhales a long, whistling sigh and shifts his weight toward the wall. The leather thong slips free of its copper button with a faint, greasy pop. The iron ring rests entirely in your palm without a single metallic clink to betray the deed. You tuck the cold iron deep into your canvas bag beneath a bundle of damp blotting-paper, carrying away a small, silent token that unlocks every restricted passage between here and the deep stacks.

nodes.title: The Marginal Clause
nodes.brief: You spot an unwritten exemption clause in the rule-book on his podium, legally compelling him to open the gate.
nodes.page: Leather-bound volumes lean against one another like exhausted travellers on the high podium, their gilded lettering flaking off into dry golden dust. Your finger traces a cramped, handwritten note squeezed into the narrow gutter of page four hundred and twelve, penned in the spidery ink of some long-dead junior clerk. The rule is absurdly specific, citing an ancient ordinance from the Third Century of the Catalogues that grants any junior shelver the right of unhindered passage if the hour is prime and the ink-wells are full. You tap the margin firmly, knowing the custodian must heed the letter of the law or face a formal audit.

nodes.title: The Scholarly Citation
nodes.brief: You spot an unwritten exemption clause in the rule-book on his podium, legally compelling him to open the gate.
nodes.page: You clear your throat and recite the archaic clause with deliberate, unhurried cadence, matching the pedantic rhythm of the official code-books. The custodian freezes mid-reach, his ink-stained thumb hovering over a ledger entry as his mind races to cross-reference your absurd interpretation against forty years of administrative precedent. His jaw tightens behind his graying beard, his eyes darting frantically across the crowded shelves as he searches for a contradictory footnote that might let him deny your passage.

nodes.title: A Flawed Precedent
nodes.brief: You spot an unwritten exemption clause in the rule-book on his podium, legally compelling him to open the gate.
nodes.page: The custodian slams his heavy bone paper-knife against the mahogany desk with a dry, cracking sound that echoes sharply down the corridor. He points a trembling, ink-blackened finger at a later addendum scrawled in red ink across the flyleaf, proving that the clause you cited was formally repealed during the Great Binder's Strike. Your ears burn with mild humiliation as he slaps a fine-slip onto your ledger-board and demands two hours of tedious sorting in the damp basement among the moldering parish registers before you may take another step.

nodes.title: The Conceded Passage
nodes.brief: You spot an unwritten exemption clause in the rule-book on his podium, legally compelling him to open the gate.
nodes.page: The custodian lets out a long, wheezing hiss of reluctant surrender. His shoulders go slack. He has recognized the airtight logic of your citation. With a sour scowl he reaches for his brass stamp and inks the margin of your travel-permit with a deep purple impression that carries the full authority of the Cataloguers' Court. He shoves the paper across the counter without a single word. You fold the official waiver that turns every locked barrier into a portal.

nodes.title: The Descending Vault
nodes.brief: You step through the threshold into the deep shadows as the heavy iron doors begin their slow, irreversible descent.
nodes.page: You cross the damp stone threshold just as the massive iron counterweights begin their deep, grinding descent into the floor-slots. Dust cascades from the carved lintel like gray snow, stinging your eyes and coating your tongue with the taste of century-old lime and iron filings. Behind you the Reading Rooms fall quiet into a suffocating hush as the corridor narrows and the walls sweat cold moisture. The air grows noticeably thinner here, smelling strongly of charred willow-bark and ancient parchment that has never seen a living flame. You pull your collar tight against the draft, knowing the return path is sealing itself shut behind you for an entire generation.

nodes.title: Arguments over Ink-Scraps
nodes.brief: You manipulate the arguing monks with quick wit, convincing them to let you inspect their forbidden scrap-basket.
nodes.page:
Three red-robed monks crowd a high lectern, their dry voices rasping like parchment dragged across gravel as they dispute the ownership of a crumpled scrap of vellum. You step smoothly into their circle, dropping a well-timed quotation from the third chapter of the municipal tax code that stops their bickering cold. While they blink in sudden confusion, your fingers slip neatly into their wicker scrap-basket, lifting a discarded margin note that bears Thessaly Marr's familiar, hurried handwriting.

With a polite nod, you leave the baffled scholars to resume their theological dispute in peace.

exits.label: Inspect the recovered vellum scrap closely

nodes.title: The Scholar's Ledger
nodes.brief: You decipher the obscure dialect on the scholar's open ledger, trading a brilliant translation for a hidden map fragment.
nodes.page:
Candlelight flickers over an open calfskin ledger scrawled with a rival scholar's marginal notes in a crabbed, archaic dialect of the outer shelf-districts. You lean over the mahogany counter, pointing out a subtle error in the verb conjugation that unlocks the entire meaning of the page. Impressed despite himself, the scholar pushes a torn fragment of a bird's-eye map across the ink-stained wood in exchange for your fluent correction.

The parchment fragment fits snugly into your palm, showing a hidden stairwell behind the lending clerk's desk.

exits.label: Take the map fragment and slip away

nodes.title: Tales of the Lost Wings
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Old Barnaby sits on a battered brass trolley, his eyes clouded with cataracts as he launches once again into his endless chronicle of the wings that vanished during the great cataloguing reform of ninety-four. You nod at every appropriate interval and rest your fingers lightly on the cold iron handle of your compass-trolley. The repetition threatens to dull your wits, but patience is a shelver's truest armor against the madness of the deeper aisles.

exits.label: Continue listening to the ancient cartographer

nodes.title: The Compass-Trolley's Guidance
nodes.brief: You endure the cartographer's maddeningly repetitive tales of lost wings, retaining your sanity and a reliable compass-trolley.
nodes.page: Hours seem to dissolve into the smell of stale lamp-oil and drifting dust while Barnaby finally winds down his labyrinthine narrative with a wheezing sigh. Your reward for enduring the ordeal is a fully functional compass-trolley whose iron needle twitches reliably toward the nearest dry corridor. You check the leather straps, load your spare ink-pots, and prepare to leave the relative safety of the galleried halls for the shifting shadows beyond.

exits.label: Push the trolley into the gloom

nodes.title: The Sliding Stacks
nodes.brief: You emerge into the shifting expanse of the Unshelved Stacks where towering mahogany bookcases slide across stone floors to block old pathways.
nodes.page: Towering mahogany bookcases grind across the flagged floor with the groaning resonance of shifting tectonic plates, parting briefly to reveal narrow chasms of gloom before slamming shut again to seal off yesterday's thoroughfares. You lift your tin lamp higher, wincing as a cascade of dislodged octavos rains down from the upper shelves to shatter against the damp flags with sharp, papery reports. The air tastes of copper-gall ink and scorched tallow while countless uncatalogued volumes slide into new, unauthorized geometries. Ahead, several massive iron cases converge on a central junction, steel feet scraping deep furrows into the stone; miss their timing and they will crush your glass chimney.

exits.label: Dash across before the iron cases lock

nodes.title: The Iron Junction
nodes.brief: The Iron Junction: Several sliding iron cases converge at a central junction, threatening to crush your lamp if you misjudge their timing.
nodes.page: Several massive sliding iron cases converge at a central junction, grinding together with a tooth-aching shriek that threatens to shatter your lamp if you misjudge their timing. The floor beneath your boots vibrates with the immense weight of thousands of forgotten volumes shifting toward unseen destinations. Narrow gaps open briefly between the iron flanks, offering glimpses of deeper aisles choked with drifting dust. Every passage looks equally perilous, demanding absolute precision from anyone daring to cross.

exits.label: Dodge through the closing iron gap
Leap across the swaying oak tiers

nodes.title: Carved Floor Numbers
nodes.brief: You decode the carved numbering systems on the floor tiles to find a safe standing seam, securing an oil-flask from a crushed ledge.
nodes.page:
Frost-white numerals are chiseled into the gray paving stones, marking out a complex mathematical sequence that governs the movement of the heavy iron cases overhead. You trace the fading digits with the toe of your boot, stepping carefully from one safe seam to the next while the metal walls rumble inches from your shoulder. Wedged between the base of a crushed shelving unit, a brass oil-flask gleams dully in the dim light of your flickering wick.

You reach down, pry the flask free from the debris, and tip it once to judge what sits inside.

exits.label: Advance to the next numbered seam

nodes.title: The Numbered Seam
nodes.brief: You decode the carved numbering systems on the floor tiles to find a safe standing seam, securing an oil-flask from a crushed ledge.
nodes.page: Another sequence of worn numerals appears under your soles, etched deeply into the dark stone to warn of shifting foundation blocks. The air grows noticeably colder here, smelling strongly of iron filings and vinegar-ink from some unsealed vat in the floor below. You keep your eyes fixed on the carved patterns, ignoring the scraping sound of thousands of pages rustling in the darkness behind you. Every stone must be weighed and tested before you commit your full weight.

nodes.title: Reading the Floor Glyphs
nodes.brief: You decode the carved numbering systems on the floor tiles to find a safe standing seam, securing an oil-flask from a crushed ledge.
nodes.page: The numbering system suddenly breaks its predictable rhythm, branching into three overlapping geometric series that seem to contradict one another on the damp stone. You hold your smoking lamp lower, squinting at the worn chisel-marks as the massive iron cases on either side begin to accelerate their grinding crawl toward each other. You must calculate the exact intersection point before the walls meet.

nodes.title: A Crushing Misstep
nodes.brief: You decode the carved numbering systems on the floor tiles to find a safe standing seam, securing an oil-flask from a crushed ledge.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the stone floor throws your calculations into disarray, and you leap forward just as the iron wall slams shut behind you with a deafening crash. The impact rattles your teeth and scrapes a deep, raw graze across your forearm, sending your lamp flying into the gloom. You tumble hard onto the grit, clutching your bleeding arm while the darkness presses in close. Though you survived the squeeze, the cost in skin and spilled oil is immediate and sharp.

exits.label: Pick yourself up from the grit

nodes.title: Through the Iron Gap
nodes.brief: You decode the carved numbering systems on the floor tiles to find a safe standing seam, securing an oil-flask from a crushed ledge.
nodes.page: You slip through the narrowing gap between the grinding bookcases just as they lock together with a heavy, final thud that echoes through the stacks. Your shoulder aches from the close brush, but your lamp remains lit and your wits are intact. Clutched in your fist is the dented brass oil-flask you salvaged from the ledge, its contents sloshing steadily against the metal walls. You catch your breath in the sudden, eerie silence of the new aisle.

nodes.title: The Swinging Oak Tiers
nodes.brief: You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel.
nodes.page: You cross the widening void between two swaying oak tiers as the floorboards shudder and groan underfoot. Dust hangs in the amber glare of your sputtering lamp while bound volumes shift in the gloom. On the far ledge among the debris, a discarded brass-bound clasp catches what little light there is - a secure fastening for your travel satchel. You pocket the metal piece and look into the drifting dark ahead.

exits.label: Clamber across the swaying timber ledge

nodes.title: Leap Across the Gap
nodes.brief: You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel.
nodes.page: A sudden tremor shakes the towering oak shelves, widening the chasm between the swaying cases until the dark drop below gapes like an open mouth. You crouch low on the trembling floorboards, measuring the distance with a sharp eye while the smell of old paper and lamp-oil thickens in the damp air. Tense muscles bunch in your thighs as you prepare to spring across the void before the gap widens beyond reach.

nodes.title: Stumbling on the Timbers
nodes.brief: You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel.
nodes.page: Your boots strike the slick edge of the opposite shelf at an awkward angle, sending a shower of loose parchment fluttering down into the black abyss. Pain shoots up your ankle as you slam hard against the heavy oak upright, nearly dropping your precious lamp-oil into the dark. You drag yourself over the lip of the tier with a grimace, nursing a bruised shoulder while the groaning shelves settle back into their grinding routine.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: The Firm Landing
nodes.brief: You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel.
nodes.page: Your boots carry you lightly across the hazardous void just as the oak tiers grind to a sudden, jarring halt against one another. You land with secure footing on the dusty ledge, your fingers closing around a sturdy brass-bound clasp left behind by a previous shelver. This small prize fastens securely to your travel satchel, offering a reliable latch for the long hours ahead in the shifting stacks.

exits.label: Follow the narrowing stack edge forward

nodes.title: Bracing Against the Timber
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder firmly against the grinding timber to halt a shifting wall of encyclopedias, gaining a helpful tip on local navigation.
nodes.page: Grinding timber presses against your shoulder as an entire wall of encyclopedias begins to slide sideways with relentless, crushing force. You lean your full weight into the leather-bound spines, halting the slow migration of knowledge with straining muscles and gritted teeth. A fellow shelver's chalked warning on the adjacent shelf points out a safer route through the rattling stacks. You memorize the faded arrow before the heavy case resumes its slow journey into the dark.

nodes.title: Halt the Shifting Wall
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder firmly against the grinding timber to halt a shifting wall of encyclopedias, gaining a helpful tip on local navigation.
nodes.page: Iron gears shriek behind the oak panels as a towering wall of heavy encyclopedias surges forward, threatening to pin you against the stone pillar. You plant both palms flat against the cold leather spines, summoning every ounce of stubborn resolve to check the crushing momentum. The timber shudders beneath your weight, resisting your push with the accumulated gravity of ten thousand forgotten facts.

nodes.title: Pinned by the Tomes
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder firmly against the grinding timber to halt a shifting wall of encyclopedias, gaining a helpful tip on local navigation.
nodes.page: The bookcase surges forward despite your shove and slams into your shoulder. Pain flares and your breath catches. You squeeze sideways through the narrow gap just in time. A torn scrap of your sleeve stays wedged between the iron shelves. Dust fills your lungs. You cough hard in the damp gloom and stumble clear of the treacherous timber.

exits.label: Drag yourself past the jammed case

nodes.title: The Steadfast Hold
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder firmly against the grinding timber to halt a shifting wall of encyclopedias, gaining a helpful tip on local navigation.
nodes.page: Stubborn pressure brings the sliding wall of encyclopedias to a groaning halt just inches from your chest, proving your resolve matches the ancient timber. Carved into the wooden upright near your hand is a helpful tip on local navigation left by an earlier visitor. You trace the scratched arrows with your thumb, committing the secret path through the moving stacks to memory before moving on.

nodes.title: The Iron Bulkhead
nodes.brief: A heavy iron bulkhead slams shut ahead, leaving only a narrow transom through which dark lamp-oil drips into a stagnant pool below.
nodes.page: Iron panels slide together across the vaulted passage and crash shut; the shock runs up through your boots. A narrow transom stays open near the ceiling, and thick dark lamp-oil drips through it in a slow rhythm into a stagnant pool below. Mineral grease and old ink mark the air where the orderly rows give way to the flooded sumps. You wipe soot from your forehead and peer through the iron gap into the dark beyond.

nodes.title: The Sump of Pages
nodes.brief: The Sump of Pages: Discarded manuscripts form soggy drifts around a sluggish stream of black ink that swallows stray footsteps.
nodes.page: Soggy drifts of discarded manuscripts carpet the damp floor around a sluggish stream of black ink that swallows stray footsteps without a sound. Faint whispers rise from the wet pages, murmuring forgotten arguments and unread tragedies into the gloom. Every surface gleams with a slick, greasy sheen under the feeble light of your lamp, offering several uncertain paths across the mire.

exits.label: Wade through the black ink stream
Trace the swirling ink patterns carefully
Brave the bitter cold of the rising tide
Salvage intact cartography from the muck
Cross the chasm on the bridge of spines

nodes.title: The Vapours Rise
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the noxious vapours rising from the dark stream, retrieving a waterproof ledger of forgotten debts.
nodes.page:
Thick, chemical fumes drift upward from the sluggish surface of the black stream, carrying the sharp scent of copper and burnt tannin that stings the back of your throat. Bending low over the unstable margin of pulp and silt, your fingers graze the soaked leather binding of a waterproof ledger containing forgotten debts.

A faint murmuring rises from the damp pages as you lift the book clear of the muck, urging you to step away from the encroaching fog before the lamp-oil gutters completely.

nodes.title: Withstanding the Fumes
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the noxious vapours rising from the dark stream, retrieving a waterproof ledger of forgotten debts.
nodes.page: Greasy vapors coil around your temples and threaten to cloud your judgment and blur the cramped columns of figures written in the water-damaged ledger. You clench your jaw against the dizziness. Boots brace against the shifting pulp while you pull the damp volume entirely free from the suction of the ink-stream.

check.label: Anchor your resolve against the rising vapours

nodes.title: Cost of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the noxious vapours rising from the dark stream, retrieving a waterproof ledger of forgotten debts.
nodes.page: Lungs burn. Your head pounds from the noxious fumes. At the critical moment your grip slips, and a shower of ink-stained pages flies into the dark stream. You stumble backward onto firmer shelving and cough hard as your last flask of lamp-oil shatters against the stone.
