Now you grope through the gloom with only the faint whispering margin-notes to guide your hands.

exits.label: Flee deeper into the dark stacks

nodes.title: The Unwritten Page
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the noxious vapours rising from the dark stream, retrieving a waterproof ledger of forgotten debts.
nodes.page:
Smoke and shadow swirl around you. You secure the ledger against your chest and come out of the choking vapours with your wits intact. Between the waterlogged records of forgotten debts, your thumb catches on a completely blank, dry leaf of parchment that smells faintly of clean ozone rather than ink.

You tuck the pristine sheet into your coat. Not every volume in the world needs to be read or rewritten.

nodes.title: Beneath the Waterlogged Treatises
nodes.brief: You push through a thick wall of waterlogged treatises with quiet determination, uncovering a hidden pouch of silver coinage.
nodes.page:
Layers of soggy, unread treatises block your advance through the narrow aisle, pressing against your chest with the cold weight of centuries of neglected scholarship. With steady, deliberate shoves, you clear a passage through the dissolving pulp, your fingers suddenly brushing against a hard, metallic shape wedged deep within the soggy bindings.

Pulling aside the damp paper reveals a small pouch that clinks softly with old silver coinage, enough to buy passage or supplies from the clerks above.

nodes.title: Pressing the Bound Wall
nodes.brief: You push through a thick wall of waterlogged treatises with quiet determination, uncovering a hidden pouch of silver coinage.
nodes.page: The mass of waterlogged treatises shifts menacingly under your weight, threatening to collapse into a suffocating avalanche of pulp and mud that would pin you to the floor indefinitely. Bracing your shoulders against the damp, swaying stack, you summon every ounce of inner strength to keep the barrier from sliding closed while your hand gropes blindly for the hidden pouch.

check.label: Hold back the heavy paper wall

nodes.title: Buried in Pulp
nodes.brief: You push through a thick wall of waterlogged treatises with quiet determination, uncovering a hidden pouch of silver coinage.
nodes.page: The unstable wall of books finally gives way with a wet thud, burying your arms in a freezing slurry of ink and decaying paper that tears your coat sleeve and opens a deep scratch across your wrist. You claw your way back to the surface gasping for air, poorer by a day's worth of dried rations that dissolved into the grey slush during the scramble.

exits.label: Drag yourself from the damp ruins

nodes.title: Recovered Coin
nodes.brief: You push through a thick wall of waterlogged treatises with quiet determination, uncovering a hidden pouch of silver coinage.
nodes.page: You heave yourself clear of the collapsing pile just as the final treatises settle into the mud, clutching the small leather pouch of silver coinage against your ribs, however narrowly. The heavy coins jingle softly against your belt, providing both a tangible reward for your perseverance and a practical means to bribe any wary sentries you might encounter ahead.

nodes.title: Tracing the Black Current
nodes.brief: You trace the swirling patterns of the ink-stream with clever fingers to unearth a brass skeleton key from the sludge.
nodes.page:
Swirling patterns of oily black ink trace intricate, labyrinthine designs across the surface of the sluggish channel, mirroring the shifting architecture of the stacks themselves. Your fingers move carefully along the edge of the current, feeling for anything solid hidden beneath the floating debris of torn indexes and damp pamphlets.

A jagged piece of brass catches your skin before your fingertips hook firmly through the cold, ornate bow of a skeleton key resting in the sediment.

exits.label: Lift the brass key from the sludge

nodes.title: The Key in the Sludge
nodes.brief: You trace the swirling patterns of the ink-stream with clever fingers to unearth a brass skeleton key from the sludge.
nodes.page:
Cold metal scrapes stone while you pry the brass skeleton key free of the thick gelatinous sediment lining the ink-stream's bed. The teeth of the key are notched in an unfamiliar pattern. It looks made for a restricted cabinet or a private vault within the deeper annexe, not any ordinary shelver's locker.

You pocket the cold metal. Somewhere out of sight, shelves grind and shift. The corridors have started their migration again.

nodes.title: Snatching the Relic
nodes.brief: You trace the swirling patterns of the ink-stream with clever fingers to unearth a brass skeleton key from the sludge.
nodes.page: The surface of the ink-stream suddenly boils upward in a thick black wave, threatening to swallow the brass key back into the depths before your fingers can secure a proper grip. Quick reflexes and delicate maneuvering are your only hope as you plunge your hand into the swirling vortex to snatch the metal before the current tears it away.

check.label: Snatch the key from the swirling ink

nodes.title: Slipped from the Fingers
nodes.brief: You trace the swirling patterns of the ink-stream with clever fingers to unearth a brass skeleton key from the sludge.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of dark liquid slams your wrist against the stone ledge, forcing your fingers open and sending the brass key plunging into a deep, fathomless drain in the floor. You nurse a bruised hand and a bruised ego as you watch the precious find vanish forever into the subterranean plumbing of the library, leaving you with nothing gained from the risky attempt.

exits.label: Withdraw your bruised and empty hand

nodes.title: The Brass Key in the Sump
nodes.brief: You trace the swirling patterns of the ink-stream with clever fingers to unearth a brass skeleton key from the sludge.
nodes.page: Sludge clings to your knuckles like cold grease, yet your careful fingers sift through the sodden paper drifts until they strike something unyielding. From the black current you lift an oil-darkened brass skeleton key, its wards shaped like the interlocking spines of an octavo folio. It is cold to the touch and smells faintly of old tallow and river silt. A quiet promise lingers in its heft, granting you the quiet leverage needed to turn stubborn bolts that were never meant to budge.

exits.label: Step carefully across the leather bridge

nodes.title: The Sump Edge
nodes.brief: You endure the bitter cold of the rising black tide without flinching, securing a bundle of dry linen rags for cleaning.
nodes.page: Frost clings to the iron bolts of the masonry as the black current laps against your boots with a weight like lead. Shivering in the draft from the deep stacks, you reach into the oily sludge and draw out a heavy wad of coarse linen rags, stiffened by decades of damp and printer's paste. They smell faintly of turpentine and old tallow. Squeezing the dark moisture from the fabric requires both hands and a stubborn disregard for the cold sinking into your marrow.

nodes.title: Pressing the Fabric
nodes.brief: You endure the bitter cold of the rising black tide without flinching, securing a bundle of dry linen rags for cleaning.
nodes.page: With the sodden rags cleared of the worst black grit, you spread them across a dry ledge of flagstone to catch the feeble warmth of your hurricane lamp. The oil flame flickers low, casting long, wavering shadows against shelves that seem to shift slightly when unobserved. Every surface in this wing is coated in a fine grey grime composed of pulverized book-dust and soot. By folding the coarse cloths into tight pads, you create a makeshift barrier against the corrosive ink-spray drifting from the swollen channel nearby.

nodes.title: Resisting the Current
nodes.brief: You endure the bitter cold of the rising black tide without flinching, securing a bundle of dry linen rags for cleaning.
nodes.page: A sudden tremor shakes the basalt floor beneath your feet, sending a fresh surge of black grease spilling over the edge of the sump to wet your ankles. Burning juniper smells dry and choking all at once, while unseen marginalia hiss their whispers from the darkness behind the stacks. You plant your boots firmly against the greasy stone, tightening your grip on the salvaged bundle while the relentless tide threatens to sweep your footing away into the deep drains.

nodes.title: A Bitter Toll
nodes.brief: You endure the bitter cold of the rising black tide without flinching, securing a bundle of dry linen rags for cleaning.
nodes.page: The surge proves too fierce for your footing, slamming your shoulder hard against a projecting corner of iron shelving and wrenching a sharp gasp from your throat. The impact tears your coat sleeve and scatters your newly gathered linen rags into the black torrent, where they dissolve instantly into grey pulp. Nursing a dull, bruising throb in your shoulder and shivering from the chill, you drag yourself back onto the dry path, poorer by a bundle of supplies but still breathing.

nodes.title: The Clean Extraction
nodes.brief: You endure the bitter cold of the rising black tide without flinching, securing a bundle of dry linen rags for cleaning.
nodes.page: Whatever the cost in cold sweat and strained muscle, your stubborn endurance pays off as the black wave breaks harmlessly against your boots and recedes back into the depths. Tucking the dry bundle of linen securely beneath your arm, you find that the struggle has left you with something unexpected: a tightly rolled sheaf of water-resistant parchment wedged inside the rags, covered in neat, unfamiliar cataloguing symbols.

exits.label: Return to the ink stream hub

nodes.title: Voices in the Silt
nodes.brief: You master your dread of the whispering dampness to salvage an intact volume of ancient cartography from the muck.
nodes.page: Whispers drift from the damp crevices between the stone blocks, repeating fragments of sentences you read yesterday in volumes that have since changed their text. Ignoring the faint, papery rustle of unseen pages turning in the dark, you probe the sludge near the base of a sagging wooden case. Your fingers encounter the stiff, water-swollen leather of a binding that refuses to yield to the rot, wedged tight beneath a collapsed tier of discarded ledgers.

nodes.title: Cartography of Ruin
nodes.brief: You master your dread of the whispering dampness to salvage an intact volume of ancient cartography from the muck.
nodes.page: Pulling the thick volume clear of the muck, you scrape away a crust of dried ink with your thumbnail to reveal faded copperplate cartography stamped onto calfskin. The maps depict corridors and archive rooms that do not exist in the current catalogue, their ink lines shifting slightly under the lamplight as if recording a geography that continues to redraw itself while you watch. The binding groans under your touch, warm with a low, faint pulse like a sleeping heart.

nodes.title: The Whispering Murk
nodes.brief: You master your dread of the whispering dampness to salvage an intact volume of ancient cartography from the muck.
nodes.page: A sudden, chorus-like murmur rises from the margins of the salvaged maps, a swarm of tiny voices warning you that the ink-channel is about to flood its banks entirely. The lamp-oil gutters low, sputtering against the damp air as shadows lengthen and begin to detach themselves from the rows of silent shelves. You must close your mind to the enticing, false directions hissed by the paper ghosts and trust only the steady memory of your own footsteps in the dark.

nodes.title: The Price of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You master your dread of the whispering dampness to salvage an intact volume of ancient cartography from the muck.
nodes.page: Distracted by the persuasive voices whispering from the margins, you misjudge your step on the slick stone and plunge knee-deep into a stagnant pocket of black runoff. The ancient cartography slips from your numbed fingers, tumbling into the viscous fluid where it dissolves into a greasy smudge before you can snatch it back. Soaking wet and cursing under your breath, you haul yourself out onto higher ground, poorer in patience and supplies.

nodes.title: Salvaged Secrets
nodes.brief: You master your dread of the whispering dampness to salvage an intact volume of ancient cartography from the muck.
nodes.page: Against the tide of whispering voices you hold your place and pull a tangible prize from the edge of the muck. Tucked safely inside the back cover of the ancient volume before it could ruin is a slender bone stylus tipped with hardened silver, etched with the official mark of a long-vanished junior cataloguer. It hums with a faint, residual static whenever it passes close to the ink-channels.

exits.label: Return to the ink stream hub

nodes.title: The Ledger Span
nodes.brief: You cross a narrow chasm on a precarious suspension bridge woven entirely from the heavy leather spines of discarded ledgers.
nodes.page:
Calfskin bindings groan beneath your boots. Waxed cord still carries the murmur of old legal disputes. Below this precarious suspension bridge, a chasm of shifting shadows exhales the cold scent of damp rag paper and oxidized copper ink. Every step sends a tremor through the woven spines of discarded ledgers, and a flurry of marginal notes drifts upward, pale and frantic. You grip your lamp tighter. Vertical walls begin to slide against one another until the passage narrows and the leather handrails writhe like live eels.

Oil sloshes in the tin. Long, jittery shadows fall across the embossed titles of forgotten bankruptcies and royal decrees. There is no turning back toward the flooded ink-channels. The shelves behind you have already retracted into the masonry.

nodes.title: The Spine Span
nodes.brief: The Spine Span: A trembling bridge of stitched bindings sways over a bottomless vertical shaft filled with rustling loose-leaf papers.
nodes.page: Trembling bindings sway violently over a bottomless vertical shaft where thousands of loose-leaf papers rustle in the updraft. The air here tastes of iron filings and ancient parchment dust, thick enough to coat your teeth. Across the void, shadowy corridors branch away into the gloom, each promising a different route through the erratic heart of the Uncatalogued Stacks. Your lamp flame flickers low, starved of fresh oxygen by the deep stone vents.

nodes.title: The Flawed Lashing
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural flaw in the lashings and bypass the weakest section, securing an ivory bookmark engraved with secret wards.
nodes.page:
Tucked behind a swinging stack of quarto volumes, the hempen lashings on the gantry go slack as drifting iron shelves load them down. You trace the fraying strands with cautious fingers, bypassing the treacherous span entirely by stepping onto a rigid bracket of old oak. Lodged between two chained ledgers lies an ivory bookmark, its surface cool to the touch and finely etched with wards that prickle against your skin with the faint taste of copper.

Slip the engraved talisman into your coat pocket and leave the sagging timber behind.

exits.label: Climb along the reinforced oak bracket

nodes.title: Reading the Stitches
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural flaw in the lashings and bypass the weakest section, securing an ivory bookmark engraved with secret wards.
nodes.page: The suspension cords groan under a sudden gust of dry, paper-scented wind rising from the abyss below. You press yourself flat against the vertical stack-face, trying to calculate the exact tension required to cross the frayed gap without snapping the remaining threads. Your fingers trace the embossed lettering on a nearby spine, searching for the hidden structural pins that hold the entire hanging bridge in equilibrium.

nodes.title: A Slipping Grasp
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural flaw in the lashings and bypass the weakest section, securing an ivory bookmark engraved with secret wards.
nodes.page: The leather loop gives way with a wet snap, dropping your lead boot into empty space and sending a shower of loose index cards into the dark. You catch yourself by the elbows against a jutting mahogany shelf, but the sudden jolt sends your tin oil flask clattering into the depths. A sharp splinter of dry oak pierces your left sleeve, leaving a shallow, burning scratch across your forearm. You haul yourself back onto solid timber, panting as the shelves grind shut behind you.

nodes.title: The Secured Binding
nodes.brief: You spot a hidden structural flaw in the lashings and bypass the weakest section, securing an ivory bookmark engraved with secret wards.
nodes.page: You keep your footing on the shifting stacks long enough for your fingers to snag a tangible prize from the edge of the gap. The leather eases just enough for you to scramble onto safer timber. A small token sits in your palm and warms faintly against your skin whenever the library lamps flare.

nodes.title: Tension in the Leather
nodes.brief: You negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page.
nodes.page:
Suspended chains creak as you test the weight of the hanging leather footway, its thick hide stretched tight across a chasm of dark ink-water. By reading the subtle grain of the dried hide and the rhythmic tremor of the links, you adjust your pace and offer a quiet nod to a nervous wandering page crouched near the guide-rope. The stranger relaxes, shares a dry crust of bread, and nods in respect for your footwork over the abyss.

Leave the cautious page to tend their lantern and press forward across the span.

exits.label: Cross the hanging leather to safety

nodes.title: Measuring the Drift
nodes.brief: You negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page.
nodes.page: The entire row of shelves shudders sideways, threatening to pinch your shoulders between two heavy oak presses. You watch the rhythm of the swinging spines, trying to anticipate the exact moment the gap between the hanging walkways will briefly narrow. Your mind races through the cataloguing codes for structural movement while the floorboards beneath your boots tilt at an alarming angle.

nodes.title: Caught in the Press
nodes.brief: You negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page.
nodes.page: The oak shelves slam together a fraction too soon, and they catch the brim of your cap and tear your canvas satchel at the seam. You wrench yourself free. A valuable bundle of salvaged blank leaves stays crushed between the wooden blocks. Your shoulder is bruised and aching. The stone floor knocks under your boots in time with the bruise.

nodes.title: The Cleared Margin
nodes.brief: You negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page.
nodes.page: You slip through the grinding timber frames into the adjacent alcove. The stranger in the ink-stained coat watches your escape with dry approval and tosses a small token across the widening gap before he slips back into the shadows. You catch it cleanly in your palm. A borrowed brass key rests there, sized for the subsidiary locks of the lower stacks.

nodes.title: The Swaying Span
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page:
The stitched bindings of the bridge flex underfoot like living tendons across the abyss of falling papers. Dust hangs in the amber radius of your guttering oil-lamp, and beneath your boots the timber ribs groan and heave with the subterranean tide. Ahead, among the fluttering loose-leaf debris, a fine steel reading knife catches a stray slant of pale lantern light. You reach out. Your fingers curl around the cold hilt just as the entire pathway drops an inch into the gloom.

You ride out the violent roll and make your way toward the further side where the spine bridge meets the solid oak of the misfiled wing.

nodes.title: Crossing the Ribs
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page:
Slipping past the trembling margins of the bridge, your boots find purchase on a spine-bound rail that pitches wildly in the draft. The reading knife is already tucked securely into your belt, its tempered edge humming with a faint, low-pitched vibration against your ribs. Loose pages swirl in a miniature tempest around your ankles, whispering fragments of forgotten histories that dissolve before they can be fully read. Below, the vertical shaft yawns wide, smelling powerfully of old leather, dried paste, and damp lime.

Every muscle in your legs strains to compensate for the erratic motion of the suspended floor until you finally reach the firm stone of the adjoining alcove.

nodes.title: Balancing the Tremor
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page: Sensation drains from your fingertips as the spine bridge below your boots suddenly bucks upward like a startled animal in a dark stable. You drop into a low crouch, arms spread wide to catch the shifting center of gravity while the steel reading knife jingles against your canvas satchel. Every plank groans in protest, threatening to pitch you over the low wooden rail and into the paper-choked chasm spinning endlessly below. You fix your eyes on the glinting brass latch of the opposite door, waiting for the precise heartbeat when the violent oscillation pauses.

nodes.title: A Heavy Toll
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page: A sudden lateral wrench of the bridge sweeps your boots out from under you, sending you sprawling hard across the abrasive spine-bindings. The sharp edge of a protruding board catches your forearm, tearing through your woolen sleeve and leaving a bright, stinging red graze that begins to ooze against your cuff. You lose your grip on a spare tallow taper, watching it bounce once before vanishing into the dark vertical shaft below. Gasping for breath in the dust-thick air, you drag yourself over the threshold into the next alcove, richer by a fresh scar and poorer by your best candle.

nodes.title: The Kept Blade
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page: You get across the bucking span and land on the firm boards beyond. Inside your damp satchel sits the prize; a few scraped knuckles and a shaken frame were the whole cost. It is a finely balanced steel reading knife, pommel engraved with the discreet seal of the central registry, blade keen enough to cut stubborn leather binding cord in one stroke. Breath comes back in short pulls. You turn the instrument once in your palm, then face the deeper stacks.

nodes.title: The Soot-Choked Conduit
nodes.brief: The air grows thick with stinging carbon grit as you enter a narrow corridor flanked by unlit wall sconces and heavy soot.
nodes.page:
Grey carbon grit billows from the low ceiling as you force your way into a narrow corridor flanked by unlit wall sconces and banks of soot. The air tastes of scorched parchment and ancient lamp-oil. Bitter film coats the tongue. Along the blackened stonework, bronze sconces drip with cold grease, and their unlit wicks send up thin oily wisps of smoke that swirl into strange shapes above your head. Scratching noises issue from behind the wainscot, as though little teeth were gnawing through the backing boards of the lowest shelves.

You press your shoulder against the warm masonry that trembles under your palm. Your hood stays low against the grit. The corridor narrows ahead.

nodes.title: The Smoky Refuge
nodes.brief: The Sooted Alcove: A secluded shelving bay filled with smoke-stained biographies offers temporary shelter from the prevailing draughts.
nodes.page: A secluded shelving bay filled with smoke-stained biographies offers temporary shelter from the prevailing draughts of the lower levels. The floor here is littered with discarded book-plates and greasy soot-flakes that cling to your boots like grey snow, while a faint, stagnant warmth radiates from the masonry behind the shelves. To one side, a heavy wooden cabinet sits half-shrouded in shadow with a rusted latch, while an old woollen scarf soaked in soothing herbal oil hangs neglected from a nearby brass bracket. The gloom presses close on every hand, whispering of hidden caches and blocked passages waiting to be discovered by anyone bold enough to search the shadows.

nodes.title: The Charred Wainscot
nodes.brief: You interpret the faded annotations on a charred manuscript to locate a hidden cache of refined lamp-oil behind the wainscot.
nodes.page:
You kneel beside the smoke-stained biographies and trace the faded annotations on a burnt theological manuscript. Green ink marks the way. In the gloom it holds a faint luminous tinge and points you toward a loose oak panel near the floorboards. Your fingers slide into the narrow gap. A cold draft proves a cavity waits behind the wall. One gentle tug swings the panel inward on silent, well-oiled hinges, and glass flasks throw a dull glint from the dark recesses.

A row of glass phials filled with refined lamp-oil rests on shredded news-sheets, clear of the soot that coats the corridor outside.

nodes.title: The Hidden Cache
nodes.brief: You interpret the faded annotations on a charred manuscript to locate a hidden cache of refined lamp-oil behind the wainscot.
nodes.page:
You lift the glass phials from their dusty bed and check each stopper so the precious oil has not leaked away during decades of neglect. The liquid gleams pale amber. It smells faintly of pressed olives and dried lavender rather than the foul tallow burned by the city porters. You slip three of the phials into your satchel and space them so they will not clink together as you walk. Warmth from the hidden compartment seeps into your chilled fingers, a brief break from the biting damp that fills every corner of the Underlibrary.

You close the oak panel with a soft click, stand up, and scan the dim smoke-hung corridor for the next stretch of your journey.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Burned Marginalia
nodes.brief: You interpret the faded annotations on a charred manuscript to locate a hidden cache of refined lamp-oil behind the wainscot.
nodes.page:
Squinting in the uncertain amber glow of your lamp, you bend close to the crumbling parchment of the charred manuscript resting on the shelf. The annotations are written in a cramped, archaic hand that shifts and blurs whenever the flickering lamplight catches the greasy soot-flakes suspended in the air. You mutter the complex sequence of cross-references under your breath, trying to reconcile the misfiled shelf marks with the architectural anomalies of the surrounding stacks. A wrong turn here could plunge you straight into the burning flues or leave you trapped behind a wall of sliding timber presses.

Your mind races through the catalogue codes while the ink on the page begins to pulse with a faint, warning heat beneath your fingertips.

nodes.title: Smoke and Ash
nodes.brief: You interpret the faded annotations on a charred manuscript to locate a hidden cache of refined lamp-oil behind the wainscot.
nodes.page: Your eyes water sharply as a sudden gust of sulfurous air blows back from the dark recesses of the wainscot, blurring the intricate ink marks into an unreadable smudge. In your confusion, you misjudge the shelving alignment and your shoulder strikes a protruding iron bracket with a heavy, sickening thud. A sharp ache radiates down your arm, numbing your hand and sending your oil-lamp clattering against the stone floor where its glass chimney shatters into a thousand glittering shards. You are left groping in near-total darkness, smelling the rich scent of spilled oil soaking uselessly into the stone floor while your bruised shoulder throbs in rhythm with your racing pulse.

nodes.title: The Amber Phials
nodes.brief: You interpret the faded annotations on a charred manuscript to locate a hidden cache of refined lamp-oil behind the wainscot.
nodes.page: Your reading of the cryptic marginalia opens a profitable harvest from the hidden recess behind the wainscot. You pocket the last of the sealed glass phials of refined lamp-oil, their contents promising many hours of clear, steady illumination in the gloom of the deep stacks. The ancient annotations remain clear in your memory, quiet proof that the old classification rules still work against the chaos of the drifting library. Slinging your satchel over your shoulder, you step out from the smoky alcove and prepare to face the moving timber labyrinth ahead.

nodes.title: The Rusted Latch
nodes.brief: You expertly pick the rusted latch on a locked journal cabinet to find a bundle of dry tallow tapers inside.
nodes.page:
Amber lamp-light flickers over a heavy iron cabinet wedged deep between two shifting rows of leather-bound volumes. Beneath a crust of verdigris and forgotten grease, a stubborn brass latch guards the dark interior from curious hands. Pressing the flat of your thumb against the cold metal, you slide a slim brass spine from your pocket to feel for the hidden tumblers within.

The mechanism gives a dry, muffled click as it yields to your practiced touch, swinging wide to reveal a neat stack of dry tallow tapers bundled tightly with coarse twine.

nodes.title: Tapers in the Dark
nodes.brief: You expertly pick the rusted latch on a locked journal cabinet to find a bundle of dry tallow tapers inside.
nodes.page:
Cool air drafts through the narrow gap in the wainscot, carrying the faint scent of old tallow and burnt peat from the lower stacks. Reaching into the dark recess of the journal cabinet, your fingers brush against the rough twine binding the fresh tapers together. Each candle is thick and pale, smelling faintly of rendered mutton fat and cellar dust, ready to push back the damp of the uncatalogued wings.

Lifting the bundle free from its dusty resting place, you tuck the tapers securely into your satchel beside your spare ink-bottle and lamp-oil flask.

nodes.title: Reaching Through the Gap
nodes.brief: You expertly pick the rusted latch on a locked journal cabinet to find a bundle of dry tallow tapers inside.
nodes.page:
Shadows lengthen across the floorboards as the neighbouring bookshelf shudders and begins its slow, mechanical drift toward the adjoining alcove. Snatch your hand back too soon and the prize stays locked forever; hesitate too long and the shifting oak frame will pin your wrist against the stone wall. You take one measured breath and slide your fingers back into the narrow gap of the cabinet while the timber groans and grinds its teeth against the floor.

You angle your fingers toward the hidden brass lever deep within the shadowed recess, testing the weight of the mechanism as the gap narrows.

check.label: Slide fingers into the moving gap

nodes.title: Caught in the Timber
nodes.brief: You expertly pick the rusted latch on a locked journal cabinet to find a bundle of dry tallow tapers inside.
nodes.page:
The oak frame catches your sleeve with sudden malice, drags your forearm hard against the iron latch, and prints a purple bruise across your skin. A sharp splinter of ancient deal bites deep into your palm, drawing a bright drop of blood that immediately stains the paper cuff of your jacket. You wrench your arm free with a frantic heave just as the shelves slam together with a hollow thud, crushing your last spare bottle of lamp-oil into fragrant shards.

Gathering your wits amidst the scattered glass and spilled oil, you nurse your bruised arm and limp onward into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Tallow Cache
nodes.brief: You expertly pick the rusted latch on a locked journal cabinet to find a bundle of dry tallow tapers inside.
nodes.page:
Working with the thin blade of a bone paper-knife, you expertly pick the rusted iron latch on a locked journal cabinet set deep within the wainscot. The stubborn hinge yields with a dry, protesting rasp, releasing a faint cloud of ancient dust that smells of dried lavender and old leather. Within the cedar-lined recess lies a tightly bound bundle of dry tallow tapers, wrapped in a broadsheet of discarded shipping manifests. They are remarkably well preserved against the damp air of the lower stacks, promising a steady, bright flame when your own lamp begins to sputter in the drafty corridors ahead.

Pocketing the bundle carefully among your loose papers, you leave the hollow cabinet behind and slip back into the shifting gloom of the stacks.

exits.label: Take shelter in the sooted alcove

nodes.title: Scarf in the Smoke
nodes.brief: You maintain your focus through the choking darkness to secure a woollen scarf soaked in soothing herbal oil.
nodes.page:
Thick, acrid smoke rolls across the floor from a smouldering cart of discarded encyclopaedias wedged in the adjacent aisle. Coughing behind your hand, you grope blindly along the rough wainscot until your fingers encounter a damp woolen wrap hanging from an iron peg. Drawing the thick cloth to your face, you breathe in the sharp, medicinal sting of herbal oil infused with dried eucalyptus and rosemary.

The soothing vapour clears your burning passages, restoring a measure of calm as you peer through the grey haze toward the darker stacks beyond.

nodes.title: Breathing Through the Haze
nodes.brief: You maintain your focus through the choking darkness to secure a woollen scarf soaked in soothing herbal oil.
nodes.page:
The air turns thick with the grey, suffocating dust of burnt paper as a distant shelf collapses into a heap of smouldering fragments. Your lungs burn for clean oxygen, and every instinct urges you to turn back toward the safety of the main stairwell. You shut your eyes against the soot, clamp the herbal-soaked scarf tight over your nose and mouth, and keep your chest from heaving while the heat presses in from all sides.

You steel your resolve against the panic scratching at your throat, standing firm as the suffocating cloud billows around your shoulders.

nodes.title: Choking on the Ash
nodes.brief: You maintain your focus through the choking darkness to secure a woollen scarf soaked in soothing herbal oil.
nodes.page:
A sudden, violent gust of sulfurous air tears the protective scarf from your grip, swirling the hot ash directly into your face. You stumble backward against a stack of folios, gasp, and swallow a mouthful of bitter, choking soot that leaves your throat raw. The delay costs you precious time and wastes half your remaining water flask just to rinse the grit from your mouth.

You wipe the black grime from your streaming eyes and stagger forward with a tight chest and a lingering cough.

nodes.title: The Herbal Compress
nodes.brief: You maintain your focus through the choking darkness to secure a woollen scarf soaked in soothing herbal oil.
nodes.page:
Bitter sulfur still hangs in the aisles. You hold your focus through the dark until your fingers brush a stray bundle on a peg at the end-panel. The hemp cord yields under stiff fingers, and you take a long woollen scarf soaked in herbal oil, mint and eucalyptus sharp enough to cut the smoke. You press the damp fabric to mouth and nose. Eyes stop watering. Breath settles into short pulls, and the worst stretch of the drift turns into a climb you can manage.

Through the scented wool the timber frames around you start a slow rotation, wood on wood.
nodes.grant: woollen scarf soaked in herbal oil

nodes.title: The Rotating Maze
nodes.brief: A labyrinth of identical wooden shelving units begins to rotate around you in slow circles, confusing your sense of direction.
nodes.page:
Floorboards shudder under your boots with a subterranean groan while entire rows of wooden shelving pivot in slow, concentric circles. Bound volumes slide from their ledges with dull thuds, and loose catalogue cards scatter across the shifting dust. A pale murmur rises. Forgotten margins whisper, "We speak as one". You duck beneath a swinging arm of folio cases just as the corridor seals itself shut behind you, and only one narrow gap opens toward the revolving heart of the stacks.

Old ink and dry paste smell sharper as the labyrinth resets its boundaries around your solitary lamp.

nodes.title: The Carousel of Tomes
nodes.brief: The Carousel of Tomes: A revolving circular chamber of encyclopaedias spins continuously, hiding the exit behind a blur of spinning labels.
nodes.page: Mahogany housings spin in endless concentric circles and throw long shadows across the stone floor; encyclopaedias of forgotten fauna blur into a wall of calfskin and gold leaf. The air smells of warm lamp-oil and pulverized vellum, thick with the grinding shriek of iron axles turning beneath the flags. Through the spinning gaps, tantalizing vistas beckon from the shifting maze, each passage promising a way forward before the turning walls swallow it whole. You grip your sputtering oil-lamp tighter against the draft, weighing which rotating gap to intercept before the machinery shifts its rhythm once more.

nodes.title: The Jammed Teeth
nodes.brief: You trick the rotation mechanism by tossing a heavy stone into the gear-teeth, capturing a stray cataloguer's brass stamp.
nodes.page: Heavy iron gears screech as they grind against the subterranean floorboards, sending vibrations straight up through the soles of your boots. Seizing a jagged fragment of masonry from a fallen plinth, you lean in close against the churning pressure and wedge the stone directly into the primary brass cogs. The deafening rotation stutters with a violent metallic groan, forcing the adjacent rows of shelving to lock rigid in a crooked, uneven alignment. A stray cataloguer's brass stamp lies wedged on the stationary ledge just beyond the jammed mechanism, glinting dully in the amber light of your lamp.

nodes.title: Seizing the Brass Stamp
nodes.brief: You trick the rotation mechanism by tossing a heavy stone into the gear-teeth, capturing a stray cataloguer's brass stamp.
nodes.page: Iron teeth grind violently against your makeshift stone wedge. They could shatter the masonry and set the mahogany shelves spinning back into motion with bone-crushing force. You calculate the exact tolerance of the straining brass cogs, timing your reach to slip past the biting pinch-point while the frame shudders. Muscles tense in your forearm as you thrust your fingers into the churning gap to snatch the heavy metal stamp before the jam gives way.

nodes.title: A Crushed Finger
nodes.brief: You trick the rotation mechanism by tossing a heavy stone into the gear-teeth, capturing a stray cataloguer's brass stamp.
nodes.page: Metal teeth bite down with unforgiving speed, shattering your stone wedge and catching the edge of your knuckles before you can jerk your hand back. Pain spikes through your fingers as the brass stamp is knocked deeper into the churning machinery, lost forever to the grinding cogs. You stumble backward onto the ash-strewn floor, nursing a badly bruised hand and leaving a smear of dark blood on the edge of the shelf. The rotation resumes with a mocking shudder, costing you precious lamp-oil and steady nerves as you limp away into the dim aisles.

nodes.title: The Heavy Seal
nodes.brief: You trick the rotation mechanism by tossing a heavy stone into the gear-teeth, capturing a stray cataloguer's brass stamp.
nodes.page: Fingers darting past the straining iron cogs with desperate precision, your hand closes firmly around the heavy brass stamp just as the stone wedge finally crumbles into gray powder. You yank your arm back an instant before the entire wall of shelving lunges forward with a renewed, deafening roar. A cold cataloguer's seal rests in your palm, carved with the insignia of the lower indices and notched with a curious private mark. You slip the recovered implement into your pocket, feeling the reassuring weight of official authority as you trace your steps back to the spinning hub.

nodes.title: The Patient Watch
nodes.brief: You wait with unwavering patience until the correct doorway aligns with your position, earning a reliable pocket compass.
nodes.page: Standing motionless in the shadow of a towering atlas case, you let the rhythmic thunder of the revolving stacks wash over you while dust motes dance in your lamp-light. Hours seem to dissolve into the smell of drying ink and ancient glue as entire rows of history and geography whirl past in a dizzying succession of leather spines. You watch the intersecting sightlines with steady concentration, waiting for the momentary pause when the chaotic geometry of the aisles resolves into a clear, straight corridor. Across the gap, a discarded pocket compass rests on a tilting bracket, its needle spinning wildly before settling toward some hidden magnetic north.

nodes.title: The Steady Vigil
nodes.brief: You wait with unwavering patience until the correct doorway aligns with your position, earning a reliable pocket compass.
nodes.page: The turning shelves groan as they shift positions once again, creating a claustrophobic corridor that threatens to pin you against the cold stone wall if your footing slips. A sudden gust of sulfurous wind sweeps down from the upper stacks, flickering your lamp and threatening to plunge you into total darkness while you wait for the final doorway to lock into place. You force your breathing to remain slow and even, fighting the rising panic that urges you to run blindly into the revolving maze.

nodes.title: Blinded by the Dust
nodes.brief: You wait with unwavering patience until the correct doorway aligns with your position, earning a reliable pocket compass.
nodes.page: A choking cloud of dry paper-dust billows from the revolving shelves, watering your eyes and breaking your concentration at the exact moment of alignment. You stumble forward into a closing gap, dropping your spare flask of lamp-oil as the heavy wooden panel slams shut against your shoulder with a dull thud. Bruised and disoriented in the growing gloom, you spend long, agonizing minutes groping along the cold timber until you find your bearings. The delay costs you half your remaining fuel and leaves you coughing in the stagnant air, but you drag yourself back toward the central chamber.

nodes.title: The True North
nodes.brief: You wait with unwavering patience until the correct doorway aligns with your position, earning a reliable pocket compass.
nodes.page: Unwavering patience pays off as the spinning wooden rows settle into a momentary, crystalline stillness, opening a direct line of sight straight through the heart of the rotating maze. You step forward through the newly formed gap, your boots making scarcely a sound on the dust-covered floorboards before the machinery dares to move again. Resting on the bracket is a sturdy brass pocket compass, its glass face unscratched and its needle locked firmly onto the faint magnetic pull of the deep stacks. You pocket the instrument with quiet satisfaction, turning your steps back toward the central chamber.

nodes.title: The Graceful Gap
nodes.brief: You time your exit with a graceful pirouette through the revolving gap, retrieving an intricately carved bone paper-knife.
nodes.page: Heavy leather-bound volumes shift and grind on either side of you, creating a narrow corridor that opens and closes like a mechanical jaw with every rotation of the stack. You measure the rhythmic cadence of the turning timber, watching the narrow slit where a glint of polished bone catches the amber glow of your lamp. Waiting for the precise heartbeat when the gap reaches its widest span, you prepare your limbs for a sudden, fluid movement that will carry you past the grinding teeth of the shelves. A small bone paper-knife, its carvings worn smooth, rests on the receding ledge, waiting for anyone daring enough to catch it on the wing.

nodes.title: The Flawless Arch
nodes.brief: You time your exit with a graceful pirouette through the revolving gap, retrieving an intricately carved bone paper-knife.
nodes.page: The gap in the rotating shelving narrows abruptly, transforming a generous opening into a razor-thin fissure of moving wood and iron trim. You launch yourself forward into the narrowing space, twisting your torso with instantaneous agility to slide between the crushing panels before the latch catches. The edge of the moving shelf clips your coat-tail with a sharp snap, but your momentum carries you cleanly into the recess.

nodes.title: Caught in the Timber
nodes.brief: You time your exit with a graceful pirouette through the revolving gap, retrieving an intricately carved bone paper-knife.
nodes.page: The gap snaps shut a fraction too fast, catching the hem of your tunic and pinning you hard against the rough wooden spine of a massive ledger. You wrench yourself away with a desperate heave, tearing the fabric free and leaving a long strip of cloth wedged deep within the unyielding cogs. The sudden struggle wrenches your shoulder painfully, leaving a dull ache that echoes down your spine as you tumble into the dusty recess. Though bruised and missing a piece of your coat, you gather your breath and limp back toward the central junction.

nodes.title: The Ivory Blade
nodes.brief: You time your exit with a graceful pirouette through the revolving gap, retrieving an intricately carved bone paper-knife.
nodes.page: You slip through the closing timber, shoulder brushing warm leather spines, and duck into the recess before the gap seals. The shelf groans and locks behind your heels with one final thud that cuts the passage off. In your hand sits a carved bone paper-knife covered in microscopic marginalia that shift and rewrite under your eyes. You pocket the strange blade, feel its chill through the cloth at your side, and retrace your path to the revolving hub.

nodes.title: The Misfiled Wing
nodes.brief: You stumble into the Misfiled Wing where misdirected histories and misplaced maps pile high in chaotic, unclassifiable heaps.
nodes.page: Drifts of uncatalogued maps and misdirected histories rise into chaotic sloping ramparts across the flagged floor. Loose vellum crunches beneath your boots like autumn leaves and hides the proper seams of the flagstones under drifts of misfiled paper. You stop short. Somewhere within these towering mounds of discarded paper the natural order of the stacks has completely unraveled, and only a vast wilderness of forgotten ink and displaced geography remains. Every surface wears a fine grey film of old dust that smells of rancid lamp-oil and dried gall. You pick your way. One careless step could bring a mountain of orphan folios down on your shoulders.

exits.label: Climb higher into the drifting paper mounds

nodes.title: Mountains of Stray Folios
nodes.brief: The Misfiled Wing: Mountains of stray folios and uncatalogued scrolls spill across the flagged floor in complete taxonomic disorder.
nodes.page: Mountains of stray folios and uncatalogued scrolls spill across the flagged floor in complete taxonomic disorder, a labyrinth of paper waste underfoot. Iron-gall ink and decaying rag-paper catch bitter in the throat with every shallow breath. Faint scratching comes from deep in the heaps; even here the texts will not lie still. You stand where several faint trails fork and vanish into the grey gloom of the stacks.

exits.label: Pick a narrow path through the poetry drifts
Traverse the unstable slopes of loose paper
Unearth a misplaced royal decree from beneath the rubbish
Recover a heavy brass reading glass using clever sleight of hand
Approach the turbulent river of jet-black ink

nodes.title: The Poetry Heaps
nodes.brief: You outwit a nest of territorial book-worms guarding a heap of poetry, claiming a rare manuscript of lyric verse.
nodes.page: Heaps of verse bound in frayed lambskin block the narrow corridor, their parchment leaves fluttering like trapped moths in the draught. A colony of pale, segmented book-worms stirs within the damp bindings, their blunt heads weaving hungriest towards the warmth of your lantern. You drop low, moving your light in slow, deliberate circles to confuse their blind senses while keeping your fingers clear of their clicking mandibles. Half-buried under a mound of epics sits a thick manuscript of lyrical odes, ready for anyone bold enough to snatch it away.

exits.label: Reach quickly into the shifting parchment

nodes.title: Reclaiming the Verses
nodes.brief: You outwit a nest of territorial book-worms guarding a heap of poetry, claiming a rare manuscript of lyric verse.
nodes.page: Thick colonies of territorial book-worms writhe across the margins of the poetry heap, their segmented bodies glistening with the oily residue of ancient glue. You inch your fingers toward the calfskin binding of the lyrical manuscript, watching their blunt heads snap rhythmically toward the amber glow of your lamp. One sudden movement will bring the entire writhing mass down upon your knuckles in a frenzy of hungry mandibles. You time your breath with their blind swaying, curling your fingers around the cool leather spine as you prepare to yank the prize free.

check.label: Snatch the rare manuscript before they strike

nodes.title: Tangled in the Binding
nodes.brief: You outwit a nest of territorial book-worms guarding a heap of poetry, claiming a rare manuscript of lyric verse.
nodes.page: Blind mandibles slash through the air a fraction too late, yet the sudden, violent twitch of the book-worm colony sends a shower of loose vellum cascading over your wrist. You jerk your arm back with a sharp hiss, leaving a jagged scratch across your forearm where acidic ink has seeped into the fresh skin. The rare manuscript remains trapped beneath a heavy avalanche of satirical verse, its leather corners chewed and glistening with slimy residue. You wipe the dark ink from your sleeve, nursing the dull, throbbing ache in your hand as the paper-pests retreat into the shadows.

exits.label: Return empty-handed to the main chamber

nodes.title: The Poet's Keep
nodes.brief: You outwit a nest of territorial book-worms guarding a heap of poetry, claiming a rare manuscript of lyric verse.
nodes.page: Quick fingers slip past the snapping jaws and snatch the calfskin manuscript from the writhing heap just as the colony collapses inward upon itself. You tuck the slim volume safely beneath your arm. Its yellowed leaves smell of dried lavender and old sorrow despite the surrounding dust. Book-worms retreat to their nests. A small token of salvaged poetry rests in your grip.

exits.label: Retrace your steps to the central crossroads

nodes.title: The Paper Slopes
nodes.brief: You deftly navigate the unstable drifts of loose paper without triggering a collapse, unearthing a leather-bound tally book.
nodes.page: Loose leaves of ledger-paper form treacherous, shifting scree slopes that threaten to slide away beneath the slightest weight. You crouch low, keeping your center of gravity balanced over the firmer stones hidden beneath the paper drifts. Every inch requires a delicate test of footing, listening closely to the dry rustle of vellum for any sign of an impending avalanche. A leather-bound tally book rests atop a precarious pillar of old customs records, just within reach if your footing holds.

exits.label: Step carefully toward the ledger pillar

nodes.title: Crossing the Tally Slopes
nodes.brief: You deftly navigate the unstable drifts of loose paper without triggering a collapse, unearthing a leather-bound tally book.
nodes.page: Slopes of loose, unnumbered paper shift treacherously beneath your boots with every subtle weight shift, threatening to carry you down into a deep crevasse of discarded tracts. You plant your heels firmly into the vellum drift, using your lantern arm to counterbalance the sudden sliding of a hundred administrative rolls. The leather-bound tally book teems on the edge of a paper precipice, its pages fluttering wildly in the sudden draught. You catch your breath and prepare to lunge across the unstable gap before the entire slope gives way beneath you.

check.label: Leap lightly across the sliding vellum drift

nodes.title: Buried in the Ledger
nodes.brief: You deftly navigate the unstable drifts of loose paper without triggering a collapse, unearthing a leather-bound tally book.
nodes.page: The paper slope gives way beneath your boot with a dry roar, plunging you knee-deep into a suffocating avalanche of municipal receipts and outdated tariffs. You claw your way back to the surface through a thick cloud of choking dust, coughing violently as grey particles coat your tongue. The leather tally book slips deeper into the slide. You are left with bruised shins and a torn hem to show for your trouble. You drag yourself onto solid flagstones, shaking the endless scraps of paper from your pockets with a muttered curse.

exits.label: Crawl back to the central hall

nodes.title: The Accountant's Ledger
nodes.brief: You deftly navigate the unstable drifts of loose paper without triggering a collapse, unearthing a leather-bound tally book.
nodes.page: Light steps dance across the sliding vellum, finding solid purchase on hidden flagstones just as the paper wave threatens to break beneath your weight. You scoop up the leather-bound tally book with a smooth, practiced motion, tucking it securely against your chest as the surrounding drifts settle into quiet stillness. The volume feels dense in your hands, its pages crammed with cramped notes on forgotten debts and lost shipments from the upper city.

nodes.title: The Misplaced Royal Decree
nodes.brief: You identify the true provenance of a misplaced royal decree beneath the rubbish, winning a valuable information debt from a scholar.
nodes.page: Heaps of discarded broadsheets and crumpled proclamations hide countless administrative secrets within their folds. Among these yellowed papers lies a royal decree bearing the distinct crimson wax of a long-deposed sovereign. A rival scholar from the reading rooms kneels nearby, desperately hunting for evidence to settle a historical dispute. By deciphering the archaic watermarks and margin notes, you instantly recognize the document's true provenance. You slide the parchment toward the scholar, whose expression shifts from frantic frustration to grudging respect as they realize the magnitude of their discovery and the debt they now owe you.

nodes.title: Tracing the Royal Seal
nodes.brief: You identify the true provenance of a misplaced royal decree beneath the rubbish, winning a valuable information debt from a scholar.
nodes.page: Dust hangs in the dim lamp-light while you sift crumbling layers of discarded state papers for the hidden margins that name the true origin of the royal proclamation. A draft from the lower stacks lifts the fragile scraps. You lean in over the vellum and squint past flaking ink to read the faded scribbles of the royal scribe. Your fingers hover at the torn edge. You mean to lift the document before the paper drift covers it.

nodes.title: Buried Under Old Statecraft
nodes.brief: You identify the true provenance of a misplaced royal decree beneath the rubbish, winning a valuable information debt from a scholar.
nodes.page: The paper mound falls with a dry, papery sigh, and centuries-old dust floods your eyes and lungs until you can hardly see the aisle. You stagger back. Loose folios cascade over your boots and pin your hem to the flagged floor, and by the time you claw free, minutes have gone and your lamp oil runs low. The rival scholar watches your exit with a cold, superior smirk. You leave with a bruise and an obligation you would rather have skipped.

nodes.title: A Scholar's Secret Obligation
nodes.brief: You identify the true provenance of a misplaced royal decree beneath the rubbish, winning a valuable information debt from a scholar.
nodes.page: Your eye picks out the hidden watermark amidst the clutter and locks down the precise historical context before the paper stack settles. The rival scholar nods. A reluctant sigh follows as he acknowledges your scholarship, and the transaction stands complete and binding under the unwritten laws of the stack. You depart with leverage over someone who knows the hidden corridors well.

nodes.title: The Snapping Bindings
nodes.brief: You manoeuvre past snapping volumes with clever sleight of hand to recover a heavy brass reading glass.
nodes.page: Leather-bound volumes skitter across the stone flags like disturbed crabs, their metal clasps clicking with sharp, metallic warnings. Deep in the shadow of a listing bookshelf, a brass reading glass rests on a drift of discarded invoices. The lenses catch the feeble yellow glow of your lantern, glinting like an eye in the dark. You edge closer, watching the nearest volumes rear up on their frayed spines as if ready to defend their temporary roost against any intrusive fingers.

nodes.title: Glint in the Shadows
nodes.brief: You manoeuvre past snapping volumes with clever sleight of hand to recover a heavy brass reading glass.
nodes.page: Shadows lengthen across the uneven masonry as the moving shelves grind together with a low, wooden groan. The brass reading glass remains just out of reach, half-swallowed by a nest of aggressive leather-bound folios that snap their covers shut at the slightest vibration. You ready your hand, timing your movement to match the rhythmic sway of the hanging lamps overhead. Every instinct warns you that a clumsy grab will draw a sharp nip from the territorial tomes.

exits.label: Time your reach past the volumes

nodes.title: Snatching the Brass Lens
nodes.brief: You manoeuvre past snapping volumes with clever sleight of hand to recover a heavy brass reading glass.
nodes.page: You wait for the exact moment the flanking volumes part their leather jaws, then dart your hand straight into the gap toward the gleaming brass. The reading glass presses against a spine that shivers hard under your knuckles, sensing the intrusion. You slide your fingers beneath the cold metal frame, holding your breath as the surrounding covers begin to angle inward to trap your wrist against the shelf.

nodes.title: Nicked by Bound Pages
nodes.brief: You manoeuvre past snapping volumes with clever sleight of hand to recover a heavy brass reading glass.
nodes.page: A sudden snap echoes through the aisle as sharp paper edges and iron clasps bite deep into your skin. You jerk your hand back with a sharp intake of breath. A smear of crimson marks a blank flyleaf while the brass glass clatters deeper into the shadows out of reach. The pain is sharp and stinging, a stark reminder of the hostility harboured by uncatalogued texts. You nurse your bleeding thumb, vowing to approach the territorial literature with far greater caution next time.

nodes.title: Secured Brass Lens
nodes.brief: You manoeuvre past snapping volumes with clever sleight of hand to recover a heavy brass reading glass.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the cool handle and slip the brass glass free from its nest just as the snapping covers slam shut on empty air. The prize is yours. Glass in the lens sits thick enough to magnify the tiniest marginal notes hidden in the darkest corners of the stacks, and the frame still holds the warmth of the shelf. You pocket the instrument.

nodes.title: The Flow of Black Ink
nodes.brief: A turbulent river of jet-black ink cuts straight across the floor, fed by weeping stone walls and overflowing ink-wells.
nodes.page: A wide, sluggish river of pure black ink cuts directly across the flagged pathway, fed by weeping stone walls and overflowing storage urns. Bubbling pools of thick writing fluid swirl sluggishly around the base of submerged shelving units, occasionally releasing heavy, metallic bubbles that burst into greasy clouds of vapour. Makeshift stepping stones of discarded slate lie scattered across the current, but they shift constantly under the oily tide. Across the dark channel, the stacks continue their endless, silent drift into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Ink-Weir
nodes.brief: The Ink-Weir: A rushing sluice of thick writing fluid blocks the main pathway with bubbling pools and submerged shelving units.
nodes.page:
Thick writing fluid boils against submerged shelving units, churning into a dark froth that swallows the main pathway. Bubbles of stale iron-gall rise and burst, releasing a pungent vapour of old vitriol and wet hemp. Across the churning surface, drifted ledgers bob like broken vessels while narrow timber spans tilt dangerously toward the foam. Every route demands a choice

A rusted iron crane creaks overhead in the draught, its chain swinging toward a channel of black water. Further along the sluice, slick wooden planks offer a treacherous crossing past sunken dictionary cases that mutter definitions into the eddy.

exits.label: Probe the swirling current with care

nodes.title: Timber and Twine
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page:
Heavy ledger boards drift within the dark current, their waterlogged covers bound in faded calfskin. You drag several buoyant oak slabs onto the shelving bank, lashing them tight with tarred cord scavenged from a discarded binding press. Each knot must hold against the lateral pull of the black water

A watertight canvas sack sits open beside your knees, waiting to receive whatever dry gear remains salvageable from the surrounding shelves. Pushing off from the slippery stone requires steady balance as the makeshift raft settles into the current.

exits.label: Push off into the dark channel

nodes.title: Floating Ledger Raft
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page:
The timber frame creaks under your weight, riding low upon the sluggish ink-river as the walls slide past in a blur of damp mortar. Stray scraps of parchment drift alongside, covered in marginalia that dissolve into grey smears before your eyes. You guide the awkward craft with a splintered slat, keeping clear of iron brackets jutting from the masonry

A narrow gap in the shelving opens ahead, revealing a dry stone ledge where the current loses its grip on the floor.

nodes.title: Lash the Drifting Timbers
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page: Swift fingers loop tarred cord around water-swollen ledger boards, drawing the knots tight while the current surges against your boots. The binding threatens to slip as a sudden wave of black fluid spills over the makeshift deck, soaking your sleeves in bitter ink. You pull the final hitch taut with your teeth, bracing your weight against the shifting frame just as the craft breaks free from the shelving leg.

nodes.title: Tangles in the Sluice
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page:
The knot slips with a harsh snap, pitching one corner of the timber frame deep beneath the churning ink. Frantic hauling saves the canvas sack from the flood, but the sudden strain tears a long, jagged gash across your forearm where a rusted binder's clasp bites through your wool sleeve. You drag yourself onto the stone margin

Dripping black fluid from your torn coat, you nurse the stinging wound while the rest of your makeshift raft drifts out of reach into the gloom.

nodes.title: Bound in Waterproof Canvas
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page: Your makeshift vessel holds together through the worst of the turbulence, scraping gently against a protruding iron shelf until you secure the painter line. Inside the waterproof canvas sack, your spare lamp-oil and dry chalk remain untouched by the bitter fluid of the weir. You shake the dark droplets from your coat, pocketing a small lead seal found pressed into the corner of the wreckage.

nodes.title: Iron Tracks Above
nodes.brief: You bypass the raging current by climbing the overhead iron tracks, acquiring a long iron pole with a hooked end.
nodes.page:
Overhead rails run parallel to the ceiling, bolted into granite blocks that once carried traveling crane-books for the senior scribes. You reach upward, catching the cold iron bar with both hands and drawing your boots clear of the ink-swollen floor. Every joint aches with the effort of suspension as you haul yourself hand over hand into the gloom

Below you, the black river churns against the base of empty bookshelves while distant shadows shift behind rusted wire grilles.

nodes.title: Reach for the Overhead Rail
nodes.brief: You bypass the raging current by climbing the overhead iron tracks, acquiring a long iron pole with a hooked end.
nodes.page: Fingers close around the grease-slicked iron bar just as the ledge crumbles beneath your heels, leaving your entire weight dangling above the ink-sluice. Your shoulders burn with sudden strain while the heavy brass glass swings from your belt, clattering loudly against the stone masonry. You hook one knee over the cold metal, searching for a firmer grip in the dim light.

nodes.title: Slipping the Iron Grasp
nodes.brief: You bypass the raging current by climbing the overhead iron tracks, acquiring a long iron pole with a hooked end.
nodes.page:
A sudden tremor shakes the ceiling brackets, loosening a shower of gritty mortar dust into your eyes just as you reach for the next support. Your grip slips on the oily iron, dropping you hard onto a jutting wooden cornice that catches your ribs with a dull thud. You roll gasping onto the narrow ledge

Bruised and breathless, you lose a half-flask of lamp-oil that shatters silently against the dark water far below.

nodes.title: Hooked from the Current
nodes.brief: You bypass the raging current by climbing the overhead iron tracks, acquiring a long iron pole with a hooked end.
nodes.page: You brace the iron rod against the overhead bracket and swing past the worst of the boiling weir. Below your boots, the ink-river slides in thick sluggish folds toward the lower stacks and never reaches you. You drop onto the far pathway. Boots hit stone. Old lamp-grease blacks your palms.

nodes.title: The Sunken Chest
nodes.brief: You trick the swirling eddies into depositing a sunken chest onto the bank, claiming an assortment of coloured sealing waxes.
nodes.page:
Dark galleried shelving leans over the ink-sluice like ancient ribs and casts long wavering shadows across the bubbling surface. Wooden crates and waterlogged ledgers drift in the sluggish black channel and churn against a rusted bulkhead. You prod the current. An iron-bound chest nudges away from the suction point.

The eddy slackens just enough for the latch to snag upon a rusted mooring ring near the stone bank, and a trove of sealed wax blocks in bold colour comes with it. Rich purples and deep indigos flake off the wooden lid, smelling faintly of rendered tallow and dried resin from some long-forgotten departmental audit.

exits.label: Pry open the damp wooden latch

nodes.title: Deceiving the Current
nodes.brief: You trick the swirling eddies into depositing a sunken chest onto the bank, claiming an assortment of coloured sealing waxes.
nodes.page: Swirling black water laps against the crumbling stone plinth where you balance, throwing up thick droplets of iron-scented gall. Just beyond arm's reach, an iron-bound chest rides the churning backwater, trapped in a treacherous swirl of discarded book-scraps. You nudge a floating ledger into the main eddy, hoping the sudden weight will disrupt the suction and force the submerged prize toward the shallow bank. Your fingers tighten around the slippery metal rod as the whirlpool shifts unpredictably beneath the surface.

check.label: Redirect the swirling vortex with debris

nodes.title: Snagged in the Sluice
nodes.brief: You trick the swirling eddies into depositing a sunken chest onto the bank, claiming an assortment of coloured sealing waxes.
nodes.page: Treacherous undercurrents catch the floating ledger and spin it violently against your shins, knocking your boots out from under the stone ledge. Icy writing fluid floods your coat pockets, ruining your spare lamp wicks and soaking deep into your wool trousers. You scramble backward up the slick masonry, coughing up bitter traces of gall as the iron-bound chest slips forever beneath the dark surface. The heavy loss of lamp-oil leaves your lantern sputtering with a thin, yellow flame that barely cuts through the damp haze.

exits.label: Crawl clear of the black water

nodes.title: Recovered Sealing Waxes
nodes.brief: You trick the swirling eddies into depositing a sunken chest onto the bank, claiming an assortment of coloured sealing waxes.
nodes.page:
Iron-bound wood bumps against the mossy bank and settles into the grit as the dark eddies lose their grip. You throw back the swollen lid. Neat rows of preserved sealing sticks sit in velvet padding, untouched by the ink, and your fingers trace the cool smooth surfaces of crimson, amber, and deepest black wax salvaged from a forgotten departmental archive.

This little prize will open many locked filing drawers ahead.

nodes.title: The Shallow Bar
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow rate to find a shallow stone bar across the weir, retrieving an intact quill-case of silver.
nodes.page: Sluggish ink-channels divide around a long ridge of grey shale that breaks the black surface like the spine of a sleeping leviathan. Among the bubbling ripples you find a shallow shelf where the current loses its bite against the subterranean masonry. You wade through knee-deep writing fluid, using your long brass measuring rod to probe the sludge for hidden drop-offs. A glint of polished metal catches your eye from a niche between two sunken book-cases near the shale bar.

nodes.title: Reading the Flow
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow rate to find a shallow stone bar across the weir, retrieving an intact quill-case of silver.
nodes.page: Bitter mist rises from the ink-weir, stinging your eyes as you study the chaotic geometry of the moving shelves and swirling black pools. A faint, rhythmic bubbling pattern suggests a submerged barrier of solid stone cutting across the turbulent channel just beneath the surface. You map the velocity of the drifting debris with practiced precision, calculating where a dry footing might hold against the pressure. Your boots test the slick edge of the shale bar while the roaring current strains against your shins.

nodes.title: Swamped by the Weir
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow rate to find a shallow stone bar across the weir, retrieving an intact quill-case of silver.
nodes.page: Sudden turbulence surges over the submerged ridge, sweeping your feet out from under you and plunging you into the icy writing fluid. You kick hard against the current, bruise your ribs on an iron shelving bracket, then haul yourself onto the bank. Your lantern glass cracks in the commotion, leaking precious oil and plunging half the alcove into deep, flickering shadows. The physical toll leaves a dull, throbbing ache in your side and a heavy film of black ink caked over your fingers.

nodes.title: The Silver Quill-Case
nodes.brief: You analyze the flow rate to find a shallow stone bar across the weir, retrieving an intact quill-case of silver.
nodes.page:
Shale footing holds firm beneath your boots, offering a narrow, dry pathway through the heart of the roaring ink-weir. You reach deep into the alcove's recess, fingers closing around a remarkably dry, chased silver cylinder resting upon a forgotten pedestal. The hinged lid springs open with a clean snap, revealing an intact set of matched nibs carved from pale goose bone.

Whether found with calm precision or snatched from the rushing flood through sheer grit, this delicate case promises steady service in the deep stacks.

nodes.title: Across the Dark Spray
nodes.brief: You leap gracefully across the slick stepping-stones amidst the dark spray, earning a pair of oilskin gaiters.
nodes.page: Deeper in the shifting stacks a wide gap of churning ink blocks the path, spanned only by jagged, moss-covered stepping-stones. Dark spray coats the stonework. Each foothold is slick with old paper pulp. You wait for the black fluid to surge, then step from one damp outcrop to the next while wet parchment and cold stone fill your nose and distant lanterns flicker on the damp walls.

nodes.title: The Slick Crossing
nodes.brief: You leap gracefully across the slick stepping-stones amidst the dark spray, earning a pair of oilskin gaiters.
nodes.page: Droplets of dark ink patter against your canvas hood from the vaulted ceiling above, soft as autumn drizzle. You balance carefully on the edge of a basalt block and watch writing fluid swirl in the deep trough between the foundations. A sudden gust of warm, dry air sweeps up from the lower levels, carrying the faint, dry rustle of a thousand turning pages. You adjust your shoulder strap and take another steadying breath before negotiating the final stretch of the wet causeway.

nodes.title: Leaping the Spray
nodes.brief: You leap gracefully across the slick stepping-stones amidst the dark spray, earning a pair of oilskin gaiters.
nodes.page: Black spray drenches your wool coat as you launch yourself toward a mossy outcrop jutting from the swirling ink-weir. The landing stone tilts dangerously under your weight, sending a shower of loose mortar fragments tumbling into the dark fluid below. You throw your arms wide to maintain balance, fighting the sudden momentum that threatens to pitch you headfirst into the boiling channel. Your boots slide half an inch on the slick, ink-stained slime before finding a stubborn ridge of rough granite.

nodes.title: Slips in the Spray
nodes.brief: You leap gracefully across the slick stepping-stones amidst the dark spray, earning a pair of oilskin gaiters.
nodes.page: Treacherous moss gives way beneath your boot heel, pitching you sideways into the cold, shallow margin of the ink-channel. You scrape your palms raw against the sharp corner of a cast-iron shelving upright, leaving red streaks mixed with black fluid. The sudden impact drives the breath from your lungs, forcing you to huddle against the damp masonry until your ribs stop aching. Although you manage to crawl clear of the channel, your shins are badly bruised and your oilskin cloak is torn at the shoulder.

nodes.title: The Oilskin Gaiters
nodes.brief: You leap gracefully across the slick stepping-stones amidst the dark spray, earning a pair of oilskin gaiters.
nodes.page:
Surefooted balance carries you lightly across the last slick stone, landing with a soft thud on the dry flagged floor of the outer gallery. A discarded leather bundle lies wedged between two heavy iron shelf-bases, half-buried under a drift of damp catalogue cards. You untie the hemp cord to reveal a sturdy pair of oiled leather gaiters, perfectly preserved and smelling strongly of neat's-foot oil.

Whether crossed with acrobatic grace or managed through frantic, bruising recovery, this protective gear will shield your lower legs from the biting ink-spray.

exits.label: Head back to the main ink-weir

nodes.title: The Vertical Cleft
nodes.brief: The stacks narrow dramatically into a vertical cleft where the stone walls press inward and whisper archaic warnings.
nodes.page: Stone walls press inward from both flanks until the air tastes of dry lime and old mortar. The stacks narrow dramatically into a vertical cleft where your shoulders brush cold, weeping masonry on every step. Faint, dry breath sounds drift from the hairline fractures in the stone, murmuring archaic warnings about books that remember forgotten names. Your lantern beam catches scrawled marginalia bleeding directly from the rock face into the darkness ahead.

exits.label: Squeeze forward through the whispering stone

nodes.title: The Narrowing Cleft
nodes.brief: The Narrowing Cleft: A claustrophobic fissure between two massive stone book-presses forces you to squeeze through side-on in total darkness.
nodes.page: A claustrophobic fissure between two massive stone book-presses forces you to squeeze through side-on in total darkness. The scent of lamp-oil hangs thick in your wool coat as you weigh the narrow paths stretching into the gloom. To your left, a jagged passage leads toward a shimmering curtain of dust and iron bindings. Straight ahead, the fissure splits into darker crevices where the ink-sellers' routes are said to cross.

exits.label: Slip sideways into the tightest gap
Bend your posture to the curve

nodes.title: The Silver Bookmark
nodes.brief: You slip sideways through the tightest portion with smooth grace, recovering a dropped silver-plated bookmark of fine make.
nodes.page: Smooth stone slides against your sleeve as you slip sideways through the tightest portion of the cleft with measured grace. A faint metallic gleam catches the pale light of your brass lamp from a crevice near the floor. Reaching down, your fingers brush against a dropped silver-plated bookmark of fine make, engraved with the stamp of the Cataloguers' Court. It hums with a faint, residual chill against your palm before you tuck it securely into your pocket.

nodes.title: The Slippery Ledger
nodes.brief: You slip sideways through the tightest portion with smooth grace, recovering a dropped silver-plated bookmark of fine make.
nodes.page: Loose pages from a displaced ledger flutter across the narrow floor, slick with a film of dark, stagnant condensation. You must balance your weight precisely on the balls of your feet to cross the hazard without sliding into the jagged masonry. Lifting your lantern high, you test the slick stone edge with your boot heel while the surrounding shelves groan and shift.

check.label: Balance carefully across the slick pages

nodes.title: A Heavy Stumble
nodes.brief: You slip sideways through the tightest portion with smooth grace, recovering a dropped silver-plated bookmark of fine make.
nodes.page: Your boot slips on the wet vellum, pitching you heavily against a protruding corner of iron-bound shelving. A sharp pain flares along your ribs as you catch your breath against the cold stone, losing precious lamp-oil from your battered tin flask. The bruising will linger for days, serving as a bitter reminder of the Underlibrary's shifting floors. You pick yourself up from the dusty floorboards, dusting your wool coat with a grimace.

nodes.title: The Silver Bookmark
nodes.brief: You slip sideways through the tightest portion with smooth grace, recovering a dropped silver-plated bookmark of fine make.
nodes.page: You slip sideways through the tightest portion with smooth grace, your shoulder grazing the damp leather spines of forgotten folios until your bootheels find firm flagstones once more. Dust motes dance in the amber glare of your lantern, settling over the endless labyrinth of drifting stacks that stretch out into the gloom.
