Clutched tightly in your palm is a silver-plated bookmark of fine make, rescued from the gap just as the shelves shifted their iron-bound joints. It hums faintly against your skin like a trapped bee, carrying the secret weight of a librarian's forgotten favor.

exits.label: Squeeze back through the narrow fissure

nodes.title: The Fig Stash
nodes.brief: You navigate the jagged stone protrusions using balanced footwork, finding a forgotten stash of sweet dried figs.
nodes.page: Jagged stone protrusions jut from the walls like the teeth of an ancient mechanism, requiring careful observation with every step. You navigate the obstacle using balanced footwork, testing each handhold before trusting your weight to the ancient masonry. Wedged behind a stack of untagged pamphlets, your fingers brush against a small, wrapped bundle. Opening it reveals a forgotten stash of sweet dried figs, surprisingly moist and smelling of honey and old paper.

nodes.title: Crossing the Gap
nodes.brief: You navigate the jagged stone protrusions using balanced footwork, finding a forgotten stash of sweet dried figs.
nodes.page: A wide gap opens between the stone shelves where the floor has drifted away into black emptiness. You test the stability of a narrow wooden plank bridging the chasm, watching tiny motes of dust spin into the abyss. Holding your breath, you prepare to step onto the trembling timber while the lamp flame flickers dangerously in the draft.

check.label: Step lightly across the trembling plank

nodes.title: A Bitter Drop
nodes.brief: You navigate the jagged stone protrusions using balanced footwork, finding a forgotten stash of sweet dried figs.
nodes.page: The timber groans under your weight and tips sharply, sending you tumbling onto a rough pile of discarded parchment rolls. A sharp paper-cut stings across your palm, drawing a bead of dark blood, and your spare tin of lamp-oil cracks against the floor. You salvage what remains of your supplies with trembling fingers, nursing your bruised hand in the gloom.

nodes.title: Across the Timber
nodes.brief: You navigate the jagged stone protrusions using balanced footwork, finding a forgotten stash of sweet dried figs.
nodes.page: Your footwork holds true as you glide across the plank, and your heels land with a solid thud on the far side. The drop yawns under the timber. Among the litter of the ledge, you discover a small leather-bound notebook filled with helpful shortcut notes left by a friendly clerk.

nodes.title: The Flowing Shelf-Ends
nodes.brief: You slide past a row of projecting shelf-ends with liquid fluidity, securing a small vial of soothing throat cordial.
nodes.page: Heavy mahogany book-presses drift sideways on hidden brass runners, grinding against the limestone flooring with a low, rhythmic sigh. Dust motes dance in the amber beam of your lamp, smelling faintly of rancid tallow and old linen. Liquid fluidity carries your momentum past a row of projecting shelf-ends, your shoulder brushing the cold timber as you slip smoothly into the narrow gap beyond. Resting upon a jutting bracket of iron sits a small vial of soothing throat cordial, its glass stopper sealed with dried green wax. Your fingers close around the chilled vessel, pocketing it against the damp chill that seeps upward from the ink-rivers below.

nodes.title: The Narrow Iron Alley
nodes.brief: You slide past a row of projecting shelf-ends with liquid fluidity, securing a small vial of soothing throat cordial.
nodes.page: Trembling shelving units converge from both flanks, threatening to crush your passage into the masonry unless you time your dart with absolute precision. The gap between the sliding walnut stacks narrows to a hair's breadth, vibrating with the subterranean groan of shifting foundations. Lamp-oil sloshes anxiously inside your tin lantern as you lower your center of gravity, preparing to thread the needle through the shifting maze. You spring forward with balanced agility, trusting your footing on the slick stone flags as the massive timber walls close in around you.

nodes.title: A Scraped Shins Recovery
nodes.brief: You slide past a row of projecting shelf-ends with liquid fluidity, securing a small vial of soothing throat cordial.
nodes.page: Rough oak catches your hip with a brutal impact, spinning you sideways and bruising your ribs against a protruding metal bracket. Your lamp slips from numbed fingers, shattering against the floorboards and spilling precious oil into the dark cracks between the stones. A sharp sting flares along your shin where a splintered shelf-edge rakes across flesh, leaving a thin line of crimson blood. Cursing softly in the gloom, you press onward into the damp shadows, poorer by a pint of oil and richer by a dull, throbbing ache that settles deep into your bones.

nodes.title: The Liquid Slide Reward
nodes.brief: You slide past a row of projecting shelf-ends with liquid fluidity, securing a small vial of soothing throat cordial.
nodes.page: Precision carries your weight clear of the grinding timber, however narrowly, leaving you safely balanced upon a stationary ledge of granite. Your heart thrums a rapid tattoo against your ribs while the massive shelves rumble past like passing merchant barges. Resting on the dusty timber ledge is a forgotten token left by some earlier cataloguer who vanished during the Long Closing. You tuck the prize safely inside your waistcoat pocket, feeling its reassuring weight against your chest before turning your gaze toward the darkness ahead.

nodes.title: The Vaulted Curve
nodes.brief: You bend your posture to match the curving stone vault with elegant poise, earning a sturdy leather wrist-guard.
nodes.page: Arched ribs of grey granite soar overhead, forming a gothic canopy where ancient manuscripts are stacked in towering, precarious tiers. Bending your posture to match the curving stone vault requires careful adjustment, your spine aligning with the ancient geometry of the masonry. Every breath draws in the rich perfume of dry vellum and oxidized copper ink that coats the cavern walls like frost. A sturdy leather wrist-guard, discarded by a weary cataloguer, rests upon a protruding decorative corbel within arm's reach. You unbuckle it from the stone and strap it securely around your forearm, testing the stiff hide against your pulse.

nodes.title: The Vaulted Spring
nodes.brief: You bend your posture to match the curving stone vault with elegant poise, earning a sturdy leather wrist-guard.
nodes.page: Overhead masonry dips perilously low, forcing you to compress your frame into a tight, fluid arc to clear the jagged keystones. Stagnant ink and scorched lamp-wick smell sharp enough to water your eyes as you crouch low. Shadows stretch long and distorted across the vellum-packed shelves as your lamp flickers in the draft. You gather your muscles for a sudden, sweeping slide beneath the descending stone arch, measuring the distance with a practiced eye.

check.label: Bend low beneath the stone arch

nodes.title: The Low Arch Strike
nodes.brief: You bend your posture to match the curving stone vault with elegant poise, earning a sturdy leather wrist-guard.
nodes.page: Stone meets crown with a dull, ringing thud that jars your teeth and sends a shower of gritty mortar dust into your hair. You stumble hard onto your knees upon the abrasive flags, gasping for breath as a sharp knot swells rapidly above your brow. The impact leaves your head ringing with hollow echoes from the nearby stacks, reminding you harshly of the library's unyielding nature. Nursing the tender bruise with one palm, you haul yourself back to your feet and press forward through the gloom.

nodes.title: The Vaulted Reward
nodes.brief: You bend your posture to match the curving stone vault with elegant poise, earning a sturdy leather wrist-guard.
nodes.page: Motion carries you beneath the jagged limestone ribs with practiced elegance, however narrowly, bringing you safely into a wider alcove of quiet shadows. The air here tastes faintly of peppermint and old parchment, offering a brief respite from the choking dust of the moving stacks. Resting upon a low reading desk is a stout leather wrist-guard, its surface etched with the faded insignia of the Shelvers' Fellowship. You slip it onto your forearm, feeling the stiff leather mold comfortably to your wrist as an unspoken token of safe passage.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium of Echoes
nodes.brief: You emerge into a vaulted scriptorium where hundreds of disembodied quills scratch frantically across empty vellum sheets.
nodes.page: Vaulted ceilings arch high above a vast, stone-flagged chamber where hundreds of disembodied iron quills scratch frantically across endless sheets of blank vellum. The air vibrates with a continuous, dry rustling sound, like thousands of beetles scuttling behind ancient wainscoting. Ghostly inkwells hover unsupported above rows of vacant desks, spilling drops of luminescent blue fluid that evaporate before they touch the floor. You step cautiously across the threshold, careful not to disturb the invisible currents that guide the phantom writers. Every footstep you take is mirrored instantly by a dozen scratching nibs in the darkness, recording your journey in neat, cursive script upon the drifting rolls. A carved oak archway stands at the far end of the hall, flanked by towering stacks of uncatalogued pamphlets.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium of Echoes
nodes.brief: The Scriptorium of Echoes: Ghostly pens write furiously in the empty air, recording every footstep and breath you take in rustling prose.
nodes.page: Ghostly pens write in the empty air around you, recording every footstep and breath in rustling prose. The vast scriptorium fills with the scrape of a thousand unseen writers scratching out histories that have not yet happened. Lamp-oil burns low in your lantern and throws long wavering shadows against walls lined with towering cabinets of discarded index cards. Four openings cut the edges of the hall, each leading into a different aisle of the deep archive.

exits.label: Move with silent grace among phantoms

nodes.title: The Dripping Rafters
nodes.brief: You study the scribbling patterns to deduce a safe path through the phantom ink-fall, capturing an enchanted quill that never blunts.
nodes.page: Hundreds of suspended nibs hang above the stone floor like stalactites of iron and brass, weeping dark droplets into shallow copper basins. Each splash sends a tiny ripple through the pooled ink, reflecting strange, non-existent constellations that shift whenever you blink. The air smells strongly of copper filings and ancient gall, catching in the back of your throat with every inhalation. You step carefully between the brimming basins, watching your boots avoid the dark puddles while a phantom draft hums low through the metal tines.

exits.label: Trace the edge of the copper basins

nodes.title: Currents of Gall
nodes.brief: You study the scribbling patterns to deduce a safe path through the phantom ink-fall, capturing an enchanted quill that never blunts.
nodes.page: Heavy drops of gall strike the flagstones with the rhythmic persistence of a slow clock, forming dark patterns that dissolve before your eyes can quite capture their meaning. Ahead lies a curtain of falling ink, thick and unbroken as grease, sealing the narrow gap between two stone pillars. You pause to watch the endless descending gray, wondering how many reams of paper have been ground down to feed this subterranean precipitation. Your fingers trace the damp stone of the pillar, feeling the vibration of thousands of unseen writers scratching away in the dark.

exits.label: Step closer to the descending gray curtain

nodes.title: Reading the Scribe
nodes.brief: You study the scribbling patterns to deduce a safe path through the phantom ink-fall, capturing an enchanted quill that never blunts.
nodes.page: You crouch low beneath the low-slung iron rafters, narrowing your eyes against the heavy mist of falling gall that coats your lashes in a fine, dark grit. The collective scratching of a thousand invisible quills surrounds you, forming a complex auditory lattice of intersecting strokes, loops, and furious crosshatchings. By mapping the cadence of the descent, you try to catch the brief pauses where the ink-fall thins enough to grant safe passage through the curtain.

check.label: Decipher the frantic quill strokes in the gloom

nodes.title: Splattered Flagstones
nodes.brief: You study the scribbling patterns to deduce a safe path through the phantom ink-fall, capturing an enchanted quill that never blunts.
nodes.page: A surge in the overhead pressure makes the iron quills spit a blinding squall of gall straight into your face, burning your eyes and soaking your collar through. You stumble backward into a copper basin, tipping the dark contents across the flagstones and ruining your boots with permanent, indelible stains. The bitter taste of iron fills your mouth as you wipe the stinging fluid from your brow, losing precious minutes while your lamp-oil dwindles in its reservoir.

exits.label: Recover your footing and press onward

nodes.title: The Unblunting Nib
nodes.brief: You study the scribbling patterns to deduce a safe path through the phantom ink-fall, capturing an enchanted quill that never blunts.
nodes.page: Steady patience rewards your careful observation, allowing you to slip through the dense shower of gall just as a stray, self-writing nib detaches itself from the invisible air and drops neatly into your open palm. The metal is cool to the touch and possesses a fine, needle-sharp point that never dulls against the hardest vellum. You pocket the strange instrument, and a faint pulse ticks against your ribs like a captured heartbeat.

exits.label: Follow the corridor toward the echoing chamber

nodes.grant: an enchanted quill that never blunts

nodes.title: The Unattended Desk
nodes.brief: You steel your mind against the deafening scratching noise to harvest blank vellum sheets from an unattended desk.
nodes.page: A heavy oak desk sits abandoned amid the drifting shadows, its surface littered with loose scraps of parchment and discarded nibs caked in dried black crusts. The ambient scratching noise from the ceiling fills the space with a ceaseless, nervous rustle that rattles the edges of every sheet left behind. You approach the writing surface, your lamp casting a long, wavering shadow across the grain while the smell of vinegar-based ink rises thick from the wood.

exits.label: Inspect the stacks of loose vellum sheets

nodes.title: Whispering Margins
nodes.brief: You steel your mind against the deafening scratching noise to harvest blank vellum sheets from an unattended desk.
nodes.page: Countless sheets of blank vellum flutter slightly in the draft, their pristine edges catching the pale yellow glow of your hurricane lamp like small, pale sails. Faint marginal notes scrawled in the very wood of the table seem to murmur warnings about the dangers of taking more than your share, though the voices are too quiet to make out clearly. You brush a thumb across the smooth, heavy grain of the uppermost sheet, feeling the fine tooth of the paper beneath your skin.

exits.label: Reach out to gather the loose sheets

nodes.title: The Deafening Scratch
nodes.brief: You steel your mind against the deafening scratching noise to harvest blank vellum sheets from an unattended desk.
nodes.page: The chaotic scratching of the unseen quills swells suddenly into a deafening roar, vibrating straight through the floorboards and rattling your teeth in your skull. You press your palms hard against your ears, fighting back the rising panic as the surrounding shadows seem to close in and mimic the sound of rushing water. With your breath coming short and sharp, you reach across the littered desk to scoop up the unblemished vellum before the noise overwhelms your senses entirely.

check.label: Steel your mind against the deafening scratch

nodes.title: Scattered Harvest
nodes.brief: You steel your mind against the deafening scratching noise to harvest blank vellum sheets from an unattended desk.
nodes.page: The overwhelming metallic shriek pierces your mental defenses, causing your hands to jerk violently and send a cascade of vellum tumbling down into a dark drainage slot. You lurch after the sliding sheets, managing to snatch only a handful of creased and ink-smeared fragments before the rest vanish into the gloom below. The sudden exertion leaves your chest aching and your lamp guttering dangerously low, casting a meager, flickering yellow light across the damp flagstones.

exits.label: Gather the remaining scraps and move on

nodes.title: Pristine Bundles
nodes.brief: You steel your mind against the deafening scratching noise to harvest blank vellum sheets from an unattended desk.
nodes.page: You keep the din at bay long enough to gather a neat stack of unmarked vellum into your satchel without dropping a sheet. The paper feels cool at your hip and smells faintly of clean linen and fresh rag-pulp. The leather flap buckles shut. The abandoned desk stays in shadow as the scratching thins behind you.

exits.label: Approach the barricade of locked iron cabinets

nodes.title: Phantoms of the Shelf
nodes.brief: You move with silent grace among the writing phantoms to avoid attracting their attention, securing a jar of gold leaf dust.
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the aisle, smelling of lamp-oil and parched hides, while pale silhouettes lean over invisible desks. These writing phantoms scratch furiously at the air, recording every breath and shift of your boots in rustling prose. You press your shoulder against a shifting mahogany stack, sliding past a cluster of spectral scribes whose pens never touch tangible paper. Your fingers trace the cool wood until they brush against a glass jar of gold leaf dust resting upon a stray ledge. Securing the tiny vessel into your satchel, you keep your breathing shallow and watch the drifting shelves part ahead.

nodes.title: The Gilded Passage
nodes.brief: You move with silent grace among the writing phantoms to avoid attracting their attention, securing a jar of gold leaf dust.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch long across the floorboards as the adjacent stack groans and grinds its iron wheels against hidden floor-grooves. Pale ink drips from an overhead shelf, forming dark, glossy pools that threaten to stain your boots if you linger. You step lightly over the dark puddles, keeping your eyes fixed on the narrow lane between towering folios. The air grows cold and tastes strongly of metallic copper and old rag paper. A faint whispering rises from the margins of the nearest books, urging you to turn back before the shifting architecture seals this corridor for good.

nodes.title: Tread of Shadows
nodes.brief: You move with silent grace among the writing phantoms to avoid attracting their attention, securing a jar of gold leaf dust.
nodes.page: Motes of gold dust cling to your fingertips as you edge past a phalanx of luminous scribes whose quills stroke the empty air with frantic speed. A single false step will trigger the scratching entities to turn their eyeless faces toward your presence. Balancing your weight evenly across the warped oak boards, you inch forward while the floor beneath your feet begins a slow, lateral drift. Your muscles tense against the sudden lurch of the shelves, requiring absolute stillness to avoid clipping the hanging brass lamp.

nodes.title: Heavy Footsteps
nodes.brief: You move with silent grace among the writing phantoms to avoid attracting their attention, securing a jar of gold leaf dust.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the drifting shelving throws you off balance, your boot heel coming down hard upon a loose iron plate with a sharp ring. The writing phantoms halt their furious scratching in unison, their hollow gazes snapping directly toward your position. You stumble sideways into a protruding stack, grazing your shoulder against a row of sharp-edged ledgers and dropping your precious lamp-oil flask onto the floorboards. It shatters with a dull clatter, leaving you with a stinging scrape and a darkened corridor to navigate by touch alone.

nodes.title: Silent Navigation
nodes.brief: You move with silent grace among the writing phantoms to avoid attracting their attention, securing a jar of gold leaf dust.
nodes.page: Your weight shifts with perfect equilibrium, your boots gliding over the vibrating oak planks without disturbing a single grain of dust or drawing the notice of the scribbling phantoms. You slip through the narrow gap between the moving stacks, keeping your breathing slow and controlled against the heavy smell of old ink. The danger recedes behind you as the shelves settle into a temporary alignment, leaving you safe in the dim stillness. Tucked securely within your palm is the prize you came for, gleaming faintly in the gloom.

nodes.title: The Iron Barricade
nodes.brief: A barricade of locked iron cabinets blocks the exit, each door inscribed with riddles about the forgotten catalogue.
nodes.page: Iron cabinets bar the way ahead, double doors locked with massive padlocks and inscribed with shifting riddles about the forgotten catalogue. Each metal face bears deep scratches from previous scholars who tried and failed to force the springs. The air here tastes of cold rust and burnt lamp-oil, heavy with the quiet despair of the deep stacks. You trace the script carved into the steel and read lines that question the very nature of memory and record. The riddles shift beneath your fingertips, demanding an answer before the corridor shifts its walls and traps you permanently among the locked files.

nodes.title: The Iron Grille
nodes.brief: The Iron Grille: A massive barrier of interlocking security gates bars the forward passage with heavy padlocks and intricate keyholes.
nodes.page: Interlocking security gates bar the forward passage, their padlocks and cut keyholes gleaming in the dim lamp-oil light. The metal framework vibrates with a low, rhythmic hum as the surrounding stacks shift their positions in the gloom. Beyond the barrier, narrow corridors branch off into the depths of the Unshelved Stacks, each offering a different path through the labyrinth of forgotten literature. The iron bars smell of old grease and cold sweat as the corridors wait beyond, and the Long Closing will seal the vaults soon enough.

nodes.title: Master of the Lock
nodes.brief: You resolve the cryptographic riddle engraved on the central padlock through sheer willpower, acquiring a heavy iron master-key.
nodes.page: You stare intently at the complex cryptographic riddle engraved upon the central padlock, letting your focus shut out the surrounding hum of the moving shelves. The cryptic verses shift under your gaze, challenging the logic of the Index and the memory of the city above. By sheer force of will, you parse the hidden grammar of the puzzle and align the heavy iron tumblers within the mechanism. A satisfying internal click echoes through the quiet aisle as the massive shackle springs open, granting you full access to the hidden mechanism within.

nodes.title: Mind Against Metal
nodes.brief: You resolve the cryptographic riddle engraved on the central padlock through sheer willpower, acquiring a heavy iron master-key.
nodes.page: The heavy padlock resists your initial mental push, its ancient brass tumblers grinding stubbornly against the internal steel springs. A cold headache blooms behind your temples as the puzzle shifts its terms, demanding an absolute exertion of your mental stamina to prevent the mechanism from locking permanently. You focus every ounce of your concentration on the tiny alignment notches, ignoring the distant groaning of the shifting stacks around you. The cold iron radiates a biting chill into your fingers as you hold your mental grip at the very edge of failure.

check.label: Force the lock with sheer willpower

nodes.title: Mental Strain
nodes.brief: You resolve the cryptographic riddle engraved on the central padlock through sheer willpower, acquiring a heavy iron master-key.
nodes.page: The stubborn lock defeats your mental assault with a sharp, metallic snap that sends a piercing shockwave through your thoughts. A dull, persistent ache throbs behind your eyes, and your fingers tremble with sudden exhaustion against the cold iron shackle. The padlock remains stubbornly sealed, mocking your effort and consuming precious minutes while the distant stacks continue their slow, relentless drift. You pull your hand back, nursing a numbed thumb and a bruised spirit, but the corridor still waits for your next move.

nodes.title: The Master Key
nodes.brief: You resolve the cryptographic riddle engraved on the central padlock through sheer willpower, acquiring a heavy iron master-key.
nodes.page: Your mental discipline holds firm against the ancient puzzle, forcing every stubborn tumbler into its proper alignment with a crisp, echoing click. The iron shackle springs open in your palm and looses a cloud of grey dust that smells of ancient parchment and dry ink. You lift the artifact free from its hasp, and the cold metal settles into your hand. This key will open doors that have remained shut since the founding of Quillon, offering safe passage through the most heavily guarded sections of the Underlibrary.

exits.label: Step back to the security gate

nodes.title: The Rusted Latch
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted latch with dogged persistence, earning a sturdy pair of blacksmith-forged pincers.
nodes.page: Iron flakes crumble under your calloused thumbs as you wedge the flat of your heavy ledger-knife into the stubborn crevice of the maintenance box. Thick grease and centuries of soot coat the mechanism, offering a stubborn resistance that threatens to snap your blade. You lean your full shoulder weight against the cold metal casing, forcing the corroded joint until a sharp screech echoes through the empty stack. Inside the recessed chamber, on a bed of mouldering parchment, lies an implement forged by municipal smiths. You lift the sturdy tool free from its resting place, feeling its solid balance in your palm.

nodes.title: Pincers of the Smith
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted latch with dogged persistence, earning a sturdy pair of blacksmith-forged pincers.
nodes.page: Blacksmith-forged pincers settle into your leather belt, their iron jaws cold against your hip. The narrow service corridor smells of stagnant lamp-oil and damp wool, and drifting shelves shift in the distance like slow wooden ships. You adjust your oil-lamp. Amber flame flickers against long rows of uncatalogued ledgers that line the walls while floorboards groan under misplaced knowledge and forgotten appendices. You take care. Ahead, a secondary latch catches the dim light and offers passage deeper into the maze of stacks.

nodes.title: Testing the Bound Iron
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted latch with dogged persistence, earning a sturdy pair of blacksmith-forged pincers.
nodes.page: Frost glazes the exterior of the heavy maintenance hatch, radiating a bitter chill that numbs your fingertips as you reach for the primary fastening bolt. The internal spring groans under immense tension, whispering warnings of a jagged snap if your focus wavers even for a fraction of a breath. You steady your breathing, block out the drifting echoes of the deeper stacks, and channel every ounce of your resolve into maintaining a slow, unwavering pressure against the frozen tumblers. Your muscles strain against the cold iron while the ancient mechanism hovers on the razor edge of release.

nodes.title: Bitter Frost and Strain
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted latch with dogged persistence, earning a sturdy pair of blacksmith-forged pincers.
nodes.page: A sudden, vicious slip sends a jarring vibration straight up your forearm and throws your shoulder hard against the jagged iron corner of the shelving unit. Pain flares across your skin. A deep, weeping graze quickly stains your sleeve with dark crimson. You stumble back into the reeking gloom while precious lamp-oil splatters onto the dusty floorboards. The latch remains sealed. Its frozen grin does not move. You gather yourself and push onward through the gloom.

nodes.title: The Smith's Leverage
nodes.brief: You force open a rusted latch with dogged persistence, earning a sturdy pair of blacksmith-forged pincers.
nodes.page: The restraint gives way. In the shadowed recess sits a pair of iron-jawed pincers, their forged surfaces stamped with the official insignia of the Quillon municipal workshops. This implement will serve when you face rusted padlocks or stubborn binding wires in the deeper stacks, where softer tools fail. You secure the tool among your gear as the path ahead clears toward the iron grilles.

nodes.title: Floor of Pressure
nodes.brief: You slip past the pressure-plate triggers in the floor with clever timing, retrieving a velvet-lined cache of spare brass tumblers.
nodes.page: Smooth brass plates lie flush with the worn timber flooring, connected to subterranean wire traps that snake away into the shadowed depths beneath the shelves. You time your strides carefully, stepping only where the grain of the wood appears unmarred and stable. A slight misstep would set the alarm bells ringing across the entire administrative tier, drawing unwanted attention from vigilant cataloguers. Reaching out with practiced fingers, you slide open a velvet-lined cache hidden beneath a loose skirting board, discovering its contents untouched by time or dampness.

nodes.title: Threading the Traps
nodes.brief: You slip past the pressure-plate triggers in the floor with clever timing, retrieving a velvet-lined cache of spare brass tumblers.
nodes.page: Caution pulls at you as you pick a path among the hidden pressure plates that guard the narrow passage between the shifting stacks. A single errant footfall could depress a fatal trigger and snap shut the iron wire that spans the shadowy gap. You calculate the exact span between each brass plate, balancing your weight on your toes while your heart hammers a frantic rhythm against your ribs. With infinite care, you reach out toward the concealed alcove where the prize rests, holding your breath at the absolute edge of discovery.

nodes.title: Springing the Trap
nodes.brief: You slip past the pressure-plate triggers in the floor with clever timing, retrieving a velvet-lined cache of spare brass tumblers.
nodes.page: A metallic click breaks the silence of the stack, and at once a tripwire snaps tight around your ankle. You tumble forward onto the dusty boards. Your palms skin raw, and spare tinder scatters across the floor while the warning bell above tolls a muffled alarm. Dust billows up from the ancient floorboards and coats your throat in dry soot as you scramble to free your boot from the brass jaws. You wrench yourself loose. A torn strip of leather stays in the trap as you retreat to safer boards.

nodes.title: Velvet and Brass
nodes.brief: You slip past the pressure-plate triggers in the floor with clever timing, retrieving a velvet-lined cache of spare brass tumblers.
nodes.page: You slip past the invisible tripwires with feather-light steps and slide your fingers into the velvet-lined recess. Inside the plush lining lie a dozen spare brass tumblers, polished bright and sorted by size, ready to replace worn parts in any lock you meet. This delicate cache holds hours of forgotten craftsmanship from some long-dead locksmith of the Underlibrary. You pocket the roll. You turn toward the massive barriers ahead.

nodes.title: Frostbitten Iron
nodes.brief: You endure the biting frost radiating from the iron bars to unlock a hidden maintenance hatch, finding a warm fur-lined collar.
nodes.page: Bitter drafts whistle through the narrow gaps between the drifting bookshelves, carrying the scent of ancient rime and stagnant river-damp from the lower vaults. You pull your collar high against the piercing cold that radiates directly from the iron-bound masonry of the walls. Tucked within a recessed alcove behind a row of unindexed gazetteers, a small maintenance hatch waits with a frosted handle that glistens under your lamp-light. You reach out with a gloved hand, brushing away the thick crust of grey rime to expose the hairline seam of the door.

nodes.title: Enduring the Chill
nodes.brief: You endure the biting frost radiating from the iron bars to unlock a hidden maintenance hatch, finding a warm fur-lined collar.
nodes.page: The intense cold bites deep into your knuckles, threatening to stiffen your fingers before you can engage the delicate internal mechanism of the hatch. Frost crystals crumble under your touch, melting slightly from your body heat only to refreeze instantly into a slippery glaze over the brass lock. You channel your inner fortitude against the numbing agony, forcing your stiffened hands to steady the pick against the icy tumblers while the freezing draft gnaws through your woollen coat. Your focus narrows to the tiny point of contact inside the lock, awaiting the decisive click.

nodes.title: Numbed Fumbling
nodes.brief: You endure the biting frost radiating from the iron bars to unlock a hidden maintenance hatch, finding a warm fur-lined collar.
nodes.page: A sudden spasm of shivering ruins your delicate alignment. The pick slips out of the frozen keyway with a sharp scrape of metal. Frost drives into your bones. Your right hand goes stiff and clumsy, and each movement costs you. You shove your freezing fingers into your armpits for warmth and watch frost crystals gather again on the abandoned latch. The attempt failed this time. You push past the numbness anyway and look for another approach along the ice.

nodes.title: The Warm Collar
nodes.brief: You endure the biting frost radiating from the iron bars to unlock a hidden maintenance hatch, finding a warm fur-lined collar.
nodes.page: The frozen tumblers align with a crisp, muffled snap inside the frosted casing. Inside the hidden maintenance compartment hangs a heavy, fur-lined collar of ancient cut, smelling faintly of pipe-smoke and old cedar wood. Wrapping it around your neck instantly traps your body heat, pushing back the relentless chill of the drifting stacks. You secure the garment with quiet satisfaction, knowing this practical keepsake will keep the damp air at bay as you approach the vast subterranean archipelago.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Frame Marks
nodes.brief: You decipher the ancient cataloguing marks on the frame to trip the internal release spring, securing an illustrated manual of locks.
nodes.page: Frost crrusts the iron lintel, but your fingernails trace the shallow, deliberate grooves left by a long-dead cataloguer. These subtle scratches are not random damage; they form a sequence of ancient rules that dictate how the internal levers of the locking assembly must settle. You press your thumb against a cold indentation shaped like a crescent moon, feeling the internal spring give a fraction of an inch as the mechanism recognises the authorized touch.

nodes.title: Tripping the Release Spring
nodes.brief: You decipher the ancient cataloguing marks on the frame to trip the internal release spring, securing an illustrated manual of locks.
nodes.page: Pressure on the crescent notch sends a deep, muffled clunk through the hollow metal frame. The rusted tongue within the casing withdraws from its socket with a dry, papery slide, freed from decades of accumulated grime and stagnant lamp-oil. You slide your fingers into the widening gap and pull back the iron plate, opening the dark interior where your prize rests untouched by the damp air of the stacks.

nodes.title: Releasing the Stubborn Tumblers
nodes.brief: You decipher the ancient cataloguing marks on the frame to trip the internal release spring, securing an illustrated manual of locks.
nodes.page: You slide your thin brass pick into the narrow slot, relying entirely on the subtle vibrations traveling up through your stiff fingertips to map the hidden interior. The cold metal resists your pressure, binding tightly against an unyielding brass lever that refuses to slip into place. You lean your weight against the frozen casing, trying to recall every diagram of this specific pattern you ever copied out in the dim light of the shelvers' hall.

nodes.title: A Costly Slip of the Hand
nodes.brief: You decipher the ancient cataloguing marks on the frame to trip the internal release spring, securing an illustrated manual of locks.
nodes.page: A sudden, violent tremor in the iron floor jolts your elbow, throwing off your careful alignment and sending the pick scraping harshly against the frozen brass casing. A sharp shard of rusted iron bites deep into the meat of your thumb, drawing a dark bead of blood that freezes almost instantly in the bitter draft. You hiss through your teeth and jerk your hand back, nursing the stinging wound as you realize the mechanism has jammed tight.

nodes.title: Securing the Illustrated Manual
nodes.brief: You decipher the ancient cataloguing marks on the frame to trip the internal release spring, securing an illustrated manual of locks.
nodes.page: The frozen tumblers yield with a sharp snap, and the inspection hatch swings wide to show your prize in the velvet-lined recess. You lift out a heavy, leather-bound manual detailing every forgotten lock, latch, and security seal ever devised by the early Cataloguers. Your fingers ache from the relentless chill, but tucking this volume into your coat gives you a quiet, enduring advantage against the closed doors ahead.

nodes.title: The Drifting Archipelago
nodes.brief: The floor gives way to a vast subterranean chamber where thousands of drifting bookshelves form a floating archipelago over mist.
nodes.page: The narrow corridor abruptly terminates at a sheer precipice where the solid stone floor simply ends above an immense, lightless cavern. Thousands of mahogany bookshelves hang suspended in the damp air like a floating archipelago, drifting lazily upon slow currents of pale white mist. Faint scratching sounds drift up from the shadowy gaps between the floating rows, where chained volumes twitch and whisper in the dark. A thick rope bridge sways gently in the draft, offering the only immediate pathway across the dizzying expanse.

exits.label: Cross the swaying bridge of spines

nodes.title: The Floating Archive Hub
nodes.brief: The Floating Archive: A vast cavern filled with drifting islands of mahogany bookcases suspended over a deep abyss of pale white mist.
nodes.page: A vast, silent cavern opens before you, filled with countless islands of dark mahogany bookcases suspended over a bottomless abyss of pale white mist. Distant chains groan rhythmically as the shelves shift their positions in the gloom, rearranging the geography of knowledge while you watch. Every direction presents a different peril and a potential route deeper into the shifting maze toward the distant vault.

exits.label: Leap across the swirling mist sea
Slide down the suspended iron conduit
Bridge the widest gap with anchor chains

nodes.title: Reaching for the Anchor Chains
nodes.brief: You manipulate the anchor chains of a drifting bookcase to bridge the widest gap, securing a telescope made of brass and horn.
nodes.page: From the nearest drifting bookcase, iron links dangle and swing in a slow arc above the pale abyss. You wait until the links swing close enough, then lunge forward and catch a cold, greasy link in both gloved hands. The chain jerks violently under your weight before steadying, allowing you to haul the massive mahogany frame closer to your crumbling ledge.

nodes.title: Bridging the Widest Gap
nodes.brief: You manipulate the anchor chains of a drifting bookcase to bridge the widest gap, securing a telescope made of brass and horn.
nodes.page: You snub the iron chain around a rusted floor stanchion and lock the floating bookcase against your ledge. A narrow gap remains, spanned only by the polished oak spine of an oversized folio that bridges the chasm like a perilous beam. You test the sturdy leather binding with the toe of your boot, ensuring it can bear your full weight before stepping out over the open drop.

nodes.title: Navigating the Swaying Chasm
nodes.brief: You manipulate the anchor chains of a drifting bookcase to bridge the widest gap, securing a telescope made of brass and horn.
nodes.page: You step out onto the suspended oak spine, arms held wide to balance against the unpredictable drafts rising from the deep mist below. Halfway across, the entire shelf assembly shifts abruptly to the left, tilting the makeshift bridge at a sickening angle over the dark void. You must time your footing and lean against the sway with absolute precision to keep from tumbling into the grey nothingness.

check.label: Balance across the shifting spine bridge

nodes.title: Falling into the Pale Mist
nodes.brief: You manipulate the anchor chains of a drifting bookcase to bridge the widest gap, securing a telescope made of brass and horn.
nodes.page: The bookcase gives a sudden, violent heave beneath your boots, slipping out from under your feet and sending you crashing hard against the sharp edge of a lower shelf. The impact knocks the wind from your lungs and leaves a deep, purple bruise across your ribs, while your favorite lantern shatters against the masonry below. You haul yourself up coughing into the dim gloom, alive but thoroughly battered by the treacherous stacks.

nodes.title: Securing the Brass Telescope
nodes.brief: You manipulate the anchor chains of a drifting bookcase to bridge the widest gap, securing a telescope made of brass and horn.
nodes.page: You catch the edge of the opposing shelf with your fingertips, scrambling over the polished mahogany molding just as the gap widens beyond reach. Resting against a discarded reading desk is a compact telescope fashioned from polished brass and ribbed horn, left behind by some vanished scholar. You pocket the fine instrument, knowing it will help you spot distant landmarks across the drifting maze ahead.

exits.label: Return to the floating archive hub

nodes.title: The Swaying Mahogany Beam
nodes.brief: You leap across the swirling sea of mist with daring balance, earning a silk rope-ladder with wooden rungs.
nodes.page: Iron chains creak overhead while another towering stack drifts past through the pale, lamp-lit mist. Dust motes dance in the amber glow of your oil lantern while your boots find steady purchase upon a slick expanse of oak flooring. Somewhere down in the hidden depths below, an ink-river laps rhythmically against the stone foundations of the Unfiled Wing. You adjust the heavy strap of your leather satchel and eye the widening gap where the next shelf ought to drift.

nodes.title: Beyond the Ink River
nodes.brief: You leap across the swirling sea of mist with daring balance, earning a silk rope-ladder with wooden rungs.
nodes.page: Thick vapors curl upward from the black, slow-moving channel of discarded ink that separates the upper and lower tiers. Shelves shift with a low, mechanical grinding sound, exposing vertical rows of leather-bound volumes whose spines whisper forgotten titles into the damp air. You test the stability of a protruding mahogany molding, feeling the timber shudder gently under your weight as the entire architectural assembly settles into a new alignment.

nodes.title: Across the Chasm
nodes.brief: You leap across the swirling sea of mist with daring balance, earning a silk rope-ladder with wooden rungs.
nodes.page: Pale mist swirls below your boots like driven wool, swallowing the lower reaches of the stacks in an indifferent white silence. The gap between the swaying shelves widens by the heartbeat, leaving only a turbulent void of damp air and the faint, coppery scent of old ink drifting up from the depths. Balancing your weight on the narrow, vibrating oak edge, you gather your breath, coil your muscles, and prepare to hurl yourself across the immense chasm toward a hanging rope ladder trembling in the draft.

nodes.title: The Bitter Fall
nodes.brief: You leap across the swirling sea of mist with daring balance, earning a silk rope-ladder with wooden rungs.
nodes.page: Gravity proves too swift for your frantic scramble as your fingers brush the opposite molding and slip on the dust-slicked lacquer. You drop hard against a lower crossbeam, bruising your ribs against protruding brass brackets and dropping your spare flask of lamp-oil into the pale haze below. Stifling a sharp groan, you haul yourself onto firm timber, left with a dull ache in your side and a torn sleeve.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: The Tangled Ascent
nodes.brief: You leap across the swirling sea of mist with daring balance, earning a silk rope-ladder with wooden rungs.
nodes.page: Wind tears at your jacket as your fingers finally close around the rough hemp of the swinging ladder, swinging you hard against the wooden rungs with a heavy rattle. Your ribs ache from the impact, and the oil-lamp at your belt sputters alarmingly, but you hold fast against the void below, hauling yourself up onto the stable timber of the upper shelf. Suspended there in the dim stillness, you secure a sturdy silk rope-ladder with polished wooden rungs, retrieved just before the chasm parted further.

nodes.title: Down the Iron Pipe
nodes.brief: You slide down a suspended iron conduit with practiced agility, retrieving a heavy pouch of dry flints and steel.
nodes.page: A rusted vertical conduit descends steeply through the heart of the shifting stacks, vibrating with the muffled hum of distant cataloguing machinery. You wrap your leather-gloved hands around the cold iron tube, testing its rigid support against the surrounding chaos of drifting bookcases and whispered margins. The air smells sharply of machine grease and oxidized brass.

nodes.title: The Iron Descent
nodes.brief: You slide down a suspended iron conduit with practiced agility, retrieving a heavy pouch of dry flints and steel.
nodes.page: Rivets groan in the rusted conduit above as the entire row of mahogany shelving lurches sideways toward the abyss. Below, an ink-river cuts a dark, shining channel through the gloom, its surface skinning over with a dull, iridescent sheen. Clamping your legs around the grease-slicked iron of the drainage pipe, you slide downward into the freezing draft toward a small metal latch where a pouch of dry flints and steel hangs from a protruding bracket.

nodes.title: Scraped and Stranded
nodes.brief: You slide down a suspended iron conduit with practiced agility, retrieving a heavy pouch of dry flints and steel.
nodes.page: The mounting bracket shears away from the wall with a deafening screech, spilling you sideways into a disorderly drift of misfiled folios. You land heavily on your shoulder, tearing your jacket and scattering several pages of notes into the dark shadows. Bruised and cursing softly, you salvage what remains of your gear from the dusty floorboards.

exits.label: Crawl out from the fallen folios

nodes.title: Sparks in the Gloom
nodes.brief: You slide down a suspended iron conduit with practiced agility, retrieving a heavy pouch of dry flints and steel.
nodes.page: Friction burns hot against your palms before you slam to a halt beside the mounting bracket, your boots skidding across the iron plates with a shower of sparks. The conduit shudders and pulls away into the fog just as your fingers curl around the canvas pouch, and you clutch it to your chest despite the scrapes on your skin. Within the leather wrappings, dry flints and thick steel strike together with a reassuring weight, promising warmth against the damp chill of the deep stacks.
nodes.grant: heavy pouch of dry flints and steel

nodes.title: Mapping the Drift
nodes.brief: You calculate the drift vectors of the floating stacks to chart a direct route across, acquiring a detailed map of the deep vault.
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the amber beam of your lamp as you unfold a grease-stained vellum chart across the top of a tilted ledger-desk. The surrounding bookcases groan and shift like timber in a heavy swell, altering the labyrinth of the Unshelved Stacks minute by minute. By measuring the angle of the ink-rivers against the drifting mahogany columns, you calculate the invisible drift vectors that govern the vault's perpetual motion, tracing a clean, deliberate path through the chaos toward the restricted zones beyond.

nodes.title: The Charted Corridor
nodes.brief: You calculate the drift vectors of the floating stacks to chart a direct route across, acquiring a detailed map of the deep vault.
nodes.page: Measured steps carry you deeper into the interior of the moving labyrinth, past towering stacks of forgotten treatises and leather-bound ledgers that whisper softly as you pass. The vellum map in your hand remains steady, its freshly inked lines offering a reliable anchor against the bewildering architectural shifts of the great hall. Ahead, a narrow maintenance gantry spans a wide fissure where several tiers of shelving intersect in a complex, temporary knot of wood and iron.

nodes.title: Calculating the Vectors
nodes.brief: You calculate the drift vectors of the floating stacks to chart a direct route across, acquiring a detailed map of the deep vault.
nodes.page: Numbers and geometric angles blur in your mind as the shelf beneath your boots begins an abrupt, alarming lateral slide toward a towering wall of ledgers. The drift vectors you laboriously mapped moments ago shift wildly as a fresh tremor rattles the iron bracing overhead, threatening to close your intended passage in a matter of seconds. Squinting against the swirling paper-dust, you must instantly recalculate the precise trajectory of the moving stacks before the entire corridor shears apart.

nodes.title: The Cost of Miscalculation
nodes.brief: You calculate the drift vectors of the floating stacks to chart a direct route across, acquiring a detailed map of the deep vault.
nodes.page: A sudden lurch of the mahogany flooring catches you entirely off balance, pitching you violently sideways into a sharp stack of protruding ledgers. Leather spines slam against your shoulder, bruising the bone and tearing your sleeve. Your ink-flask spins into the dark abyss below. Shaking off the dull ache and brushing gray paper-dust from your coat, you pick yourself up from the tilted floor, poorer by a flask of ink and a precious measure of time.

exits.label: Retrieve the detailed map of the vault

nodes.title: The Vault Diagram
nodes.brief: You calculate the drift vectors of the floating stacks to chart a direct route across, acquiring a detailed map of the deep vault.
nodes.page:
Geometric calculations prove their worth as the mahogany floor settles into a momentary, stable alignment against the stone pier. The drifting vectors of the deep stacks resolve into a clear, legible pattern within your mind, revealing a hidden pathway beneath the hanging ledgers. Clutched tightly in your gloved hand is a creased parchment sheet covered in fine ink lines detailing every shift and pivot of the subterranean labyrinth.

This detailed map of the deep vault remains tucked securely inside your travel satchel, offering a reliable guide through the shifting gloom where ordinary directions fail entirely.
nodes.grant: a detailed map of the deep vault

nodes.title: The Swaying Heights
nodes.brief: You vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil.
nodes.page: Shadows lengthen across the pale dust as the oak shelves tilt toward the abyss in a slow, hypnotic dance. Each foothold demands absolute concentration upon the grain of the wood and the steady rhythm of the distant ink-rivers far below. You spring and vault from one swaying shelf-top to another through the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil. The cool metal feels reassuringly solid against your palm while the blue-tinted wick flickers with an internal, unchanging flame.

nodes.title: The Hanging Stacks
nodes.brief: You vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil.
nodes.page: Iron-bound spines creak in unison as the upper tiers shift sideways like drifting barges upon a sluggish tide. You catch the edge of a projecting mahogany cornice just as the gap widens into a dizzying drop above the pale white mist. Pulling yourself upward with a quiet grunt of exertion, you vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil before the shelf can slip away. The enclosed flame casts a steady amber glow that beats back the creeping damp of the stack.

nodes.title: Crossing the Chasm
nodes.brief: You vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil.
nodes.page: The gap between the opposing rows of folios widens alarmingly as a subterranean tremor shakes the entire wing. A narrow mahogany plank suspended by frayed hemp cords offers the only immediate passage across the ink-black void. You gather your breath, eye the swinging distance, and prepare to spring across the swaying expanse before the suspension gives way entirely.

nodes.title: A Heavy Landing
nodes.brief: You vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil.
nodes.page: Hemp cords snap with a sharp whip-like crack as your boots strike the opposite ledge an inch too low, sending a cascade of loose folios tumbling into the mist below. The sudden impact drives the breath entirely from your lungs and leaves a dull, throbbing ache across your ribs as you haul yourself over the timber edge. You lie gasping against the rough boards for a long moment while the lamp-oil seeps sluggishly from a cracked tin in your coat pocket, leaving a fragrant, oily stain against your tunic.

nodes.title: Whispers in the Smoke
nodes.brief: You vault lightly from one swaying shelf-top to another in the dim haze, capturing a small brass lantern filled with perpetual oil.
nodes.page: Dark figures wrapped in soot-stained wool crouch among the trailing cobwebs of a half-collapsed alcove, tending a small brazier fueled by discarded broadsheets. They do not threaten you, but speak in low, deliberate murmurs about the coming purge when every contradictory word recorded in the Index must be turned to fine grey ash. One of them presses an iron strike-flint into your palm, nods once, and melts back into the shadows of the uncatalogued stacks.

nodes.title: The Great Bronze Threshold
nodes.brief: You reach the great bronze threshold of the Deep Annexe, where the heavy scent of old paper signals the end of the shifting stacks.
nodes.page: Massive panels of green-stained bronze loom out of the pale mist, etched with thousands of microscopic procedural entries that shift beneath your gaze like resting insects. The heavy, unmistakable scent of ancient parchment and dried gall-ink hangs thick in the chilled air, signaling the absolute boundary where the shifting labyrinth ends and the restricted vaults begin. Every seam of the metal door is sealed with thick strips of red wax stamped with the emblem of the strict rule-keepers.

nodes.title: The Narrow Leap
nodes.brief: You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel.
nodes.page: Iron chains clank in the dim distance as the entire mahogany wing lists hard to the left, about to spill its contents into the grey void. You time the momentum of the moving furniture with practiced precision, ignoring the dry scratching of marginal notes echoing from the surrounding shelves. You leap across the narrowing gap between two swaying oak tiers with nimble balance, earning a brass-bound clasp for your travel satchel that keeps the bulging flap securely fastened against the damp air.

nodes.title: The Rolling Span
nodes.brief: You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife.
nodes.page: A narrow suspension bridge constructed entirely from the heavy leather spines of discarded encyclopaedias stretches across the dark gulf between two stationary pillars. Each footstep produces a soft, fibrous groaning sound as the old binding glue resists the sudden tension of the hanging span. You glide lightly across the undulating surface while the bridge rolls violently beneath your boots, retrieving a fine steel reading knife wedged securely between two calfskin boards. The slender blade carries the neat maker's mark of the basement bindery.

nodes.title: The Tension Reader
nodes.brief: You negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page.
nodes.page: Frayed suspension ropes hum like violin strings under the immense weight of the drifting stacks, vibrating with a rhythmic frequency that betrays every upcoming structural shift. You pause on the landing to press your fingertips against the taut leather bindings, feeling the internal tremors that signal when the wooden tiers are about to swap places. By interpreting these subtle mechanical strains, you negotiate a safer crossing by reading the structural tension in the hanging leather, earning the favour of a cautious wandering page who shares a crust of dry bread and a nod of quiet fellowship.

nodes.title: The Ledger Raft
nodes.brief: You construct a makeshift raft from floating ledger boards using clever knots, securing a waterproof canvas sack.
nodes.page: Discarded heavy ledger boards float like dead timbers upon the sluggish ink-river, smelling strongly of vinegar and gall. You lash them together with quick, secure knots drawn tight through the frayed holes of the covers, fashioning a makeshift raft that dips unsteadily under your weight. Pressing down firmly on the lashed planks, you strap a waterproof canvas sack containing your meager remaining rations and dry lamp-oil against the centre timber. The dark current laps hungrily at your boots, thick and glistening like petroleum, urging you to cast off before the entire shelf-side tilts further into the grey void.

nodes.title: The Sunken Chest
nodes.brief: You trick the swirling eddies into depositing a sunken chest onto the bank, claiming an assortment of coloured sealing waxes.
nodes.page: Swirling dark eddies churn against a jagged stone abutment where refuse from a thousand misfiled folios has collected over decades. Reaching down with a length of copper-reinforced twine, you snag the iron handle of a waterlogged oak chest trapped beneath the surface. You throw your shoulder into a sudden heave and coax the spinning currents to lift the oak chest onto the slimy bank. You pry the swollen lid loose with your fingers and find a neat, intact assortment of coloured sealing waxes set in damp velvet.

nodes.title: The Overhead Tracks
nodes.brief: You bypass the raging current by climbing the overhead iron tracks, acquiring a long iron pole with a hooked end.
nodes.page: Frothing black water rushes too fiercely across the lower stacks to permit any crossing by foot or makeshift raft. You abandon the floor entirely and leap upward to catch the overhead brass tracks where the sliding ladders hang. Hand over hand, you haul your weight along the grease-slicked rail while the dark flood hisses below your dangling boots. A discarded iron pole with a heavy hooked end hangs from a bracket just ahead, waiting within arm's reach.

nodes.title: Threshold of the Court
nodes.brief: You stand before the towering bronze doors of the Cataloguers' Court, where a stern clerk demands your travel permit and searches your belongings for illicit manuscripts.
nodes.page: Bronze doors inscribed with endless lists of prohibited topics stand before you, tall as a tomb's gateway. A stern cataloguer in stiff, ink-stained cuffs steps out from the shadows, barring your path with a clipboard of black walnut. Demand for travel permits echoes hollowly off the vaulted stone ceiling while the clerk inspects every seam of your coat for illicit manuscripts. Every confiscated margin-note and smuggled scrap of paper sits conspicuous in your pockets under that unblinking, bureaucratic glare.

nodes.title: Hall of Classification
nodes.brief: The Hall of Classification: Rows of high desks stretch into the gloom where junior scribes sort whispering index cards by obsolete filing systems.
nodes.page: Endless rows of high walnut desks stretch away into the gloom of the great administrative chamber, smelling of stale parchment and damp wool. Junior scribes hunch under green-shaded lamps, mechanically sorting whispering index cards according to obsolete filing systems that change every hour. To your left, a narrow archway leads deeper into the archives; straight ahead, a stern inquisitor glares over a high lectern; to your right, a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers begs for intervention; and behind a frosted glass screen, armed beadles pace with rhythmic boots.

exits.label: Slip past the silent junior desks

nodes.title: The Polished Floor
nodes.brief: You attempt to slip past a sleeping clerk by gliding silently across the polished marble floor, risking exposure, to secure a stolen seal-ring.
nodes.page: Smooth marble tiles stretch across the open floor between towering card-cabinets, gleaming like frozen black water under the sputtering gas-jets. A solitary clerk sits slumped over an immense ledger near the far archway, his chin on his chest in deep slumber. You take a slow, deliberate step forward, testing the slickness of the stone beneath your soft-soled boots while the scratching of distant pens marks time behind you. One false movement upon this polished expanse will echo through the entire hall and ruin your approach.

nodes.title: Shadow of the Cabinet
nodes.brief: You attempt to slip past a sleeping clerk by gliding silently across the polished marble floor, risking exposure, to secure a stolen seal-ring.
nodes.page: Deep shadows cast by towering rows of oak card-drawers offer a temporary haven from the glaring lamps of the central aisle. You press your back against the cold wood, listening intently to the rhythmic, whistling snores of the sleeping clerk just yards away. The stolen seal-ring glints dully on the corner of his unattended desk, resting beside a brass inkpot shaped like an owl. Your fingers itch to reach out across the intervening space, but the floorboards here groan faintly beneath a coat of dried paste.

nodes.title: The Silent Glide
nodes.brief: You attempt to slip past a sleeping clerk by gliding silently across the polished marble floor, risking exposure, to secure a stolen seal-ring.
nodes.page: You ease your weight forward onto the ball of your foot, gliding across the polished marble with the deliberate caution of a cat stalking through a library of glass. The sleeping clerk stirs in his high-backed chair, his hand twitching toward a fallen quill as a sudden draft rustles the papers on his desk. You freeze mid-stride, balancing your entire momentum on a single heel while holding your breath against the rising smell of hot lamp-oil.

check.label: Balance silently across the slick floor

nodes.title: The Clattering Fall
nodes.brief: You attempt to slip past a sleeping clerk by gliding silently across the polished marble floor, risking exposure, to secure a stolen seal-ring.
nodes.page: Your boot heel skids unexpectedly on a stray grain of dried sealing wax scattered across the marble floor. You stumble forward with a sharp gasp, catching your shoulder hard against the edge of the clerk's high desk and sending a heavy brass inkpot clattering across the flags. The sleeping clerk jerks awake with a shout, lunging blindly into the gloom while you scramble backward into the shadows, nursing a bruised shoulder and leaving a torn scrap of your sleeve caught on the desk-leg.

nodes.title: The Stolen Seal
nodes.brief: You attempt to slip past a sleeping clerk by gliding silently across the polished marble floor, risking exposure, to secure a stolen seal-ring.
nodes.page: You complete the final, delicate stretch across the smooth floor, your fingers closing firmly around the cold metal of the seal-ring just as the clerk shifts in his sleep. Slipping the heavy brass band into your pocket, you retrace your steps into the relative safety of the towering card-cabinets before anyone can raise an alarm. Your heart thumps heavily against your ribs, but your stealth has bought you a quiet victory and a tangible token of authority within these rigid halls.

nodes.title: The Inquisitorial Desk
nodes.brief: You endure a punishing cross-examination by an inquisitorial senior archivist regarding your true loyalties, risking your sanity, to earn a signed clearance pass.
nodes.page: Senior Archivist Haxby pins you with a stare forged from decades of cataloguing heresy, his spectacles reflecting the dim amber glow of a desk lamp smelling of stale tallow and dried ink. He interrogates your allegiances to the Fellowship with a relentless cadence, demanding to know whose marginalia you carry in your pockets and whether you have sworn oaths to the Burners. Every question scrapes against your thoughts like a blunt nib on cheap vellum, and his bureaucratic scrutiny works at the edges of your sanity. You must face his final, probing inquiry directly before any clearance pass can be written.

nodes.title: Weathering The Interrogation
nodes.brief: You endure a punishing cross-examination by an inquisitorial senior archivist regarding your true loyalties, risking your sanity, to earn a signed clearance pass.
nodes.page: Haxby leans forward across the ledger-strewn mahogany. His voice falls to a dry, rasping whisper that finds the roots of your teeth, and ink in the nearby inkwells ripples without a touch on the glass. You clamp the edge of the oak desk and bite back the urge to confess every rule you have ever bent in the dim corridors. His scrutiny lands like an iron press on wet paper, and thoughts want to flee into the stacks. Against the psychic undertow of his questions you spend every scrap of fortitude you still own.

nodes.title: The Cost Of Hesitation
nodes.brief: You endure a punishing cross-examination by an inquisitorial senior archivist regarding your true loyalties, risking your sanity, to earn a signed clearance pass.
nodes.page: Haxby's last volley breaks through your guard. Your temples pound with a copper taste and the stale bite of lamp-oil. The senior archivist draws a jagged red stroke across your temporary ledger sheet and mutters a dry reprimand about undisciplined shelvers and unstable wits. You stagger back from the high desk, one hand pressed to your splitting head as pain digs in behind your eyes like an unindexed splinter. An administrative debt lands on your file. Every trip through the lower stacks will now cost you a punishing surcharge.

nodes.title: The Signed Clearance
nodes.brief: You endure a punishing cross-examination by an inquisitorial senior archivist regarding your true loyalties, risking your sanity, to earn a signed clearance pass.
nodes.page: Haxby's pen scratches a final, definitive flourish across the heavy parchment before he shoves the document across the ink-stained blotter toward you. You pick up the crisp voucher, feeling the faint, reassuring vibration of its official stamp against your fingertips despite the exhausting ordeal of the cross-examination. This signed clearance pass will grant you unhindered passage through the guarded thresholds of the lower tiers, offering a rare shield against the zealous inquiries of the rule-keepers. You tuck the paper safely into your tunic pocket alongside your bone-handled cutter.

nodes.title: The Cascading Cabinets
nodes.brief: You dance between drifting card-cabinets to intercept a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers, risking a heavy fall, to retrieve a misplaced transit voucher.
nodes.page: Massive wooden card-cabinets grind across the uneven stone floor on rusted iron casters, their countless drawers sliding open and shut in a mechanical rhythm that mimics a giant's breathing. Ahead of you, a high-wheeled wooden trolley laden with teetering piles of confidential dossiers hits a ridge in the masonry and begins to careen wildly toward a sheer drop into the ink-rivers. You dart between the shifting furniture as stray index cards flutter through the air like startled moths, chasing the runaway records before they plunge into the dark fluid below.

nodes.title: The Lurching Stacks
nodes.brief: You dance between drifting card-cabinets to intercept a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers, risking a heavy fall, to retrieve a misplaced transit voucher.
nodes.page: Iron-bound shelving units grind against one another with a shriek of protesting metal, narrowing the gap between the card-drawers into a hazardous, swaying corridor. You press your shoulder against a vibrating bookcase as a towering cart of misfiled dossiers rattles past, its loose wheels spitting dry wooden shavings across the polished flagstones. The scent of ancient glue and damp paper fills your lungs while you calculate the precise moment to leap across the widening chasm between the shelves.

nodes.title: Chasing The Runaway Cart
nodes.brief: You dance between drifting card-cabinets to intercept a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers, risking a heavy fall, to retrieve a misplaced transit voucher.
nodes.page: You launch yourself off the edge of a drifting shelf, straight at the careening timber cart as confidential papers spill from its top tier like a white waterfall. The stone floor drops away. You hang for a terrifying heartbeat in the dusty air between two moving stacks of literature. Then you throw your weight sideways, and balance and agility have to carry you through the gap before the furniture shifts again and blocks the path completely.

check.label: Leap and catch the runaway cart

nodes.title: The Heavy Spill
nodes.brief: You dance between drifting card-cabinets to intercept a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers, risking a heavy fall, to retrieve a misplaced transit voucher.
nodes.page: Your boot clips the lower rail of a sliding cabinet as you land. You crash hard against a stack of bound volumes, shoulder bruised, palm scraped raw. The runaway cart slams a pillar with a splintering thud and spills hundreds of confidential dossiers across the floor in a white drift. You push up from the dusty flagstones. Raw skin on your knuckles flares as the surrounding cataloguers murmur from their high desks.

nodes.title: The Retrieved Voucher
nodes.brief: You dance between drifting card-cabinets to intercept a tumbling cart of confidential dossiers, risking a heavy fall, to retrieve a misplaced transit voucher.
nodes.page: Your fingers clamp firmly around the edge of the leather-bound transit dossier just as the cart shudders to a permanent halt against a stout stone pillar, however narrowly avoiding a disastrous plunge into the ink-river. You pull the required parchment free from the tangled heap of paperwork, checking its embossed stamp to ensure the transit voucher remains intact and unsoiled. Tucking the recovered document securely into your belt pouch, you leave the scattered papers for the junior scribes to sort.

nodes.title: The Water-Clock Antechamber
nodes.brief: Armed beadles intercept your progress down the vaulted corridor, escorting you into a dim antechamber filled with the ticking of a hundred water-clocks.
nodes.page: Oak doors swing shut behind you with a dull boom. Armed beadles in stiff grey uniforms escort you into an austere antechamber carved from the living rock of Quillon's foundations. A hundred water-clocks tick in the chamber, brass-and-glass reservoirs dripping dark, ink-like fluid into pewter basins that mark the passage of the Long Closing. Spectators murmur from shadowy alcoves as you are led to the center of the mosaic floor, where the tribunal waits to weigh your transgressions against the ancient laws of the library.

nodes.title: The Tribunal Gallery
nodes.brief: The Tribunal Gallery: Spectators in grey robes watch from tiered benches as judges deliberate over charges of unauthorized cataloguing.
nodes.page: Tiered benches of soot-stained pine rise into the damp vaulting, packed with grey-robed spectators whose breath smells of stale ink and dried chicory. Below, upon a raised dais of veined slate, three judges of the Cataloguers' Court whisper behind high barricades of cross-indexed ledgers, weighing charges of unauthorized cataloguing against the fellowship of the lower stacks. A thin drift of lamp-oil smoke hangs in the cold air, stinging your eyes while the scratching of nibs echoes like restless beetles. Every aisle out of this hollow court offers a desperate gamble, whether through forged credentials, balanced leaps across ledgers, or sheer defiance of the bench.

exits.label: Slip into the clerk's alcove unnoticed
Face the chief judge without flinching

nodes.title: The Clerk's Alcove
nodes.brief: You manipulate the clerk of court into misfiling your indictment papers, risking public exposure, to secure a key to the lower archive stairs.
nodes.page: Piles of parchment requisitions tower over a sloping mahogany desk where a weary clerk mutters complaints about missing red twine. You step softly across the damp flagstones, slipping your own indictment folio into the middle of a stack marked for indefinite archiving. The clerk dips a heavy steel nib into an ink-pot, distracted by a noisy dispute echoing from the gallery benches above. Whispering remarks about routine administrative transfers, you point toward the bottom shelf where the keys to the lower archive stairs hang from a brass hook, waiting for a steady hand to reach out and take them.

nodes.title: Reordering the Indictment
nodes.brief: You manipulate the clerk of court into misfiling your indictment papers, risking public exposure, to secure a key to the lower archive stairs.
nodes.page: While the clerk's ink-stained quill scratches a slow, rhythmic tally just inches away, your fingers hover over the iron ring of keys. A single misstep will scatter the precarious columns of ledgers across the flagstones, drawing the sharp eyes of the armed beadles stationed at the archway. You lean into the reek of lamp-oil and gum arabic and time your reach to the chime of the distant water-clock as your palm slides toward the brass ring.

check.label: Slide your hand toward the keys

nodes.title: A Heavy Misplacement
nodes.brief: You manipulate the clerk of court into misfiling your indictment papers, risking public exposure, to secure a key to the lower archive stairs.
nodes.page: A corner of your leather sleeve catches the edge of an open register, sending a cascade of loose ink-vials shattering across the stone floor in a dark, spreading flood. The clerk lets out a sharp shriek of indignation, and iron-shod boots stampede across the flagstones from the gallery doors. You snatch the iron ring from its hook just as iron-shod hands clamp heavily onto your shoulders, dragging you away into a cramped holding cell. The rough handling leaves a deep, angry scrape along your ribs and costs you precious hours of precious time before you manage to slip free into the dim corridors again.

nodes.title: The Purloined Pass-Key
nodes.brief: You manipulate the clerk of court into misfiling your indictment papers, risking public exposure, to secure a key to the lower archive stairs.
nodes.page: Your fingers close securely around the cold brass ring, lifting it from the hook just as the clerk looks up with a sudden, suspicious frown. You slip the iron key into your waistcoat pocket as the ink-pot wobbles and settles back onto its blotter. Just beyond the shadow of the filing cabinets, the timber door to the lower stairs stands shut, away from the watchful eyes of the tribunal.

nodes.title: The Piercing Gaze
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute composure under the piercing gaze of the Chief Cataloguer, risking your inner resolve, to gain a written pardon for past offenses.
nodes.page: Cold yellow lamplight flickers across the polished mahogany of the dock where you stand under the uncompromising scrutiny of the Chief Cataloguer. Around you the court goes silent, broken only by a distant drip from the cave ceiling and the scratch of a recording scribe's quill. The Chief Cataloguer's sharp eyes narrow behind wire spectacles, searching every fold of your shelver's tunic for any sign of hesitation or guilt regarding the lost indexing notes.

nodes.title: Silence in the Dock
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute composure under the piercing gaze of the Chief Cataloguer, risking your inner resolve, to gain a written pardon for past offenses.
nodes.page: Dust motes dance in the shaft of greasy light cutting across the wooden barrier, settling upon the ink-stained cuffs of your uniform. The senior magistrates lean together, muttering dry legalities concerning the misplacement of historical volumes and the unauthorized reading of restricted margins. You keep your shoulders squared against the damp chill radiating from the masonry behind you, listening to the soft murmur of rival scholars whispering from the rear benches about your impending sentence.

nodes.title: Unwavering Resolve
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute composure under the piercing gaze of the Chief Cataloguer, risking your inner resolve, to gain a written pardon for past offenses.
nodes.page: The Chief Cataloguer raises a parchment slip bearing your name and reads aloud a list of infractions that could condemn you to decades of sorting scrap paper in the Misfiled Wing. The pressure inside the stone chamber grows thick and heavy, threatening to crush your inner resolve and force a panicked confession from your lips. You lock your jaw against the rising tide of doubt, staring straight into the cold glare of the magistrate while every instinct screams at you to break and run.

nodes.title: A Fractured Will
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute composure under the piercing gaze of the Chief Cataloguer, risking your inner resolve, to gain a written pardon for past offenses.
nodes.page: The crushing weight of the court's accumulated silence breaks your concentration like dry brittle paper, forcing you to stagger back against the wooden rail with a sharp gasp. A murmur of disapproval ripples through the tiered benches as the Chief Cataloguer marks a heavy red cross across your dossier. Though you manage to avoid outright imprisonment, the grueling interrogation leaves you mentally exhausted and burdened with a formal reprimand that triples your official debt to the fellowship.

nodes.title: The Signed Acquittal
nodes.brief: You maintain absolute composure under the piercing gaze of the Chief Cataloguer, risking your inner resolve, to gain a written pardon for past offenses.
nodes.page: Your steady gaze meets the magistrate's eyes until the Chief Cataloguer lets out a dry, reluctant sigh and dips a bone pen into the black well. A formal pardon is scratched onto heavy rag paper, sealed with a glob of hot crimson wax that smells faintly of burnt resin. You take the document cleanly as the court bailiff steps aside and clears your path toward the iron depths, no public reprimand spoken.

nodes.title: The Confiscated Warrant
