nodes.brief: You forge an official signature on a confiscated warrant using quick wit, risking discovery by guards, to obtain an exemption seal.
nodes.page: Ink smells of iron and vinegar in the small vestibule behind the magistrate's bench, where discarded requisitions pile like fallen leaves. Your fingers trace the damp margin of the confiscated warrant while a guard's heavy boots echo on the floorboards outside. Every second spent holding the bone pen risks discovery by watchful officials who patrol the corridors.

nodes.title: The Forged Seal
nodes.brief: You forge an official signature on a confiscated warrant using quick wit, risking discovery by guards, to obtain an exemption seal.
nodes.page: Swiftly and silently, you mimic the loops of the Chief Cataloguer's peculiar script, letting the dark ink settle into the thirsty grain of the official paper. A lamp flickers in the draft, casting long shadows across the rows of card-drawers. The exemption seal must look entirely genuine if it is to withstand the strict scrutiny of the gatekeepers ahead.

nodes.title: Imitating the Chief Cataloguer
nodes.brief: You forge an official signature on a confiscated warrant using quick wit, risking discovery by guards, to obtain an exemption seal.
nodes.page: Breath held, you finish the last flourish on the forged warrant as footsteps pause just outside the wooden partition. The risk of sudden exposure hangs thick in the dusty air of the chamber as you press your thumb against the wet ink to smudge it convincingly. Everything depends on whether your hasty imitation holds up under the cold eyes of the guard.

nodes.title: Smudged Ink and Scrutiny
nodes.brief: You forge an official signature on a confiscated warrant using quick wit, risking discovery by guards, to obtain an exemption seal.
nodes.page: The guard notices the uneven weight of the strokes and snatches the warrant away with a sharp reprimand, leaving your fingers stained with cheap lamp-black. You lose precious minutes arguing your case in the draughty corridor while a stern clerk docks your weekly rations of dried meat. Though you escape without being hauled back before the magistrates, the bitter memory of failure clings to your thoughts like soot.

nodes.title: The Forged Exemption Seal
nodes.brief: You forge an official signature on a confiscated warrant using quick wit, risking discovery by guards, to obtain an exemption seal.
nodes.page:
Ink stains smear across your fingertips as you scratch the final loop of the Chief Cataloguer's signature onto the confiscated warrant, your pulse racing against your ribs. Boots echo just beyond the arched oak partition, yet your hand holds firm enough to press the brass stamp into the hot red wax, sealing the document with a forged authority that might buy your passage or condemn you to the deepest cells.

Pocketing the cool parchment exemption seal before the sentries round the corner, you slip away into the shadows of the card-drawers with a dry throat and a dangerously acquired leverage that no tribunal clerk can easily dispute.

nodes.title: Balancing Acts Before Bench
nodes.brief: You gracefully navigate a stack of collapsing reference ledgers while addressing the bench, risking physical stumbling, to impress a sympathetic assessor.
nodes.page: Great towers of calfskin-bound ledgers groan and shudder beneath your boots as you lean forward to address the stern-faced assessors on the tribunal bench, trusting entirely to balance and nerve. A sudden shift in the floor makes a dozen volumes cascade in a dusty avalanche around your ankles, yet you turn the stumble into a measured bow, catching a sympathetic flicker of amusement in the eyes of the eldest magistrate.

nodes.title: Crossing the Collapsing Stacks
nodes.brief: You gracefully navigate a stack of collapsing reference ledgers while addressing the bench, risking physical stumbling, to impress a sympathetic assessor.
nodes.page: More heavy volumes slide from their rotting shelves, creating an unpredictable hazard of shifting leather and sharp paper edges right across the gallery floor. You leap across a chasm of spilled folios while keeping your gaze fixed firmly on the sympathetic assessor's attentive face. A single misstep will send you crashing into the rows of stacked authorities below.

nodes.title: A Clumsy Misstep
nodes.brief: You gracefully navigate a stack of collapsing reference ledgers while addressing the bench, risking physical stumbling, to impress a sympathetic assessor.
nodes.page: Your boot clips the corner of an open atlas and a cascade of ancient appendices spills across the stone floor in a humiliating racket. The sympathetic assessor turns away. He gives a disappointed wince while you scramble to gather the loose leaves under the cold stares of the court. You limp off with a scraped shin. Bruised pride will take days to mend.

nodes.title: Grace Among the Falling Tomes
nodes.brief: You gracefully navigate a stack of collapsing reference ledgers while addressing the bench, risking physical stumbling, to impress a sympathetic assessor.
nodes.page: Leather-bound volumes tumble in a cascading roar around your ankles, yet you manage to keep your footing atop the swaying ledgers while addressing the bench with cool, deliberate precision. The sympathetic assessor in the second row watches your agile recovery with a quiet, approving nod, slipping a folded slip of parchment into your palm as a reward for your uncommon balance under pressure.

exits.label: Return to the crowded tribunal gallery

nodes.title: Staring Down the Prosecutor
nodes.brief: You stare down a hostile prosecutor who threatens your shelver fellowship, risking psychological collapse, to win the right of free passage.
nodes.page: The prosecutor leans across the polished oak barrier, his voice dropping to a dry rasp as he lists the petty thefts of your shelver fellowship. Shadows stretch across the floor from the high arched windows, smelling of damp parchment and old tallow. You meet his gaze without flinching, refusing to let the weight of institutional malice break your spirit.

nodes.title: The Weight of Silence
nodes.brief: You stare down a hostile prosecutor who threatens your shelver fellowship, risking psychological collapse, to win the right of free passage.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the crowded benches like a physical blanket of grey dust, muffling the distant scraping of pens from the outer rooms. The prosecutor narrows his eyes, testing your resolve with veiled threats about the Misfiled Wing and its endless stacks of uncatalogued scrap. Your pulse beats hard against your ribs, but you keep your shoulders squared against the courtroom wall.

nodes.title: Facing the Accuser
nodes.brief: You stare down a hostile prosecutor who threatens your shelver fellowship, risking psychological collapse, to win the right of free passage.
nodes.page: Cold sweat gathers at your temples as the prosecutor invokes the dreaded name of the Chief Cataloguer to terrify you into submission. The flickering lamp-oil casts dancing distortions across his severe face while you summon every ounce of stubborn loyalty to your fellowship. You must anchor your thoughts against the rising panic before the tribunal demands your surrender.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Prosecutor
nodes.brief: You stare down a hostile prosecutor who threatens your shelver fellowship, risking psychological collapse, to win the right of free passage.
nodes.page:
The prosecutor's harsh interrogation hammers against your thoughts like an iron mallet on a cracked bell, draining your resolve until your temples throb. A sharp, stinging headache flares behind your eyes as the mental strain forces you to grip the wooden rail just to stay upright. Though you secure the grudging right of passage through the lower arches, the ordeal leaves you battered in spirit and nursing a deep, throbbing weariness that makes every breath feel like drawing dry ash.

You stumble into the shadows of the corridor, swallowing the bitter taste of exhaustion as you press onward.

exits.label: Advance into the dim corridor with a heavy heart and ringing ears.

nodes.title: The Tribunal Yields
nodes.brief: You stare down a hostile prosecutor who threatens your shelver fellowship, risking psychological collapse, to win the right of free passage.
nodes.page: Tremors fade from your fingers as the prosecutor's gaze finally falters, beaten back by the sheer granite weight of your unyielding stare. The judges mutter among themselves, shuffle parchment rolls, and grudgingly grant you clearance to leave the dock with your shelver fellowship's honor intact. You slip away from the bench into the shadow of the tiered galleries, clutching your prize tightly.

exits.label: Step through into the viewing gallery

nodes.title: The Iron Portcullis
nodes.brief: A massive iron portcullis slams shut ahead of you, operated by a mechanical registrar who demands a heavy toll of rare marginalia.
nodes.page: Iron links groan overhead while a towering mechanical registrar bars the way with spikes and cold grey metal. The clockwork figure extends a brass hand and demands a steep toll of rare marginalia torn straight from the margins of forbidden volumes before it will grant permission to pass. You search your pockets, sacrificing precious hand-scrawled notes left behind by ancient readers to appease the greedy mechanism. Gears shriek dry and grinding as the portcullis drags itself upward into the stone ceiling and clears the path ahead.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium of Appeals
nodes.brief: The Scriptorium of Appeals: Despairing scholars plead their cases at individual booths while ink-stained scribes record every whispered grievance.
nodes.page: Despairing scholars lean over individual wooden booths, whispering frantic grievances while ink-stained scribes record every complaint with scratchy nibs. The air smells strongly of gall-ink and nervous sweat under the vaulted stone ceiling where multiple arched corridors diverge into shadow. You pause by the central pillar, weighing your options as impatient murmurs rise from the crowded petitioners around you. Every path leads deeper into the labyrinthine machinery of the court, demanding immediate decision before the guards notice your hesitation.

exits.label: Seek out the quiet southern exit

nodes.title: The Requisition Booth
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past the booth guard by claiming urgent magisterial business, risking detection, to acquire a blank requisition form.
nodes.page: Brass wire mesh separates you from a clerk whose ink-stained fingers tap impatiently against a stack of official forms. You lean in close, speaking in the brisk, clipped tones of urgent magisterial business to mask the rapid hammering of your heart against your ribs. The clerk narrows their eyes behind wire-rimmed spectacles, weighing your audacity against the formidable penalties for forgery. With a reluctant sigh, a blank requisition form slides across the scarred wooden counter toward your waiting fingers.

nodes.title: Claiming the Form
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past the booth guard by claiming urgent magisterial business, risking detection, to acquire a blank requisition form.
nodes.page: Your fingers stretch across the wooden counter toward the crisp, unsullied slip of official paper while the clerk turns away to answer a distant summons. A sharp cough from the neighboring booth threatens to expose your unauthorized reach, drawing the immediate attention of the watchful guard stationed nearby. You freeze in place, feigning innocent curiosity about the posted schedule while tension coils tight in your shoulders.

check.label: reach across the counter for the form

nodes.title: A Costly Deception
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past the booth guard by claiming urgent magisterial business, risking detection, to acquire a blank requisition form.
nodes.page: Boots strike the stone flags as the booth guard intercepts your hand mid-motion and twists your wrist behind your back with bruising force. Your carefully crafted bluff collapses instantly under the sharp glare of the magistrate's official, costing you precious minutes and leaving a dull, throbbing ache in your joints. You are shoved roughly aside into the drafty corridor, poorer by a valuable slip of parchment you had hoped to keep.

nodes.title: The Blank Slip Secured
nodes.brief: You bluff your way past the booth guard by claiming urgent magisterial business, risking detection, to acquire a blank requisition form.
nodes.page: Your fingers close around the crisp, official paper just as the booth clerk turns back to face the counter. The blank requisition form bears the authentic watermark of the Cataloguers' Court, offering an invaluable key to restricted archives if used with care. You pocket the prize immediately, slipping away into the press of petitioners before anyone realizes the oversight.

nodes.title: The Procedural Code
nodes.brief: You decipher an ancient clause in the procedural code hidden within a massive tome, risking mental fatigue, to unlock a restricted passage.
nodes.page: Yellowed pages turn with a dry rustle beneath your trembling fingertips as you scan lines of dense, archaic legal prose written by forgotten judges. The heavy leather-bound tome rests on a sloping lectern, its iron chains clinking softly against the stone floor with every breath you draw. Somewhere within these tangled clauses lies the exact wording needed to unlock the restricted passage ahead, provided your mind does not buckle under the sheer weight of the bureaucracy.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Clauses
nodes.brief: You decipher an ancient clause in the procedural code hidden within a massive tome, risking mental fatigue, to unlock a restricted passage.
nodes.page: Candlelight flickers across thin vellum leaves as you trace faded ink annotations scrawled by generations of tired scholars who walked this hall before you. Your temples throb with a dull, persistent ache from hours of intense concentration in the dusty, poorly ventilated alcove. The procedural code begins to reveal hidden exceptions and forgotten exemptions buried deep within the convoluted legal phrasing.

exits.label: Turn to the final coded page

nodes.title: Unlocking the Passage
nodes.brief: You decipher an ancient clause in the procedural code hidden within a massive tome, risking mental fatigue, to unlock a restricted passage.
nodes.page: Your eyes scan the final dense paragraph of legal jargon while mental fatigue presses against your brain like a leaden weight threatening to obscure your focus entirely. A hidden catch somewhere within the wooden shelving clicks softly in response to your murmured interpretation of the ancient rule. You hold your breath and wait to see if the mechanism accepts your deduction or seals the passage permanently.

nodes.title: Mental Fatigue
nodes.brief: You decipher an ancient clause in the procedural code hidden within a massive tome, risking mental fatigue, to unlock a restricted passage.
nodes.page: The legal clause blurs into a meaningless smear of black ink as your exhausted mind rebels against the complex phrasing, leaving your thoughts scattered and confused. A sharp spike of mental fatigue strikes like a physical blow, costing you precious time and leaving you with a lingering, throbbing migraine. You stagger back from the lectern, rubbing your aching temples in the dim candlelight.

exits.label: Recover your wits in the hallway

nodes.title: The Secret Clearance
nodes.brief: You decipher an ancient clause in the procedural code hidden within a massive tome, risking mental fatigue, to unlock a restricted passage.
nodes.page: The dense legal jargon yields in your head, and the hidden mechanism gives a thud that unlatches a narrow vertical door in the oak paneling. The secret passage swings outward on well-oiled hinges, revealing a dark stone stairwell descending into the restricted stacks. You pocket your notes and step through the gap before the librarian notices the breach.

nodes.title: The False Ledger
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to falsify your own travel records under intense interrogation, risking your nerve, to earn the secret respect of a senior clerk.
nodes.page:
Mahogany desks crowd the ink-stained floor of the tribunal chamber while clerks whisper behind towers of stamped parchment. A senior inquisitor slides an open register across the blotter, demanding an alteration to your entry dates with a smooth, dangerous smile that invites quiet compliance. The scratch of steel nibs fills the breathless air, and temptation whispers that a single amended stroke of your pen will clear your path instantly.

Instead of bending the truth, your fingers tighten around your dry quill while you consider the severe penalties for falsifying official records within these echoing stone vaults. Every instinct urges you to slide the ledger back unmarked before the watchful eyes across the desk narrow any further.

nodes.title: Ink on the Sleeve
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to falsify your own travel records under intense interrogation, risking your nerve, to earn the secret respect of a senior clerk.
nodes.page:
Cold lamplight catches brass spectacle frames as the examiner leans in and taps an ink-stained finger on the suspicious gap in your movement logs. Between the tall bookshelves the silence holds gum arabic and dried gall. You hold his gaze. His pale palm carries your administrative fate.

A draft from the ventilation shafts makes the oil lamps jump. Shadows climb the rows of card-drawers behind the tribunal dais. The senior official tilts his head, matching your mute defiance against the easy convenience of a forged confession.

exits.label: Meet the cold gaze without flinching

nodes.title: The Inquisitor's Stare
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to falsify your own travel records under intense interrogation, risking your nerve, to earn the secret respect of a senior clerk.
nodes.page: Every muscle in your neck stiffens as the chief inquisitor places his pen down with a sharp click that reverberates through the arched hall. He slides the incriminating page an inch closer to your fingers and waits to see if his official stare will break your nerve. You feel the temptation to scratch out the date and rewrite your history pulling at your resolve like a strong current dragging you toward a safe harbor. Sweat beads at your temples while you force your hands to remain flat and open upon the polished timber surface.

check.label: Maintain steady eye contact under pressure

nodes.title: A Slip of the Pen
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to falsify your own travel records under intense interrogation, risking your nerve, to earn the secret respect of a senior clerk.
nodes.page:
Your nerve splinters under the unrelenting gaze of the tribunal, and a nervous twitch betrays your hesitation just long enough for the senior clerk to note your weakness. For your brief panic he extracts a formal debt of service and marks your travel parchment with a crimson stamp of censure that will follow you through every stack in the Underlibrary. A sharp reprimand echoes through the hall, costing you valuable hours of transit time and leaving your shoulders aching from the tension of the ordeal.

You gather your remaining papers with trembling fingers, chastened by the encounter but still permitted to leave the tribunal desk with your skin intact.

exits.label: Gather your marked papers and leave

nodes.title: Respect Across the Desk
nodes.brief: You resist the temptation to falsify your own travel records under intense interrogation, risking your nerve, to earn the secret respect of a senior clerk.
nodes.page:
The senior clerk stares at your unblemished logbook for a long, silent moment before a dry, approving cough breaks the heavy stillness of the hall. He closes the register with a dull thud, your records still intact against his probing questions. A nod of hard-earned recognition passes between you as he signs your clearance slip with a flourish of his own pen.

You slide the small token into your coat pocket, knowing its value among the stack-keepers will open doors that remain firmly bolted to ordinary shelvers.

exits.label: Walk toward the Scriptorium of Appeals

nodes.title: The Magistrate's Demand
nodes.brief: You hold your ground against a bullying magistrate who tries to confiscate your lamp, risking your courage, to protect your precious oil supply.
nodes.page:
A stout magistrate blocks the narrow stone archway, his brass badge catching the yellow glow of your brass-bound hand-lamp while he insists that open flames violate municipal code. He reaches out with stubby, ink-stained fingers to snatch the oil reservoir from your grip, citing emergency regulations that govern the lower stacks during the Long Closing. The acrid stench of cheap tallow hangs around his woollen coat as he looms closer, daring you to challenge his authority in the crowded transit corridor.

You grip the handle of your lamp tighter, feeling the warm metal press against your palm as scholars bustle past on their way to the galleried reading rooms.

exits.label: Stand firm against the bullying magistrate

nodes.title: Shadows on the Wall
nodes.brief: You hold your ground against a bullying magistrate who tries to confiscate your lamp, risking your courage, to protect your precious oil supply.
nodes.page:
Shadows fall long and crooked across the limestone blocks as the magistrate raises his voice. Passing cataloguers glance over, arms full of thick folios. You will not give up your only light in this dim labyrinth, where an unlit corridor can finish a junior shelver. The brass lamp grows hot against your knuckles, a small sun held against the creep of the deep shelves.

Something under the floorboards knocks through your boots. The architecture itself cares nothing for a petty quarrel over fuel.

exits.label: Hold the lamp above the dispute

nodes.title: Defending the Flame
nodes.brief: You hold your ground against a bullying magistrate who tries to confiscate your lamp, risking your courage, to protect your precious oil supply.
nodes.page: The magistrate lunges forward with both hands outstretched to wrench the brass lamp from your fingers, his face flushed with the righteous fury of a petty rule-keeper. You brace your boots against the uneven paving stones, throwing your entire weight backward while your fingers lock around the carrying handle with desperate strength. The flickering flame casts wild, leaping patterns of soot across the stone vaulting as you pit your raw courage against his aggressive advance.

nodes.title: A Shattered Reservoir
nodes.brief: You hold your ground against a bullying magistrate who tries to confiscate your lamp, risking your courage, to protect your precious oil supply.
nodes.page:
The magistrate's rough yank tears the lamp from your grasp. It crashes against the stone floor, and the brass reservoir splits open with a sharp clatter. Precious lamp-oil spills across the flags. Your primary light is gone, and a jagged scratch runs across your knuckles. The bitter taste of wasted fuel fills the air as the official marches away, and you are left to nurse the minor injury and piece together your journey through the gathering gloom.

You salvage the dented wick-holder from the floor. The confrontation cost you supplies.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Flame
nodes.brief: You hold your ground against a bullying magistrate who tries to confiscate your lamp, risking your courage, to protect your precious oil supply.
nodes.page:
Your grip holds against the magistrate's sudden lunge, and the brass lamp stays clear of the flagstones. The official snorts in disgust, adjusts his spectacles, and steps aside into the shadows with a muttered warning about future inspections. You steady your breathing and check the fuel level through the small glass viewing port, finding the oil supply miraculously intact within the battered casing.

As a reward for your stubborn courage, you discover a discarded pass slipped beneath the base of the lamp, granting access to restricted transit routes.

exits.label: Proceed into the moving filing labyrinth

nodes.title: The Crushing Stacks
nodes.brief: You navigate a labyrinthine filing labyrinth where towering shelves slide back and forth to crush unauthorized intruders.
nodes.page: Towering banks of oak and iron glide across the flagstones with a low, bone-grinding groan, sealing off alleyways of classification without warning. You press your spine flat against a cold mahogany upright as two immense stacks rumble past each other, missing your coat-tails by a hair's breadth and smelling heavily of dry wood-rot and old gall-ink. The labyrinthine filing system shifts beneath your boots, rearranging whole centuries of philosophy and trade tariffs into new, suffocating corridors that demand immediate, breathless navigation before the moving timber closes your escape entirely.

exits.label: Squeeze past the shifting mahogany bulkheads

nodes.title: The Shifting Stacks
nodes.brief: The Shifting Stacks: Rows of heavy oak bookcases glide across recessed tracks, rearranging the geography of the entire chamber.
nodes.page: Oak bookcases glide along recessed iron tracks, redrawing the geography of the vaulted chamber with a rhythmic, mechanical sigh that smells of dust and machine oil. Faint glimmers of copper light catch the edges of moving shelves where distant scholars or unseen mechanisms alter the categorisation of the entire floor. You stand at a temporary nexus of converging corridors, weighing which uncertain path might lead deeper into the masonry. Every partition is restless, promising either a swift passage or a labyrinthine trap among the forgotten folios.

exits.label: Leap toward the suspended iron catwalk

nodes.title: The Maintenance Hatch
nodes.brief: You study the complex mechanical rhythm of the moving shelving units, risking miscalculation, to discover a hidden maintenance hatch.
nodes.page: Deep among the groaning framework of the movable cases, you trace the rhythmic, sliding cadence of the counterweights until your fingers brush against a flush brass ring set into the floorboards. The complicated choreography of the shelving units creates a brief, synchronized pause in the machinery, offering a narrow window to unlatch the concealed iron plate. You drop to one knee, ignoring the biting scent of aged paper and copper dust, to pry open the hidden maintenance shaft before the rolling library resumes its deafening march.

nodes.title: The Rhythmic Timing
nodes.brief: You study the complex mechanical rhythm of the moving shelving units, risking miscalculation, to discover a hidden maintenance hatch.
nodes.page: Staring intently at the gleaming bronze gears spinning behind a slotted iron grille, you try to map the precise cadence of the counterweights shifting overhead. A single miscalculation in timing will wedge your arm between two converging tonnes of philosophy and theology, yet the hidden latch cannot be lifted without matching their mechanical pulse. You reach your fingers toward the latch, holding your breath as the massive oak case begins its inevitable, crushing glide.

nodes.title: A Crushing Misstep
nodes.brief: You study the complex mechanical rhythm of the moving shelving units, risking miscalculation, to discover a hidden maintenance hatch.
nodes.page: Your fingers slip against the greased iron just as the case lurches forward, catches your sleeve, and pins your shoulder hard against the rough oak upright with a sickening jolt. Pain flares sharply across your collarbone. A deep purple bruise spreads, and a ragged strip tears from your shelver's coat. You wrench yourself free with a desperate heave, tumbling sideways into the dust as the massive timber grinds past, leaving you battered, winded, and poorer by a good jacket.

nodes.title: The Serviceman's Key
nodes.brief: You study the complex mechanical rhythm of the moving shelving units, risking miscalculation, to discover a hidden maintenance hatch.
nodes.page: Your fingers catch the brass ring and heave upward just as the oak case grinds to a momentary halt; the iron panel lifts and shows a dark, oil-slicked descent. You pull yourself over the lip of the hatch with the brass key still clutched in your palm, pocketing a tool meant only for the master cataloguers.

nodes.title: Across the Chasm
nodes.brief: You leap across a widening chasm between two parting bookcases with agile grace, risking a dangerous plunge, to reach a suspended catwalk.
nodes.page: Two towering shelving units part abruptly with a screech of iron wheels, exposing a black, echoing drop where the stone floor has fallen away into the under-stacks. Far below, rivers of stagnant ink gleam faintly under the pale grease-lamps of the lower tiers, while a thin iron catwalk dangles by rusted wire across the void. You step back to gain momentum on the shifting oak boards, fixing your gaze upon the narrow walkway swaying in the draft.

nodes.title: The Parting Stacks
nodes.brief: You leap across a widening chasm between two parting bookcases with agile grace, risking a dangerous plunge, to reach a suspended catwalk.
nodes.page: Mahogany timber groans and splits as oak bookcases grind apart in opposite directions, carving a jagged black void through the heart of the aisle. The gap widens with every second, revealing only the misty, ink-stained abyss far below where the floorboards ought to be. Trusting in quick feet and steady balance, you kick off the trembling edge of the retreating shelf, launching yourself outward over the chasm with arms outstretched.

exits.label: Scramble onto the trembling iron grating.

nodes.title: The Midair Leap
nodes.brief: You leap across a widening chasm between two parting bookcases with agile grace, risking a dangerous plunge, to reach a suspended catwalk.
nodes.page: You hurl yourself outward from the edge of the receding bookcase, leaving the solid oak behind to hang suspended for one breathless heartbeat in the dusty gloom. Below you, the ink-rivers swirl in silent mockery while the iron catwalk sways wildly away from your oncoming trajectory. You tuck your chin and reach out with both hands, trusting your balance to carry you across the lethal chasm.

nodes.title: A Plunge Into Ink
nodes.brief: You leap across a widening chasm between two parting bookcases with agile grace, risking a dangerous plunge, to reach a suspended catwalk.
nodes.page: Your boots strike the slick edge of the catwalk with insufficient purchase, sending you skidding over the opposite side and plunging your right arm deep into a trough of stagnant, foul-smelling copying ink. You haul yourself back onto the grating with a wet gasp, leaving your sleeve stained a permanent, indelible black that smells of gall and copper. The sudden impact leaves your ribs aching and your pride thoroughly dampened, though you are alive to drag yourself along the iron mesh.

nodes.title: The Balanced Landing
nodes.brief: You leap across a widening chasm between two parting bookcases with agile grace, risking a dangerous plunge, to reach a suspended catwalk.
nodes.page: Your boots hit the center of the swaying iron mesh with practiced lightness, absorbing the shock as the catwalk rings like a struck bell in the hollow vault. You secure a loose brass link from the railing as a souvenir of your crossing and pocket the metal peg before the structure settles back into place.

nodes.title: The Carved Floorboards
nodes.brief: You decipher the shifting categorical symbols carved into the floorboards, risking profound confusion, to map the safest route forward.
nodes.page:
Cold drafts whistle through the intersecting alleyways of the lower archives, carrying the sharp tang of gall ink and damp masonry. Beneath your ink-stained boots, the wooden floorboards bear a labyrinth of deep-chiselled symbols, shifting their angles each time the distant water-clocks chime. These marks denote the rigid taxonomy of the Cataloguers, separating history from fiction by fractions of a degree. You kneel beside a particularly stubborn glyph that pulses with a faint, amber luminescence, tracing its contours with a gloved finger while overhead iron chains groan against unseen weights.

To secure your path toward the restricted corridors without triggering a tribunal alarm, you must interpret the sequence before the floor sections slide apart into absolute darkness.

nodes.title: The Ciphered Path
nodes.brief: You decipher the shifting categorical symbols carved into the floorboards, risking profound confusion, to map the safest route forward.
nodes.page:
Shadows lengthen across the pine planks as the categorization marks bleed thin lines of red sealing wax into the grain. Your fingers trace the complex geometries. Far below Quillon, subterranean machinery shifts tons of vellum and parchment, and a faint vibration rises through the floor. Every symbol stands for a category of forbidden thought, a dangerous taxonomy meant to keep unruly volumes in their proper stalls. From the adjacent stack comes a low, rhythmic scratching. Rule-keepers are close.

You raise your lamp. Warm oil-light shows the next junction, where the floorboards split into three forks of logic.

nodes.title: Reading The Runes
nodes.brief: You decipher the shifting categorical symbols carved into the floorboards, risking profound confusion, to map the safest route forward.
nodes.page: Sweats collects at your temples as the floorboards beneath your knees begin to tilt sideways, threatening to slide your boots into a yawning crevice of uncatalogued pamphlets. You press your palms flat against the restless oak, frantically cross-referencing the drifting symbols against the memory of every classification manual you ever memorized as a junior page. The rules are ancient, contradictory, and fiercely enforced by the invisible tribunal watching from the high balconies. Your eyes dart across the carved sequence, desperately seeking the single logical thread that binds the chaotic taxonomy together before the entire floor rotates into the abyss.

nodes.title: The Cost Of Confusion
nodes.brief: You decipher the shifting categorical symbols carved into the floorboards, risking profound confusion, to map the safest route forward.
nodes.page: A sudden wrenching shudder of the timbers betrays your faulty calculation. You sprawl across the abrasive oak planks. A row of shelf-dividers snaps shut like teeth. The sharp edge of a brass classification plate slices a jagged line across your knuckles and draws a bright line of crimson that stains the sacred wood. You scramble backward with a sharp intake of breath, clutch your bleeding hand, and feel the floor settle into a crooked unstable angle. Precious minutes are gone. Ache sits in your fingers, but the path ahead finally locks into a grudging permanent alignment.

nodes.title: The Scholar's Key
nodes.brief: You decipher the shifting categorical symbols carved into the floorboards, risking profound confusion, to map the safest route forward.
nodes.page: Your mind cuts through the complex web of cross-references with absolute precision, translating the erratic floor carvings into a clean, flawless vector across the trembling chamber. Your boots find purchase on the exact center of each stable plank just as the surrounding rows lock into place with a solid thud. In the groove of the final timber, your fingers brush a small object wedged deep in the grain: an iron key bearing the stamp of the lower stacks.

nodes.title: The Rails Of Brass
nodes.brief: You slide along the top rail of a moving bookcase with practiced balance, risking a clumsy tumble, to retrieve a dropped brass compass.
nodes.page:
High above the stone floor, the polished brass guide rails of the moving bookcases shiver enough to rattle your teeth. You hook your heels over the top timber of a towering oak case and brace against the drop into the shadowy aisles. A discarded brass compass gleams just out of reach on a parallel rail that drifts away across empty air. Old paper and lamp-oil fill the damp smell of a place that has forgotten the sun.

You tighten your grip on your leather satchel and ready yourself to bridge the widening gap.

nodes.title: The Gleaming Needle
nodes.brief: You slide along the top rail of a moving bookcase with practiced balance, risking a clumsy tumble, to retrieve a dropped brass compass.
nodes.page:
Metal screeches against metal as the neighboring stack shifts two inches to the left and narrows the gap between your perch and the lost brass compass. Below you the leather-bound rows look like the teeth of a sleeping leviathan. You slow your breath. The needle keeps spinning. Eyes stay on that small point of brass as it aims toward some hidden magnetic north in the heart of the Underlibrary, while overhead chains tug at your balance on the narrow strip beneath your soles.

You crouch lower and lean forward to shorten the reach to the prize before the tracks grind into their next layout.

nodes.title: Balancing On The Beam
nodes.brief: You slide along the top rail of a moving bookcase with practiced balance, risking a clumsy tumble, to retrieve a dropped brass compass.
nodes.page: You throw your weight forward along the greasy brass pipe, letting momentum carry you across the growing void while the iron shelf beneath your knees shudders violently from side to side. The wind of the moving stacks whips at your coat tails, threatening to pitch you headfirst into the dark abyss of the unmapped tiers. Your fingers stretch toward the spinning compass as the rail beneath it dips sharply downward, testing your equilibrium to its absolute limit in the hushed, dusty gloom.

nodes.title: A Clumsy Tumble
nodes.brief: You slide along the top rail of a moving bookcase with practiced balance, risking a clumsy tumble, to retrieve a dropped brass compass.
nodes.page: Your boot slips on a film of spilled gall ink coating the brass rail, sending you tumbling sideways into a dense thicket of protruding shelf brackets. You catch yourself with a bruised shoulder, dangling by one arm over the drop while your leather satchel swings loose and scatters a handful of crumpled catalog slips into the dark below. The loss of your notes leaves a stinging humiliation, and your shoulder flares with a sharp ache as you haul yourself awkwardly back onto a solid wooden ledge. You are battered and lighter by several useful memos, but you survive the fall with your determination intact.

nodes.title: The Steady Hand
nodes.brief: You slide along the top rail of a moving bookcase with practiced balance, risking a clumsy tumble, to retrieve a dropped brass compass.
nodes.page: Your fingers close securely around the cold metal ring of the compass just as the rails lock together with a resounding clang that echoes through the hollow vaults. You crouch atop the towering mahogany case with your prize in hand, feet set on the narrow track. The compass needle spins erratically before locking onto a bearing that points straight through a narrow, unlisted archway ahead.

nodes.title: Red Robes At The Gate
nodes.brief: A detachment of red-robed enforcers blocks the archway, demanding you surrender all notes pertaining to the missing Archivist.
nodes.page:
Wool cloaks dyed the color of dried cinnabar block the narrow stone archway, and their brass fasteners catch the weak yellow glare of corridor lamps. Three enforcers of the Cataloguers' Court stand shoulder to shoulder, their iron-tipped staves planted against the flagged floor. Their leader, a scarred veteran with ink-stained knuckles, holds out an open palm. He wants the scraps.

These are the illicit notes concerning Thessaly Marr and her frantic scribblings about the vault, gathered from the edge of the Misfiled Wing. Every breath tastes of lamp-oil and stale dust as iron armor shifts in the cramped passage. Surrender is unthinkable. Stepping past that wall of red wool means threading a needle through a falling portcullis, and you tighten your grip on your leather pouch until the hard edges of the stolen leaves press against your palm. The enforcers watch you with cold practiced disinterest; they know the deep stacks will soon seal their iron grilles for a generation.

exits.label: Slip past the crimson guard line

nodes.title: Linseed And Polished Brass
nodes.brief: The Enforcers' Barracks: Armor clinks against wooden bunks in a long, smoke-filled dormitory smelling of linseed oil and polished brass.
nodes.page:
Rows of wooden bunks line the long, timber-vaulted dormitory. Blankets sit folded with severe military precision. Linseed oil for leather scabbards cuts sharp in the nose, and brass polish rubbed into uniform buttons leaves a metallic bite on the tongue. Iron lanterns rock from overhead beams and throw long wavering shadow across scarred tables where off-duty guards usually mend their gear. Faint murmurs rise from the far alcoves and mix with condensation that drips through the ancient stone ceiling.

The enforcers run their domain from this room. Dark corners open onto the stone maze beyond.

exits.label: Descend into the towering card rotunda

nodes.title: Shadows In The Barracks
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the intimidating threats of the watch captain, risking your composure, to secure a stolen patrol schedule.
nodes.page:
Cold drafts sweep across the timber floorboards as you press your shoulder against the damp stone wall of the dormitory annex. The watch captain's sharp voice echoes from the inner office, barking orders about confiscated registers and the impending closure of the lower vaults. You wait in the gloom until the junior orderly hurries away toward the mess hall and leaves the oak door slightly ajar. Moonlight filters through a narrow, barred slit high above, illuminating dust motes dancing over a rogue sheaf of parchment resting on the corner desk.

Slipping inside feels like walking across thin ice above a bottomless ink-well, but the prize outweighs the danger of discovery. Your fingers trace the edge of the wooden threshold as you prepare to confront the heavy gaze of the man who holds the keys to the inner patrol routes.

exits.label: Stand your ground before the captain

nodes.title: Facing The Watch Captain
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the intimidating threats of the watch captain, risking your composure, to secure a stolen patrol schedule.
nodes.page: The watch captain looks up from his ledgers, his pale eyes narrowing beneath a heavy brow scarred by an old bookbinder's clamp. He fixes you with a stare honed by decades of interrogation in the salt-cellars of the court, dismissing your presence with a low, gravelly snarl that demands an immediate confession. Your pulse thumps against your ribs like a trapped moth inside a glass jar, threatening to crack your composure entirely. You refuse to flinch, locking your gaze onto his while reaching slowly toward the edge of the cluttered desk where the patrol schedule lies pinned beneath a bronze paperweight.

check.label: Hold firm against the captain's gaze

nodes.title: A Flawed Resolve
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the intimidating threats of the watch captain, risking your composure, to secure a stolen patrol schedule.
nodes.page: Your nerve fractures just as the captain slams a heavy fist down upon the oak desk, sending a cloud of dried blotting sand into the air. The sudden violence shatters your focus, and you stumble backward against a stack of discarded penalty slips, scattering white paper across the flags. The captain's laughter is dry and bitter as he seizes your arm, relieving you of a handful of copper coins and your only tin of restorative ink by way of a summary fine. You limp out into the drafty corridor a moment later, bruised in spirit and poorer by several farthings, but still breathing.

nodes.title: The Stolen Roster
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the intimidating threats of the watch captain, risking your composure, to secure a stolen patrol schedule.
nodes.page: Your steady stare never wavers, meeting the captain's intimidating glare until the older man finally grunts, looks away, and reaches for his porcelain tea cup. In that brief second of diverted attention, your hand slips across the polished wood to snatch the inked parchment bearing every patrol rotation for the next three bells. You fold the schedule into a tight square and tuck it deep inside your waistcoat, slipping out the side door into the shadows before he notices its absence. You carry away a precise blueprint of every guard movement through the lower stacks.

nodes.title: Whispers Among The Bunks
nodes.brief: You endure a grueling interrogation about your fellowship ties without yielding, risking your resolve, to gain the trust of a dissident guard.
nodes.page: Dim amber light flickers over rows of iron-framed beds as you pace quietly between the silent sleeping quarters. A junior guard sits alone on a low bench near the hearth, mending a torn canvas strap with thick waxed thread while keeping a wary eye on the shadows. He belongs to the fellowship of the outer stacks, though he wears the red coat of the enforcers to keep his belly full and his debts paid. When you approach, he pauses his stitching, fingers hovering over the leather.

nodes.title: The Bitter Inquisition
nodes.brief: You endure a grueling interrogation about your fellowship ties without yielding, risking your resolve, to gain the trust of a dissident guard.
nodes.page: The guard leans forward, resting his calloused elbows on his knees and narrowing his eyes as he questions your ties to the underground shelvers. Every word he speaks carries the weight of a potential betrayal, probing deep into your past loyalty to Thessaly Marr and the hidden indexes. You feel the iron walls of the barracks pressing inward, demanding that you yield an inch of truth to satisfy his caution. You take a slow, deep breath, steadying your voice against the rising tide of panic as you prepare your reply.

nodes.title: Broken Trust
nodes.brief: You endure a grueling interrogation about your fellowship ties without yielding, risking your resolve, to gain the trust of a dissident guard.
nodes.page: Your voice wavers under the relentless questioning, betraying a flicker of panic that the guard catches instantly in the quiet gloom. He pulls back his hands, shaking his head with a cynical sneer and refusing to share anything further about the hidden exit routes. The interrogation leaves you drained, your temples throbbing with a dull ache and your coat stained with spilled gall ink from where you knocked over a brass inkwell in your agitation. You crawl away into an empty corner to nurse your frayed nerves while the watch bells toll above.

nodes.title: An Unlikely Ally
nodes.brief: You endure a grueling interrogation about your fellowship ties without yielding, risking your resolve, to gain the trust of a dissident guard.
nodes.page: Your plain, unyielding answers cut through his suspicion and convince the guard that your loyalty to the missing Archivist runs deeper than mere survival. He nods slowly, pulls a small folded slip of parchment from his sleeve, and presses it into your palm with a warning about the patrolling inquisitors in the west wing. You leave him stitching his canvas strap by the dying fire, richer by a secret password that will open the side-gates without raising the alarm.

nodes.title: Halberds in the Archivist's Hall
nodes.brief: You dodge between swinging halberds to snatch a bundle of confiscated dispatches, risking a heavy blow, to acquire vital intelligence.
nodes.page:
Iron-shod boots hammer the mosaic floor of the Cataloguers' Court as the guard detail closes a ring around the bronze sorting tables. Halberds whistle through the air. Polished edges catch the amber glare of the brass oil-lamps. Beneath a mountain of impounded dispatches tied with stiff twine, the bundle of confiscated papers you need rests on a folding walnut trestle. Smoke from tallow candles drifts across the rafters and blurs the stern stone faces of ancient rule-keepers carved into the corbels. Dust floats in narrow shafts of light through the tall leaded windows that overlook the deep stacks. Every breath tastes of dry parchment and cold iron.

You crouch behind ledger-cases. You wait for the sergeant to bark his next command and turn his broad back toward the shadowed archway, because only then can care and an eye for the guards' shift carry you past the swinging blades.

exits.label: Dart beneath the swinging iron blades

nodes.title: Reaching for the Tied Bundles
nodes.brief: You dodge between swinging halberds to snatch a bundle of confiscated dispatches, risking a heavy blow, to acquire vital intelligence.
nodes.page:
Cold sweat slicks your palms as you inch closer to the trestle table, keeping your weight balanced on the balls of your feet. The rhythmic thud of polearms biting into the timber floor vibrates through the soles of your boots, setting your teeth on edge. A silver-clasped mail-bag lies half-hidden beneath the dispatches, swelling with handwritten ink-slips that outline the movements of the search parties. Scorched lamp-oil and the metallic tang of sweat from the patrolling guards fill the corridor. You have only a heartbeat of misdirection while a distant bell tolls from the central clock-tower, echoing endlessly down the stone corridors of the Annexe.

Your fingers brush the rough twine of the topmost bundle, feeling the familiar texture of cheap rag-paper beneath your fingertips. The guards shift their formation, closing the gap between the desks with deliberate, unhurried steps.

exits.label: Snatch the dispatches from the table

nodes.title: Seizing the Imperial Dispatches
nodes.brief: You dodge between swinging halberds to snatch a bundle of confiscated dispatches, risking a heavy blow, to acquire vital intelligence.
nodes.page: Muscles coil tight as you spring forward from the shadow of the card-drawers, lunging directly into the narrow corridor between two sweeping polearms. One blade arcs downward with terrifying speed, shears a button from your waistcoat, and grazes the skin of your shoulder with a searing lick of cold steel. You fling your weight sideways, sliding across the polished oak surface of the sorting table to scoop the tied parcel into your arms against your chest. The remaining guards pivot in unison, shouting hoarsely as iron heels slam against the flagged floor, trapping your exit route behind a wall of uplifted steel.

check.label: Dodge the swinging halberds with grace

nodes.title: The Cost of a Blundered Leap
nodes.brief: You dodge between swinging halberds to snatch a bundle of confiscated dispatches, risking a heavy blow, to acquire vital intelligence.
nodes.page: A steel haft catches you squarely across the ribs, drives the breath from your lungs in a ragged gasp, and knocks you sprawling hard onto the cold flagstones. The bundle of dispatches scatters across the floor, loose ink-slips fluttering like wounded crows before a pair of iron-plated boots pins them down. You scramble backward on hands and knees, tasting copper and dust while a sharp, throbbing ache blooms along your left side. The guards haul you to your feet with bruising rough-hands, relieving you of your remaining spare quills. A deep purple bruise spreads over your ribs that will ache every time you lift a folio for weeks to come.

nodes.title: The Seized Dispatch Bundle
nodes.brief: You dodge between swinging halberds to snatch a bundle of confiscated dispatches, risking a heavy blow, to acquire vital intelligence.
nodes.page: Momentum carries you cleanly beneath the intersecting arcs of steel, your fingers locked around the twine of the confiscated parcel even as the wind of the missed blows stirs your hair. You tumble head over heels into the alcove beyond the desks. On your feet again with the prize clutched to your chest, you move before the guards can wheel about. Your coat is torn at the cuff. The prize is yours.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Commander
nodes.brief: You stare down the intimidating garrison commander during a tense standoff, risking your mental fortitude, to win an unhindered departure.
nodes.page:
Oak doors loom at the end of the vaulted corridor, barred by two towering sentries and overseen by the senior garrison commander whose reputation for cruelty is etched into every line of his scarred face. He stands beside a brazier of glowing coals. His folded arms rest across a chest adorned with disciplinary medals forged from old printer's lead. Silence fills the stone-walled foyer, broken only by the crackle of burning coke and a slow drip of water from an unseen leak in the high vaulting. His dark, unblinking eyes lock onto yours the way an inquisitor inspects heresy in a marginal note.

You refuse to drop your gaze. The commander steps forward. His boots click against the paving stones.

nodes.title: The Weight of Unblinking Eyes
nodes.brief: You stare down the intimidating garrison commander during a tense standoff, risking your mental fortitude, to win an unhindered departure.
nodes.page:
Tension stretches like a dry bowstring across the narrow hall as the commander measures your worth with a slow, calculating sneer. The stacks fall back. Only your breath and the hiss of the nearby brazier remain. He tilts his head slightly and tests whether your nerve will shatter under the intimidation of his presence and the implied threat of the deep cells below. Every instinct screams at you to look away, to bow your head and murmur excuses for your intrusion into the restricted administrative wards.

You plant your heels on the stone. Your chin stays raised. Your expression stays blank.

exits.label: Stand firm against his silent scrutiny

nodes.title: Facing the Commander's Will
nodes.brief: You stare down the intimidating garrison commander during a tense standoff, risking your mental fortitude, to win an unhindered departure.
nodes.page: The commander steps closer still, towering over you as he projects an aura of absolute authority meant to crush any defiance before it can take root in your mind. He leans in, whispering a low, venomous reminder of what happens to shelvers who pry too deeply into the missing Archivist's private ledgers. The air between you grows thick and suffocating, laden with the metallic scent of old armor and the dry dust of forgotten centuries. You feel your thoughts beginning to scatter under the immense pressure of his unyielding gaze, threatening to betray your panic.

nodes.title: Broken Resolve in the Foyer
nodes.brief: You stare down the intimidating garrison commander during a tense standoff, risking your mental fortitude, to win an unhindered departure.
nodes.page: Your nerve cracks under the sheer weight of his glare, and a sudden, involuntary shudder betrays your terror before you can mask it. The commander smiles thinly, recognizing your weakness instantly, and presses his advantage with a stinging reprimand that leaves your pride in tatters. He denies you passage through the main gates, forcing you to endure a humiliating interrogation that strips away hours of precious time and leaves your thoughts foggy and scattered. You limp away from the threshold with a throbbing headache and a bitter sense of humiliation that settles deep into your bones.

nodes.title: Unbroken Will and Passage
nodes.brief: You stare down the intimidating garrison commander during a tense standoff, risking your mental fortitude, to win an unhindered departure.
nodes.page: However narrowly, your resolve holds fast against his oppressive stare, refusing to yield an inch of ground to his intimidation. The commander's eyes narrow in grudging, silent recognition; he recognizes a will that cannot be easily broken by mere bluster or rank. With a sharp, dismissive jerk of his chin, he steps aside from the heavy oak doors, granting you an unhindered departure into the restricted corridors beyond. As you pass him, he slips a small, folded scrap of parchment into your palm - a forbidden pass-token scribbled in hurried ink.

nodes.title: The Quartermaster's Ledger
nodes.brief: You talk your way past the armory quartermaster with clever deception, risking immediate arrest, to acquire a set of duplicate keys.
nodes.page: Ranks of heavy iron lockers gleam under the greasy yellow glow of brass bulkhead lamps. The armory quartermaster sits behind a high oak counter, dipping a thick nib into a well of purple ink while sharpening a brass-handled letter opener with steady, rhythmic strokes. Every fiber of your training warns you that a single hesitation will bring the watch-guards down upon your shoulders before you can draw breath. You lean against the counter, adopting the bored slouch of a senior auditor inspecting surplus inventory, and let your fingers trace the edge of a forged requisition slip tucked inside your sleeve.

nodes.title: Polished Brass and Bluff
nodes.brief: You talk your way past the armory quartermaster with clever deception, risking immediate arrest, to acquire a set of duplicate keys.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch long across the flagstones, smelling faintly of gun-oil and dry wool. The quartermaster pauses his rhythmic sharpening, his rheumy eyes narrowing behind tinted spectacles as he studies your uniform with suspicious slowness. You pitch your voice to a dull, bureaucratic drone, complaining loudly about missing inventory schedules and uncalibrated brass weights in the lower sectors. The old man grunts, muttering something about cataloguing delays, and reaches beneath the high timber shelf where a heavy ring of iron keys hangs from a steel hook.

nodes.title: Testing the Quartermaster's Patience
nodes.brief: You talk your way past the armory quartermaster with clever deception, risking immediate arrest, to acquire a set of duplicate keys.
nodes.page: Sweat cools at the small of your back while the quartermaster's thick, ink-stained fingers hover inches from the dangling ring of duplicate keys. One false syllable, a twitch too many of your jaw, or a flicker of panic in your gaze will shatter the flimsy illusion of authority you have so carefully constructed. You point an accusatory finger toward a ledger on the far side of the room, manufacturing a fake discrepancy in the quarterly brass allocation to draw his clouded eyes away from your outstretched hand. Your fingers brush the cold iron loop as you wait for the reckoning.

check.label: Distract the guard with false audits

nodes.title: The Cost of a Flawed Lie
nodes.brief: You talk your way past the armory quartermaster with clever deception, risking immediate arrest, to acquire a set of duplicate keys.
nodes.page: The quartermaster jerks his hand back with a sharp snort of disbelief and catches your fingers mid-reach against the cold iron loop. Alarms clang down the stone corridor. Rough hands seize your shoulders and haul you toward the holding cells. A brass ledger drops hard across your knuckles and leaves a swollen purple bruise that burns hot. Ten minutes later, in the confusion of a shifting stack-shift, you slip your bonds. You emerge poorer by a pouch of copper slugs, your right hand still swollen and raw.

nodes.title: Keys of the Iron Vault
nodes.brief: You talk your way past the armory quartermaster with clever deception, risking immediate arrest, to acquire a set of duplicate keys.
nodes.page: Your fabricated tale holds together by a thread of pure audacity, folding the old man's suspicions back upon himself just long enough for your fingers to close around the cold iron ring. He nods dismissively, muttering a curse about bureaucratic inspections, and turns back to his ledgers without a backward glance. You pocket the duplicate keys and slip into the shadows of the armory corridor before the illusion can unravel around you.

nodes.title: The Rotunda of Cards
nodes.brief: You emerge into a vast subterranean rotunda where towering pillars of index cards support a vaulted ceiling of dark stone.
nodes.page: Immense pillars of yellowed index cards rise like ancient tree trunks to support a vaulted stone ceiling lost in perpetual gloom. Millions of handwritten slips flutter like trapped moths in the persistent drafts stirred by unseen subterranean vents, whispering unintelligible fragments of history, forgotten debts, and names of people who never drew breath. A low, collective hum vibrates through the flagstones beneath your boots, as if the very foundations of Quillon are cataloguing themselves syllable by syllable. You walk between towering walls of drawers, feeling the immense, crushing weight of institutional memory pressing down upon your shoulders like an invisible mantle of lead.

nodes.title: The Rotunda of Records
nodes.brief: The Rotunda of Records: Millions of catalogued index cards flutter like trapped moths in the drafts stirred by unseen subterranean vents.
nodes.page: Endless rows of cabinets stretch out into the gloom, their countless drawers sliding open and shut of their own accord with a dry, rhythmic clicking. Somewhere in the deep shadows, an unseen clerk stamps endless documents with a heavy iron seal that echoes like distant thunder. The air is thick with floating paper-dust and the sharp tang of fresh walnut ink, tempting you to lose yourself among the records or seek a passage deeper into the stone.

nodes.title: The Mechanical Scribe
nodes.brief: You trick a diligent filing automaton into indexing your name as a visiting inspector, risking discovery, to gain permanent administrative clearance.
nodes.page: A brass-plated automaton with articulated fingers and glass lenses for eyes sits rigidly behind a high mahogany desk, endlessly stamping triplicate forms with mechanical precision. You step into its field of vision, assuming the brisk, impatient posture of a visiting inspector from the high archives. The automaton's internal clockwork grinds and clicks as its glass lenses whir, focusing on your face while steam hisses softly from a copper valve behind its metal ear. You invent a fictitious supervisory mandate concerning misfiled genealogies and recite the fabricated codes with practiced indifference.

exits.label: Feed false credentials to the machine

nodes.title: Gears and Counterspells
nodes.brief: You trick a diligent filing automaton into indexing your name as a visiting inspector, risking discovery, to gain permanent administrative clearance.
nodes.page: Steam curls lazily from the automaton's joints, smelling faintly of warm lard and old oil as its steel fingers begin to tap out your new classification on a strip of parchment. You stand perfectly still, offering a curt nod whenever its glass lenses swivel in your direction to verify your imaginary credentials. The machine pauses, its internal gears slipping with a metallic screech that sets your teeth on edge, before it stamps an iridescent seal of administrative clearance onto your sleeve.

nodes.title: Testing the Automaton's Logic
nodes.brief: You trick a diligent filing automaton into indexing your name as a visiting inspector, risking discovery, to gain permanent administrative clearance.
nodes.page: The automaton's jaw clicks open, and a thin brass tongue extends to taste the air for forged signatures and unauthorized ink compounds. If its internal logic detects the faint chemical signature of your true shelver's badge, pneumatic clamps will snap shut around your wrists and lock you into the permanent indexing queue. You lean closer to the humming housing, feeding it a stream of complex administrative jargon designed to loop its mechanical reasoning into an endless verification cycle. You hold your breath as the steel fingers hover over the final approval stamp.

nodes.title: Caught in the Logic Loop
nodes.brief: You trick a diligent filing automaton into indexing your name as a visiting inspector, risking discovery, to gain permanent administrative clearance.
nodes.page: A sharp mechanical whistle pierces the air as the automaton rejects your fabricated codes, its steel claws snapping shut on your sleeve and tearing away a strip of cloth. You wrench your arm free with a violent heave, leaving behind a button and a patch of skin grazed raw by the jagged brass housing. The machine lets out a dismal clank, locks its drawers, and seals the local transit conduit behind an iron grille. You limp away empty-handed, nursing a smarting scratch on your forearm.

nodes.title: The Stamped Pass
nodes.brief: You trick a diligent filing automaton into indexing your name as a visiting inspector, risking discovery, to gain permanent administrative clearance.
nodes.page: The automaton's internal gears click in reluctant harmony, accepting your convoluted narrative with a soft, pneumatic sigh of resignation. It stamps your collar with a permanent seal of administrative privilege, granting you unhindered access to the restricted administrative conduits that bypass the lower checkpoints entirely. You tuck the warm, ink-stained pass beneath your collar and stride past the clicking cabinets with newfound authority.

nodes.title: The Vault of Echoes
nodes.brief: You withstand the psychic weight of a million forgotten names whispering in unison, risking your sanity, to extract a true historical record.
nodes.page:
Shadows cling to the stone pillars of the gallery like damp moss as the murmurs begin to swell from the dark floorboards. Every forgotten name, erased from the ledgers of Quillon, presses against your temples with the heavy, suffocating weight of unremembered history. Your lamp flickers, threatened by the cold psychic gale of vanished lives clamoring for a single voice. You slow your breath against the rising tide of forgotten grief and fix your thoughts on the familiar smell of lamp-oil and ink.

Step past the trembling barrier of voices and press onward toward the deeper corridor before your resolve shatters.

nodes.title: Threshold of the Past
nodes.brief: You withstand the psychic weight of a million forgotten names whispering in unison, risking your sanity, to extract a true historical record.
nodes.page:
Cold drafts sweep through the aisle. They bring the dry scent of centuries-old paper and the metallic tang of dried blood on forgotten decrees. Psychic pressure inside your skull lessens just enough to let you draw a full, ragged breath without tasting copper on the tongue. Ahead, a narrow iron gate stands half-open. Shelves pile high beyond it. Unindexed folios tremble in the gloom. Your leather satchel rides tight at your hip, and shelver's stamps knock solid against your side as you prepare to cross the threshold.

Slip through the iron gate before the shelves shift their alignment again.

nodes.title: Bearing the Weight
nodes.brief: You withstand the psychic weight of a million forgotten names whispering in unison, risking your sanity, to extract a true historical record.
nodes.page: Millions of erased identities converge upon your consciousness, their collective grief threatening to scour your memories clean and leave your mind an empty book. You clamp your teeth together until your jaw aches, fighting to separate your own existence from the vast, drowning chorus of the unwritten dead. Every second feels like an eternity spent standing under a cataract of cold ink and phantom tears. You push your mind against the invading tide, summoning every ounce of inner fortitude to pluck a single true record from the howling air.

check.label: Anchor your mind against the whispers

nodes.title: The Cost of Listening
nodes.brief: You withstand the psychic weight of a million forgotten names whispering in unison, risking your sanity, to extract a true historical record.
nodes.page:
The psychic backlash strikes like a leaden mallet, driving you to your knees upon the cold flagstones as blood trickles warm and sharp from your nose. Your vision blurs with shimmering motes of silver ink, and for a terrifying moment you cannot remember your own name or your rank in the Shelvers' Fellowship. When the roaring in your ears finally subsides into a dull ache, you find your fingers clutching a torn page, purchased at the steep price of a persistent, throbbing migraine that settles deep behind your eyes.

Gather your fallen lamp and limp forward into the gloom.

nodes.title: A True Record Secured
nodes.brief: You withstand the psychic weight of a million forgotten names whispering in unison, risking your sanity, to extract a true historical record.
nodes.page:
Through sheer stubborn endurance, however narrowly, you manage to carve a pocket of absolute silence within the storm of forgotten names, plucking the genuine parchment from the drifting illusion. The recovered leaf rests in your palm, cold as winter stone yet vibrating with the faint, residual heartbeat of history. It is a fragile fragment of truth salvaged from the rising tide of fabrication, capable of shifting the balance in the Cataloguers' Court.

Return to the main hall with your prize tucked safely inside your tunic.

exits.label: Ascend to the Rotunda of Records

nodes.title: The Chief Sorter
nodes.brief: You deceive the chief card-sorter with a fabricated counter-directive, risking exposure, to acquire a master key for the lower levels.
nodes.page:
Rows of towering card-cabinets stretch into the dim subterranean haze, where the chief card-sorter sits behind a mahogany desk stamping rejection notices with rhythmic precision. You smooth down your tunic, adopting the brisk, indifferent posture of an authorized auditor delivering an urgent directive from the upper administration. The sorter's ink-stained fingers pause mid-stroke above a drawer of cross-references, his sharp eyes narrowing behind spectacles thick as bottle-bottoms as he weighs your confident bearing against the strict rules of the court.

Hand over the fabricated paper before your nerve breaks.

nodes.title: Beyond the Card Index
nodes.brief: You deceive the chief card-sorter with a fabricated counter-directive, risking exposure, to acquire a master key for the lower levels.
nodes.page: The forged seal on the counter-directive holds against the sorter's scrutiny, gleaming dully under the amber glow of the desk lamps. With a disgruntled grunt, he reaches into a locked brass drawer and tosses a heavy iron ring of keys onto the blotter without another word. You scoop them up quickly before he can change his mind, feeling the cold metal bite into your palm. The way down to the lower stacks lies open before you, veiled in thick shadows and the scent of damp leather.

nodes.title: Weaving the Deception
nodes.brief: You deceive the chief card-sorter with a fabricated counter-directive, risking exposure, to acquire a master key for the lower levels.
nodes.page: You lean across the mahogany counter, pitching your voice to the exact dry, bureaucratic register favored by the senior rule-keepers of the court. Every syllable must fall with absolute precision to convince the chief card-sorter that your unsanctioned presence is part of a routine archival audit. His quill hovers inches above the parchment, trembling slightly as he hesitates between upholding protocol and avoiding a costly administrative dispute. You hold his gaze with unblinking assurance, feeding him the next layer of your elaborate fiction.

nodes.title: Caught in the Bureaucracy
nodes.brief: You deceive the chief card-sorter with a fabricated counter-directive, risking exposure, to acquire a master key for the lower levels.
nodes.page: A sudden twitch of the sorter's eyebrow betrays the lie a fraction too late, and the rubber-stamped rejection mark comes down upon your paperwork with a sharp crack. Alarms chime in the cabinets. Thousands of index cards flutter like trapped moths. You snatch your ruined papers back from the desk. A strip of your sleeve stays caught in the brass sorting mechanism as you turn and flee into the labyrinth of aisles.

nodes.title: The Master Key
nodes.brief: You deceive the chief card-sorter with a fabricated counter-directive, risking exposure, to acquire a master key for the lower levels.
nodes.page:
Audacity and persuasive fiction win out: the chief card-sorter surrenders the iron master key without sounding the general alarm. The cold metal ring rests in your hand, its iron teeth notched to fit every restricted lock down to the Deep Annexe. It is a dangerous trinket to carry through the lower levels, but one that unlocks doors the Cataloguers thought sealed forever.

Pocket the keys and turn toward the descending stone stairs.

exits.label: Make your way toward the Rotunda

nodes.grant: Master key of the lower levels

nodes.title: Spine Span Passage
nodes.brief: A narrow bridge constructed entirely from the reinforced spines of giant encyclopedias spans a deep ink-river below.
nodes.page: Calfskin bindings, banded in rusted iron and pressed vellum, arch rigid over the slow, viscous creep of the black ink-river below. Faint odors of lamp-oil and oxidized iron rise from the dark currents, clinging to your coat as you step onto the trembling bridge. Every footfall elicits a dry, papery groan from the compacted encyclopedias beneath your boots, reminding you of the thousands of forgotten definitions and obsolete facts locked tight within their compressed pages.

exits.label: Tread carefully across the bound volumes

nodes.title: The Spine Bridge Junction
nodes.brief: The Spine Bridge: Heavy leather-bound volumes form a precarious crossing over dark, slow-moving channels of black printing ink.
nodes.page: Sluggish currents of black printing ink slide beneath a precarious crossing formed entirely from massive, clamped volumes of forgotten lore. The leather bindings shift underfoot with every drop of moisture and exhale faint clouds of yellowed dust and old paper scent into the damp air. To your left, a narrow toll-booth looms through the gloom, while ahead the bridge dips toward a swaying, ink-stained span that invites a lighter, more daring traversal.

exits.label: Step lightly across the swaying spines

nodes.title: The Reluctant Gatekeeper
nodes.brief: You talk a nervous toll-keeper into lowering the span without paying the usual fee, risking suspicion, to cross without delay.
nodes.page: Shadows flicker against the wooden panels of the small booth where a junior clerk sits wringing ink-stained hands over a ledger of fines. You lean in close, speaking with all the measured authority of a senior rule-keeper inspecting compliance records. The clerk pauses, staring suspiciously at your borrowed master key before casting a nervous glance toward the dark waters of the ink-river below.

exits.label: Persuade the clerk to drop the span

nodes.title: Bending the Rules
nodes.brief: You talk a nervous toll-keeper into lowering the span without paying the usual fee, risking suspicion, to cross without delay.
nodes.page: Your tongue moves with practiced smoothness, weaving a plausible fiction about emergency cataloguing amendments and retroactive exemptions that completely overwhelms the tired clerk's defenses. You lean heavier against the wooden counter, matching your breathing to the slow drip of ink from the ceiling while fixing the clerk with an unblinking, bureaucratic stare. The clerk's fingers hover indecisively over the heavy brass lever that controls the bridge span, trembling between strict duty and the fear of making a costly administrative error.

check.label: Talk your way past the toll

nodes.title: A Costly Deception
nodes.brief: You talk a nervous toll-keeper into lowering the span without paying the usual fee, risking suspicion, to cross without delay.
nodes.page: A sudden, sharp snort from behind the partition shatters your practiced composure, and the clerk's hand jerks downward on the wrong lever. The heavy brass gate slams shut with a bone-jarring crash, catching your sleeve and tearing the sturdy fabric away from your wrist with a sharp rip. You retreat hastily into the shadows, rubbing a raw, ink-stained graze where the iron grazed your skin, poorer in time and temper but still free to seek another path deeper into the stacks.

exits.label: Slip away toward the main junction

nodes.title: The Unpaid Span
nodes.brief: You talk a nervous toll-keeper into lowering the span without paying the usual fee, risking suspicion, to cross without delay.
nodes.page: Cool damp air rises from the dark ink-channels below as you lean against the toll-keeper's iron grille, spinning a quick, plausible yarn about an urgent audit in the outer stacks. The gatekeeper's fingers hover indecisively over the brass lever, suspicious yet reluctant to invite a formal reprimand from the senior inspectors. With a reluctant sigh, he dips his foot to release the counterweight, letting the heavy leather-bound bridge groan downward into place without extracting the customary copper toll. You slip across the gap into the shadows, pocketing a small stamped brass token of exemption that ensures safe passage through the lower checkpoints.

nodes.title: Dancing on Words
nodes.brief: You cross the swaying bridge of old book spines with light, dancing steps, risking a fall into the ink, to retrieve a floating notebook.
nodes.page: Slender leather volumes sway under your boots like stepping stones across a peat bog, each one threatening to tilt and slide into the thick black current. You keep your center of gravity low, arms spread wide to catch your balance as the distant sound of dripping ink echoes off the vaulted stone ceiling. Ahead, a waterlogged notebook bobs lazily against a protruding metal spine, its sodden pages fluttering like trapped moths.

exits.label: Step closer to the floating notebook

nodes.title: Reaching for the Tides
nodes.brief: You cross the swaying bridge of old book spines with light, dancing steps, risking a fall into the ink, to retrieve a floating notebook.
nodes.page: The damp air smells strongly of gall ink and rotting parchment as you crouch low upon the trembling arch of encyclopedias. Below you, the dark river crawls in absolute silence, occasionally swallowing a stray scrap of paper with a wet, sucking sound. You extend a cautious hand toward the bobbing prize, watching the ink ripple outward in small, concentric rings from its sodden cover.

exits.label: Balance carefully to snatch the book

nodes.title: Walking the Razor Spine
nodes.brief: You cross the swaying bridge of old book spines with light, dancing steps, risking a fall into the ink, to retrieve a floating notebook.
nodes.page: You shift your weight onto the narrow edge of an open atlas, trusting your momentum and light footing to carry you across the gap before the binding gives way. The leather surface is slick with condensation, and a sudden draft from the lower tunnels threatens to sweep your feet out from under you. You steady your breath, lifting your heels just enough to skim across the treacherous surface toward the drifting notebook.

nodes.title: Slip in the Ink
nodes.brief: You cross the swaying bridge of old book spines with light, dancing steps, risking a fall into the ink, to retrieve a floating notebook.
nodes.page: A treacherous patch of damp calfskin betrays your footing at the worst possible moment, sending your heel sliding off the edge into the black, sluggish current. You snatch your boot back with a sharp gasp, but not before a heavy splash of ink drenches your trousers and stains your ankles a permanent, indelible purple. You scramble back onto the firm center of the bridge, shivering with cold and dripping with the bitter taste of oxidized iron.

exits.label: Press onward toward the lower stairs
