nodes.page: Loose signatures and broken spines spill around your boots as folios tumble from above, and the slick stone underfoot tries to steal your footing. You drop low, shifting your weight from heel to toe as you prepare to lunge past the falling debris and snatch the delicate glass vial resting on the crumbling wooden ledge before the whole structure gives way.

nodes.title: Buried in Paper
nodes.brief: You gracefully sidestep a cascade of tumbling folios to pluck a preserved ink-vial from a crumbling wooden ledge.
nodes.page: The crumbling ledge breaks under you, and splinters and old paper shower your shoulders as you scramble clear. You tumble hard against a cold stone pillar, scrape your knee, and lose a portion of your supplies to the drifts of loose text. Dust fills your lungs. You cough, then brush the ruined pages from your coat.

exits.label: Dust yourself off and move on

nodes.title: The Preserved Drop
nodes.brief: You gracefully sidestep a cascade of tumbling folios to pluck a preserved ink-vial from a crumbling wooden ledge.
nodes.page: Falling folios sheet past as your fingers close around the cold glass vial just as the wooden ledge shatters into dust behind you. The prize stays secure. Iridescent ink inside the vial swirls with strange deep colors that seem entirely untouched by the age of the surrounding stacks, and the glass stays cold against your palm.

nodes.title: The Murmuring Mastic Floor
nodes.brief: The floor beneath your boots turns to a mosaic of discarded bookplates that murmur complaints about your heavy tread.
nodes.page: Underneath your heavy boots, the solid stone gives way to a shifting mosaic of discarded bookplates that whisper sharp, paper-dry complaints about your clumsy tread. Each tiny square of gummed paper protests its displacement, grumbling of glue and heraldry against the soles of your shoes. You keep your lamp steady as the floorboards ripple like water, shifting patterns of faded crests and latin mottoes sliding this way and that across the gloom. The air tastes strongly of old paste and copper-gall ink, thick enough to coat your tongue while the subterranean vaults echo with the collective murmuring of thousands of disgruntled past owners. You press forward into the heart of the Deep Annexe, where the walls itself seem to listen to the paper chatter beneath your feet.

exits.label: Follow the murmuring mosaic deeper inward

nodes.title: The Ex-Libris Corridor
nodes.brief: The Ex-Libris Corridor: You traverse a narrow gallery paved with thousands of discarded ownership plates shifting underfoot.
nodes.page: Thousands of discarded ownership plates pave this narrow gallery, shifting and rustling underfoot like dry leaves in an autumn gale. Every tile bears a different coat of arms or solemn pledge of collection, now loose and restless under the dim glow of your swinging lamp. Ahead, multiple passages branch into the deep shadows of the oldest stacks, each promising a different route through the ancient paper labyrinth. The air is thick with the scent of rancid glue and aged vellum, whispering hints of secrets half-forgotten by the city above.

exits.label: Tread lightly across the shifting paper tiles
Balance along the petrified oak beam above
Trick the mosaic into lowering its barrier
Press through the thick fog of pulverized dust

nodes.title: The Sprite's Favor
nodes.brief: You tread a delicate path across the shifting tiles without breaking a single seal, earning the favor of the resident bookplate sprite.
nodes.page: Delicate and measured steps carry you across the shifting tiles without disturbing a single gummed corner or tearing an aged paper edge. A tiny, rustling creature no larger than your hand emerges from a crevice between the floorboards, its body woven from vintage leather bindings and gold-leaf trim. It tilts a head fashioned from a marbled endpaper, inspecting your cautious advance with sharp, ink-stained eyes. Recognizing your respect for its fragile domain, the sprite gives a silent nod of approval and flits ahead to guide your path. You follow its flickering golden silhouette through the labyrinthine gloom of the Annexe.

exits.label: Follow the nimble guide through the stacks

nodes.title: The Gilded Passage
nodes.brief: You tread a delicate path across the shifting tiles without breaking a single seal, earning the favor of the resident bookplate sprite.
nodes.page: Golden light spills from hairline cracks in the masonry and catches motes of paper dust in the still air. Your companion flits from shelf to shelf, its paper wings rustling like turning pages in a silent reading room. The surrounding shelves loom tall and crooked, stacked with massive folios bound in calfskin darkened to the color of strong tea. A faint residual static charge lifts the hairs on your arms as you pass. You watch the sprite. Its uncanny knowledge of the shifting architecture is what you trust.

exits.label: Descend toward the whispering alcove below

nodes.title: Balancing on the Edge
nodes.brief: You tread a delicate path across the shifting tiles without breaking a single seal, earning the favor of the resident bookplate sprite.
nodes.page: A sudden drop in the floor leaves only a slick, moss-grown spine of an ancient ledger bridging the dark chasm ahead. You test the narrow bridge with the toe of your boot, feeling the centuries-old parchment sag and groan under your weight above the black abyss. Balancing your lamp in one hand, you stretch your arms wide to catch any stray draft that might throw you off course. Every muscle in your body tightens as you prepare to cross the dangerous span without losing your footing in the dark.

check.label: Step carefully across the parchment bridge

nodes.title: The Torn Spine
nodes.brief: You tread a delicate path across the shifting tiles without breaking a single seal, earning the favor of the resident bookplate sprite.
nodes.page: The ancient ledger spine gives way under you and tears with a wet, fibrous snap that rings hard through the vault. You lurch hard. Arms windmill as you drop to your knees on the jagged stone ledge just beyond the chasm, and loose pages and iron bookmarks clatter down into the darkness below. Your shins are bruised. Lamp-oil leaks onto the dusty floor. You pull yourself up, out of breath, and see that haste cost you both skin and supplies.

exits.label: Drag yourself toward the flickering light

nodes.title: The Sprite's Ledger
nodes.brief: You tread a delicate path across the shifting tiles without breaking a single seal, earning the favor of the resident bookplate sprite.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the corridor as your boots find the exact centre of each stone seal, disturbing neither dust nor slumber. Perched upon a leather-bound milestone, a tiny bookplate sprite with wings of gummed paper nods in quiet approval at your measured tread. It reaches into its copper waistcoat and presses a warm, damp stamp into your palm, leaving behind an indelible mark that smells faintly of dried lavender and archival paste. This token of passage will stay your hand against the minor trip-wires of the lower stacks, granting you safe conduct among the territorial spirits of the bindery.

exits.label: Step carefully back onto the shifting plates

nodes.title: The Petrified Beam
nodes.brief: You balance along a narrow beam of petrified oak to bypass the unstable floor, discovering a pouch of scented sealing wax.
nodes.page: A beam of petrified oak spans the unstable expanse and offers a dry and rigid highway above the restless paper floor. You hoist your lamp higher. Ancient wood takes a tentative hand, and then you climb onto its rounded surface and ease out over the drop. Halfway across, your fingers brush a small, forgotten leather pouch wedged into a knot in the timber. The drawstring gives. Inside lies a cache of scented sealing wax, fragrant with crushed cloves and dried lavender, perfectly preserved in the cool subterranean air. You pocket the prize and continue across the span.

exits.label: Follow the oak beam to the far ledge

nodes.title: The Narrow Crossing
nodes.brief: You balance along a narrow beam of petrified oak to bypass the unstable floor, discovering a pouch of scented sealing wax.
nodes.page: The timber beam narrows sharply as it approaches a vertical stack of encyclopedias leaning precariously over the void. A sudden gust of cold air sweeps through the stacks, threatening to unbalance your stance on the slick, petrified wood. You freeze in place, shifting your weight low and centering your breathing against the sway of the hanging lamp. Your boots cling to the rounded grain while you measure the final leap to safety across the remaining gap.

check.label: Leap across the remaining timber gap

nodes.title: A Heavy Fall
nodes.brief: You balance along a narrow beam of petrified oak to bypass the unstable floor, discovering a pouch of scented sealing wax.
nodes.page: The gust catches your coat at the worst possible moment, tipping your balance and sending you skidding off the rounded timber. You tumble hard onto a massive pile of discarded folios, the impact knocking the wind from your chest and cracking the glass of your oil lamp. Scrambling upright with a bruised shoulder and a torn sleeve, you watch the last drops of fuel soak uselessly into the thirsty paper beneath you. You survive the clumsy landing, but the shadows crowd closer now that your light burns dimmer.

exits.label: Gather your wits in the dim gloom

nodes.title: The Scented Vault
nodes.brief: You balance along a narrow beam of petrified oak to bypass the unstable floor, discovering a pouch of scented sealing wax.
nodes.page: Balancing with absolute precision along the heart-wood beam, you leave the collapsing flags far behind and reach the comparative safety of an unscarred alcove. Tucked into the cranny of a dormant oak press rests a heavy linen pouch tied with a length of crimson silk, its contents cold and satisfyingly dense against your fingers. Inside lies a cache of perfumed sealing wax infused with crushed cloves and dragon's blood, prized by senior scribes for securing documents against the damp air of the vaults. Pocketing the prize, you prepare to re-enter the shifting labyrinth with your provisions replenished.

exits.label: Step carefully back onto the shifting plates

nodes.title: The Mosaic Barrier
nodes.brief: You trick the mosaic into lowering its protective barrier by misdirecting its queries, securing a master ledger fragment.
nodes.page: Glazed ceramic tiles interlock across the archway, forming a restless mosaic of crimson and ochre beasts that snap their jaws at your approach. Each query the surface throws out demands a historical falsehood about the city's foundation, written in sharp-edged lettering that burns against the gloom. Instead of answering with truth or silence, you feed the wall a web of deliberate misdirections culled from corrupted duplicate folios tucked in your pockets. The ceramic creatures snarl, confused by the cascade of contradictory dates and phantom dynasties, their glowing mortar fracturing with a soft sigh of exhausted alchemy. The barrier droops into the floor-grooves. Behind it sits a jagged, rectangular sliver of calfskin inscribed with ink that refuses to dry.

exits.label: Step through the lowered ceramic barrier

nodes.title: Unraveling the Mosaic
nodes.brief: You trick the mosaic into lowering its protective barrier by misdirecting its queries, securing a master ledger fragment.
nodes.page: Cold ceramic beasts writhe across the stone portal, their interlocking jaws clicking with the dry sound of snapping spines as they demand an answer to an impossible administrative riddle. The mosaic's surface pulses with a blinding amber luminescence, scanning your intent for any trace of true compliance with its archaic protocols. Every muscle in your arms tenses against the suffocating weight of your oil-skin pack while you feed the surface a calculated tangle of contradictory cataloguing codes, deliberately scrambling the sequence of classification until the tiles begin to chatter and vibrate with uncertainty. You plant your boots firmly against the trembling flagstones, steadying your breath against the acrid smell of ozone and hot ink, and reach out a bare hand to pry the loose fragment free from its slot before the defense mechanism catches your deceit.

nodes.title: The Cost of Deceit
nodes.brief: You trick the mosaic into lowering its protective barrier by misdirecting its queries, securing a master ledger fragment.
nodes.page: Ceramic teeth snap shut on the edge of your canvas sleeve and tear a deep jagged strip from fabric into skin before you wrench your arm back. Pain flares white and hot. Lamp-oil and dried ink grind into the fresh scratch on your forearm. The mosaic settles with a sullen rattle, its angry amber glow dimming to a dull bruised purple as it keeps the shredded scrap of your coat as forfeit. You press a stained rag against the bleeding line and swallow a metallic taste. Pulse hammers hard against your ribs. Your sleeve hangs in tatters, yet the path ahead clears enough that you stumble forward into the dust.

nodes.title: The Ledger Fragment
nodes.brief: You trick the mosaic into lowering its protective barrier by misdirecting its queries, securing a master ledger fragment.
nodes.page: Relieved of its anchor, the calfskin fragment slides free into your grip, cold and slick with an oily preservative that smells faintly of crushed elderberries. The prize rests in your palm. Etched into the hide is a forgotten marginal note in Thessaly Marr's familiar cramped hand, detailing how the Index might be unwritten entirely: a mercy of absolute forgetting to wipe away the city's oldest shames. You press the cold leather against your chest. It sits there like a small dormant seed of deliverance against your ribs.

nodes.title: The Choking Sump
nodes.brief: A thick fog of pulverized paper dust fills the corridor, obscuring the oil lamps and choking your breath.
nodes.page: Thick clouds of pulverized paper dust roll down the vaulted ceiling like an incoming tide, swallowing the amber halos of your belt-lamp and filling your nose with the dry, grey taste of century-old pulp. Every breath scrapes raw against your windpipe as millions of disintegrated pages settle over your shoulders in a heavy, suffocating mantle. Through the blinding haze, distant shelves groan and shift their weight in the dark, their timber frames weeping resin as the atmosphere grows thick enough to chew. You grope blindly along the uneven stone wall, keeping your fingertips pressed against the cold masonry to avoid stepping off the edge into the vertical drops where the stacks fall away into nothingness. The air tastes of dead ink and forgotten controversies, pressing down on your chest until your vision blurs at the edges and every step feels like wading through wet cement.

exits.label: Follow the wall toward the draft

nodes.title: The Dust-Sump
nodes.brief: The Dust-Sump: You enter a stagnant hollow where centuries of disintegrating pages have settled into shifting dunes.
nodes.page: You stumble out of the choking white fog into a vast stagnant hollow where centuries of disintegrating paper have settled into undulating dunes of grey powder. Ghostly drifts rise and fall with every breath of subterranean air and bury the lower shelves in silent shifting piles that hiss when your boots disturb them. To your left a narrow rift opens between two leaning folio-cases. Faint bluish phosphorescence pulses from the floor there. Straight ahead a steep mound of pulverized index cards spills toward a dark gap in the masonry, while a narrow catwalk of lashed book-spines stretches off to the right above a black drop. The air here is dead and cold. It smells of old linen and dried glue. Your tracks fill in behind you.

exits.label: Climb the mound of index cards
Leap toward the swirling dust devils
Trace the stable limestone floor below

nodes.title: The Phosphorescent Path
nodes.brief: You navigate the blinding haze by reading the faint phosphorescence of specialized marginal notes, uncovering a hidden brass compass.
nodes.page:
You drop to one knee in the knee-deep drifts and sweep away the surface grey to reveal faint, glowing instructions scrawled in phosphorescent ink across the flagstones by some long-dead scholar. Pale blue light traces a winding trail between towering stacks that lean toward one another. You follow.

Your fingers brush a cold metal object half-buried in the paper dust near a rotten baseboard. You unearth a brass compass whose needle does not point north, but twitches toward the hidden heart of the archives whenever a distant book is pulled from its shelf. The compass clicks in your palm. Its glass face is warm and fogged with condensation that smells faintly of rain.

nodes.title: Navigating the Haze
nodes.brief: You navigate the blinding haze by reading the faint phosphorescence of specialized marginal notes, uncovering a hidden brass compass.
nodes.page: Blinding clouds of airborne paper-rot swirl around your head, clinging to your eyelashes and turning the dim lantern light into a milky, suffocating blur. You lean heavily upon your iron cataloguing rod, squinting through the stinging particulate to catch the briefest flicker of the phosphorescent marginal notes etched into the floor-tiles ahead. The ground shifts beneath your soles as layers of uncollected pamphlets slide like shale under your boots, threatening to pitch you sideways into the dark void between the stacks. You hold your breath to keep from coughing, steadying your hand on the cold brass compass while you calculate the exact angle of the drift before taking your next blind step into the swirling grey.

nodes.title: Blind Misstep
nodes.brief: You navigate the blinding haze by reading the faint phosphorescence of specialized marginal notes, uncovering a hidden brass compass.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the paper dunes pulls the floor-tiles out from under your boots, and you plunge sideways into a knee-deep drift of razor-sharp card catalogues. Sharp edges slice your shins. Hot cuts burn with the salt of old paper-dye. You wrench yourself free with a harsh gasp and scatter priceless records into the dark as you scramble back onto the firmer masonry of the walkway. Your lamp flickers and dies in the impact. Inky gloom takes the aisle, and only the faint blue glow of the floor-notes guides your bruised and trembling hands. You sit a long moment. Dust coats your torn uniform.

nodes.title: The Guiding Needle
nodes.brief: You navigate the blinding haze by reading the faint phosphorescence of specialized marginal notes, uncovering a hidden brass compass.
nodes.page: You pick your way through the swirling grey by the brass compass's tick, and the instrument walks you clear of the blind storm. The prize sits firm in your pocket either way. In your palm the glowing needle locks on a corridor of iron-ribbed shelving you had not seen before, where the air turns crisp and cold. You slip the compass under your coat. A small mechanical pulse ticks against your ribs in time with your own.

nodes.title: The Folio Shield
nodes.brief: You outwit the swirling dust devils by redirecting their airflow with a discarded folio cover, retrieving a sealed parchment tube.
nodes.page: Vellum flakes slap your lantern glass like hail and nick your knuckles whenever you brace against the tilting stacks. You spot a discarded calfskin folio cover wedged half-buried in a drift of gritty ink-dust, its stiff edges scarred by old damp. Snatching the cover from the debris, you snap it hard into a crude wedge against the churning air current, feeling the mini-cyclone split and veer away from your face. A cylindrical length of parchment rolls free from the eddy and taps against the toe of your boot.

nodes.title: Sealed in Wax
nodes.brief: You outwit the swirling dust devils by redirecting their airflow with a discarded folio cover, retrieving a sealed parchment tube.
nodes.page: Thick red lamp-wax seals both ends of the retrieved cylinder, stamped with the blunt thumb-print of an anonymous cataloguer who clearly did not expect anyone to come looking. The air around you grows colder, carrying the unmistakable tang of oxidised copper and old tallow that marks the deeper passages of the Annexe. You turn the heavy tube over in your palms, listening to a faint scratching sound from within, as if a trapped silverfish were trying to chew its way through sixty years of bureaucracy.

nodes.title: Diverting the Gale
nodes.brief: You outwit the swirling dust devils by redirecting their airflow with a discarded folio cover, retrieving a sealed parchment tube.
nodes.page: Miniature gales of shredded index cards scream past your ears. They try to rip the folio cover from your aching grip and blind you with flying pulp. You refuse a head-on fight with the turbulence. Instead you angle the stiff leather against the vortex's primary spin and bank on what you know of draft patterns in the narrow aisles to open a short vacuum. Your grip locks on the greasy parchment tube. The vortex twists hard and pulls at your shoulder while you test your leverage against the roaring air.

nodes.title: A Blind Lunge
nodes.brief: You outwit the swirling dust devils by redirecting their airflow with a discarded folio cover, retrieving a sealed parchment tube.
nodes.page: The wind shears past your guard with a vicious snap, tears the folio cover from your fingers, and sends it spinning away into the grey dark. A sharp edge of flying card stock catches the skin of your forearm and slices a clean red line across your sleeve before you scramble backward into the shelter of a limestone pillar. Grit fills the air. The parchment tube stays clutched tight in your left fist.

nodes.title: Salvaged Secrets
nodes.brief: You outwit the swirling dust devils by redirecting their airflow with a discarded folio cover, retrieving a sealed parchment tube.
nodes.page: Grit in your teeth, arms burning from the effort, you secure the cylinder against your chest just as the local turbulence collapses into a harmless scatter of grey flakes. Whether won by clever leverage or sheer stubborn persistence, the prize is yours to carry into the gloom ahead. The wax seal yields with a satisfying crack under your thumb, revealing a cramped slip of paper detailing the forgotten route past the sealed masonry.

exits.label: Follow the path of the slip

nodes.title: Limestone Footing
nodes.brief: You analyze the mineral composition of the particulate storm to find the stable limestone floor beneath, gaining an enduring soot-filter mask.
nodes.page: Gritty dust coats your eyelashes, but your fingers trace the coarse texture of the floor tiles beneath the drifts until you feel the smooth, unmistakable cold of solid bedrock. By reading the grain of the particulate fallout against the baseboards, you deduce where the ancient ventilation flues still pull a steady draft from the city above. You press your boot heel down firmly, finding a secure foundation amidst the shifting paper dunes that threaten to swallow every landmark in sight.

nodes.title: The Grey Blanket
nodes.brief: You analyze the mineral composition of the particulate storm to find the stable limestone floor beneath, gaining an enduring soot-filter mask.
nodes.page: Every surface wears a deep fleece of pulverized print, silencing your footsteps until you seem to be walking through an underwater world of drowned ink and forgotten vocabulary. You wipe a smear of grey grime from your spectacles with a corner of your neckerchief, squinting into the gloom where distant rows of shelving loom like the ribs of stranded whales. The air tastes faintly of iron filings and vinegar, reminding you that these texts have been quietly fermenting in the dark for centuries.

nodes.title: Reading the Particulate
nodes.brief: You analyze the mineral composition of the particulate storm to find the stable limestone floor beneath, gaining an enduring soot-filter mask.
nodes.page: Tiny flecks of red and black ink drift through the hazy air like ash from a dying forge, settling in intricate patterns upon the ledges of the low bookcases. You crouch down close to the floor tiles, squinting through the stinging haze to calculate the precise mineral density and fallout drift of the paper-rot. Your mind races through shelf-indices and geologic strata maps, trying to predict exactly where the underlying limestone floor holds true beneath the treacherous drifts.

nodes.title: A Miscalculated Step
nodes.brief: You analyze the mineral composition of the particulate storm to find the stable limestone floor beneath, gaining an enduring soot-filter mask.
nodes.page: Your boots misjudge the particulate crust. With a sickening crunch your right leg plunges through a hollow pocket of discarded pamphlets straight down to the knee. White dust erupts around your face and fills your nose and mouth with the dry, bitter taste of centuries-old rag paper. You haul yourself out with a grunt. A stained boot-strap stays behind, and you limp onward into the haze short on time.

nodes.title: Filtered Breath
nodes.brief: You analyze the mineral composition of the particulate storm to find the stable limestone floor beneath, gaining an enduring soot-filter mask.
nodes.page: Your careful analysis pays off as you tie a damp strip of flannel tightly across your nose and mouth, instantly filtering out the stinging cloud of paper-rot. You now possess a sturdy, soot-darkened filter mask that keeps your lungs clear in the blinding grey. The suffocating air turns manageable, allowing you to breathe deeply as you navigate the treacherous floor.

nodes.title: The Lean-To Vaults
nodes.brief: You reach a cavernous hall where towering bookshelves lean against one another in precarious, threatening arches.
nodes.page: Bookshelves lean on one another in precarious arches across a cavernous subterranean hall where the air smells of old paste and damp plaster. Oak cases tilt at alarming angles, their top cornices wedged hard into the opposite masonry. Fine dust trickles down from the high ledges whenever you shift. Worm-eaten spines settle with a dry tick. Somewhere above, a loose folio flutters through the gloom like a dying moth, caught in an upward draft of cold air from the deeper strata. You press flat to a pine upright. The wood groans under thousands of forgotten volumes.

nodes.title: The Leaning Spires
nodes.brief: The Lean-To Stacks: You navigate an unstable cathedral of leaning wooden cases held together only by stubborn friction and old glue.
nodes.page: Stacks of massive octavos tilt in a great circle around you, forming an unstable cathedral of leaning wooden cases held together only by stubborn friction and old glue. Every timber creaks with a dry, complaining resonance as distant air currents shift through the vast chamber. A sliver of pale lamplight filters from a crack far overhead, glinting off copper clasps and leather bindings that threaten to slide down upon your shoulders at any second.

exits.label: Leap across the swaying shelf gap
Slide down the polished oak pilaster
Bridge the chasm with timber tension
Thread the shuddering aisles with grace
Approach the black ink river below

nodes.title: The Swaying Gap
nodes.brief: You leap across a collapsing gap between swaying shelves with agile precision, securing a bundle of reinforced binding cord.
nodes.page: Heavy pine shelves sway rhythmically above a dark crevice, held only by frayed hemp cord and stubborn gravity. You steady your breathing against the smell of ancient leather and rosin, timing your movement to the slow oscillation of the wooden monoliths. A bundle of reinforced binding cord lies caught upon a jagged splinter of oak just within arm's reach across the void. With a sharp intake of breath, you prepare your footing on the sloping veneer, ignoring the dry rattle of sliding folios echoing from the deeper dark below.

nodes.title: Across the Abyssal Shelf
nodes.brief: You leap across a collapsing gap between swaying shelves with agile precision, securing a bundle of reinforced binding cord.
nodes.page: Suspended timber frames groan in protest as you plant your boots firmly upon the narrow edge of a fallen bookcase spine. The damp air of the deep stacks chills your forehead, smelling strongly of gall ink and decomposing vellum. You gather the reinforced binding cord close to your chest, feeling its rough hemp fibers bite into your canvas coat as you edge past a protruding row of ecclesiastical registers. Every movement must be calculated to the inch, lest a sudden shift send the entire stack cascading into the blackness beneath.

nodes.title: The Shifting Span
nodes.brief: You leap across a collapsing gap between swaying shelves with agile precision, securing a bundle of reinforced binding cord.
nodes.page: A sudden tremor runs through the leaning stacks, causing the precarious bridge of books beneath your feet to tilt sharply toward the void. You throw your weight backward, arms windmilling to catch your balance as centuries-old volumes cascade like heavy dominoes into the darkness. Your boots slip on a slick cover of stamped calfskin, and you fling yourself forward toward the opposite ledge, trusting entirely in your agility to bridge the treacherous gap before the timber gives way beneath you.

check.label: Leap across the swaying gap with absolute agility

nodes.title: A Heavy Toll
nodes.brief: You leap across a collapsing gap between swaying shelves with agile precision, securing a bundle of reinforced binding cord.
nodes.page: Your fingers miss the far ledge by a hair's breadth. You drop hard against a jagged stack of projecting ledgers. Sharp pasteboard edges tear through your sleeve and rake a long scrape down your forearm while a small avalanche of theological pamphlets buries your ankles. You haul yourself upward with a dry curse, one arm around your bruised side. The mishap cost you precious minutes and left your left sleeve in tatters. The stacks settle around you with a final groan. You are bruised, but intact.

exits.label: Return to the leaning stack junction

nodes.title: The Narrow Crossing
nodes.brief: You leap across a collapsing gap between swaying shelves with agile precision, securing a bundle of reinforced binding cord.
nodes.page: You clear the treacherous gap with a sudden, fluid bound, landing securely upon the stable oak flooring of the opposite gallery, however narrowly. Your heart hammers against your ribs in the hushed gloom, but your grip remains firm on the prize you came for. Tucked securely into your belt is a length of sturdy hemp cord that will serve you well in the dark mazes ahead. You turn your back on the settling timber and retrace your steps toward the central junction.

exits.label: Return to the leaning stack junction

nodes.title: The Polished Pilaster
nodes.brief: You slide effortlessly along the polished grain of a fallen pilaster to safety, finding a durable horn-handled penknife.
nodes.page: A fallen pilaster of polished cherrywood bridges a narrow chasm between two listing cases, its surface gleaming faintly in the dim lamp-oil haze. You sit astride the smooth timber, sliding downward with controlled momentum past rows of forgotten medical treatises and municipal rolls. Halfway down, your gloved hand brushes against a small metal object wedged into a crack in the grain - a durable horn-handled penknife left behind by some long-forgotten cataloguer. You snatch it free on the fly without breaking your descent, landing neatly in the dust of the lower tier.

exits.label: Examine the penknife in the gloom

nodes.title: The Pillar Descent
nodes.brief: You slide effortlessly along the polished grain of a fallen pilaster to safety, finding a durable horn-handled penknife.
nodes.page: The cherrywood pilaster wobbles beneath your weight, threatening to tip sideways into the open shaft of the lower stacks. You lean your torso back against the grain, spreading your limbs to increase friction as the timber accelerates faster than you intended toward a pile of loose pamphlets. The darkness below swallows the landing point entirely, requiring a split-second shift of your center of gravity to avoid a jagged tier of iron-clasp ledgers rushing up to meet you.

check.label: Balance along the sliding pilaster grain

nodes.title: A Grazed Descent
nodes.brief: You slide effortlessly along the polished grain of a fallen pilaster to safety, finding a durable horn-handled penknife.
nodes.page: The pilaster lurches unpredictably near the end of the slide, dumping you unceremoniously into a heap of discarded cataloguing slips and torn parchment. A sharp iron corner catches your shoulder as you tumble, tearing your jacket and leaving a dull, throbbing ache across your collarbone. You pick yourself up from the paper drift, brushing dust from your hair while muttering a dry oath about the shoddy carpentry of the early cataloguers. Though your pride and your shoulder are smarting, you press on toward the dark river.

exits.label: Continue toward the black ink river

nodes.title: The Clean Slide
nodes.brief: You slide effortlessly along the polished grain of a fallen pilaster to safety, finding a durable horn-handled penknife.
nodes.page: You control the descent with expert precision, shedding momentum smoothly at the base of the pillar and landing upright without a single misstep, however narrowly. As you steady yourself in the dust, you pocket a durable horn-handled penknife found wedged in the grain, its blade keen and ready for cutting stubborn binding threads. In the quiet shadows beyond, an old, blind figure stirs from a high-backed chair, recognizes your quiet footfall, and gives you an unexpected nod of trust alongside a solemn promise to read the Index aloud, complete and unedited when the time arrives.

nodes.title: The Leaning Timber
nodes.brief: You manipulate the leaning timber tension points to bridge the chasm safely, earning a debt of honor from a trapped cataloguer.
nodes.page:
Splintered oak and cracked pine groan under your boots as you step onto the unstable joists bridging the abyss. Dust motes dance in the amber glow of your lamp, illuminating a trapped cataloguer clinging desperately to a protruding shelf bolt on the far side.

You must steady the shifting timber framework before the whole structure yields to gravity and tumbles into the dark.

nodes.title: The Bridging Span
nodes.brief: You manipulate the leaning timber tension points to bridge the chasm safely, earning a debt of honor from a trapped cataloguer.
nodes.page:
Tremors ripple through the floorboards while you kneel to test the tension points of the leaning beams. Every adjustment shifts the load, threatening to send both you and the stranded official sliding into the shadowy depths below.

Careful fingers find the rusted iron pins that lock the timber framework into place, demanding a delicate touch to avoid a catastrophic collapse.

nodes.title: Tension Points
nodes.brief: You manipulate the leaning timber tension points to bridge the chasm safely, earning a debt of honor from a trapped cataloguer.
nodes.page: Fractured pine beams groan beneath your weight as you test the structural tension of the leaning timbers that span the widening chasm. Below you, the abyss drops away into absolute blackness, save for the faint glimmer of phosphorescent fungi clinging to the ancient stone foundations. You wedge your shoulder against a straining upright, fingers tightening around the cold iron bolt that holds the makeshift bridge together while a trapped cataloguer watches you with desperate, narrowed eyes from the far ledge. Balancing your entire weight on the precarious fulcrum, you reach out to adjust the binding screw just as the wood gives a sharp, warning crack.

nodes.title: A Slipping Footing
nodes.brief: You manipulate the leaning timber tension points to bridge the chasm safely, earning a debt of honor from a trapped cataloguer.
nodes.page: The ledge snaps without warning, sending a shower of wood splinters into the dark chasm and dropping you hard against the stone. Your shoulder takes the brunt of the impact, leaving a deep bruise that throbs in time with your racing pulse. The trapped cataloguer hauls you over the threshold just in time, panting and muttering stiff words of gratitude for your reckless rescue.

exits.label: Pick yourself up and press onward

nodes.title: A Debt Of Honour
nodes.brief: You manipulate the leaning timber tension points to bridge the chasm safely, earning a debt of honor from a trapped cataloguer.
nodes.page: Solid stone rises to meet your boots as you haul yourself across the gap, however narrowly avoiding a plunge into the dark. The rescued cataloguer brushes the dust from their severe woollen robes and presses an embossed brass token into your palm. This official seal binds the rule-keeper to your cause, ensuring safe passage through any future disputes.

nodes.title: Weight And Measure
nodes.brief: You calculate the precise weight distribution of the falling texts to predict a safe route, acquiring an architectural diagram of the vaults.
nodes.page: Heavy volumes rain down from the upper tiers like falling masonry, crashing into the flagged floor with hollow thuds. You press your back against a stone pillar and study the rhythmic cascade of tumbling texts, searching for patterns in the chaos. The debris follows a predictable arc dictated by the settling foundations of the ancient stacks.

exits.label: Trace the path of falling books

nodes.title: Calculating the Descent
nodes.brief: You calculate the precise weight distribution of the falling texts to predict a safe route, acquiring an architectural diagram of the vaults.
nodes.page: Falling texts blur past your eyes in a dizzying cascade of black ink and yellowed leaves, each volume adding its mass to the chaotic kinetic puzzle of the shifting stacks. You narrow your gaze against the swirling paper-dust, mentally mapping the trajectories of the heaviest theological treatises as they plummet toward the floor below. Every second requires a swift recalculation of load and momentum to anticipate where the structural stress will settle next. Your boots hover an inch above the trembling floorboards as you ready yourself to dart across the precise convergence point before the timber flooring gives way completely.

nodes.title: The Weight of Paper
nodes.brief: You calculate the precise weight distribution of the falling texts to predict a safe route, acquiring an architectural diagram of the vaults.
nodes.page: Cascading folios shift under your boots like scree on a slate roof, and an avalanche of folio volumes sweeps your feet out from under you. You scramble for a protruding iron bracket, but lamp-oil and old dust grease the metal and your fingers slip. You tumble into a narrow recess between two tilting oak cases, bruise your ribs on a drawer-handle, and lose your tin of spare nibs in the dark. Crushed vellum and damp earth fill the air. You haul yourself upright. Your shoulder aches while the distant rumble of the stacks fades.

nodes.title: The Vault Diagram
nodes.brief: You calculate the precise weight distribution of the falling texts to predict a safe route, acquiring an architectural diagram of the vaults.
nodes.page: Calculations form in your mind like ink soaking into blotting paper as you watch the rhythm of the descending leather-bound tomes. You pick your footing across the sliding oak cases with measured precision, timing each leap to match the groaning shift of the timber framing. A heavy ledger brushes past your ear with the whisper of a blade, yet your route holds true through the chaotic flurry of falling knowledge. Tucked neatly into the spine of a wedged dictionary, your fingers close around a crisp parchment sheet detailing the hidden structural braces of the deep annexe vaults.

nodes.title: The Shuddering Aisles
nodes.brief: You move with fluid grace through the shuddering aisles while books plummet around you, collecting an undamaged vellum journal.
nodes.page: Rows of towering oak shelves sway in unison like trees in a gale, casting long and dancing shadows across the flagged floor. You time your movements to the rhythm of the tremors, slipping through narrow gaps between swaying cases as books plummet into the gloom. Every instinct urges caution, yet the way forward demands absolute speed.

nodes.title: Fluid Aisle Weaving
nodes.brief: You move with fluid grace through the shuddering aisles while books plummet around you, collecting an undamaged vellum journal.
nodes.page: Heavy octavos plummet from the high shelves like falling masonry, transforming the narrow corridor into a gauntlet of flying paper and splintering wood. You drop into a low crouch and slide beneath a tilting crossbeam, letting your momentum carry you smoothly past a crashing stack of encyclopaedias. Every instinct urges you to run, but you force your limbs into a controlled, dancing glide through the gaps in the falling debris, reaching out without breaking your stride toward a stray vellum journal resting on a dangling shelf. Your fingers brush the edge of the leather binding just as the shelf snaps violently upward into the gloom.

nodes.title: A Narrow Escape
nodes.brief: You move with fluid grace through the shuddering aisles while books plummet around you, collecting an undamaged vellum journal.
nodes.page: The falling book clips your heel and sends you sprawling into a heap of discarded cataloguing slips. Your ankle flares. You scramble away on hands and knees as a secondary wave of folios rains down around your ears. You limp in the dim light, battered but clear of the heap.

exits.label: Dust off your coat and stand

nodes.title: The Vellum Journal
nodes.brief: You move with fluid grace through the shuddering aisles while books plummet around you, collecting an undamaged vellum journal.
nodes.page: Shuddering aisles sway like masts in a rising gale while heavy octavos rain down around you in a flurry of torn leaves and flying parchment. You slip sideways through a gap in the shelving, your shoulder brushing the rough timber with fluid lightness as another leather-bound volume shatters the flagstones where you stood a heartbeat prior. Your hand shoots out instinctively to snatch a bound notebook tumbling past in mid-air, clutching it tight against your chest before the momentum carries you clear of the hazard. The leather cover is unmarked by dust or damp, and its uncreased pages offer a clean slate for whatever notes remain to be written.

nodes.title: The Black Sluice
nodes.brief: The air grows cold and damp as you approach an underground river of glistening black ink that blocks your path.
nodes.page: Frost forms along the margins of the paving stones and hardens the soot into crystalline crusts that crunch beneath your boots. Vapours rise from a trench carved deep into the limestone floor and bring the bitter tang of copper, lamp-oil, and boiled gall-nuts. Before you flows an underground river of glistening black ink, and its sluggish surface catches the dull amber glow of distant wall-brackets without returning any warmth. Bubbles of forgotten prose break lazily against the slick stone banks and release faint dry sounds that fade before any meaning arrives. You press your shoulder against the cold masonry. Nothing crosses the tide.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium Sluice
nodes.brief: The Scriptorium Sluice: You stand before a slow-moving current of waste ink draining from the upper writing chambers.
nodes.page: Stagnant vapours curl around iron sluice-gates that drip with dark, viscous residue draining from the writing chambers above into the black current at your feet. To your left a narrow ledge hugs the limestone wall, and ink-crusted stepping stones break the flow. Straight ahead a smoother stone pathway winds toward the deeper subterranean vaults. Dust coats your tongue. Beyond a partition of warped oak a ferry-rope sags slack over the stream. You grip your satchel.

nodes.title: The Chemical Current
nodes.brief: You study the chemical flow of the dark tide to locate its shallowest stepping stones, obtaining a water-resistant leather satchel.
nodes.page: Careful observation of the dark tide reveals a regular rhythm to the swirling eddies, governed by some distant sluice-master's schedule. You crouch near the brink, dipping a testing finger into the runoff to gauge its density and temperature. Among the discarded debris trapped in an eddy, a water-resistant leather satchel floats wedged between two sodden ledgers of local tariffs. You hook it out with the toe of your boot, shaking away a cluster of damp cataloguing slips. Inside, the lining remains dry, offering a safe vessel for whatever fragile notes you might gather from the shelves.

exits.label: Step out upon the narrow stone ledge

nodes.title: Assessing the Sludge
nodes.brief: You study the chemical flow of the dark tide to locate its shallowest stepping stones, obtaining a water-resistant leather satchel.
nodes.page: Calculating the exact intervals between the heavier influxes of waste ink requires precise attention to the bubbling patterns near the footing stones. You squint through the dim amber light, mapping the slick patches of residue against the damp masonry of the lower vault. One misplaced footstep upon a grease-slicked ledge could plunge your legs into the caustic black current, ruining your remaining dry clothes and fouling your equipment. You take a slow, measured breath, readying yourself to test the stability of the nearest submerged slab before the next dark surge arrives.

nodes.title: A Slipping Footing
nodes.brief: You study the chemical flow of the dark tide to locate its shallowest stepping stones, obtaining a water-resistant leather satchel.
nodes.page: A sudden surge from an upper sluice sends a greasy wave over the ledge, catching your ankle and sweeping your boot out from under you. You scramble against the slimy stone wall, scraping your palms raw as you haul yourself back from the black brink. Your trousers are soaked through with caustic ink that burns sharply against a fresh scrape on your shin, and the damp chill settles deep into your marrow. The satchel's strap is coated in sticky black residue, but you are alive and coughing on solid ground once more.

exits.label: Return to the main sluice junction

nodes.title: Crossing the Chemical Tide
nodes.brief: You study the chemical flow of the dark tide to locate its shallowest stepping stones, obtaining a water-resistant leather satchel.
nodes.page: The stones are slick. You pick your way across and reach the far side without a serious misstep, boots already stained deep violet with spilled gall. Balance holds against the vapours rising from the ink-channelling trench below, and the air tastes of iron and gall. Tucked into a crevice of the opposite wall, a discarded wire-bound notebook catches your eye, its pages entirely blank yet smelling strongly of fresh lavender and old paper. You slide the clean quire into your satchel.

exits.label: Return to the main sluice junction

nodes.title: The Drifting Plank
nodes.brief: You leap lightly over the churning ink channel on a drifting shelf board, retrieving an ornamental silver dipping pen.
nodes.page: Loose shelving boards bob sluggishly upon the oily surface of the ink-channel, held together by strands of rotted hemp and dried paste. You brace a long oak plank with the butt of a ledger and test whether it will float against the underground drain's pull. Glinting beneath a tangle of waterlogged parchment near the middle of the span lies an ornamental silver dipping pen, its nib intact and untarnished by the corrosive fluid around it. The wood groans softly under your weight as you shift your stance to secure the prize.

nodes.title: Reclaiming the Quill
nodes.brief: You leap lightly over the churning ink channel on a drifting shelf board, retrieving an ornamental silver dipping pen.
nodes.page: Snatching the silver pen from its resting place, you tuck it swiftly into your coat pocket just as the floating board tips alarmingly toward the dark drain. The ink-channel bubbles angrily beneath your boots, spitting tiny droplets of black gall onto your cuffs as the current accelerates into a narrow conduit. You spring across the widening gap, landing hard on the opposite stone apron with a muffled clatter of loose slate chips. Your heart thumps against your ribs in the hushed air of the stacks.

exits.label: Return to the main sluice junction

nodes.title: The Mid-Stream Leap
nodes.brief: You leap lightly over the churning ink channel on a drifting shelf board, retrieving an ornamental silver dipping pen.
nodes.page: Balancing upon the narrow edge of a shifting oak board, you prepare to vault across the churning black channel toward the opposite stack. The air is thick with the acrid scent of boiling copperas, blurring the edges of the distant wall-brackets and making distances hard to judge. A single mistimed jump will plunge you directly into the corrosive stream, while a clean landing will clear the hazard entirely. You bend your knees, fixing your gaze upon a narrow gap in the shelving opposite.

nodes.title: Plunging into the Ink
nodes.brief: You leap lightly over the churning ink channel on a drifting shelf board, retrieving an ornamental silver dipping pen.
nodes.page: Your boot clips the upper rim of a floating folio, throwing off your balance mid-air and sending you crashing sideways into the dark current. You scramble upright with a sharp gasp, coughing up the bitter taste of iron and lamp-oil while your left sleeve drips black slime. The fall leaves a deep, stinging bruise along your ribs where you struck a projecting shelf-bracket, and your pockets are sodden with ruined notes. You drag yourself onto the stone margin, shivering and dripping ink onto the dry dust of the floor.

exits.label: Return to the main sluice junction

nodes.title: Clearing the Dark Conduit
nodes.brief: You leap lightly over the churning ink channel on a drifting shelf board, retrieving an ornamental silver dipping pen.
nodes.page: You spring across the gap and your boots find solid purchase on the opposite flags above the churning froth. You stumble once against a stack of discarded parliamentary acts, but keep your balance without losing your footing or your composure. Tucked into the timber frame of the nearest shelf is a slender bone-handled paper knife, cold to the touch and remarkably sharp. You slide it into your belt, adding a handy implement for cutting stubborn bindings and sealed envelopes.

exits.label: Return to the main sluice junction

nodes.title: The Heavy Tomes
nodes.brief: You forge a clever diversion by damming a tributary feeder with heavy encyclopedias, securing a cache of dry blotting paper.
nodes.page: Thick calfskin volumes settle with a sodden thud into the black channel, their gold-leafed spines absorbing the dark liquor of the tributary feeder. You wedge the massive encyclopedias between two trembling iron pillars, diverting the greasy current into a temporary backwater where the surface skims clear. Carefully, you press sheets of dry blotting paper across the damp flagstones, soaking up the residual sheen until the slate is workable. The lamp-oil gutters low in your brass lantern, casting long, wavering shadows against the towering stacks of forgotten geography.

exits.label: Step across the dry stone path

nodes.title: The Dammed Rill
nodes.brief: You forge a clever diversion by damming a tributary feeder with heavy encyclopedias, securing a cache of dry blotting paper.
nodes.page: Iron-clasped geographies serve as your temporary masonry; you drop them one by one into the pulsing throat of the feeder until the black fluid slows to a sluggish trickle. You work with frantic haste, your fingers stained deep with walnut-brown gall, stacking damp folios to block every escaping rivulet. Across the makeshift timber-and-paper barrier, a pocket of clean air opens above a dry stretch of flooring. You slide your remaining stack of blotting paper into the sheltered recess, keeping the fragile sheets safe from the drifting spray.

nodes.title: Choking the Sluice
nodes.brief: You forge a clever diversion by damming a tributary feeder with heavy encyclopedias, securing a cache of dry blotting paper.
nodes.page: Pressure from the upstream feeder swells against your hasty dam as black fluid bubbles hard around the edges of the encyclopedias. You shove against the spine of a massive biographical dictionary and try to wedge it deeper into the groove before the barricade yields to the rising tide. The soaked paper groans and slips under your palms. The seal could burst and wash your dry cache into the void.

nodes.title: Soaking the Stash
nodes.brief: You forge a clever diversion by damming a tributary feeder with heavy encyclopedias, securing a cache of dry blotting paper.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of black liquor punches right through the center of your barricade, showering your boots and clothes in bitter, staining sludge. The precious cache of dry blotting paper drinks the overflow in an instant, swelling into a useless, soggy pulp that falls apart in your hands. You scramble backward up the slippery stone slope, coughing against the sharp smell of iron gall and lamp-oil, poorer by a dozen sheets and half your breath.

nodes.title: The Sluice Dam
nodes.brief: You forge a clever diversion by damming a tributary feeder with heavy encyclopedias, securing a cache of dry blotting paper.
nodes.page:
Heavy calfskin encyclopedias tumble into the tributary feeder one by one, their dense paper absorbing the black current until the trickling water pools and stalls. You scoop up a thick bundle of dry blotting paper from the ledge before the pressure shifts, stuffing the absorbent sheets into your coat pocket where they will keep damp ink at bay for hours to come.

This salvaged stack-guard's paper remains stiff and dry, ready to soak up stray fluids or shield your fingers from biting bindings in the deeper vaults.

exits.label: Retrace your steps toward the sluice

nodes.title: The Ferryman's Toll
nodes.brief: You negotiate safe passage with the ink-rower by offering a pinch of salt, winning a ferry token for future crossings.
nodes.page: A flat-bottomed punt drifts out from the shadow of the iron stacks, poled by a silent figure draped in grease-stained canvas. You reach into your pocket and draw out a twisted pinch of coarse grey salt, holding it flat upon your palm until the rower's dark eyes catch the glint of mineral. A gnarled hand reaches across the gunwale to accept the trade, dropping a small notched bone disc into your palm in return.

nodes.title: Bargaining in Ink
nodes.brief: You negotiate safe passage with the ink-rower by offering a pinch of salt, winning a ferry token for future crossings.
nodes.page: The hooded rower pauses his long ash pole inches from the stone shelf, watching you with the suspicious stillness of a gargoyle. You offer the pinch of grey salt across the dark gap, pitching your voice to a low, respectful murmur that will not disturb the whispering margins around you. The ferryman cocks his head, weighing your sincerity against the rising tide of the ink-rivers below.

nodes.title: A Sour Trade
nodes.brief: You negotiate safe passage with the ink-rower by offering a pinch of salt, winning a ferry token for future crossings.
nodes.page: Your hand slips on the damp stone as you reach out, spilling half the precious salt into the dark current where it dissolves in an instant. The rower scowls, a harsh sound like dry parchment tearing, and pushes the punt an arm's length away from the ledge. You are left standing alone with wet boots and a lighter pouch, forced to find another way across the channel without a token.

nodes.title: The Ferry Token
nodes.brief: You negotiate safe passage with the ink-rower by offering a pinch of salt, winning a ferry token for future crossings.
nodes.page:
A pinch of coarse grey salt drawn from your provisions draws a low rasping whistle from the hooded ink-rower, who steers his skiff against the drifting current long enough for you to step aboard the damp timber planks. He drops a cold disk of cast lead into your palm before pushing off into the gloom, a small circular token of safe passage across any dark water in the stacks.

The token rests against your thumb. Another crossing is yours whenever the channels block your path.

exits.label: Return toward the waste ink sluice

nodes.title: The Iron Trial
nodes.brief: You find a series of iron-bound trial chambers where the history of the Underlibrary judges every visitor.
nodes.page: Iron doors stand ajar in the deepest roots of the annexe and open onto vaulted chambers where the history of the Underlibrary keeps its mute tally. Ancient administrative verdicts cut every stone face, and soft voices of forgotten cataloguers seem to skim the carvings, as if they still weighed each manuscript ever shelved. You cross into the chill draft of the tribunal. Centuries lean close enough to prick the conscience. The walls note each pause while you hunt for any trace of Thessaly Marr among the dusty records.

exits.label: Enter the court of red ink

nodes.title: The Court of Red Ink
nodes.brief: The Court of the Red Ink: You enter a severe judicial chamber where past administrative verdicts echo from the stone walls.
nodes.page: Cold crimson light spills from high lancet windows across flagstones stained by centuries of judicial overflow. Past administrative verdicts leak from the damp masonry and hiss, grease cooling on a pan, whenever a shadow shifts. Rows of high mahogany benches face an empty tribunal chair; the automated weights and balances hang still in the close air. Iron filings and vinegar mark every surface. To the left a narrow wicket gate opens toward the lower archives. Straight ahead an arched portal carries the dry crackle of ancient folios. To the right a low iron wicket stands unlatched above a spiral stair. Further on a shadowy breach gapes behind the scales. Beyond the benches a wide tunnel runs straight into the murmuring dark.

nodes.title: Precedents in the Dust
nodes.brief: You research the ancient precedents to argue successfully against an unjust citation, earning an official seal of exemption.
nodes.page: Iron-bound codexes litter the reading desk like fallen masonry, pages yellowed by age and sour lamp-oil. Brittle parchment lines in the severe hand of early cataloguers hold the clause that frees junior pages from retroactive shelving debts. The ink flakes beneath your thumb and releases a sharp tang of vinegar and dried gall that bites your eyes. Dust hangs in the beam. Overhead gears grind with a long groan. A marginal correction catches your eye, scrawled in an unfamiliar violet ink that seems to pulse faintly under the paper's skin. You gather your notes and prepare to test the ancient wording against the mechanical magistrate.

nodes.title: The Citation Hearing
nodes.brief: You research the ancient precedents to argue successfully against an unjust citation, earning an official seal of exemption.
nodes.page: Silence settles over the alcove as you place your handwritten transcript upon the bronze reading slope before the magistrate's empty chair. The room grows colder. Violet marginalia on the sheet begins to crawl across the page like trapped insects seeking an escape route. Mechanical wheels grind behind the wainscot. They click through centuries of accumulated fines and unreturned folios to find a matching infraction. Dense legal shorthand waits on the page, and you have to match the archaic phrasing before the tribunal's brass claws snap shut on your cuffs. Your fingers hover over the claim, ready to press it home against the grinding of the archive.

nodes.title: A Heavy Penalty
nodes.brief: You research the ancient precedents to argue successfully against an unjust citation, earning an official seal of exemption.
nodes.page: The brass claws strike with sudden, bone-numbing force, catch your sleeve, and tear away a strip of coarse wool along with a steep toll of precious time. You wrench your arm free. The automated register stamps a harsh red debt mark across the back of your hand. Hours slip away in the gloom while you wait for the machinery to reset its cogs. Your joints stiffen. A raw welt on the skin smells faintly of copper. The temporary exemption slips through your fingers. Administrative grievance lingers in its place. The machinery grinds to a halt at last, and you stumble onward into the dim corridors.

nodes.title: The Seal of Exemption
nodes.brief: You research the ancient precedents to argue successfully against an unjust citation, earning an official seal of exemption.
nodes.page: The heavy brass machinery shudders, clicks twice, and grudgingly spits out a small leaden token stamped with the unbroken seal of the high cataloguers. Whether through swift wit or sheer stubborn endurance, you have beaten the automated court at its own game and secured your freedom from further citation. The cold air of the chamber seems to lighten slightly, and the surrounding stacks appear to settle into a more orderly alignment. You pocket the token. It presses cool against your palm as you prepare for the next leg of your journey.

nodes.title: The Hidden Drawer
nodes.brief: You parse the complex jurisdictional codes inscribed upon the bench to unlock a hidden drawer containing a silver seal-ring.
nodes.page: The judicial bench is scarred with deep notches carved by generations of desperate readers and delinquent scholars. You run your fingers along the intricate wood-carvings beneath the writing surface, feeling for the secret release spring hidden among the carved oak leaves. The wood gives way with a dry, satisfying snap, revealing a shallow recess lined with faded velvet. Inside rests a small silver ring bearing the insignia of an early cataloguer, its surface untarnished by the damp atmosphere of the deep stacks. You pick up the metal band, noting how the ambient lamplight seems to bend around its polished hoop.

nodes.title: Parsing the Codes
nodes.brief: You parse the complex jurisdictional codes inscribed upon the bench to unlock a hidden drawer containing a silver seal-ring.
nodes.page: The symbols engraved on the silver hoop match the jurisdictional codes carved into the rim of the writing desk. As you turn the ring against the metal grooves, a series of internal clicks runs through the hollow core of the furniture like falling pins. A hidden compartment springs open. Fine grey preservative powder billows into your face. You slow your breath and read the remaining sequence of glyphs before the chemical dust blinds you completely. The next glyph swims half-seen in the powder cloud.

nodes.title: Choked by the Past
nodes.brief: You parse the complex jurisdictional codes inscribed upon the bench to unlock a hidden drawer containing a silver seal-ring.
nodes.page: Caustic grey powder fills your lungs. You stumble back against the cold stone wall and cough hard enough that the empty aisle carries the sound. A dusty sleeve clears your streaming eyes and leaves a raw, inflamed scratch across your cheek where a stray metal burr caught the skin. Precious minutes go while the burn in your chest eases. Your provisions wear an alkaline film that ruins half your dry rations. A costly stumble: breath short, body sore in the dim lamplight. The danger fades. The air clears enough for you to move on.

exits.label: Return to the red ink court

nodes.title: The Silver Hoop
nodes.brief: You parse the complex jurisdictional codes inscribed upon the bench to unlock a hidden drawer containing a silver seal-ring.
nodes.page: Your fingers move with precise, practised certainty, aligning the difficult sequence just as the internal tumblers fall into place with a soft chime. Whether through careful calculation or sheer intuitive luck, you lift the silver seal-ring free from its velvet bed without triggering the preservative trap. The cool metal feels remarkably light against your skin, and as you slide it onto your finger, the nearby catalogue drawers slide shut in unison as if acknowledging a master's touch. You secure the valuable keepsake within your coat pocket and retrace your steps toward the central hall.

exits.label: Return to the red ink court

nodes.title: The Tribunal's Whisper
nodes.brief: You maintain unyielding resolve against the accusatory whispers of the automated tribunal, winning the enduring respect of the court ghost.
nodes.page: Countless phantom voices rise from the empty benches like steam from a cooling kettle, hissing accusations of lost books, altered indexes, and unpardonable negligence. The unseen judges debate your worthiness with dry, paper-rustling murmurs that scrape against your thoughts like sand in an inkwell. You stand before the central dais and slow your breath while the phantom arguments wash over your shoulders in waves of cold air. One by one, the hostile whispers begin to falter, cowed by your unyielding posture and the quiet stillness of your resolve. The presiding court ghost leans forward from the shadows, dipping its incorporeal quill in silent acknowledgement.

nodes.title: The Unyielding Will
nodes.brief: You maintain unyielding resolve against the accusatory whispers of the automated tribunal, winning the enduring respect of the court ghost.
nodes.page: The phantom voices swell into a deafening chorus of censure. They conjure visions of endless stacks collapsing into ink-rivers and catalogues rewriting themselves into oblivion. The floor beneath your boots trembles as if the entire foundation of the Underlibrary is testing your inner strength. Lock your jaw. Refuse to give ground against the psychic pressure, and hold fast to your identity as a shelver of the deep stacks. Spiritual force bears down upon your chest and tries to force a confession of guilt for crimes you never committed. You tighten your grip on your lapel and brace for the breaking point.

nodes.title: Broken Resolve
nodes.brief: You maintain unyielding resolve against the accusatory whispers of the automated tribunal, winning the enduring respect of the court ghost.
nodes.page: The psychic pressure shatters your concentration at the last possible second. You stagger back. Sharp pain flares behind your temples and iron tastes bitter in your mouth. You drop to one knee on the flagstones and gasp for air while the tribunal's mocking laughter rustles through the vaulted ceiling like dry autumn leaves. Pain digs into your skull. Spirit drains. The ghostly judges withdraw into the masonry. You are alone in the dim light. You get up, bruised in mind if not in limb, and limp back toward the main chamber.

nodes.title: The Ghostly Respect
nodes.brief: You maintain unyielding resolve against the accusatory whispers of the automated tribunal, winning the enduring respect of the court ghost.
nodes.page: The chaotic chorus of whispers abruptly ceases. An absolute, reverent silence settles over the entire court. Whether through unshakeable mental fortitude or sheer stubborn defiance, you weather the storm of accusations until the automated tribunal acknowledges your quiet strength. The chief ghost dips its spectral head in formal salute and slides a scrap of vellum across the polished wood of the bench. You pick up the document, feeling a faint residual warmth radiate from its surface. It is a signed testimonial from the court itself, granting you safe passage through any judicial zone in the library.

exits.label: Return to the red ink court

nodes.title: The Swinging Scales
nodes.brief: You slip past the mechanical judgment scales with fluid agility, securing a blank writ of passage signed by a dead judge.
nodes.page:
Heavy iron balance pans sway rhythmically in the damp subterranean draft, hung from a vaulted ceiling of soot-stained brick. Each breath tastes of stale copper and lamp-oil as you edge past the towering mechanical apparatus, its pointer twitching with every passing tremor of the deep archive. A discarded quill lies on the flagged stones near the brass pedestal, still wet with dark ink.

You reach out with a gloved hand, lifting a blank parchment slip from the dead judge's velvet-lined tray while the iron counterweights hover inches above your shoulder.

exits.label: Slip past the silent judgment scales

nodes.title: Beyond the Pendulum
nodes.brief: You slip past the mechanical judgment scales with fluid agility, securing a blank writ of passage signed by a dead judge.
nodes.page:
Shadows lengthen across the flagstones as the swinging chains settle into a low, rhythmic hum that vibrates through the soles of your boots. The blank writ rests securely within your inner pocket, stiff against your ribs, carrying the faint, cold smell of parchment stored too long in a vault. Ahead, a narrow stone stairwell descends deeper into the limestone, its handrail slick with condensation and fine black dust.

You check the seal on the slip one last time before stepping down into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Pivot of Balance
nodes.brief: You slip past the mechanical judgment scales with fluid agility, securing a blank writ of passage signed by a dead judge.
nodes.page: Iron weights click against the brass housing of the scale with a sharp, warning note that echoes off the low ceiling. The gap between the swinging counterweights narrows abruptly as a sudden tremor shakes the masonry, threatening to trap your arm against the pedestal. You gather your focus, timing your movement to slide through the narrow clearance before the brass tongue slams home into its locking groove.

nodes.title: A Narrow Escape
nodes.brief: You slip past the mechanical judgment scales with fluid agility, securing a blank writ of passage signed by a dead judge.
nodes.page: Iron edges graze your sleeve with enough force to tear the wool. You stumble hard against the damp pillar. A dull ache flares along your forearm where a jagged corner of the brass pan clipped your skin, leaving a thin line of dark blood that smears against your cuff. The scales settle into a sullen clank behind you, the opportunity for a clean passage lost to your awkward timing.

exits.label: Gather your breath and move on

nodes.title: The Signed Warrant
nodes.brief: You slip past the mechanical judgment scales with fluid agility, securing a blank writ of passage signed by a dead judge.
nodes.page: Fingers close around the smooth parchment slip, its surface cold and dry despite the damp air of the annexe. A faint scent of dried gall and old cedar clings to the official signature scrawled at the bottom by a hand that has long since turned to dust. You fold the warrant carefully, tucking it away as a tangible reminder of how thinly order holds the archive together.

exits.label: Enter the Court of Red Ink

nodes.title: The Amphitheatre of Whispers
nodes.brief: The shelves give way to an open amphitheatre where thousands of marginal ghosts debate the fate of the archive.
nodes.page: Stone tiers rise into the gloom, crowded with thousands of pale, translucent figures leaning forward from shadowed alcoves. These are the Marginalia, the disembodied thoughts and caustic comments of readers long dead, and their voices merge into a low continuous surf of criticism and debate. They argue fiercely over what Thessaly Marr sought in the deep vaults. Spectral fingers point at the lower darkness. Salt-peter and old ink-stains crust every shelf. Unvoiced opinions prickle the air. You tip your chin toward the dark they indicate.

exits.label: Face the assembly of shifting ghosts

nodes.title: The Assembly of Marginalia
nodes.brief: The Assembly of Marginalia: You stand in the centre of a murmuring crowd of disembodied reader opinions and dissenting notes.
nodes.page: Murmurs swell and recede around you like tide water against shelving iron, each ghostly voice offering conflicting advice on how to approach the inner sanctum. Some figures lean close to murmur warnings about trapped passages, while others gesture toward hidden alcoves where forgotten papers lie half-buried in dust. The air grows thick with the scent of old leather and burning rush-lights, and every shadow seems to shift with intent.

exits.label: Steel your nerves against the cacophony
Hold your ground against the spectral surge
Approach the sliding letter puzzle door

nodes.title: The Flawed Logic
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page:
Voices falter as you dissect the faulty premise of a disputed footnote concerning the original catalogue numbering. The argument ripples outward through the tiers of ghosts, silencing the nearest rows with sudden intellectual surprise. A translucent scroll drifts down from an upper bracket, landing lightly upon your shoulder before tumbling to the flagstones.

You pick up the discarded paper, its margins filled with neat, hurried handwriting that outlines a forgotten path through the stacks.

nodes.title: The Quiet Tiers
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page:
Silence follows your analysis through the dim stone aisles, broken only by the faint scratching of phantom nibs against unseen paper. The marginal ghosts withdraw into their respective alcoves, nodding in reluctant acknowledgment of your reasoning. Ahead, a low archway opens into a narrow service passage lined with leather-bound volumes that smell faintly of bitter almonds and vinegar.

You step through the stone frame into the stillness.

nodes.title: The Logic of the Margins
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page: Thousands of critical eyes fix upon you as you trace the tangled web of cross-references governing the shelf allocations. A contradiction in the ancient indexing rules hangs in the air, waiting for your tongue to either resolve it or trigger a storm of disapproval from the assembled scholars. You slow your breath and run the proper sequence of shelf numbers through your mind before the assembly begins its collective censure.

check.label: Trace the flaws in the debate

nodes.title: The Cost of Contradiction
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page: A sharp wave of collective derision washes over your thoughts, twisting your reasoning into knotting confusion and leaving a bitter taste of ink on your tongue. The mental strain leaves you with a dull, persistent throbbing behind your temples that makes every footstep echo like a hammer-blow. You stagger against a stack of ledgers, clutching your head as the ghostly murmurs resume their chaotic chatter around you.

exits.label: Recover your wits in the dust

nodes.title: The Transcribed Truth
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page: Ink flows smooth and black across the parchment sheet as you capture the essence of the scholars' debate, binding their scattered arguments into a coherent whole. The parchment warms in your palm, imbued with the lingering intellectual authority of a thousand critical readers. You tuck the document safely into your satchel, knowing it will open doors that remain firmly shut to ordinary inquirers.

nodes.title: Whispers of the Stacks
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the overwhelming psychic cacophony of a thousand competing thoughts, gaining a mental warding charm.
nodes.page: Sound presses against your skull like parchment folded too tightly, and disembodied opinions brush past your temples with endless critiques, retractions, and bitter footnotes left by generations of departed scholars. Every shelf around you seems to vibrate with its own discordant frequency of mental static. You force each breath. Your palms press hard against your ears while you hunt for an anchor in the howling gale of other people's thoughts.

nodes.title: Threshold of Cries
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the overwhelming psychic cacophony of a thousand competing thoughts, gaining a mental warding charm.
nodes.page: Stale lamp-oil mixes with the copper tang of old ink in the stagnant air of the annexe. A dense cloud of restless annotations hovers above the floorboards, shifting shapes like starlings over a winter field. Each passing second amplifies the mental pressure, threatening to splinter your focus into a thousand useless fragments. Gathering your tattered resolve, you force your boots forward into the heart of the whispering storm.

nodes.title: Fortress of Mind
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the overwhelming psychic cacophony of a thousand competing thoughts, gaining a mental warding charm.
nodes.page: Voices shriek inside your consciousness, tearing at the barriers of your sanity with spectral claws of pure logic and regret. You lock your teeth, sealing your jaw against a cry of sheer agony as the collective weight bears down upon your resolve. Every memory of home and quiet corridors flickers under the blinding glare of a thousand critical intellects. Closing your eyes, you build an interior wall of absolute silence, bracing for the psychic impact.

check.label: Anchor your mind against the noise

nodes.title: Fracture of Resolve
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the overwhelming psychic cacophony of a thousand competing thoughts, gaining a mental warding charm.
nodes.page: The mental tide shatters your fragile mental defenses, flooding your thoughts with a crippling wave of self-doubt and borrowed despair. A sharp, burning ache blooms behind your temples, leaving your hands trembling and your mouth dry with the metallic taste of spoiled ink. You stumble against a towering oak bookcase, gasping for breath as the psychic shockwave rolls over you. Though bruised in spirit and drained of energy, you refuse to let the stacks consume your identity entirely.

exits.label: Recover your footing in the aisle

nodes.title: The Warding Spark
nodes.brief: You steel your nerves against the overwhelming psychic cacophony of a thousand competing thoughts, gaining a mental warding charm.
nodes.page: Iron discipline holds your thoughts intact against the overwhelming swell of intellectual pressure. The chaotic noise drops away into the distance, and a crystalline stillness settles in your mind. Between the leaves of a discarded volume near your boot, a scrap of paper catches your eye. You retrieve it, recognizing the precise, familiar handwriting of the missing Archivist detailing a hidden mental ward.

nodes.title: Shadows on the Floor
nodes.brief: You glide through the phantom audience with effortless poise, collecting dropped notes containing secret archival passwords.
nodes.page: Phantom scholars drift through the galleried aisles like smoke trapped in an alabaster jar. Their translucent robes brush against your coat sleeves as they debate forgotten statutes with silent, frantic gestures. You slide between their overlapping forms with measured steps, keeping your balance poised on the edge of the polished timber floor. Every movement must be deliberate, lest your physical presence disrupt their timeless arguments and draw unwanted attention.
