nodes.title: Silent Footfalls
nodes.brief: You glide through the phantom audience with effortless poise, collecting dropped notes containing secret archival passwords.
nodes.page: Dropped scraps of parchment flutter down through the dim air like dying autumn leaves. You track their erratic fall. You time your stride and intercept them before they dissolve into the floorboards, while cold iron and dry cellulose scent the corridor and a cluster of disapproving spectral examiners follows your passage with cold curiosity.

nodes.title: The Graceful Descent
nodes.brief: You glide through the phantom audience with effortless poise, collecting dropped notes containing secret archival passwords.
nodes.page: A sudden shift in the floorboards threatens to unbalance your footing right beneath the noses of the severe spectral tribunal. You dip your shoulder, shifting your weight with instantaneous precision to slide beneath a sweeping gesture of academic disdain. Your fingers sweep low across the grain of the wood, aiming to scoop up a fluttering handful of stray archival passwords. The slightest twitch of muscle will betray your intrusion to the watching phantoms.

nodes.title: Stumbled Ledger
nodes.brief: You glide through the phantom audience with effortless poise, collecting dropped notes containing secret archival passwords.
nodes.page: A misjudged step catches the hem of your coat on an unyielding brass bracket, sending you lurching awkwardly into a stack of loose papers. The phantom examiners turn their collective gaze upon you with chilling unanimity, their silent scolds stinging worse than physical blows. You snatch up what you can, your fingers scraping raw against the rough grain of the shelf in your hasty recovery. Though your dignity suffers a severe fracture and your ribs ache from the strain, you break free into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Unseen Thief
nodes.brief: You glide through the phantom audience with effortless poise, collecting dropped notes containing secret archival passwords.
nodes.page: You pass through the phantom throng without displacing a single draft of air. The valuable slips of paper settle neatly into your palm, warm with residual ink and carrying the precise access ciphers you require. Not a single spectral scholar turns a head as you merge seamlessly back into the deeper shadows of the alcove. You pocket the secure notes, knowing they hold the key to unlocking the restricted passages ahead.

nodes.title: The Gaze of Annotators
nodes.brief: You withstand the collective gaze of the critical spirits without flinching, earning a promise of warning against upcoming traps.
nodes.page:
Shadows stretch over the vellum-paved floor as the spectral tribunal leans forward together. Their ink-stained fingers twitch above pages that are not there, and they take the measure of each breath you draw in this old cellar. You lift your chin and meet that shared look without a tremor. Dried gall and bitter tannins hang in the air, the leftover scent of a thousand forgotten censors. One leading shade, draped in academic robes woven from grey spider-silk, tips its translucent head in a rare show of respect.

In return for that composure the gathering pledges to murmur warnings whenever invisible snares or shifting floorboards wait ahead in the gloom of the stacks. You hitch the strap of your satchel and step on deeper into the shelves.

nodes.title: Whispers from the Margin
nodes.brief: You withstand the collective gaze of the critical spirits without flinching, earning a promise of warning against upcoming traps.
nodes.page:
Pale ink-marks drift off the nearby vertical bindings like startled midges and hang in the stagnant air around your ears. They carry the collective irritation of scholars whose corrections were ignored by generations of lazy cataloguers. Your calm keeps them from settling into your hair or nipping exposed skin. The lead shade raises a pale, ink-stained hand and sketches a quick circle in the dust to mark a truce between the living shelver and the restless dead. You nod once. Their terms stand. You keep your guard up against the damp chill that creeps up from the foundations.

Safe passage holds through the next gallery if you respect the margins and tread lightly over the fallen flyleaves. The phantoms part just enough to reveal a narrow gap between two leaning folios, and the oil lamp flickers there against the encroaching dark.

nodes.title: The Censor's Rebuke
nodes.brief: You withstand the collective gaze of the critical spirits without flinching, earning a promise of warning against upcoming traps.
nodes.page: Iron-bound ledgers drop from the upper galleries with deafening thuds. Your footing threatens to give as the trial intensifies. You brace your boots against the vibrating floorboards, planting your weight firmly to resist the sudden psychological pressure of a hundred judging eyes. The air grows cold enough to freeze the breath in your throat, and the whispering voices swell into a harsh, accusatory chorus that tries to crack your resolve. Gathering every ounce of internal discipline, you lock your jaw and stare down the descending tide of falling folios, refusing to give ground to the spectral onslaught.

check.label: Anchor your mind against the judgment

nodes.title: Bruised and Bound
nodes.brief: You withstand the collective gaze of the critical spirits without flinching, earning a promise of warning against upcoming traps.
nodes.page: Collective disapproval hits too hard to shrug off, slamming into your chest like a swinging oak door. You stagger backward, your shoulder blades colliding hard with a jutting iron bracket that tears a jagged hole in your coat lining and leaves a dull, throbbing ache along your ribs. Several loose sheets of paper flutter down around you, mocking your stumble with dry, rustling whispers. Catching your breath in the dusty gloom, you press a hand to your bruised side and force yourself upright. The trial demands its toll in pain and lost moments, but the living blood still pumps through your veins, and the path forward remains open.

nodes.title: The Censor's Stamp
nodes.brief: You withstand the collective gaze of the critical spirits without flinching, earning a promise of warning against upcoming traps.
nodes.page: You hold your ground through the invisible tempests of disapproval until the spectral tribunal settles into an uneasy, respectful hush. The leading shade reaches out a translucent hand and presses a cold token straight into your palm, then fades back into the shelving. You pocket the keepsake. A faint tremor runs against your fingers. You leave with a solid mark of their grudging truce.

nodes.title: Weight of the Past
nodes.brief: You hold your ground as the spectral crowd surges forward, securing a heavy brass paperweight that anchors your thoughts.
nodes.page:
Several bronze card-drawers slide outward from the nearby stack-ends of their own accord, dropping iron paperweights onto the flagstones around your boots. You hold your ground. Metal clatters past your shins while phantom onlookers watch from the gloom. Amid the settling dust your fingers close on the coolest paperweight of the lot, its surface engraved with obsolete cataloguing runes. The metal sits solid against your palm as the surrounding shelves give a slow, settling groan.

The murmur of the marginalia softens into a respectful hush. You slip the bronze object into your deep coat pocket, and its mass anchors you against the shifting draft.

nodes.title: The Iron Scriptorium
nodes.brief: You hold your ground as the spectral crowd surges forward, securing a heavy brass paperweight that anchors your thoughts.
nodes.page: A sudden lateral shift of the towering bookshelves threatens to crush your arms against the adjacent rows of leather-bound volumes. You wedge your shoulder against the moving timber, pitting your willpower against the mechanical grinding of the ancient stack-gears. The wood groans in protest, splintering slightly beneath your coat as the gap narrows to a razor-thin margin of safety. Sweat beads on your forehead in the stale, lamp-lit air, but you refuse to let the collapsing aisle trap you between its unyielding pages.

nodes.title: Crushed Margins
nodes.brief: You hold your ground as the spectral crowd surges forward, securing a heavy brass paperweight that anchors your thoughts.
nodes.page: The massive oak shelves shift too violently for you to hold back, pinning your arm painfully against a protruding bracket of cast iron. You grit your teeth as a sharp edge slices through your sleeve, drawing a thin line of blood down your forearm before the grinding machinery finally grinds to a halt. The cost is steep: precious minutes lost to the squeezing darkness, and a stinging red scratch that will leave a pale scar on your skin. You wrench your arm free with a harsh intake of breath, clutching the bruised limb as the dusty air fills with the smell of crushed leather and spilled ink.

exits.label: Limp away from the biting shelf

nodes.title: Unbroken Resolve
nodes.brief: You hold your ground as the spectral crowd surges forward, securing a heavy brass paperweight that anchors your thoughts.
nodes.page: Your shoulder heaves the oak timber back into alignment just before the gap seals forever. The mechanism clicks into a secure lock, leaving you standing safely in the center of a newly widened aisle smelling of old lamp-oil and dried parchment. As you catch your breath, a faint voice from the margins whispers a strange, urgent plea directly into your ear, begging you to find a way to let the dead readers finally speak aloud when the Hundredth Door opens. You pocket this secret request alongside a small brass bookmark dropped by the grateful spirit.

nodes.title: The Threshold of Letters
nodes.brief: Ahead lies the threshold of the Last Reader's cell, guarded by an intricate puzzle door made of sliding wooden letters.
nodes.page: Beyond the final colonnade of the deep annexe stands the wooden threshold of the Last Reader's cell, blocked by a puzzle of sliding brass letters. The characters carved into its surface constantly crawl and rearrange themselves across the oak paneling, spelling out shifting aphorisms and dead languages that mock your haste. Lamp-oil burns low in your hand, casting long, jittery shadows against the grain of the door as you study the chaotic shifting of the alphabet. Somewhere behind this labyrinthine barrier sits the ancient scholar who remembers everything, holding the answers to Thessaly's disappearance and the opening of the vault. You must decipher the moving puzzle before the shifting letters lock you out for good.

nodes.title: The Labyrinthine Lintel
nodes.brief: The Labyrinthine Lintel: You face a massive wooden portal whose face continually rearranges its alphabet to bar entry.
nodes.page: Oak beams groan against your weight as you confront the massive wooden portal whose face continually rearranges its alphabet to bar entry. Brass letters slide and click across the grain like frantic beetles, and the words they form dissolve into dust before your eyes. Lamp-oil drips from a sconce. Burnt tallow and ancient pine scent the chill air. To your left, a narrow service ladder winds upward into the gloom where the marginalia murmur in the shadows. Straight ahead the shifting lintel pulses. It tugs at your thoughts and dares you to decipher its moving cipher while every plank under your boots picks up the distant pressure of the Long Closing, and haste matters before the deep stacks seal themselves for a generation.

exits.label: Force a path through the grain

nodes.title: Shifting Brass Letters
nodes.brief: You conquer the shifting linguistic puzzle through sheer mental endurance, unlocking a chamber containing a luminous reading prism.
nodes.page: Cold brass bites your fingertips as you press the shifting wooden tiles of the portal and work the linguistic puzzle past its stubborn turns. The carved alphabet reshuffles into mocking warnings, each phrase taking a fresh slice of attention while paper-dust floats in the air. You slow your breath and shut out the frantic whispers of forgotten scholars that leak from the floorboards. Piece by piece you guide the components into line. The mechanism hesitates, then stills. A narrow gap opens at the panel's center and shows a dim vaulted alcove where a single object rests on a velvet cushion.

nodes.title: The Luminous Prism
nodes.brief: You conquer the shifting linguistic puzzle through sheer mental endurance, unlocking a chamber containing a luminous reading prism.
nodes.page: Pale light spills from the small chamber beyond the puzzle-door and lights dust motes that drift in the stagnant air of the deep annexe. On a scarred mahogany pedestal sits a reading prism that catches every stray flicker of your oil lamp and breaks it into sharp violet beams. The glass cools against your skin. You lift the instrument from its velvet rest. It sits solid in your palm and throws violet light across the unread manuscripts piled on the floor. Your boots sound on the flagstones. Distant shelves grind somewhere beyond the wall as you turn the prism once in your hand.

nodes.title: Testing the Mind
nodes.brief: You conquer the shifting linguistic puzzle through sheer mental endurance, unlocking a chamber containing a luminous reading prism.
nodes.page: Sudden pressure tightens behind your temples as the prism draws upon your inner reserves, threatening to overwhelm your focus with a flood of ancient memories that do not belong to you. Images of forgotten catastrophes and long-dead cataloguers flicker behind your eyelids, dragging your concentration toward the edge of panic. You grit your teeth against the psychic tide, marshaling every ounce of stubborn resolve you possess to keep your footing on the slick stone floor. The glass grows burning hot in your grip, demanding absolute mental surrender before it will yield its secrets to a junior page.

nodes.title: Strain and Stumble
nodes.brief: You conquer the shifting linguistic puzzle through sheer mental endurance, unlocking a chamber containing a luminous reading prism.
nodes.page: Pain flares through your skull as the mental backlash throws you backward against a stack of discarded ledgers and scatters yellowed leaves across the damp floor. Your ears ring. A thin line of blood traces a slow path from your nostril down to your lip. You gasp for breath in the ink-scented gloom, drag yourself up by the edge of a shelf, and clutch your head. The prism settles into a dull sullen glow on the flagstones beside you, its demand quieted for the moment. You pick it up with a bruised shoulder.

nodes.title: Prism of Clarity
nodes.brief: You conquer the shifting linguistic puzzle through sheer mental endurance, unlocking a chamber containing a luminous reading prism.
nodes.page: Cool glass rests in your palm, and its violet beams cut a clean path through the clinging shadows of the deep annexe. Whatever resistance the object offered has gone; it now answers your grip and sharpens what you can make out in the gloom. You slip the instrument into your canvas satchel and leave the alcove behind. Ahead the corridor opens toward the heart of the archives. The air cools. Stone underfoot turns slick.

nodes.title: Stubborn Focus
nodes.brief: You push past the psychic resistance of the locking mechanism with stubborn focus, acquiring an ivory letter-opener.
nodes.page: Fingers curled tight around your lamp, you press your shoulder firmly against the oak of the portal and trust stubborn endurance to break the psychic barrier. The wood pushes back with an unnatural resistance. Tremors run up your arm, and your mouth fills with the dry taste of old paper-dust. You lean harder into the grain, past the warning creaks of the floorboards and the frantic rustle of unseen pages turning in the dark. Slowly, grudgingly, the mechanism yields an inch. A narrow sliver of cold air escapes from the chamber beyond. Your boots find purchase on the uneven stone as you wedge yourself further into the widening gap.

nodes.title: Resisting the Lock
nodes.brief: You push past the psychic resistance of the locking mechanism with stubborn focus, acquiring an ivory letter-opener.
nodes.page: A sudden surge of psychic cold rushes through the crack in the door, trying to freeze your thoughts and drive you back into the echoing corridors of the stack. You dig your heels into the mortar between the flagstones, clenching your jaw until your teeth ache with the strain. The whole archive seems to lean on your shoulders as you fight to keep the timbers from snapping shut again. The locking mechanism chatters furiously like a nest of mechanical teeth, demanding absolute mental dominance before it will grant passage.

nodes.title: Bitter Resistance
nodes.brief: You push past the psychic resistance of the locking mechanism with stubborn focus, acquiring an ivory letter-opener.
nodes.page: A sharp fracture of pain shoots through your shoulder as the door snaps back a fraction before you finally force it wide, leaving a deep bruise along your arm. You stagger forward into the dusty interior, catching yourself against a lectern with a sharp intake of breath. The air inside tastes of stale lamp-oil and scorched leather, thick with the residue of broken spells that linger in the stone. You press a hand to your throbbing arm, feeling the heat of the strain settle into muscle and bone as you survey the shadowy chamber. Whatever lies ahead must be faced with a fresh ache in your limbs and a deeper respect for the archive's defences.

nodes.title: Ivory Edge
nodes.brief: You push past the psychic resistance of the locking mechanism with stubborn focus, acquiring an ivory letter-opener.
nodes.page: Smooth and cold against your palm, an ancient ivory letter-opener rests on a small reading desk just inside the threshold, left by some long-forgotten scholar. Its surface carries etched marginal notes that shift under your thumb, spelling brief cryptic warnings about the halls ahead. You slip the slender tool into a pocket for the solid density of the blade. The door swings shut behind you with a muffled thud. Sounds from the outer stacks cut off. You stand alone among the last reader's chairs and empty lamps.

nodes.title: The Sliding Tiles
nodes.brief: You dance your fingers across the sliding wooden tiles to match the rhythm of the door, securing a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Dust hangs in the beam of your pocket-lamp and lights a panel of wooden sliders embedded in the doorframe. Each tile bears a faded letter carved by an anonymous hand centuries ago, shifting lazily under the weight of hidden springs. You trace the rhythm of the clicks echoing from deep within the mechanism, tapping your fingers against the grain to find the counter-pulse. The device yields with a soft, oiled slide, exposing a shallow cavity where a slender length of cold iron rests. You reach out your hand to lift the master skeleton key before the tiles snap back into disorder.

exits.label: Slide the key from its recess

nodes.title: Matching The Cadence
nodes.brief: You dance your fingers across the sliding wooden tiles to match the rhythm of the door, securing a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Cold air breathes across your knuckles as the wooden tiles begin to accelerate their chaotic dance, threatening to jam the internal mechanism permanently. You must mirror their frantic cadence with absolute physical precision, letting your fingertips skim the moving grain without missing a single beat of the hidden tumbler's song. The slightest hesitation will catch your skin in the snapping grooves, sealing the vault forever. You freeze your wrist, hold your breath, and plunge your fingers into the shifting maze of letters.

nodes.title: Caught In The Grain
nodes.brief: You dance your fingers across the sliding wooden tiles to match the rhythm of the door, securing a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: A dry snap echoes through the passage as a stubborn wooden tile catches your thumb, pinning it hard against the brass lining of the frame. You wrench your hand back with a sharp intake of breath, leaving behind a smear of dark blood and a deep, throbbing purple bruise across your knuckles. The mechanism chatters angrily, resetting its tumblers while you nurse your injured hand in the gloom. Time slips away in the dust as you wait for the swelling to subside, your fingers stiff and aching in the damp air.

exits.label: Retrieve the key through sheer grit

nodes.title: The Iron Master Key
nodes.brief: You dance your fingers across the sliding wooden tiles to match the rhythm of the door, securing a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Light catches the dull grey sheen of the long iron shaft resting in the velvet-lined groove, untouched by the rust that consumes the rest of the Annexe. Whether through flawless dexterity or sheer stubborn endurance against the pinching wood, your fingers close around the cold metal without triggering the trap. You lift the implement clear of its bed, feeling the balanced weight of centuries of custodial authority resting in your palm. It is a tool designed to bypass any barrier forged within these stacks.

nodes.title: Timing The Portal Gap
nodes.brief: You move in sync with the mechanical shifting of the portal to slip through its gap, retrieving a spool of stout binding thread.
nodes.page: Oak beams grind against one another in the threshold and open a narrow vertical fissure onto absolute darkness beyond. The gap pulses. It breathes in and out like the gills of some buried leviathan of paper and binding glue, and you watch for the heartbeat when the opening reaches its widest span. On a brass bracket just inside the moving boundary rests a neat spool of stout binding thread.

nodes.title: Threading The Narrow Gap
nodes.brief: You move in sync with the mechanical shifting of the portal to slip through its gap, retrieving a spool of stout binding thread.
nodes.page: The heavy timber frame surges inward unexpectedly, narrowing the passage to a sliver of breathable air and dark stone. You must thread your body through the moving gap with absolute lightness, avoiding the crushing pinch of the closing jamb while your hand darts inward to snatch the prize. A fraction of a second too slow will leave you trapped between two centuries of compressed oak. You tighten your core, dip your shoulder, and launch yourself into the tightening aperture.

nodes.title: The Toll Of The Jam
nodes.brief: You move in sync with the mechanical shifting of the portal to slip through its gap, retrieving a spool of stout binding thread.
nodes.page: A wooden edge clips your shoulder with bone-numbing force as the portal snaps shut a fraction too soon, tearing your coat and raising a jagged welt across your back. You stumble backward onto the cold flagstones, gasping for breath while the spool of thread rolls haphazardly against your boot. The bruising ache settles deep into your muscle, reminding you sharply of the library's absolute indifference to trespassers. You pick yourself up from the dust, rubbing the sore spot through the torn wool.

exits.label: Gather the thread and press onward

nodes.title: The Spool Of Hemp
nodes.brief: You move in sync with the mechanical shifting of the portal to slip through its gap, retrieving a spool of stout binding thread.
nodes.page: Smooth flaxen hemp wound tight around a bone bobbin comes away in your palm, smelling faintly of tallow and old bookbinder's paste from some older repair. The prize is yours. This stout binding thread has been treated to resist rot and mildew, and it is strong enough to hold together the crumbling spine of an entire ledger. You coil the spool beside your other gear.

exits.label: Step back to the labyrinthine lintel

nodes.grant: A spool of stout binding thread

nodes.title: Roots Of The Lock
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: Carved into the lintel above the barrier are three archaic glyphs that predate the common registry by several centuries. You trace their awkward angles with the tip of your pen-knife, muttering the ancient etymologies under your breath as you untangle the shifting linguistic roots. The door listens to the grammar of the dead, its heavy iron bolts shuddering as the syntax resolves itself into a coherent command. The timber parts with a long, groaning sigh, granting access to a small leather-bound volume resting on a lectern within.

exits.label: Collect the dictionary of dead terms

nodes.title: The Dead Lexicon
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: Pale green phosphorescence clings to the margins of the open pages, illuminating definitions of words that haven't been spoken aloud since the city above was built upon marshland. You turn the brittle leaves with infinite care, absorbing the forgotten vocabulary that once governed the deep sorting rooms. Armed with these archaic idioms, you can command doors and shelves that recognize no modern authority. You tuck the slim volume securely beneath your arm and prepare for the next leg of your journey.

exits.label: Advance into the deep annex corridors

nodes.title: Deciphering The Dead Glyphs
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: The letters carved into the locking beam twist into an unfamiliar dialect, shifting their vowels every time your eye tries to pin down their meaning. You must apply every ounce of your scholarly training to unpick the grammatical structure before the words dissolve back into meaningless scratches. A single misreading of a tense or a prefix will lock the mechanism permanently, turning the doorway into solid masonry. You squint through the dim lamp-light, scanning the syntax for the hidden root.

nodes.title: A Faulty Translation
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: A harsh grating sound reverberates through the stone as your mistranslation triggers a defensive linguistic trap in the frame. The glyphs flash a brilliant, blinding white before burning themselves out into charred ash, filling the air with the acrid stench of scorched vellum. A pounding migraine blooms behind your temples, draining your focus and leaving you dizzy and disoriented in the gloom. You lean against the cold wall to steady your racing thoughts, nursing a sharp mental fatigue.

exits.label: Push past the burnt threshold anyway

nodes.title: The Definitive Glossary
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: The grammatical puzzle yields among the charred fragments. The timber partition swings wide. Inside, a small and perfectly preserved reference volume rests upon a velvet cushion. You pick up the definitive dictionary of dead terms, and its pages hold a dormant etymological charge you can feel through the boards. It is an invaluable key to the lost dialects spoken by the earliest cataloguers of the Underlibrary.

exits.label: Return to the shifting wooden lintel

nodes.grant: A definitive dictionary of dead terms

nodes.title: The Inner Sanctum
nodes.brief: You enter the silent inner sanctum where the Last Reader sits among mountains of unread manuscripts.
nodes.page: Velvet drapes part without a whisper as you step into the innermost recess of the Deep Annexe. Here, the air smells intensely of dried rosemary, lamp-oil, and centuries of undisturbed vellum. Mountains of unread manuscripts rise like jagged cliffs around a central wicker chair, where the faint rustle of turning parchment is the only sound breaking the ancient hush.

exits.label: Approach the silent scholar with caution

nodes.title: The Blind Scholar
nodes.brief: The Sanctum of the Last Reader: You stand before the ancient, blind scholar who has memorized every word ever written in Quillon.
nodes.page: Shadows stretch across the floorboards as you stand before the blind sage of Quillon, whose milky eyes gaze sightlessly into the dark folds of history. Every word ever written in the city seems etched into the lines of that weathered face. Unread scrolls whisper from every corner of the chamber, tempting you to probe deeper into the mysteries of the Index or seek a way forward before the deep stacks seal shut for good.

exits.label: Step softly to gain restoration oil
Follow the trembling finger toward the vault

nodes.title: Words of Iron
nodes.brief: You outlast the scholar's grueling interrogation through sheer willpower, securing a personal letter of introduction to the vault guardian.
nodes.page: Hours blur into a single, grinding test of endurance as relentless questions strike at the core of your training at the Returns Desk. The old scholar tests every ounce of your resolve, demanding proof that a humble junior page understands the heavy price of forgotten history. You keep your voice steady, parrying linguistic traps and subtle trickery with stubborn persistence while the shadows lengthen across the ink-stained floorboards.

nodes.title: The Weight of Proof
nodes.brief: You outlast the scholar's grueling interrogation through sheer willpower, securing a personal letter of introduction to the vault guardian.
nodes.page: Sweat beads on your forehead as the interrogation intensifies, shifting from dry library procedure to probing inquiries about Thessaly Marr's disappearance. Every reply must be weighed carefully against the unspoken rules of the Cataloguers and the raw loyalty of the Shelvers' Fellowship. You stand your ground, offering neither flattery nor evasion, matching the elder's stern scrutiny with your own unwavering dedication to the truth.

exits.label: Meet the final test of will

nodes.title: Facing the Inquisition
nodes.brief: You outlast the scholar's grueling interrogation through sheer willpower, securing a personal letter of introduction to the vault guardian.
nodes.page: Silence stretches tautly across the cluttered chamber as the blind scholar poses a final, harrowing question regarding the true ownership of the original Index. Your temples throb and your breath catches in your throat as you summon every reserve of mental fortitude, preparing to force an answer past lips that feel suddenly dry as parchment.

nodes.title: A Costly Resolution
nodes.brief: You outlast the scholar's grueling interrogation through sheer willpower, securing a personal letter of introduction to the vault guardian.
nodes.page: Mental exhaustion fractures your focus, and a sharp, blinding headache leaves you leaning heavily against a towering stack of manuscripts that cascades down in a rustling avalanche. You pay for your survival with a splitting migraine and hours of lost time, your fingers bruised from clutching the edge of the wicker chair. The blind scholar offers no sympathy, only a dry nod as you recover your breath and limp onward.

nodes.title: The Vault Introduction
nodes.brief: You outlast the scholar's grueling interrogation through sheer willpower, securing a personal letter of introduction to the vault guardian.
nodes.page: Through sheer stubborn endurance of mind, you weather the old scholar's relentless cross-examination until the harsh lines of his weathered face soften into something resembling grudging respect. He reaches into the folds of his ink-stained woollen cloak and draws out a heavy parchment bearing his own wax seal. This personal letter of introduction grants you passage through the threshold guards of the vault guardian without further question.

nodes.title: The Scattered Glyphs
nodes.brief: You interpret the ancient, uncatalogued scrolls scattered around the chair with scholarly precision, winning a fragment of the original Index.
nodes.page: Loose leaves of vellum drift across the floor around the chair, covered in strange, erratic handwriting that belongs to no standard catalogue in Quillon. You kneel among the papers, brushing away dust to trace the unfamiliar syntax with the tip of your finger, searching for patterns hidden beneath layers of eccentric margin notes and faded ink.

nodes.title: Fragments of Memory
nodes.brief: You interpret the ancient, uncatalogued scrolls scattered around the chair with scholarly precision, winning a fragment of the original Index.
nodes.page:
Dust motes dance in the faint yellow glow of your guttering lamp as you smooth out the fragile, uncatalogued scrolls scattered across the flagstones near the chair. Every stroke of ink reveals forgotten syntax that your mind absorbs with careful precision, fitting ancient idioms together like dry kindling. Within the center of the brittle sheet lies a genuine slip of the original Index, its script burning with a quiet, pale luminance that smells faintly of dried lavender and old rain.

You fold the precious fragment securely into your inner pocket before turning your gaze deeper into the shadowed annexe.

nodes.title: Deciphering the Last Scroll
nodes.brief: You interpret the ancient, uncatalogued scrolls scattered around the chair with scholarly precision, winning a fragment of the original Index.
nodes.page: Under the velvet drapes of the annexe, silverfish and damp air have half-eaten the final uncatalogued scroll. You lean closer, bringing your lamp within a handspan of the crumbling vellum to parse the dense, archaic script before the fading ink flakes away into nothingness. Your fingers trace the margin notes while your mind races to reconcile conflicting grammatical roots against the encroaching silence of the stacks.

nodes.title: Faded Ink and Folly
nodes.brief: You interpret the ancient, uncatalogued scrolls scattered around the chair with scholarly precision, winning a fragment of the original Index.
nodes.page: A sudden misreading triggers a sharp bite from a defensive binding nearby, drawing a thin line of blood across your thumb and scattering your carefully sorted notes into the dark corners of the room. You bind the wound with a scrap of cloth, nursing a bruised ego and a lost hour of research, though the surviving fragments remain within your grasp.

nodes.title: The Index Fragment Secured
nodes.brief: You interpret the ancient, uncatalogued scrolls scattered around the chair with scholarly precision, winning a fragment of the original Index.
nodes.page: You pick at the brittle secrets in the ancient scrolls around the chair and put your training into every line. The complex syntax gives way at last and yields a genuine fragment of the original Index. The slip of paper jitters against your fingertips like a trapped bee, and on it rides a forgotten city's true name.

nodes.title: Oil and Elder
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: Dust hangs thick in the annexe, catching the faint amber glow of your pocket-lamp as you edge closer to the low wicker chair where the Last Reader sits. Every movement requires absolute precision, your boots brushing the stone floor with barely a whisper to avoid disturbing the towering, precarious columns of parchment that lean like drunken pillars all around. The old scholar breathes in slow, measured rhythms, eyes clouded and fixed on nothing. Reaching out your hand with infinite care, you lift a small, stoppered vial of thick restoration oil from the armrest before the fragile stacks can tremble or shift.

exits.label: Step carefully back into the shadows

nodes.title: The Oiled Hinge
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: Shadows flicker on the high stone walls as you pick your way through the narrow gap between leaning stacks of discarded treatises. Your fingers grip the small glass vial of restoration oil, the amber liquid cool against your palm. Dried lavender and stale lamp-oil sit on the tongue among these towering shelves. Ahead the corridor goes still, broken only by the faint ticking of a clockwork beetle somewhere behind the wainscot.

exits.label: Advance toward the distant reading desk

nodes.title: Tread of the Page
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: Balance hangs by a single thread as you step across a treacherous floor strewn with loose sheets of vellum and brittle index cards. Your boots must find the bare flags beneath the paper without disturbing a single corner, or the entire avalanche of historical error will cascade down upon you in the dark. You draw a slow, deep breath, steadying your weight over your lead foot while your eyes measure the inches between a sleeping volume of theology and a snapping codex.

check.label: Pick your way across the papers

nodes.title: Paper Cuts and Stumbles
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: A shift in the stack sends a leather-bound volume sliding across your path. It catches your ankle and drops you into a drift of loose leaves. Your lamp rattles on the flagstones and spills a thin circle of oil that flares once, then dies in the dust. Your shin is bruised. You rise with a palm scraped raw by jagged paper edges, and a small smear of blood marks an ancient treatise of forgotten laws.

exits.label: Gather your spilled belongings and stand

nodes.title: The Restorer's Gift
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: Silence settles back over the stacks as you regain your footing, your fingers brushing against the cool, smooth glass of the small vial you managed to secure despite the mishap. The restoration oil inside catches the dim lamp-light, gleaming like liquid amber meant for soothing stiff bindings or healing cracked parchment. With this quiet prize tucked safely into your pocket, the narrow aisle ahead opens up into the deeper reaches of the annexe where the air grows colder still.

exits.label: Proceed toward the central reading gallery

nodes.title: The Long Closing
nodes.brief: The Last Reader points a trembling finger toward the Hundredth Door as the deep stacks begin their final, rumbling closure.
nodes.page: A heavy tremor rolls through the foundations of the Underlibrary, shaking dust from the high rafters and setting every suspended lamp swinging in unison. Across the dim chamber, the Last Reader raises a trembling, ink-stained finger toward the far wall, where the iron-bound panels of the Hundredth Door begin to groan and part of their own accord. The deep stacks are sealing themselves for a generation, their internal mechanisms grinding together with the force of an oncoming tide. The air grows thin and electric as the original Index waits beyond the threshold, ready to be read.

nodes.title: Roots of Iron
nodes.brief: You analyze the root etymology of the locking word to force the door open, gaining a definitive dictionary of dead terms.
nodes.page: Etymologies twist and settle in your mind as you examine the carved lettering surrounding the stubborn brass keyhole. Every dead term holds a specific weight in the masonry, and tracing the ancient root reveals the exact grammatical lever needed to spring the rusted mechanism. A firm turn of your wrist sends the bolt home with a sound like a falling shelf, and the latch releases.

exits.label: Push open the heavy timber door

nodes.title: Dance of the Bindings
nodes.brief: You dance smoothly between the snapping edges of predatory reference books, retrieving a brass bookmark that repels aggressive ink.
nodes.page: From the dark shelves, reference folios snap their leather jaws and lunge as you dart past the mahogany reading tables. Your feet move with instinctive rhythm, ducking a flying dictionary of heraldry and spinning past a snapping volume of local ordinances. Amidst the flurry of snapping pages and fluttering markers, your fingers close around a cool piece of stamped brass resting on the ledge.

exits.label: Secure the brass bookmark and dash

nodes.title: The Ink-Repeller
nodes.brief: You dance smoothly between the snapping edges of predatory reference books, retrieving a brass bookmark that repels aggressive ink.
nodes.page: Black ink tracking across the floor hisses and draws back as you raise the brass bookmark before you like a shield. Its stamped edges gleam with an old, protective alloy that keeps the venomous liquids from staining your coat or shoes. The corridor ahead grows strangely quiet, the predatory books slinking back into their dark cubbies with sullen thuds.

nodes.title: Silence in the Court
nodes.brief: You trace the logical flaws in the crowd's central argument to win their collective silence, acquiring a transcribed marginal debate.
nodes.page: Murmurs swell among the gathered scholars until you step forward and point out the glaring logical fallacy in their central premise regarding the authorship of the lost catalogues. Your argument cuts through the noisy debate like a cold draft. The crowd blinks in sudden, embarrassed silence. In the wake of that pause, a student hands over a neatly transcribed scroll of the very arguments that won the day.

nodes.title: Static on the Temples
nodes.brief: You stand firm against the oppressive wave of historic static pressing on your temples, earning the protective counsel of a phantom scholar.
nodes.page:
Historic static presses at your temples like a trapped wasp and tries to knock your thoughts loose with every breath in the deep stacks. Heels dig into the carpet of damp rag-paper while the pressure climbs. A ghostly scholar steps from the margins of a hovering folio and speaks in dry tones, offering counsel on how to anchor your mind against unremembered centuries.

You take the counsel. The roar in your ears falls back, and you push deeper into the ancient annex.

nodes.title: Steps Among the Stacks
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page:
Careful balance guides your approach toward the fragile elder hunched over a desk of rotted deal, ensuring your boots make not a single whisper upon the loose paper sheets scattered across the stone floor. Every motion is deliberate, measured to avoid disturbing the towering stacks of vellum that threaten to cascade at a vibration. Your restraint is noted with a dry nod from the bent figure, who wordlessly reaches into the folds of a moth-eaten robe and extends a small, stoppered vial of amber restoration oil.

The glass feels cool and heavy against your palm as you slip it safely into your pocket, ready for whatever decay lies ahead.

nodes.title: Steps Among the Stacks
nodes.brief: You approach the fragile elder with delicate, measured steps that avoid disturbing a single paper stack, gaining a vial of restoration oil.
nodes.page: The bent elder presses the stoppered vial of amber restoration oil into your palm and closes your fingers over the cool glass with a dry nod. Moth-eaten robe folds fall back into place as he turns to his desk of rotted deal. You slip the vial into your pocket without a whisper of boots on the loose paper sheets, then leave the towering vellum stacks undisturbed behind you.

nodes.title: Static on the Temples
nodes.brief: You stand firm against the oppressive wave of historic static pressing on your temples, earning the protective counsel of a phantom scholar.
nodes.page: The phantom scholar beckons you past the hovering folio into a narrower aisle where damp rag-paper carpets the basalt. The roar that pressed your temples fades until you can hear the folio's rustle again. His dry counsel still sits in your ears as you plant each heel and follow him deeper into the annex stacks.

nodes.title: Threshold of the Hundredth
nodes.brief: You reach the threshold of the Hundredth Door, where the air smells of scorched leather and ozone, and the massive iron hinges groan as the final countdown to the Long Closing begins.
nodes.page: Scorched leather and stinging ozone hang thick in the dim air as you finally reach the threshold of the Hundredth Door at the heart of the annex. Massive iron hinges groan with a sound like grinding millstones, protesting against the centuries as the final countdown to the Long Closing begins its irreversible descent. The darkness beyond the lintel seems to breathe, curling outward with the scent of old ink and forbidden histories, waiting for someone to cross the line.

nodes.title: The Threshold Arch
nodes.brief: The Threshold Arch: The lintel is choked with iron chains and heavy padlocks left by the Cataloguers, requiring steady hands and iron resolve to clear a path.
nodes.page: The stone lintel above is thoroughly choked with rusted iron chains and thick padlocks left by generations of cautious Cataloguers. Clearing a viable path forward asks for careful hands and an unyielding will against the lingering curses still bound into the old metalwork around the gateway. A freezing draft slides through. One padlock hangs askew on the leftmost chain.

nodes.title: Prying the Rusted Iron
nodes.brief: You pry at a rusted padlock while whispers from the iron discourage your heart, testing your resolve, and you secure a heavy brass lever if you master the dread.
nodes.page:
Cold metal flakes away under your fingernails as you pry desperately at the ancient padlock, while thin, spiteful whispers coil from the iron to discourage your tired heart. You wrench the rusted shackle with both wrists and force it open, reaching for the brass lever waiting just beyond the obstruction.

The mechanism gives a sharp, protesting click as the last barrier yields to your persistence, leaving the lever ready for your grasp if you can master the dread still prickling at the back of your neck.

nodes.title: The Iron Will Test
nodes.brief: You pry at a rusted padlock while whispers from the iron discourage your heart, testing your resolve, and you secure a heavy brass lever if you master the dread.
nodes.page:
Whispers from the ancient padlock grow into a chorus of doubt inside your skull, sapping the warmth from your fingers as you throw your weight against the rusted metal shackle. Every instinct warns you to let go and retreat into the familiar safety of the stacks, but you grit your teeth against the mounting pressure on your thoughts.

You must harden your spirit to overcome the dread before the iron locks fast again.

check.label: Master the dread within the iron

nodes.title: Yielding to the Dread
nodes.brief: You pry at a rusted padlock while whispers from the iron discourage your heart, testing your resolve, and you secure a heavy brass lever if you master the dread.
nodes.page:
The malicious whispers swell into a deafening roar of historic static, shattering your concentration and forcing you to stumble backward with a sharp gasp. A jagged edge of the rusted padlock catches your forearm, leaving a shallow, burning scratch that seeps a bead of dark ink-like blood. You clutch your arm against your ribs, catching your breath as the oppressive weight of the door briefly pushes you away from the mechanism.

Though shaken and nursing a fresh sting, you pick yourself up from the cold floor, determined not to let the ancient metal defeat you entirely.

exits.label: Recover and try the latch again

nodes.title: Securing the Lever
nodes.brief: You pry at a rusted padlock while whispers from the iron discourage your heart, testing your resolve, and you secure a heavy brass lever if you master the dread.
nodes.page:
Resistance melts away as you master the creeping dread, your fingers finding the exact purchase needed to throw the heavy brass lever into its new alignment with a resounding thud. A deep shudder runs through the stonework beneath your boots as the ancient machinery acknowledges your success, however narrowly you managed to keep your footing against the psychological onslaught.

A tangible sense of accomplishment settles over you, accompanied by the acquisition of a solid tool for the trials ahead.

nodes.title: The Gilded Tumbler
nodes.brief: You trick the iron tumbler mechanism with a bent brass bookmark while guards watch from above, testing your cunning, and you gain a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Bronze lanterns swing from the vaulted ceiling above and throw fractured shadows across the stone balcony where the Cataloguer guards keep their silent watch. Below your perch, the lock-box ticks with dormant machinery, iron tumblers clicking softly in time with ink dripping from wells on the floor above. You draw a thin notched strip of brass from your sleeve even as chill rises from the bottomless stacks. Lamp-oil and parched vellum cut the air. You slide the makeshift tool into the darkened mechanism.

exits.label: Slip the bookmark into the gears

nodes.title: Shadows on the Balcony
nodes.brief: You trick the iron tumbler mechanism with a bent brass bookmark while guards watch from above, testing your cunning, and you gain a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: High overhead, iron-shod boots pace against the flagstones, the rhythmic tramping sending tiny tremors through the masonry to rattle the loose card-drawers in the wall. You freeze against the cold plaster, waiting until the footsteps fade into the distance before easing back onto the narrow stone ledge. The lock-box before you offers no second chances, its stubborn brass plates sealed tight against unauthorized hands by ancient decrees. Your palm leaves a faint smudge of grease upon the rusted casing as you adjust your grip on the bent bookmark, ready to test the alignment of the inner wards.

exits.label: Feel for the hidden tumbler catch

nodes.title: The Cunning Twist
nodes.brief: You trick the iron tumbler mechanism with a bent brass bookmark while guards watch from above, testing your cunning, and you gain a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Sweat pricks at your brow as you angle the bent brass strip deeper into the throat of the iron mechanism, searching for the delicate resistance that separates a locked ward from an open vault. Above, a guard leans over the balustrade, the yellow glare of a tallow taper cutting through the gloom and sweeping dangerously close to your hiding place. You hold your breath, relying entirely on the sensitive slide of metal against metal in the absolute dark, applying a fraction more torque to the jury-rigged lever while every instinct screams to pull back.

check.label: Probe the lock with clever fingers

nodes.title: A Costly Slip
nodes.brief: You trick the iron tumbler mechanism with a bent brass bookmark while guards watch from above, testing your cunning, and you gain a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: Metal screams against metal as the brass bookmark snaps cleanly inside the mechanism, jams the tumblers, and throws you backward against the rough stone wall. A hot streak of pain flares across your knuckles where the jagged edge tears deep into the flesh. A dark crescent of blood smears the cold masonry. Above, a sharp shout cuts through the galleried arches, then the clatter of boots rushing toward the balcony. You scramble into the gloom of the stacks, bleeding hand pressed shut, bitter failure on your tongue.

nodes.title: The Master Key
nodes.brief: You trick the iron tumbler mechanism with a bent brass bookmark while guards watch from above, testing your cunning, and you gain a master skeleton key.
nodes.page: With a sudden satisfying click through the iron housing, the final tumbler gives way and the brass tongue slides into its groove. The mechanism yields. A slender cold-forged skeleton key falls directly into your open palm. The metal is dense and impossibly old, and it carries the faint imprint of every door it has ever unlocked within these stacks. You pocket the prize. Below you the ink rises in the corridors, and behind you the box sits silent and empty.

nodes.title: The Freezing Latch
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder against the shivering latch while magical cold drains your warmth, testing your resolve, and you earn an insulating wool shawl soaked in lamp-oil.
nodes.page: Frost feathers across the iron surface of the portal, spinning crystalline webs that speak of old winters locked away in the deep annexe. The air grows preternaturally cold, drawing the heat straight from your marrow and turning every exhalation into a thick cloud of white mist that clings to the ancient timber. You stare at the massive frosted latch, feeling the magical chill bite straight through your thin shelver's tunic, numbing your collarbones and stiffening the joints in your fingers. The silence here is absolute, broken only by the faint, rhythmic ticking of a clock buried deep within the masonry.

nodes.title: Gathering Resolve
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder against the shivering latch while magical cold drains your warmth, testing your resolve, and you earn an insulating wool shawl soaked in lamp-oil.
nodes.page: Bracing your boots against a crack in the flagstones, you reach out to grip the frozen iron, feeling the supernatural frost pierce your skin like a cluster of needles. Cold seeps into your shoulders and locks your muscles rigid before you can throw the bolt. Around you, the marginal notes scrawled across the nearby stone walls murmur anxious warnings, their faded ink shivering in the draft. You force your trembling fingers to close tighter around the frosted metal, refusing to yield an inch to the creeping numbness.

nodes.title: The Iron Weight
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder against the shivering latch while magical cold drains your warmth, testing your resolve, and you earn an insulating wool shawl soaked in lamp-oil.
nodes.page: Your entire body shivers uncontrollably as the ambient temperature plunges below freezing, threatening to encase your limbs in rime and halt your progress for good. You throw your full weight against the shivering iron latch, muscles straining to their absolute limit as you pit your mortal stamina against the ancient, lingering frost of the vault. The cold bites deeper into your chest, numbing your lungs and clouding your thoughts with a heavy, soporific haze that tempts you to simply close your eyes and stop pushing.

check.label: Fight the magical frost with willpower

nodes.title: The Deep Chill
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder against the shivering latch while magical cold drains your warmth, testing your resolve, and you earn an insulating wool shawl soaked in lamp-oil.
nodes.page: The magical cold surges outward with brutal force, knocking the wind from your lungs and sending you sprawling backward onto the icy stones with a sharp gasp. A deep, aching numbness settles permanently into your left shoulder, an unwelcome souvenir of the encounter that will leave you stiff whenever the damp rises from the ink-rivers. You drag yourself upright, shivering violently as your teeth chatter in the gloom, and wrap your arms tight around your chest to preserve what little warmth remains in your body. There is no time to nurse the ache, for the stacks continue to shift around you in the dark.

nodes.title: The Oiled Shawl
nodes.brief: You brace your shoulder against the shivering latch while magical cold drains your warmth, testing your resolve, and you earn an insulating wool shawl soaked in lamp-oil.
nodes.page: The frost-locked latch takes a last heave until the frozen mechanism groans and gives way with a sharp crack of splintering ice. You stand on the threshold. Breathing stays ragged in the frozen air while your hand brushes an oil-soaked wool shawl draped over a discarded reading stand nearby. You wrap the pungent garment around your shoulders. The grease on the wool turns the cold aside.

nodes.title: The Greasy Beam
nodes.brief: You balance along a greasy beam above the bottomless ink-well to reach the bypass lever, testing your agility, and you recover a pouch of dry chalk for better footing.
nodes.page:
Thick lamp-oil slicks the iron timber stretched above the bottomless ink-well, catching the amber glow of your lantern in a greasy smear. Every breath tastes of soot and stagnant gall as you inch forward, toes curling over the cold rivet-heads. Reaching into a rotting canvas holster slung across your hip, your fingers brush against a leather pouch filled with dry chalk. You pull it free and coat your palms, restoring a thin margin of grip against the void.

The bypass lever glimmers just beyond a sagging junction of copper pipes, waiting for your hand.

nodes.title: Walking the Iron
nodes.brief: You balance along a greasy beam above the bottomless ink-well to reach the bypass lever, testing your agility, and you recover a pouch of dry chalk for better footing.
nodes.page: Frost glazes the narrow beam above the roaring black gulf where old editions dissolve into ink-sludge. Your boots slip on a patch of rime, sending a shower of loose flakes tumbling down into the lightless depths where nothing echoes back. Throwing your weight backward to check the momentum, you slide an inch further along the greasy iron, arms windmilling to keep your balance against the draft from the deep flues. The bypass lever is inches away, its metal loop trembling under a sudden vibration.

nodes.title: Into the Sludge
nodes.brief: You balance along a greasy beam above the bottomless ink-well to reach the bypass lever, testing your agility, and you recover a pouch of dry chalk for better footing.
nodes.page: The rusty timber gives a treacherous lurch beneath your heel, plunging your boot into the sticky void and throwing you hard against a jagged bracket of shelving. Pain flares across your ribs as bruised bone strikes cold iron, while a priceless ledger slips from your pocket to vanish silently into the ink-well below. You cling desperately to the upright with raw, bleeding fingers, hauling yourself upward through the reek of ancient vinegar and ruined paper. Your breath comes in ragged gasps, but you manage to scramble back onto the narrow plate of the walkway.

nodes.title: Across the Span
nodes.brief: You balance along a greasy beam above the bottomless ink-well to reach the bypass lever, testing your agility, and you recover a pouch of dry chalk for better footing.
nodes.page: Slender iron rivets groan under your boots as you make the final crossing, however narrowly, keeping your weight centered over the narrowest spine of the girder. Your fingers close around the cold brass handle of the bypass lever, steadying your pulse against the rhythmic dripping of ink from the vault ceiling above. Tucked securely into your belt-loop now is a small pouch of dry chalk, its fine white dust smelling faintly of limestone and old schoolrooms. The mechanism clicks smoothly under your palm, granting you passage toward the threshold arch.

exits.label: Return to the heavy threshold arch

nodes.title: The Phantom Clerk
nodes.brief: You stare down the whispering phantom of a senior clerk guarding the seal, testing your resolve, and you acquire a stamped waiver bearing the Archivist's own seal.
nodes.page:
Translucent grey fingers grip the edges of a towering oak lectern while pale eyes glare from a face composed entirely of dried vellum and ink-stains. The phantom clerk blocks the seal. He mutters about overdue returns and improper ink usage, and the complaint carries hollow off the stone vault until it thins and dies. You produce the folded slip signed by Thessaly Marr. The chill from the apparition's cuffs bites, yet you keep the slip firm. A low sigh rattles through the empty hall as the spirit dips an invisible stamp into phantom red wax.

The document drops. It bears the unmistakable imprint of the Archivist's office.

nodes.title: Staring Down the Guard
nodes.brief: You stare down the whispering phantom of a senior clerk guarding the seal, testing your resolve, and you acquire a stamped waiver bearing the Archivist's own seal.
nodes.page: Cold blue light bleeds from the phantom clerk's spectacles, boring straight into your thoughts and dredging up every forgotten fine, misplaced folio, and reprimand from your days as a junior page. Your jaw tightens as the apparition grows taller, whispering names of dead scholars who failed this very test and turned to dust upon the flagstones. You lock your gaze onto the flickering ink-well pinned to the clerk's lapel, refusing to blink or yield an inch of ground against the mounting pressure in your temples. The quill pauses mid-air, trembling over the parchment seal.

nodes.title: Broken Resolve
nodes.brief: You stare down the whispering phantom of a senior clerk guarding the seal, testing your resolve, and you acquire a stamped waiver bearing the Archivist's own seal.
nodes.page: A surge of old authority breaks your focus and drives you to your knees as memories of reprimands flood your mind. The phantom clerk's voice rises in a triumphant screech that mocks your humble station among the shelvers. "An impossible toll in overdue stamps," it demands. You grit your teeth against the blinding headache and crawl forward through the freezing draft until your fingers graze the oak base of the lectern. The spirit yields an inch. You stay on the flagstones and catch your breath beside the wood.

nodes.title: The Official Stamp
nodes.brief: You stare down the whispering phantom of a senior clerk guarding the seal, testing your resolve, and you acquire a stamped waiver bearing the Archivist's own seal.
nodes.page: Through its barrage of ancient rules you stare down the spectral administrator until its rigid posture crumples into a sigh of reluctant surrender. The spirit stamps the requisition slip with a sharp thud that leaves a smear of crimson sealing-wax on the page. Tucked safely inside your tunic now is a stamped waiver bearing the Archivist's own seal, an official guarantee that grants you safe passage past the administrative wardens. The ghost fades to grey dust. The threshold arch stands clear ahead.

exits.label: Advance to the heavy threshold arch

nodes.title: The Hundredth Door
nodes.brief: The massive door swings inward on oiled pivots, revealing a vast, lightless circular vault where the original Index floats within a column of pure, shifting illumination.
nodes.page:
Iron bolts groan and slide back within the masonry, releasing centuries of trapped lamp-oil fumes as the portal swings inward on oiled pivots. A lightless circular vault spreads before you. Its domed ceiling is lost in shadow where hanging lanterns swing without a sound. At the center of the chamber floats the original Index, suspended within a column of pure shifting illumination that holds every remembered name, and tiny particles of gold leaf drift through the beam like dust motes in sunlight.

Ozone and vellum scent the room. Gold leaf settles on the flagstones at your feet.

nodes.title: The Outer Ring
nodes.brief: The Outer Ring: Shelves of obsidian hold chained ledgers that hiss and writhe in the shadows, waiting for someone bold enough to touch their leather spines.
nodes.page: Colossal shelves of black obsidian curve around the central light, packed with chained ledgers that hiss and writhe in the shadows like resting serpents. Every spine is bound in stamped calfskin, their gold lettering shifting and rearranging itself while you watch in the dim lamp-oil gloom. The floor beneath your boots is paved with inscribed slate tiles that click softly whenever a distant stack adjusts its position. Across the expanse, narrow bridges of twisted twine and iron wire lead toward darker recesses where various scholars and zealots have left their marks.

exits.label: Snatch the stray parchment from bindings
Endure the ancient insults of bound law
Watch the Burner zealots breach parapet

nodes.title: Blood Red Warning
nodes.brief: You decipher a warning scrawled in blood-red ink across a shifting folio, testing your erudition, and you learn the secret cipher to bypass the outer wards.
nodes.page:
Iron shelving shifts and grinds against the masonry, opening a narrow fissure in the wall where an ancient folio hangs by threads of dried gum. Its pages flutter in a draft that smells of stale lamp-oil and copper. A jagged warning covers the vellum in blood-red ink that still looks wet. You trace the syntax and know the archaic dialect of the early Cataloguers who first mapped these vaults. The characters rearrange as you watch. They will dissolve into blotches unless you fix the precise sequence in memory.

You step closer to the trembling folio to take the cipher that unlocks the outer wards.

nodes.title: The Crimson Cipher
nodes.brief: You decipher a warning scrawled in blood-red ink across a shifting folio, testing your erudition, and you learn the secret cipher to bypass the outer wards.
nodes.page: You stare down at the shifting script. Your eyes burn from the fumes of old paper and copper-laced ink that rise from the binding. The folio writhes between your fingers. Its crimson characters mutate into deceptive traps meant to confuse the unwary scholar. Fragmented grammar has to be pieced together before the text loops backward into total illegibility and seals the corridor forever. Your mind races through centuries of marginal notes and forbidden lexical rules for the single hidden key that unlocks the ward. Air grows thin. Surrounding shelves close in on your position. You put every scrap of intellect on the blood-red riddle.

nodes.title: Ink Stained Failure
nodes.brief: You decipher a warning scrawled in blood-red ink across a shifting folio, testing your erudition, and you learn the secret cipher to bypass the outer wards.
nodes.page: A sudden spasm in the folio's spine sends a thick spray of crimson ink directly into your eyes, and a searing, bitter heat blinds you. You stumble backward against an iron upright. Your lamp drops as the metal casing cracks against the stone floor and spills its precious oil. The warning scrawl mocks you from the shelf. Its letters rearrange themselves into mocking shapes while your vision clears through a haze of tears. You press a sleeve to your smarting face and swallow the bitter taste of iron and soot that lingers in your throat. Pride takes a hard knock, and your hands are permanently stained with a rust-coloured dye, but you pick yourself up and press onward into the gloom.

nodes.title: The Ward Unlocked
nodes.brief: You decipher a warning scrawled in blood-red ink across a shifting folio, testing your erudition, and you learn the secret cipher to bypass the outer wards.
nodes.page: Your finger traces the final hidden syllable of the crimson text past the snapping edges of the folio. The iron ward lets out a long, metallic sigh. Ancient tumblers click into place as the barrier slides into the masonry. A hush falls over the alcove. A faint pulse of residual magic stays in the air. Pressed against the back of the binding is a small folded slip of paper that lists the forgotten administration codes of the early Underlibrary. You pocket the fragile slip before you turn back toward the main chamber.

nodes.title: The Flattering Ledger
nodes.brief: You flatter a self-important guardian ledger into opening its clasp, testing your cunning, and you receive a gold-plated nib that can alter official entries.
nodes.page:
Thick leather bindings groan and shift upon a high mahogany bracket, revealing a massive ledger whose golden clasps snap shut like iron jaws whenever a hand approaches. It fancies itself the sole arbiter of this corridor, preening beneath a coating of dust and old lamp-oil. You lean against the cold timber, adopting the courtly, deferential cadence common among senior scholars who wish to avoid a heavy fine. Whispering soft praises into its cracked spine, you stroke the dry leather until the metal fasteners loosen with a reluctant, shivering click. You ease the cover open just enough to slide your fingers inside the velvet-lined pocket.

Securing your prize, you prepare to leave the haughty volume behind.

nodes.title: Tongue Of Silk
nodes.brief: You flatter a self-important guardian ledger into opening its clasp, testing your cunning, and you receive a gold-plated nib that can alter official entries.
nodes.page: Whispering honeyed falsehoods into the ear of a towering, self-important ledger, you attempt to charm your way past its snapping brass clasps. The heavy volume bristles with indignation, its thick pages rustling like dry autumn leaves as it weighs every syllable of your elaborate flattery against its endless rulebook. One wrong word of modern or coarse phrasing will cause the iron covers to snap shut like a trap, crushing bone and parchment alike. You match its pompous rhythm with an equally affected cadence, coaxing the stubborn binding with practiced grace and smooth deception while sweat beads upon your forehead.

nodes.title: A Bitten Hand
nodes.brief: You flatter a self-important guardian ledger into opening its clasp, testing your cunning, and you receive a gold-plated nib that can alter official entries.
nodes.page: Catching a trace of insincerity in your cadence, the ledger snaps its brass clasps shut with the force of a falling portcullis. You jerk your hand back just in time, but the iron-edged cover clips your knuckles, drawing a bright line of blood that stains the dusty floorboards. The volume lets out a dry, rattling chuckle that echoes down the empty alcove, retreating into its shelf with an air of absolute triumph. Cursing under your breath, you bind your throbbing fingers with a strip of spare linen from your shelver's tunic. The wound aches fiercely, and the delay costs you precious minutes against the looming shadow of the Closing, but you refuse to let the book defeat you entirely.

nodes.title: The Golden Nib
nodes.brief: You flatter a self-important guardian ledger into opening its clasp, testing your cunning, and you receive a gold-plated nib that can alter official entries.
nodes.page: Smooth flattery soothes the ledger's vanity, and you coax the massive volume into parting with its most prized possession past its snapping brass teeth. The cover lifts on well-oiled hinges. Inside a small recessed compartment lined with faded velvet rests a slender gold-plated pen nib that shimmers with a faint iridescent glow beneath the amber light of your lamp. You lift the delicate instrument. Its balance is odd, and it holds the rare authority to alter official entries within the catalogue. You secure the nib inside your waistcoat pocket. You step away from the shelf.

nodes.title: The Stray Parchment
nodes.brief: You thread your fingers past snapping leather bindings to snatch a stray parchment, testing your agility, and you pocket a scrap of vellum inscribed with protective runes.
nodes.page:
Piles of discarded vellum drift across the stone floor like autumn leaves in an underground gale, and the surrounding stacks keep shifting them. Amid the fluttering debris, a single scrap of parchment catches the amber light of your lamp, and complex protective runes tick against your palm. Several leather bindings snap shut nearby, ready to shred any stray hand that lingers among the forgotten papers. You time your reach to the pulse under your boots and snatch the drifting prize before it vanishes into a dark fissure.

The vellum is safe. You prepare to move deeper into the annex.

nodes.title: Snatching The Runes
nodes.brief: You thread your fingers past snapping leather bindings to snatch a stray parchment, testing your agility, and you pocket a scrap of vellum inscribed with protective runes.
nodes.page: Leaning far out over a churning river of black ink, you measure the erratic distance between two violently shifting stacks of vellum. The scrap of parchment dances just beyond your fingertips, carried aloft by a sudden updraft of stale lamp-oil fumes and whispering drafts. Every muscle in your body coils tight as you prepare to spring across the gap, relying entirely on balance and split-second agility to avoid plunging into the dark, viscous fluid below. The leather bindings snap and writhe along the shelves like trapped serpents, snapping at your sleeves as you commit your weight to the air.

nodes.title: A Heavy Cost
nodes.brief: You thread your fingers past snapping leather bindings to snatch a stray parchment, testing your agility, and you pocket a scrap of vellum inscribed with protective runes.
nodes.page: A violent tremor shakes the stack just as your boots leave the stone, throwing your timing entirely off balance and sending you crashing sideways into a jagged oak upright. You manage to snatch the parchment from the air with your teeth, but your shoulder takes the brunt of the impact against the sharp timber, tearing your tunic and leaving a deep, purple bruise. The black ink-river below splashes upward, coating your boots and stockings in a foul-smelling sludge that burns your skin. Gasping for breath in the dust-choked air, you haul yourself back onto the narrow pathway. Though bruised and foully stained, you clutch the rune-inscribed vellum tightly in your fist as you limp forward.

nodes.title: The Runed Vellum
nodes.brief: You thread your fingers past snapping leather bindings to snatch a stray parchment, testing your agility, and you pocket a scrap of vellum inscribed with protective runes.
nodes.page: Your hand darts through the fluttering chaos. Fingers close around the drifting scrap of parchment past the snapping jaws of the leather bindings. The violent motion of the surrounding stacks dies at once as the protective runes upon the vellum flare with a brief light. You lift the prize. Geometric patterns in permanent ink shield the bearer from wandering curses. It is a rare safeguard, carved by some forgotten scholar who feared the final sealing of the library. You tuck the vellum inside your leather pouch.

nodes.title: The Ancient Rebuke
nodes.brief: You endure a barrage of ancient insults hurled by bound volumes of forgotten law, testing your resolve, and you secure an iron tongue-scraper of silence.
nodes.page:
Leather-bound folios clap shut on the stone like jaws and spit archaic insults about your parentage and the grease on your sleeves. Volumes of forgotten municipal law flutter past your ears with the sharpness of dry razor-blades, howling ancient curses that demand your immediate banishment into the ink-rivers. You grit your teeth against the rising tide of whispered vitriol, pressing your palms over your ears as the pages rustle in a furious crescendo. Amidst the fluttering storm of parchment, your fingers strike cold iron lodged between two defiant volumes.

Yanking the metal free from the biting bindings, you secure a tarnished iron tongue-scraper, its edge dulled by centuries of silencing malicious gossip.

nodes.title: Withstanding The Volume
nodes.brief: You endure a barrage of ancient insults hurled by bound volumes of forgotten law, testing your resolve, and you secure an iron tongue-scraper of silence.
nodes.page: Shouting volumes crowd the narrow ledge, their pages fanning out like wings of vellum to hurl a concentrated barrage of forgotten statutes and stinging calumny straight into your face. Every ancient penalty for unpaid fines and misplaced folios rings out with unnatural clarity, threatening to crack your focus and drive you backward into the dark abyss. You tighten your grip upon the stone edge and steel your mind against the relentless psychological assault, drawing deep breaths of lamp-oil and dust. Just as the leaden weight of their accusations threatens to shatter your resolve, you brace your boots to push forward into the howling press.

nodes.title: Silence And Scars
nodes.brief: You endure a barrage of ancient insults hurled by bound volumes of forgotten law, testing your resolve, and you secure an iron tongue-scraper of silence.
nodes.page: Words strike with the force of physical blows, leaving narrow, paper-thin gashes across your knuckles and wrists that weep thin lines of black ink instead of blood. The sheer volume of ancient venom overwhelms your defenses, driving you hard against a sharp oak pillar and bruising your ribs before you can force your way past the squabbling library. You limp away with a stinging cheek and a jagged tear in your coat sleeve, heavier by the burden of a fresh wound and the lingering hum of angry syllables trapped inside your ears. The vellum volumes snap their covers shut in triumph behind you, settling back into their slots as you catch your breath.

nodes.title: The Iron Silence
nodes.brief: You endure a barrage of ancient insults hurled by bound volumes of forgotten law, testing your resolve, and you secure an iron tongue-scraper of silence.
nodes.page: Biting leaves and screaming legalities fill the air as you push forward past snapping leather spines that nip at your heels. The flying insults beat against your leather coat like hail against a slate roof, yet your concentration remains intact as you carve a narrow path through the literary storm. Reaching into the flurry, your fingers close firmly around a cold iron piece wedged deeply between two rebellious folios, silencing their petty grievances with a single wrench. You slip the instrument into your pocket, and a peculiar absolute quiet settles over your bruised fingers.

nodes.title: Breaching The Lower Parapet
nodes.brief: Burner zealots breach the lower parapet with torches and heavy mallets, shouting that all memory must turn to ash so that humanity may begin anew without its burdens.
nodes.page: Wooden mallets pound the ancient limestone wall, and a concussive boom rattles dust from the high vaulted arches above. Shouts of crude zeal echo up the stairwells as Burner zealots drive heavy iron wedges into the mortar joints, their torches casting flickering orange smears across the endless ranks of classified ledgers. Smoke drifts through the aisles, smelling of burning buckram and rancid tallow, signaling the arrival of those who believe every word ever written must be purged to save mankind from its own history. The defending scholars scatter like autumn leaves, abandoning their ink-pots and brass stamps as the main gateway shatters inward under a final, coordinated blow of timber and iron.

nodes.title: The Scriptorium Bridge
nodes.brief: The Scriptorium Bridge: A narrow stone walkway spans a subterranean chasm of boiling black ink, now contested by desperate scholars and fanatic arsonists alike.
nodes.page: A narrow stone walkway spans a subterranean chasm of boiling black ink, now contested by desperate scholars and fanatic arsonists alike. Thick plumes of greasy smoke roll across the span, obscuring the far archways where the deep stacks begin their slow, mechanical shifting. To your left, a frantic librarian struggles to defend a stack of uncatalogued maps against a torch-waving zealot, while other paths beckon deeper into the labyrinth of rising alarms and falling masonry. Every route offers a desperate chance to alter the course of the impending closure before the heavy vault doors seal forever.

exits.label: Charge the fanatic with your iron
Lever the keystone to drop the arch
Mislead the squad into the dark abyss
Coordinate an escape with trapped scholars
